schemes.title: MGNREGA Job Card
schemes.department: Ministry of Rural Development — Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act
schemes.brief: The job card registers a rural household for guaranteed wage work. Every registered household can demand up to 100 days of unskilled manual work in a financial year, at the notified state wage, within 15 days of asking — and is owed an unemployment allowance if the work does not come.
schemes.benefit: 100 days of guaranteed wage work per household each year, paid at the notified state wage into the worker's bank account
eligibility: Household living in a rural area of the Gram Panchayat where it applies
Adult members aged 18 or above who are willing to do unskilled manual work
No income, caste or land condition — the right belongs to every rural household
One job card per household, listing all the adult members who want work
documents: Aadhaar cards of all the adult members to be listed
Passport-size photographs of those adult members — the Panchayat supplies them free if the household cannot
Proof of residence in the Gram Panchayat — ration card, voter ID or a Panchayat certificate
Bank or post-office passbook copy, since wages are paid only into an account
schemes.submitAt: Gram Panchayat office — the Panchayat Secretary or the Gram Rozgar Sevak; the Programme Officer at the Block office also accepts it

demoFields.label: Name of the Head of the Household
demoFields.hint: The household applies as one unit and the card is issued in this name, with every listed adult entitled to work under it.

demoFields.label: Father's / Husband's Name
demoFields.hint: Used to tell apart households with similar names in the same village.

demoFields.label: Village / Gram Panchayat / Block / District
demoFields.value: Salaiya / Salaiya GP / Ghansor Block / Seoni, Madhya Pradesh
demoFields.hint: All four, because work is allotted within 5 km of the village named here — beyond that distance you are owed an extra 10 per cent of the wage.

demoFields.label: Details of adult members willing to work (Sl. No., Name, Age, Sex, Relationship to head)
demoFields.value: 1. Budhram Singh Uikey, 41, M, Self; 2. Phoolwati Bai Uikey, 38, F, Wife; 3. Dinesh Uikey, 19, M, Son
demoFields.hint: List every adult who might want work, not only those working today. A name left off the card cannot demand work later without an amendment.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Numbers of the listed adult members
demoFields.hint: One against each name in the same order. Wages are paid through Aadhaar-based payment, so a missing number stops that member's wages.

demoFields.label: Category (SC / ST / OBC / General) and whether the household is a PMAY-G, land reform or small and marginal farmer beneficiary
demoFields.hint: Tick all that apply. These households get priority for individual-asset works such as a well, a cattle shed or land levelling on their own land.

demoFields.label: Ration Card Number / BPL status
demoFields.hint: Asked for identification only. MGNREGA has no poverty condition — a household above the poverty line is equally entitled to a job card.

demoFields.label: Bank / Post Office Account (bank, branch, account no., IFSC)
demoFields.value: Central Bank of India, Ghansor Branch, A/c 39876501234, IFSC CBIN0289876
demoFields.hint: Wages are paid only by bank or post-office transfer, never in cash. Give the account of the member who will work; a joint household account is also accepted.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: Work allotment and wage credit messages come here. One number for the whole household is enough.

demoFields.label: Photographs of the adult members applying
demoFields.value: 3 photographs enclosed — one for each listed adult
demoFields.hint: The photographs are pasted on the job card itself. If the household cannot afford them, the Panchayat must arrange them free of cost.

demoFields.label: Date and Signature / Thumb Impression of the Applicant
demoFields.hint: A thumb impression is fully valid. Write the date yourself, since the 15-day clock for issuing the card runs from it.

demoFields.label: Receipt of application (for office use — dated acknowledgement)
demoFields.value: Received on 22-09-2026, Regn. No. SAL/2026/0147 — Gram Rozgar Sevak, Salaiya GP (seal)
demoFields.hint: The Panchayat is bound to give you this dated receipt. It is the proof that fixes the 15-day deadline for the job card.

demoSteps: Ask the Gram Rozgar Sevak or the Panchayat Secretary for the registration application. A plain sheet of paper is legally enough — the Act says a household may apply orally or in writing — but the printed form, free at the Panchayat and downloadable from the NREGA site, keeps the office from raising objections.

Fill it in ink, listing every adult of the household who might ever want work, with age and Aadhaar number against each name. Adding a name later needs a separate amendment application, so be generous now.

Attach Aadhaar photocopies, the residence proof, the bank passbook copy and one photograph of each listed adult. If the household cannot pay for photographs, say so — the Panchayat is required to arrange them at its own cost.
Hand the application to the Gram Panchayat office. The Programme Officer at the Block office must also accept it if the Panchayat refuses, and so must the office on a Rozgar Diwas or in a Gram Sabha.
Demand a dated receipt with a registration number before you leave the counter. This receipt is the whole case: the 15-day limit for issuing the job card runs from the date written on it.

The Panchayat verifies the household — that it lives in the village and that the listed members are adults — usually within a week, and the job card must be issued free within 15 days of the application.

Collect the job card and check it at once: every listed adult's name, age and photograph, and blank pages for the work entries. Never let the Sarpanch, the Rozgar Sevak or a contractor keep your job card — holding a worker's card is an offence, and it is how false entries are made.

Applying for the card is not the same as asking for work. Give a separate written work demand for the days you want, at least 14 days' worth, and take a dated receipt for that too — work must start within 15 days or an unemployment allowance becomes payable.

Wages are due within 15 days of the closing of the muster roll, paid into the account, with compensation for delay beyond that. Check your entries against the muster roll displayed at the worksite and the records on the NREGA site.

If no card comes in 15 days, or the Panchayat refuses to accept the application, complain in writing to the Programme Officer at the Block, then to the District Programme Coordinator (the Collector), and use the toll-free helpline; an RTI application (Rs.10) on the status of the application usually moves the file.
schemes.helpline: 1800-111-555 (Ministry of Rural Development toll free); state MGNREGA helpline numbers are printed on the job card

schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
schemes.department: Ministry of Finance — Department of Financial Services
schemes.brief: A one-year life insurance cover, renewed every year, that pays the nominee on the death of the member from any cause. The premium is taken straight from the savings bank account by auto-debit once a year. The cover year runs from 1 June to 31 May, whichever month you join in.
schemes.benefit: Rs.2 lakh life cover for a premium of Rs.436 a year
eligibility: Age 18 to 50 years at the time of joining; the cover may be continued up to age 55
Holds a savings bank account, single or joint
Gives standing consent for the annual auto-debit of the premium
In good health, as declared on the form; a fresh member's claim other than by accident is not paid in the first 30 days
documents: Savings bank account number and the bank's own passbook or card
Aadhaar card, seeded with that bank account
Age proof, if the bank record does not carry the date of birth
Nominee's name, age and relationship; guardian's name if the nominee is a minor
schemes.submitAt: Your own bank branch — the branch that holds the savings account from which the premium is to be debited

demoFields.label: Name of the Bank and Branch
demoFields.hint: The branch holding the account the premium will come out of. The cover is tied to that one account.

demoFields.label: Savings Bank Account Number
demoFields.hint: Copy it digit by digit from the passbook. A wrong digit means the auto-debit fails and the cover never starts.

demoFields.label: Name of the Account Holder (in block letters)
demoFields.hint: Exactly as the bank holds it. The claim is settled against the bank's record, not against what you write here.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth / Age
demoFields.hint: You must be between 18 and 50 to join. Members already enrolled stay covered to 55.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: All twelve digits, the same Aadhaar that is seeded with this account.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number / Email
demoFields.hint: The annual renewal SMS and the auto-debit alert come here. Keep it current, or you will miss the warning when a renewal fails.

demoFields.label: Name of Nominee
demoFields.hint: The one person who will receive the Rs.2 lakh. Spell the name as it is on their own Aadhaar — the claim is paid into their account.

demoFields.label: Nominee's Age and Relationship with the Member
demoFields.hint: Both are needed. If the nominee is under 18 you must also name a guardian in the next box.

demoFields.label: Name of the Guardian (if the nominee is a minor)
demoFields.value: Not applicable — nominee is an adult
demoFields.hint: Fill only when the nominee is under 18, with the guardian's relationship to that child.

demoFields.label: Consent for auto-debit of premium
demoFields.value: I hereby give my consent to debit Rs.436 from my above savings bank account every year towards the premium under PMJJBY until I give written notice to stop.
demoFields.hint: This is the heart of the form. Without this consent the bank cannot collect the premium and there is no cover.

demoFields.label: Declaration of good health
demoFields.value: I declare that I am in good health and am not suffering from any of the conditions listed in the declaration.
demoFields.hint: Read the listed conditions before you sign. A false health declaration is the ground on which a claim is later repudiated.

demoFields.label: Place, Date and Signature / Thumb Impression of the Member
demoFields.hint: Sign the way you sign for the bank. A thumb impression needs the branch official's attestation beside it.

demoFields.label: Acknowledgement slip (tear-off portion at the bottom)
demoFields.value: To be filled and stamped by the branch: name of member, account number, date of receipt, branch seal
demoFields.hint: Do not leave the counter without this portion filled, stamped and handed back to you. It is your only proof that the bank received the consent.

demoSteps: Ask for the PMJJBY 'Consent-cum-Declaration Form' at the counter of the branch that holds your savings account. Every bank keeps it; it is a single page, free, and printable from the Jan Suraksha site in English, Hindi and the regional languages.

Check first that you are between 18 and 50 and that the account has Rs.436 sitting in it on the day of submission. The bank debits the premium as soon as it registers the enrolment, and an enrolment that fails for want of balance is simply dropped.
Fill the form in ink, copying the account number from the passbook digit by digit and writing the name exactly as the bank holds it.
Complete the nominee block with name, age and relationship, and add a guardian if the nominee is a minor. This single block decides who receives the Rs.2 lakh, so do not leave it for later.

Read the health declaration before signing it. If you already have one of the listed conditions, tell the branch officer — a claim can be repudiated years later on a declaration signed without reading.
Hand the form to the branch official yourself rather than to an agent, and sign the specimen where asked. No fee is payable beyond the Rs.436 premium; anyone asking for more is not entitled to it.
Demand the tear-off acknowledgement slip at the bottom of the form, filled in, stamped with the branch seal and signed. Keep it with the passbook — the family will need it to start a claim.

Watch the passbook for the Rs.436 debit within a few days, and for the SMS confirming enrolment. The certificate of insurance is then issued by the insurer through the bank, usually within two to four weeks; ask the branch for it if none arrives.

Remember the calendar: the cover runs from 1 June to 31 May and the premium is auto-debited each year in May. Keep the balance in the account through May, because one failed debit ends the cover, and rejoining later restarts the 30-day waiting period for non-accident death.

Tell the nominee where this paper is kept. On a death claim they take the death certificate, the acknowledgement slip and their own bank and Aadhaar details to the same branch; PMJJBY claims are normally settled within 30 days of a complete claim form.

schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
schemes.department: Ministry of Finance — Department of Financial Services
schemes.brief: A one-year accident insurance cover, renewed every year, that pays on accidental death or permanent disability. The premium is a rupee and a half a month, taken once a year by auto-debit from the savings bank account. The cover year runs from 1 June to 31 May.
schemes.benefit: Rs.2 lakh for accidental death or total permanent disability, Rs.1 lakh for partial permanent disability, at Rs.20 a year
eligibility: Age 18 to 70 years
Holds a savings bank account, single or joint
Gives standing consent for the annual auto-debit of the premium
One cover per person even if several accounts are held; the extra premium on a duplicate enrolment is forfeited
documents: Savings bank account number and passbook
Aadhaar card, seeded with that bank account
Age proof, if the bank record does not carry the date of birth
Nominee's name, age and relationship; guardian's name if the nominee is a minor
schemes.submitAt: Your own bank branch — the branch that holds the savings account from which the premium is to be debited

demoFields.label: Name of the Bank and Branch
demoFields.value: Union Bank of India, Aliganj Branch, Lucknow
demoFields.hint: The branch holding the account the Rs.20 will be debited from.

demoFields.label: Savings Bank Account Number
demoFields.hint: Copy it digit by digit from the passbook; a single wrong digit means the enrolment fails silently.

demoFields.label: Name of the Account Holder (in block letters)
demoFields.hint: Exactly as the bank holds the name. Claims are settled against the bank's record.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth / Age
demoFields.hint: You must be between 18 and 70. Unlike the life cover, there is no health declaration and no upper entry bar below 70.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: All twelve digits, the Aadhaar seeded with this account.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number / Email
demoFields.hint: The enrolment confirmation and each year's auto-debit alert come to this number.

demoFields.label: Name of Nominee
demoFields.hint: Spell it as on the nominee's own Aadhaar — the claim money is paid into their account.

demoFields.label: Nominee's Age and Relationship with the Member
demoFields.hint: Both are required. A nominee under 18 needs a guardian named in the next box.

demoFields.label: Name of the Guardian (if the nominee is a minor)
demoFields.value: Not applicable — nominee is an adult
demoFields.hint: Fill only for a minor nominee, with the guardian's relationship to the child.

demoFields.label: Consent for auto-debit of premium
demoFields.value: I hereby give my consent to debit Rs.20 from my above savings bank account every year towards the premium under PMSBY until I give written notice to stop.
demoFields.hint: The cover exists only because of this standing consent. Do not strike it out or alter the wording.

demoFields.label: Whether already covered under PMSBY through another account
demoFields.hint: Declare honestly. Two enrolments do not double the payout — only one cover operates and the second premium is lost.

demoFields.label: Place, Date and Signature / Thumb Impression of the Member
demoFields.hint: Sign as you sign for the bank. A thumb impression must be attested by the branch official beside it.

demoFields.label: Acknowledgement slip (tear-off portion at the bottom)
demoFields.value: To be filled and stamped by the branch: name of member, account number, date of receipt, branch seal
demoFields.hint: Insist on getting this portion back, filled and stamped. It is the family's proof of cover when a claim has to be filed in a hurry.

demoSteps: Ask at the counter of your own bank branch for the PMSBY 'Consent-cum-Declaration Form'. It is one page, free, kept by every bank, and printable from the Jan Suraksha site in English, Hindi and the regional languages.

Make sure the account has at least Rs.20 in it on the day you submit. The premium is debited as soon as the enrolment is registered, and an enrolment that fails for want of balance is dropped without any notice to you.
Fill the form in ink, copying the account number straight from the passbook and writing the name exactly as the bank holds it.
Complete the nominee block — name, age, relationship, and a guardian if the nominee is a minor. This is the only place the insurer learns who to pay.
If you already hold PMSBY through another bank account, say so on the form. Only one cover ever pays, and the premium on the second enrolment is simply forfeited.
Hand the form to the branch official across the counter. There is nothing to pay beyond the Rs.20 premium, and no medical examination and no health declaration are involved in this scheme.
Demand the tear-off acknowledgement at the foot of the form, filled in, stamped with the branch seal and signed, and keep it with the passbook.

Check the passbook for the Rs.20 debit and the confirmation SMS within a few days. The certificate of insurance comes from the insurer through the bank, usually inside two to four weeks — ask the branch if it does not.

Note the calendar: cover runs 1 June to 31 May with the auto-debit each May, so keep the balance in the account through that month. A failed debit ends the cover, and it restarts only from the date of a fresh enrolment.

Tell the family where the acknowledgement is kept. An accident claim has to be intimated to the bank within 30 days of the accident, with the FIR or post-mortem report for a death claim, or the doctor's disability certificate for a disability claim; settlement normally follows within 30 days of a complete claim.

schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY) Bank Account
schemes.department: Ministry of Finance — Department of Financial Services
schemes.brief: A basic savings account that any resident can open with no minimum balance and no charge. It comes with a RuPay debit card carrying free accident insurance, and after six months of satisfactory operation the branch may allow a small overdraft. It is also the account through which most government benefit transfers arrive.
schemes.benefit: Zero-balance account, free RuPay card with Rs.2 lakh accident cover, overdraft up to Rs.10,000
eligibility: Any resident individual aged 10 years or above
A minor aged 10 or above may operate the account with a guardian
One PMJDY account per person; an existing ordinary savings account can be converted instead
No income, caste or area condition of any kind
documents: Aadhaar card — by itself enough for full KYC at the branch
If no Aadhaar: voter ID, driving licence, PAN, passport or MGNREGA job card
If none of those either: a self-attested photograph plus the officer's signature opens a Small Account
One passport-size photograph
Mobile number for SMS alerts
schemes.submitAt: Any bank branch, or the Bank Mitra / Business Correspondent kiosk that serves your village or ward

demoFields.label: Name of the Bank and Branch
demoFields.value: State Bank of India, Dhanora Branch
demoFields.hint: Written by you at the top of the form. A Bank Mitra will tell you which branch the kiosk reports to.

demoFields.label: Name of the Applicant (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Letter for letter as on the Aadhaar card. A mismatch here blocks every future benefit transfer into the account.

demoFields.label: Father's / Spouse's / Mother's Name
demoFields.hint: Tick which one you are giving. It is used to tell apart account holders with the same name.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth
demoFields.hint: As on Aadhaar. An applicant aged 10 to 18 opens a minor account with a guardian.

demoFields.label: Gender / Marital Status
demoFields.hint: Tick the boxes. Women's accounts are counted separately for the overdraft priority.

demoFields.label: Address (as on Aadhaar) and Present Address if different
demoFields.value: Ward 3, Dhanora, Tehsil Chhindwara, Dist. Chhindwara, Madhya Pradesh – 480001
demoFields.hint: If you actually live elsewhere, fill the present address too — the passbook and card are posted there.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: All twelve digits. Aadhaar alone completes the KYC at the counter; nothing else is required.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: Give a number in your own possession. This is the number that will receive OTPs and every credit alert.

demoFields.label: Occupation and Annual Income
demoFields.hint: An honest rough figure. There is no minimum income to open the account.

demoFields.label: Category (SC / ST / OBC / Minority / General)
demoFields.hint: Tick one. It is collected for reporting only and changes nothing about the account.

demoFields.label: Do you already hold a bank account? If yes, give details
demoFields.hint: Answer truthfully. An existing savings account can simply be converted into a PMJDY account with the RuPay card, which is faster than opening a second one.

demoFields.label: Nominee: Name, Relationship, Date of Birth, Address
demoFields.value: Ramesh Shankar Chauhan — Husband — 22-07-1989 — same address
demoFields.hint: Never skip the nomination. Without it the family needs a succession certificate to claim the balance. Name a guardian if the nominee is a minor.

demoFields.label: RuPay Debit Card required (Yes / No)
demoFields.hint: Always tick Yes. The free accident cover of Rs.2 lakh rides on the RuPay card, and the card must be used at least once in the qualifying period for the cover to stay live.

demoFields.label: Signature / Thumb Impression of the Applicant, with date
demoFields.hint: The signature you put here becomes your specimen signature at the bank — sign the same way every time afterwards.

demoFields.label: Introducer's details (only for a Small Account without documents)
demoFields.hint: Needed only when you have no officially valid document. An existing account holder of the same branch, known to the bank, introduces you.

demoSteps: Collect the PMJDY account opening form free at any bank branch counter, or from the Bank Mitra kiosk in the village. The bilingual form is also downloadable from the PMJDY site in English and Hindi and can be printed at home.

Fill it in ink, in block letters, copying the name, date of birth and address exactly from the Aadhaar card. Paste one passport photograph in the box and sign across its corner if the form has a line running over it.

Fill the nominee block in full — name, relationship, date of birth and address. Bank staff often let this slide; insist on completing it, because without a nominee the family must produce a succession certificate to draw the balance.
Tick 'Yes' for the RuPay debit card. The Rs.2 lakh accident insurance is attached to that card, not to the account, and it lapses if the card is never used.

Carry the original Aadhaar and one photocopy to the branch. If you have no Aadhaar or any other valid document, say you want a 'Small Account' — the bank must open one on a self-attested photograph and the officer's signature, with limits on balance and withdrawals for twelve months.

Hand the form across the counter, sign the specimen signature card the officer gives you, and have the Aadhaar photocopy self-attested. Nobody may charge you anything — the account, the passbook and the RuPay card are all free.

Demand the account number in writing before you leave, along with the passbook, which the branch is required to hand over the same day. Ask for the customer ID too, and check that the mobile number printed on the acknowledgement is yours.

The account is usually live the same day, and the RuPay card either comes across the counter or reaches you by post within two to three weeks; the PIN comes separately. Activate the card at an ATM and make one small transaction so the accident cover stays in force.

If a branch refuses to open the account or asks for a deposit, quote the PMJDY zero-balance rule and ask for it in writing, then complain to the branch manager, and after that to the bank's Nodal Officer or the RBI Banking Ombudsman at cms.rbi.org.in.

schemes.title: Ration Card under the National Food Security Act
schemes.department: Department of Food & Public Distribution — state Food & Civil Supplies Department
schemes.brief: The ration card that entitles a household to subsidised foodgrain at the fair price shop under the National Food Security Act. It is issued by the state food and civil supplies department in two categories — Antyodaya (AAY) for the poorest households and Priority Household (PHH) for the rest of the covered population.
schemes.benefit: 5 kg foodgrain per person per month (35 kg per family for AAY households) from the fair price shop
eligibility: Household ordinarily resident in the state, not holding a ration card anywhere else in India
Household falls inside the state's NFSA coverage list — priority households, or Antyodaya for the poorest
Excluded if the household meets a state exclusion criterion, such as income tax payment, a four-wheeler or a government job
One card per household, with an adult woman of 18 or above as the head of the family
documents: Aadhaar cards of every family member
Proof of residence — electricity or water bill, rent agreement, or Panchayat or ward certificate
Surrender certificate or deletion certificate from the previous district or state, if the family has moved
Income certificate or self-declaration of annual income
Passport-size photograph of the head of the family
LPG consumer number and bank passbook copy, where the state form asks for them
schemes.submitAt: Taluka or tehsil supply office, or the District Food & Civil Supplies Office; in a city, the zonal or ward food office

demoSteps: Pick up the blank 'Application for New Ration Card' at the taluka or tehsil supply office, the district food and civil supplies office, or the city zonal food office. It is free, and it is also stocked at Common Service Centres and many fair price shops. The NFSA site links to each state's own form.
Fill it in ink, in block letters. Name a woman of 18 or above as the head of the family — that is a requirement of the Act, not a preference of the clerk.

List every member who eats from the same kitchen on the family table, with the exact Aadhaar number for each. The monthly entitlement is calculated per listed person, so one omitted name costs the household 5 kg every month.

Attach Aadhaar photocopies of all members, a residence proof, the income certificate or self-declaration, and one photograph of the head of the family. Self-attest every photocopy — sign across the face of each page.

If the family has moved from another district or state, get the surrender or deletion certificate from the old office and attach it. Without it the new card will be held back, since the system checks for duplicates nationwide.
Where the state form carries a verification block, get it signed and stamped by the ward member, the Sarpanch or the local revenue talathi or patwari before you submit.

Hand the file in at the taluka supply office counter and demand the acknowledgement slip with its application number and date. In most states you can also drop it at the Common Service Centre, which prints the same slip — keep it, since every follow-up runs on that number.

Expect a field verification visit within two to four weeks. Keep the original documents at home so the inspector can compare them; a household that is not found at home twice is marked 'not traceable' and the file closes.

The card is normally issued within 30 days of application — many states commit to that timeline under their Right to Public Services Act. Collect it at the supply office or the fair price shop, and check every member's name and age on it before leaving the counter.

If the 30 days pass with no card and no rejection, complain in writing to the District Supply Officer, and then to the state Food Commission or the district grievance redressal officer, both of which NFSA obliges each state to maintain.

Household is on the state's below-poverty-line (BPL) list
Not drawing another disability or social-security pension
documents: Disability certificate showing 80 per cent or more, issued by the Chief Medical Officer or a district medical board
UDID card, if one has been issued
Age proof — Aadhaar, birth certificate or school leaving certificate
BPL ration card, or the family's serial number on the BPL list
Aadhaar card photocopy
First page of the bank or post-office passbook
Two passport-size photographs

demoSteps: Get the disability certificate in hand before anything else. The Chief Medical Officer's board at the district hospital assesses free of charge on fixed weekly days — ask the hospital's disability desk for the day. The certificate must show 80 per cent or more for this pension.

Collect the blank NSAP disability pension form free from the Gram Panchayat clerk, the Block Development Office, the municipal ward office or a Common Service Centre; it can also be printed from the NSAP site.
Fill it in ink, in block letters, copying the nature of the disability, the percentage, the certificate number and its date word for word from the certificate.
Attach the disability certificate, the UDID card if issued, age proof, BPL ration card, Aadhaar photocopy, passbook first page and two photographs; paste one photograph on the form.
If the applicant cannot operate a bank account, get a guardianship certificate from the Local Level Committee under the National Trust first, and open the account with the guardian named on it.
Have the Sarpanch or Ward Member sign and stamp the verification block at the foot of the form, and check that the words 'person with severe disability' appear in it.
Submit the form at the Gram Panchayat office and ask for it to be listed in the next Gram Sabha, which approves the beneficiary list before the Block office sanctions.
Demand a dated acknowledgement with an inward number, or get your own acknowledgement line stamped on a photocopy of the form.

Sanction by the Block Development Officer normally takes 30 to 60 days, and the first credit commonly carries arrears from the sanction month. If nothing arrives in three months, send a written reminder quoting the inward number and then file an RTI application (Rs.10) with the BDO for the status of the file.

eligibility: Age 60 years or more on the date of application
Household is on the state's below-poverty-line (BPL) list
Not drawing a government service pension or another social-security pension
Indian citizen, resident of the village or ward where the form is submitted
documents: Age proof — Aadhaar, birth certificate, school leaving certificate or voter ID
BPL ration card, or the family's serial number on the BPL list
Aadhaar card photocopy
First page of the bank or post-office passbook (account in the applicant's own name)
Two passport-size photographs
Residence proof — voter ID, ration card or Panchayat certificate

demoFields.label: Name of the Applicant

demoFields.label: Category (SC / ST / OBC / General)

demoFields.label: BPL Family Identification No. / Ration Card No.

demoFields.value: L.T.I. of Shantabai P. Gaikwad, Kherwadi, 22-09-2026
demoFields.hint: If you cannot sign, a left thumb impression is fully valid. It has to be attested by the Sarpanch or any Gazetted Officer.

demoFields.label: Verification / Recommendation by Gram Panchayat (for office use)
demoFields.value: Certified that the applicant resides in this Gram Panchayat and belongs to a BPL family. — Sarpanch, Kherwadi Gram Panchayat (round seal)
demoFields.hint: Leave this block empty. The Sarpanch or Ward Member fills, signs and stamps it — never write in it yourself.

demoSteps: Ask the Gram Panchayat clerk for the blank NSAP old-age pension form (in a town, the municipal ward office or the Block Development Office). The form is free — nobody may charge for it. The same form is stocked at the Common Service Centre and can be printed on plain A4 from the NSAP site.

Fill it in ballpoint ink, in block letters, and in the language the office works in. Do not leave a box blank — write 'NIL' or 'Not applicable' instead, because a blank box lets the file be returned as incomplete.

Settle the age box first, since it decides the case: attach Aadhaar, or a birth or school-leaving certificate, or a voter ID. If no paper carries the year of birth, the Medical Officer at the Primary Health Centre can issue an age certificate free of charge.

Attach a photocopy of the BPL ration card, the first page of the passbook, the Aadhaar photocopy and two photographs. Paste one photograph on the form and clip the second one to it; sign across the pasted photo if the form has a signature line running over it.

Take the filled form to the Sarpanch or Ward Member to sign and stamp the verification block at the bottom. In a municipality the Ward Councillor or the Commissioner's clerk signs instead. This attestation is not optional — an unverified form is not put up to the Gram Sabha.

Hand the form in at the Gram Panchayat office and ask the clerk to list it in the next Gram Sabha agenda, because the Gram Sabha approves the beneficiary list before the Block office sanctions anything.

Demand a dated acknowledgement with an inward number written on it. If the clerk will not give one, put your own acknowledgement line on a photocopy of the form and have it stamped and signed there and then — that photocopy is your proof of the date.

The Gram Sabha resolution travels to the Block Development Officer, who sanctions the pension (in some states the Tehsildar or Sub-Divisional Officer signs). Expect 30 to 60 days; the first credit often carries arrears from the month of sanction.

If nothing has arrived in three months, file a written reminder at the Block office quoting the inward number, and follow it with an RTI application (Rs.10) to the BDO asking for the status of that application and the date of the sanction order.
schemes.helpline: Block Development Office; the district Social Welfare Officer's number is displayed on the Gram Panchayat notice board

Age proof of the applicant — Aadhaar, voter ID or school certificate

Aadhaar card photocopy
First page of the bank or post-office passbook in the widow's own name
Two passport-size photographs

demoSteps: Register the husband's death first if that was never done — the Registrar of Births and Deaths at the Panchayat or municipal office issues the certificate, and the whole pension file rests on it. Get two extra certified copies while you are there.

Collect the blank NSAP widow pension form free of charge from the Gram Panchayat clerk, the Block Development Office, the municipal ward office or a Common Service Centre; it can also be printed from the NSAP site on plain A4.

Fill it in ink, in block letters. Copy the husband's name, the date of death and the registration number letter by letter from the death certificate, because the verifying officer compares the two documents side by side.

Open a single-name savings account in the widow's own name if there is not one already, and seed it with Aadhaar at the branch. A joint account or the late husband's account will hold up the payment even after sanction.
Attach the death certificate, age proof, BPL ration card, Aadhaar photocopy, passbook first page and two photographs. Paste one photograph on the form and clip the other to the file.

Take the form to the Sarpanch, Mukhiya or Ward Member to sign and stamp the verification block, making sure the certificate states that she has not remarried — a verification without those words is sent back.
Submit it at the Gram Panchayat office and ask for the case to be placed before the next Gram Sabha, which approves the beneficiary list before the Block office acts on it.
Demand a dated acknowledgement carrying an inward number. Failing that, get your own acknowledgement line stamped and signed on a photocopy of the form and keep it safe.

Sanction by the Block Development Officer normally takes 30 to 60 days after the Gram Sabha approves the name, and the first credit usually includes arrears from the month of sanction. After three months of silence, send a written reminder quoting the inward number and then an RTI application (Rs.10) to the BDO.
schemes.helpline: Block Development Office; the district Social Welfare Officer's number is displayed on the Gram Panchayat notice board

schemes.title: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi
schemes.department: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
schemes.brief: Every land-holding farmer family gets Rs.6,000 a year from the central government, paid straight into the bank account. The money comes in three instalments of Rs.2,000, about four months apart. There is no fee and no middleman.
schemes.benefit: Rs.6,000 a year in 3 instalments
eligibility: The family owns cultivable land. A family means husband, wife and minor children, and gets one payment between them
The land record must be in the applicant's own name in the village revenue record
Aadhaar must be seeded in the bank account, and e-KYC must be completed on the portal
Not eligible: income-tax payers, serving or retired government employees (Class IV / Group D staff are still eligible), pensioners drawing Rs.10,000 or more a month
Not eligible: doctors, engineers, lawyers, chartered accountants and architects in practice, and holders of constitutional posts
Not eligible: institutional landholders, such as land held by a trust or company
documents: Aadhaar card, with mobile number linked for OTP
Land record (khatauni, khasra, RoR or 7/12 extract) showing the applicant's name
Bank passbook first page, showing account number and IFSC
Ration card or other proof of the family
Recent passport-size photograph

demoFields.label: Type of farmer
demoFields.hint: Choose Rural Farmer if your land is in a village panchayat, Urban Farmer if it falls inside a municipal area.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: The 12 digits printed on your Aadhaar card. The mobile number linked to it will receive the OTP, so keep that phone with you.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: The number linked to your Aadhaar. Every message about your instalment comes to this number, so do not give someone else's phone.

demoFields.label: Name (exactly as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Copy the spelling from the Aadhaar card letter by letter. If it does not match, the bank transfer will fail.

demoFields.label: Category

demoSteps: Open pmkisan.gov.in and, under Farmers Corner, choose New Farmer Registration.
Enter your Aadhaar number, mobile number and state, tick Rural or Urban farmer, and fill the captcha to get an OTP.
Type the OTP, then a second OTP sent by Aadhaar, so that your identity is verified.
Fill your name, category, bank account and IFSC exactly as they appear on your documents.
Add your land details, one row for each khasra or survey number, and upload the land record and your photo.
Save the form and note the registration number that appears on screen.

schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana

The same plot cannot be insured twice, by the bank and by the farmer separately

eligibility: Any Indian citizen with a business plan or a running non-farm business: manufacturing, trading, services, or allied farm work such as dairy or poultry
Not for crop loans and not for large companies. This is for micro enterprises
No collateral, and no processing fee on Shishu loans
The business must be your own and the account must not be a defaulter with any bank
Tarun Plus, Rs.10 lakh to Rs.20 lakh, only for those who took a Tarun loan and repaid it in full
Many banks give women borrowers a concession on the interest rate
documents: Aadhaar Card
PAN Card

demoSteps: On Jan Samarth choose the Business Activity Loan category, then Mudra.
Answer the short eligibility questions. The portal tells you at once whether you qualify.
Register with your mobile number and OTP, then PAN and Aadhaar e-KYC.

schemes.title: PM Vishwakarma
schemes.department: Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises
schemes.brief: For artisans and craftspeople in 18 traditional trades who work with their hands and tools: carpenters, blacksmiths, potters, tailors, barbers, cobblers, masons and others. You get a certificate and ID card, skill training with a stipend of Rs.500 a day, a Rs.15,000 toolkit voucher, and a collateral-free loan of Rs.1 lakh and then Rs.2 lakh at 5% interest. You cannot register yourself from home: registration is done at a Common Service Centre with a biometric Aadhaar check, and three committees verify you afterwards.
schemes.benefit: Rs.15,000 toolkit + Rs.3 Lakh loan at 5%
eligibility: Working with your hands and tools in one of the 18 listed trades, self-employed and in the unorganised sector
Aged 18 or above on the date of registration

Only one member of a family. Husband, wife and unmarried children count as one family
No credit-based loan taken under PMEGP, PM SVANidhi or Mudra in the last 5 years. A fully repaid Mudra loan does not block you
Government employees and their family members are not eligible

The district implementation committee checks next, and then the screening committee approves.
Once approved, download the PM Vishwakarma certificate and ID card from the portal.

Claim the Rs.15,000 toolkit e-voucher after the basic training is over.
Apply at the bank for the first loan of Rs.1 lakh, repayable over 18 months. A second loan of Rs.2 lakh follows after you repay it and take the advanced training.

demoFields.hint: Also filled in from Aadhaar. Check it against your own records before you go ahead.

demoFields.label: ABHA address (your health username)
demoFields.hint: Pick something easy to say out loud at a hospital counter. This is what you share, never your Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Address and PIN code
demoFields.hint: Comes from Aadhaar. Edit it if you have moved, so that nearby hospitals link to you correctly.

demoSteps: Open abha.abdm.gov.in and choose Create ABHA Number.
Select the Aadhaar route, type your Aadhaar number, and tick the consent box.
Enter the OTP sent to the mobile linked with your Aadhaar.
Give the mobile number you want on the account and verify its own OTP.
Your name, date of birth, gender and address appear on their own from Aadhaar. Check them.
Choose an ABHA address, the easy-to-say name ending in @abdm that you will share at hospitals.
Your 14-digit ABHA number is made at once. Download the card as a PDF and save it.
Install the ABHA app, sign in with the same number, and link your hospital records as they come in.

schemes.title: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY (Ayushman Card)
schemes.department: National Health Authority, Ministry of Health & Family Welfare
schemes.brief: A free health cover of Rs.5 lakh a year for the whole family, used at any empanelled government or private hospital. Treatment is cashless: the hospital bills the government, not you. The Ayushman card is what you show at the hospital desk, and you can make it yourself online.
schemes.benefit: Rs.5 lakh a year, cashless, for the whole family
eligibility: Families listed in the SECC 2011 deprivation list for rural areas, or in the listed occupational categories for urban areas
All families already covered by the older RSBY scheme
Every citizen aged 70 and above, whatever the family income, under the Ayushman Vay Vandana card
Registered construction workers, ASHA and Anganwadi workers, and other groups notified by the state
There is no cap on family size or on the age of members. Illnesses you already have are covered from day one
documents: Aadhaar card of the person whose card is being made
Mobile number for OTP (it need not be linked to Aadhaar, but Aadhaar OTP or face authentication is needed for e-KYC)
Ration card or family ID, to link the other members of the family
A live photo, taken on the phone during e-KYC

demoFields.label: Login as
demoFields.hint: Choose Beneficiary when you are making the card for yourself or your family, not Operator.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: Any working number you hold. The login OTP comes here, and so does the message when the card is approved.

demoFields.label: Scheme and state
demoFields.hint: Choose PMJAY, then the state where your ration card was issued, not the state you are working in.

demoFields.label: Search your family by
demoFields.hint: You can search by Aadhaar, family or ration card number, name, or PMJAY ID. The family number finds everyone at once.

demoFields.label: Family / ration card number
demoFields.hint: Copy the number from the ration card. If nothing is found, try searching again with your Aadhaar number.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number for e-KYC
demoFields.hint: Aadhaar of the family member whose card you are making now. Each member has to be done one at a time.

demoFields.label: e-KYC method
demoFields.hint: Aadhaar OTP if the mobile is linked to Aadhaar, otherwise choose face authentication and scan the face on the phone camera.

demoFields.label: Live photo
demoFields.hint: Take the photo in good light, face straight, no cap or dark glasses. A blurred photo gets the request rejected.

demoFields.label: Relation with head of family
demoFields.hint: How this member is related to the person named first on the ration card.

demoFields.label: District and PIN code
demoFields.hint: The address where you actually stay now, so the nearest empanelled hospitals are shown to you.

demoSteps: Open beneficiary.nha.gov.in and log in as Beneficiary with your mobile number and the OTP.
Choose the scheme PMJAY and your state, then search for your family by ration card number or Aadhaar.
The list of family members appears. Find the member with the tag eKYC pending and tap the Aadhaar icon next to the name.
Verify with an Aadhaar OTP, or use face authentication if the mobile is not linked to Aadhaar.
Take the live photo on the phone and fill in the mobile number, relation to the head of the family, district and PIN code.
Submit. The request goes to the state health agency, and approval usually comes within a day or two.
Log in again, open Download Card, verify once more with OTP, and save the Ayushman card on your phone.
At the hospital, go to the Ayushman Mitra desk and show this card. Never pay cash for a treatment listed under the scheme.

schemes.title: PM Awas Yojana Urban 2.0
schemes.department: Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs
schemes.brief: Help for a town or city family that has no pucca house of its own. There are four routes: build on your own plot, buy a flat built with government help, rent a government-built room, or take a home loan with an interest subsidy. You apply once on the portal and the urban local body decides which route fits you.
schemes.benefit: Up to Rs.2.50 lakh assistance, or Rs.1.80 lakh interest subsidy on a home loan
eligibility: The family, meaning husband, wife and unmarried children, must not own a pucca house anywhere in India
EWS: yearly family income up to Rs.3 lakh. LIG: Rs.3 lakh to Rs.6 lakh. MIG: Rs.6 lakh to Rs.9 lakh
The house must be in a town or city notified under the scheme
For the Beneficiary-Led Construction route the family must already own the plot, with clear papers
The house should be in the name of a woman of the family, or jointly, except in the rental route
The family must not have taken help under any earlier central housing scheme
documents: Aadhaar of all family members
Income certificate or proof of yearly family income
Bank passbook with account number and IFSC
Proof that you own the plot, for the build-your-own route: sale deed, patta or allotment letter
Affidavit that the family owns no pucca house in India
Caste certificate, if claiming under SC, ST or OBC
Latest municipal tax or electricity bill as address proof

demoFields.label: Yearly family income
demoFields.hint: Add up what everyone in the family earns in a year. This decides whether you fall in EWS, LIG or MIG.

demoFields.label: Does the family own a pucca house?
demoFields.hint: Answer for the whole family and for the whole country, not just this city. A wrong answer here cancels the application later.

demoFields.label: Which vertical you are applying under
demoFields.hint: BLC if you own a plot and will build, AHP to buy a flat, ARH to rent, ISS for an interest subsidy on a home loan.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number of the head of family
demoFields.hint: e-KYC is done on this Aadhaar. Prefer the woman of the house, since the house has to be in her name.

demoFields.label: Name and relation of each family member
demoFields.value: Anita Bhosale (self), Devidas Bhosale (husband), Sagar Bhosale (son, 12)
demoFields.hint: List husband, wife and unmarried children with their Aadhaar numbers. Married children make their own separate family.

demoFields.label: State / District / Town or city
demoFields.hint: Choose the urban local body where the house will stand. Your file will go to this office for checking.

demoFields.label: Address of the plot or present house
demoFields.hint: The full address with PIN code. For the build-your-own route, this must be the plot shown in your ownership paper.

demoFields.label: Plot ownership document number
demoFields.hint: The registration number on your sale deed, patta or allotment letter. Needed only for the build-your-own route.

demoFields.label: Bank account number and IFSC
demoFields.hint: The instalments are released into this account as the building work reaches each stage.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: Every message about survey, approval and instalments comes to this number. Give the number you use daily.

demoSteps: Open pmay-urban.gov.in and click Apply for PMAY-U 2.0.
Answer the eligibility questions: yearly family income, whether the family owns a pucca house, and your state.
Read the four verticals shown and pick the one that fits you, then enter your Aadhaar and complete e-KYC with the OTP.
Fill in the family details, the address of the plot or of your present house, and the bank account.
Upload the income proof, the ownership papers and the affidavit that you own no pucca house.
Submit and save the application number that appears. Print the acknowledgement.
The urban local body verifies the papers and a surveyor visits the plot.
Track the file on the same site under Search Beneficiary. Money is released in instalments as the work goes up, so send the photographs asked for at each stage.

schemes.title: Aadhaar Enrolment & Update
schemes.department: Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI)
schemes.brief: Aadhaar is the 12-digit identity number every resident of India can get, free of cost. First-time enrolment has to be done in person at an Aadhaar Seva Kendra because fingerprints, iris and photo are captured there. Name, address, date of birth and mobile can be corrected later from home on myAadhaar.
schemes.benefit: 12-digit Aadhaar number
eligibility: Any resident of India, including newborns and senior citizens — there is no minimum or maximum age.
You must have lived in India for 182 days or more in the 12 months before you apply.
NRIs holding a valid Indian passport can enrol on the strength of the passport.
Children under 5 get a Baal Aadhaar with no fingerprints; biometrics must be updated free of cost at age 5 and again at 15.
One person may hold only one Aadhaar number — enrol a second time only to correct an existing record.
documents: Proof of Identity — passport, PAN card, voter ID, ration card or driving licence
Proof of Address — electricity, water or telephone bill of the last 3 months, bank passbook or registered rent agreement
Proof of Date of Birth — birth certificate, Class 10 marksheet or passport
Proof of Relationship for a child — a parent's Aadhaar along with the child's birth certificate
Your own mobile number, which will receive the OTP for every future update

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number (only when updating)
demoFields.hint: Leave this blank if you have never enrolled. To change something in an existing record, type the 12 digits printed on your Aadhaar letter.

demoFields.label: Full Name
demoFields.hint: Write your name exactly as it should be printed — the same spelling as on your school certificate or passport. Do not use short forms.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth
demoFields.hint: DD/MM/YYYY, as written on your birth certificate or Class 10 marksheet. You will have to upload that document as proof.

demoFields.label: Gender
demoFields.hint: Choose Male, Female or Transgender.

demoFields.label: Guardian / Parent's Name
demoFields.hint: Compulsory for a child under 5. Adults may leave it blank unless they are using a parent's document as proof of address.

demoFields.label: Full Address
demoFields.value: H. No. 42, Gali No. 3, Nehru Nagar, Bhilwara, Rajasthan – 311001
demoFields.hint: House number, street, locality, village or town, district, state and PIN code — exactly as it appears on the bill or passbook you are uploading.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: Give a number you use yourself and will keep. Every Aadhaar update, bank KYC and DBT payment sends its OTP here.

demoFields.label: Email Address
demoFields.hint: Optional, but the e-Aadhaar PDF and update receipts come here. Leave blank if you do not use email.

demoFields.label: Proof of Identity Document
demoFields.hint: Pick the document type from the list, then upload a clear scan or photo of the original. The name on it must match what you typed above.

demoFields.label: Proof of Address Document
demoFields.hint: Must be in your own name and not older than 3 months for a bill. If the bill is in a parent's or spouse's name, use the relationship-proof route instead.

demoSteps: For a first Aadhaar, go straight to step 5 — a new enrolment cannot be completed online.
To correct an existing Aadhaar, open myAadhaar and sign in with your Aadhaar number and the OTP sent to your registered mobile.
Choose 'Update Aadhaar Online'. Name, date of birth, gender and address can be corrected from home; upload a scan of the supporting document.
Pay the fee online (around Rs.50 for an online document or address update) and save the URN — the Update Request Number that tracks your request.
For a first-time enrolment, or to change your photo, fingerprints or iris, book a slot at an Aadhaar Seva Kendra. This visit is unavoidable: biometrics can only be captured in person.
Carry the original documents to the centre. The operator takes your photograph, all ten fingerprints and both iris scans, and hands you an acknowledgement slip with a 14-digit EID.
Track the EID or URN on myAadhaar. The Aadhaar letter is posted to your address, and the e-Aadhaar PDF can be downloaded as soon as the number is generated.
A child's biometrics must be updated free of charge at age 5 and at 15, otherwise the Aadhaar can be deactivated.
schemes.helpline: 1947 — UIDAI toll-free helpline, available in 12 languages · help@uidai.gov.in

schemes.title: Birth Certificate (Civil Registration System)
schemes.department: Registrar General of India / State Registrar of Births & Deaths
schemes.brief: Every birth in India must be registered within 21 days, and it costs nothing in that window. The birth certificate is the first document a child owns and the one every school, passport office and employer later asks for. Since the 2023 amendment the whole system is digital and the certificate can be downloaded.
schemes.benefit: Legal birth certificate
eligibility: Every birth that takes place in India must be registered, whatever the parents' nationality or religion.
Free if reported within 21 days of the birth.
Between 22 and 30 days it is registered on payment of a late fee.
Between 30 days and one year it needs the written permission of the District Magistrate or the prescribed authority, plus an affidavit.
After one year it can only be registered on the order of a Judicial Magistrate First Class.
For a hospital birth the hospital is the informant; for a birth at home it is the head of the household.
documents: Discharge summary or the birth letter issued by the hospital or nursing home
Aadhaar of both parents
Parents' marriage certificate, where the state asks for it
Proof of the parents' address — electricity bill, ration card or Aadhaar
A declaration by the head of the household, for a birth at home
Affidavit and the competent authority's permission, for a late registration

demoFields.label: Child's Name
demoFields.hint: May be left blank if the name is not decided yet — it can be added later, free, within the period your state allows.

demoFields.label: Date and Time of Birth
demoFields.hint: Copy both exactly from the hospital discharge summary. A mismatch here is the commonest reason a certificate has to be corrected later.

demoFields.label: Sex
demoFields.hint: Male, Female or Transgender.

demoFields.label: Place of Birth
demoFields.hint: Choose Hospital, Home or Other. For a hospital birth give its registered name; for a home birth give the full house address.

demoFields.label: Mother's Name and Aadhaar
demoFields.hint: Full name as on her Aadhaar. The spelling is carried onto the child's certificate and is hard to change afterwards.

demoFields.label: Father's Name and Aadhaar
demoFields.hint: Full name as on his Aadhaar, matching the hospital record.

demoFields.label: Permanent Address of the Parents
demoFields.value: Plot 7, Ganesh Colony, Panchavati, Nashik, Maharashtra – 422003
demoFields.hint: The family's own address, which may differ from the hospital's. The certificate is issued by the registrar covering the place of birth, not this address.

demoFields.label: Mother's Age, Education and Occupation
demoFields.value: Age at marriage 24, age at this birth 27; Graduate; Homemaker
demoFields.hint: Statistical questions that the form requires. Answer honestly — they do not affect whether the certificate is issued.

demoFields.label: Informant's Name and Relationship
demoFields.hint: The person reporting the birth. For a hospital birth this is usually the hospital's records clerk; for a home birth, the head of the household.

demoFields.label: Registration Unit
demoFields.hint: The local body covering the place of birth — municipal corporation, nagar palika or gram panchayat. The portal lists the units once you pick the district.

demoSteps: If the baby was born in a hospital, the hospital reports the birth itself. Ask the records desk for the reporting or acknowledgement number before you are discharged.
For a birth at home, the head of the household registers on the CRS portal as 'General Public' and verifies the mobile number by OTP.
Fill Form 1, the Birth Report, within 21 days of the birth — registration is free inside that window.
Attach the hospital discharge summary, or a declaration for a home birth, along with both parents' Aadhaar and an address proof.
The local Registrar of Births & Deaths checks the entry and registers it. There is no biometric visit and no interview, but the registrar may call you to clarify a detail.
A late report needs more: a fee after 21 days, the prescribed authority's written permission after 30 days, and a Judicial Magistrate's order after a year.
Download the digitally signed certificate from the portal once it is issued, or collect a copy from the registrar's office. It also appears in DigiLocker.
Check every spelling and the date on the certificate the day you receive it — correcting it later needs a separate application with supporting proof.
schemes.helpline: Your municipal corporation, nagar palika or gram panchayat Registrar of Births & Deaths — CRS applications are decided by the local registrar rather than a central number

schemes.title: Driving Licence
schemes.department: Ministry of Road Transport & Highways / State RTO
schemes.brief: A driving licence comes in two stages. First you get a learner's licence after a short test on road signs and rules, then you practise for at least a month and take a driving test at the RTO to get the permanent licence. Both stages start on Sarathi.
schemes.benefit: Permanent driving licence
eligibility: 18 years for a motorcycle with gears and for a light motor vehicle such as a car.
16 years for a gearless two-wheeler up to 50cc, with the written consent of a parent or guardian.
20 years for a transport vehicle licence, along with the schooling your state requires and a year's driving experience.
You must hold a learner's licence for at least 30 days before you can sit the driving test, and it stays valid for 6 months.
You must be medically fit — a self-declaration on Form 1, or a doctor's certificate on Form 1A if you are over 40 or applying for a transport licence.
documents: Proof of Age — birth certificate, Class 10 marksheet, PAN or passport
Proof of Address — Aadhaar, electricity bill, ration card or voter ID
Form 1 self-declaration of physical fitness, or Form 1A from a registered doctor where required
Passport-size photographs and a scanned signature
The learner's licence, when you come back for the permanent licence
Consent of a parent or guardian, for a 16-year-old applying for a gearless two-wheeler

demoFields.label: State and RTO
demoFields.hint: Choose the RTO for the address where you live. Sarathi opens your state's own screens once you pick the state.

demoFields.label: Applicant's Full Name
demoFields.hint: As on your age proof. This is printed on the licence card and must match your Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth
demoFields.hint: DD/MM/YYYY. The portal checks your age against the class of vehicle you are applying for and rejects the form if you are short.

demoFields.label: Father's or Husband's Name
demoFields.hint: Full name, no initials. It is printed on the licence.

demoFields.label: Class of Vehicle
demoFields.hint: Tick every class you want. MCWOG is a scooter without gears, MCWG a geared motorcycle, LMV a car or jeep. Adding a class later means another test.

demoFields.label: Present Address
demoFields.value: C-118, Sector 12, Indira Nagar, Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh – 226016
demoFields.hint: Must match your address proof, since the licence is posted there and the RTO is decided by it.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Most states now allow Aadhaar e-KYC, which pulls in your name, photo and address and saves you a trip for document checking.

demoFields.label: Blood Group
demoFields.hint: Printed on the licence and used by hospitals after an accident. Get it right.

demoFields.label: Learner's Licence Number
demoFields.hint: Leave blank when applying for the learner's licence. Fill it when you come back for the permanent licence after 30 days.

demoFields.label: Test Slot
demoFields.hint: Book after paying the fee. Reach the RTO track on time with the vehicle of the class you are testing for.

demoSteps: Open Sarathi, choose your state and select 'Apply for Learner Licence'.
Fill Form 2, upload your age and address proof and the Form 1 self-declaration — or Form 1A from a doctor if you are over 40 or want a transport licence.
Pay the fee and book a slot. Unless your state completes Aadhaar e-KYC online, you go to the RTO for document verification, where your photograph and signature are captured.
Sit the learner's test: ten multiple-choice questions on road signs and traffic rules, taken at the RTO or from home in states that allow it. The learner's licence is issued the same day.
Practise for at least 30 days. The learner's licence is valid for 6 months.
Between the 31st day and the end of the sixth month, apply for the permanent licence on Form 4, pay the fee and book a driving test slot.
Take the driving test at the RTO track in a vehicle of the class you applied for — you have to arrange the vehicle yourself, and the inspector checks control, parking and reversing.
On passing, the licence is printed and posted to your address, and it can also be pulled into DigiLocker or mParivahan. It is valid for 20 years or until you turn 50, whichever comes first.
schemes.helpline: 0120-4925505 — Parivahan Sewa helpdesk · your own RTO for test slots and document checks

schemes.title: Indian Passport (Fresh or Re-issue)
schemes.department: Ministry of External Affairs — Passport Seva
schemes.brief: The passport is your proof of Indian citizenship and the document you travel abroad on. You apply online, then attend one appointment at a Passport Seva Kendra where your papers are checked and your photo and fingerprints are taken. A policeman usually visits your address afterwards.
schemes.benefit: Passport in about 30 days
eligibility: Any Indian citizen, of any age — there is no minimum age, and infants get a passport valid for 5 years.
A minor under 18 applies through both parents, who must sign Annexure D consenting to it.
You must apply at the Regional Passport Office covering your present address, whether or not it is your home town.
Tatkaal is open to most applicants but not to those with a pending court case, an earlier passport that was impounded, or a doubtful citizenship claim.
Anyone who has passed Class 10 gets ECNR status, which removes the emigration check requirement for working abroad.
documents: Proof of Present Address — Aadhaar, electricity or water bill, bank passbook with photo, or registered rent agreement
Proof of Date of Birth — birth certificate, Class 10 certificate, PAN or Aadhaar
Aadhaar card, which also serves as the standard proof of identity
Class 10 marksheet or certificate, if you want ECNR printed on the passport
Annexure D signed by both parents, plus their passports or IDs, when the applicant is a minor
The old passport in original, for a re-issue

demoFields.label: Type of Application
demoFields.hint: Fresh if you have never held one, Re-issue if you are renewing. Choose Tatkaal only if you genuinely need it in a week — it costs considerably more.

demoFields.label: Applicant's Full Name
demoFields.hint: Given name and surname in separate boxes, spelt exactly as on your Class 10 certificate. This spelling will follow you on every visa you ever apply for.

demoFields.label: Date and Place of Birth
demoFields.hint: Date as on your birth certificate, and the district and state where you were born — not where you live now.

demoFields.label: Father's and Mother's Name
demoFields.hint: Both are compulsory and both are printed inside the passport. Use full names, not initials.

demoFields.label: Present Residential Address
demoFields.value: 8-2-341, Road No. 5, Banjara Hills, Hyderabad, Telangana – 500034
demoFields.hint: Where you actually live now, because this is the address the police will visit. It decides which Passport Office handles your file.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: All 12 digits. A self-declaration that your Aadhaar details are correct is part of the form.

demoFields.label: Educational Qualification
demoFields.hint: Be accurate — passing Class 10 or above is what gets you ECNR status, which matters if you plan to work in the Gulf.

demoFields.label: Employment Type
demoFields.hint: Government, Public Sector, Private, Self-employed, Student, Homemaker or Retired. Government employees must also attach an Identity Certificate or NOC.

demoFields.label: Emergency Contact
demoFields.hint: A relative or friend who is not travelling with you. Their name and phone number are printed in the back of the passport.

demoFields.label: Passport Office and Appointment Slot
demoFields.hint: The office is fixed by your address; you only choose the date and time. Slots open at a set hour each day and go quickly.

demoSteps: Register on the Passport Seva portal, confirm the link sent to your email, and log in.
Choose 'Apply for Fresh Passport / Re-issue', fill the form online or upload the XML, and save it.
Pay the fee online — this is what unlocks the appointment calendar — and book a slot at your Passport Seva Kendra or Post Office PSK.
Attend the appointment in person on the given date, carrying every original plus one self-attested photocopy of each. Nobody can attend on your behalf.
Inside the PSK you pass three counters: A, where your documents are scanned and your photograph and fingerprints are captured; B, the Verification Officer; and C, the Granting Officer.
Police verification follows. A constable from your local station comes to your address to confirm you live there — keep your originals ready and be reachable on the phone number you gave.
Track the file number on the portal or the mPassport Seva app. Once granted, the passport is printed and sent by Speed Post with a tracking number.
Normal applications take roughly 30 to 45 days including police verification. Tatkaal, where the verification happens after the passport is issued, takes about 3 to 7 working days.
schemes.helpline: 1800-258-1800 — Passport Seva National Call Centre, toll-free

schemes.title: PAN Card (Form 49A)
schemes.department: Income Tax Department, CBDT
schemes.brief: PAN is the 10-character permanent account number the Income Tax Department issues to you for life. You need it to file a return, open a bank or demat account, and for any large payment or property deal. With Aadhaar e-KYC the whole application is done online and nothing has to be posted.
schemes.benefit: 10-character PAN card
eligibility: Any Indian citizen of any age — a minor's PAN is applied for by a parent or guardian.
Compulsory once your income crosses the basic exemption limit, and for filing an income tax return.
Needed to open a bank or demat account, to buy or sell property or a vehicle, and for cash payments above the prescribed limit.
Foreign citizens and foreign entities apply on Form 49AA instead of Form 49A.
One person, one PAN — holding a second PAN attracts a penalty under section 272B of the Income Tax Act.
documents: Aadhaar number, and the mobile registered with it, for e-KYC
Proof of Identity — Aadhaar, voter ID, passport or driving licence
Proof of Address — Aadhaar, electricity bill, bank statement or passport
Proof of Date of Birth — birth certificate, Class 10 certificate or passport
A recent passport-size photograph and your signature scanned on plain white paper

demoFields.label: Application Type
demoFields.hint: Choose this for a first PAN. Pick 'Changes or Correction' only if you already hold a PAN and want to fix a detail or get a reprint.

demoFields.label: Title and Full Name
demoFields.hint: Shri, Smt or Kumari, then first, middle and last name in separate boxes. It must match your Aadhaar exactly, or the e-KYC will fail.

demoFields.label: Father's Name
demoFields.hint: Compulsory even for married women. Fill your father's full name, not your husband's, unless you tick the option to print the mother's name instead.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth
demoFields.hint: DD/MM/YYYY as on your birth certificate or Class 10 certificate.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: All 12 digits. Quoting Aadhaar is mandatory, and the name and date of birth here must agree with your Aadhaar record.

demoFields.label: Address for Communication
demoFields.value: Flat 12-B, Sai Residency, Kothrud, Pune, Maharashtra – 411038
demoFields.hint: Where the printed card should be delivered. Give a full postal address with PIN code — the card is sent by ordinary post.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number and Email
demoFields.hint: The OTP for e-Sign comes to this mobile and the e-PAN PDF comes to this email, so give a working pair.

demoFields.label: Source of Income
demoFields.hint: Choose Salary, Business or profession, House property, Capital gains, Other, or 'No income' for a student or homemaker.

demoFields.label: AO Code (Area / AO Type / Range / AO Number)
demoFields.hint: Your assessing officer's code. Do not guess it — use the portal's 'AO Code Search' and pick the one for your city and income type.

demoFields.label: Name to be Printed on the Card
demoFields.hint: Usually the same as your full name. It is printed in capitals, so check the spelling carefully — a reprint costs money.

demoSteps: Open the Protean TIN-PAN portal and choose 'New PAN – Indian Citizen (Form 49A)'.
Pick the Aadhaar e-KYC and e-Sign route. Your photograph and details are pulled from Aadhaar, so no papers have to be posted anywhere.
Fill your name, father's name, address, source of income and the AO code — use the portal's AO Code Search rather than guessing.
Pay the fee online, roughly Rs.107 for a physical card delivered to an Indian address and less if you want only the e-PAN. Note the 15-digit acknowledgement number.
Authenticate with the Aadhaar OTP to e-Sign the form. There is no visit to any office on this route.
If you instead chose the physical mode, print the acknowledgement, paste two photographs, sign across them and post it to Protean's Pune office within 15 days — the application lapses otherwise.
The e-PAN PDF reaches your email in about 3 to 5 working days and the printed card follows by post in roughly two weeks.
If you need a PAN the same day and your mobile is linked to Aadhaar, the Income Tax portal's 'Instant e-PAN' issues one free in about ten minutes.
schemes.helpline: 020-27218080 — Protean TIN call centre · Income Tax helpline 1800-103-0025

schemes.title: Voter Registration (Form 6)
schemes.department: Election Commission of India
schemes.brief: Form 6 is how a first-time voter gets their name onto the electoral roll and receives an EPIC, the voter ID card. It is free. After you apply, the Booth Level Officer of your area comes to check that you really live at the address you gave.
schemes.benefit: Voter ID card (EPIC)
eligibility: You must be a citizen of India — this is the one document that is closed to non-citizens.
You must be 18 or older on the qualifying date. There are four qualifying dates a year: 1 January, 1 April, 1 July and 1 October.
A 17-year-old may apply in advance; the name is added once the next qualifying date passes.
You must be an ordinary resident of the constituency you are applying in, not a temporary visitor.
You must not already be enrolled somewhere else — to move your entry to a new address, use Form 8 instead of Form 6.
documents: Recent passport-size colour photograph with a plain white background
Proof of Age — birth certificate, Class 10 marksheet, PAN, passport or driving licence
Proof of Address — electricity, water or gas bill, bank passbook, rent agreement or Aadhaar
Aadhaar number, which is optional and collected on Form 6B
A declaration by a parent, along with their address proof, if the utility bill is not in your own name

demoFields.label: State, District and Assembly Constituency
demoFields.hint: Pick the constituency covering the address where you actually live. The portal shows the list once you choose the district.

demoFields.label: Applicant's Full Name
demoFields.hint: As on your school certificate. The portal also asks for the same name in the state's own script, which it can transliterate for you.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth
demoFields.hint: DD/MM/YYYY. You must be 18 on the qualifying date, and the age proof you upload has to show this exact date.

demoFields.label: Relative's Name and Relationship
demoFields.hint: Father, mother, husband or legal guardian. This name is printed on the EPIC below yours.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Optional. Giving it helps the officer weed out duplicate entries, and you may tick 'I am not able to furnish Aadhaar' instead.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number and Email
demoFields.hint: Every status update and the e-EPIC download link are sent here. Use a number you check.

demoFields.label: Present Ordinary Residence Address
demoFields.hint: The address where you normally live and where the BLO will come looking for you. It must match the address proof you upload.

demoFields.label: Age or Date of Birth Proof
demoFields.hint: Upload a clear scan under the size limit the portal shows. A birth certificate or Class 10 marksheet is accepted everywhere.

demoFields.label: Address Proof
demoFields.value: Electricity bill in father's name, with his declaration
demoFields.hint: If the bill is not in your name, attach the declaration from the family member whose name is on it, along with their own proof.

demoFields.label: Photograph
demoFields.value: Colour photo, white background, JPG under 2 MB
demoFields.hint: Face straight to the camera, no cap and no dark glasses. This picture goes on your EPIC, so do not use a group photo cropped down.

demoSteps: Sign up on the Voter Services portal with your mobile number and set a password.
Choose 'New registration for general electors (Form 6)'.
Fill your constituency, name, date of birth, relative's name and address; upload the photograph, age proof and address proof.
Submit and save the reference ID — that is how you track the application from here on.
The Booth Level Officer of your polling area visits your address to verify that you live there. Keep your original documents at hand; if nobody is home the application can be held up.
The Electoral Registration Officer then decides the claim, and a public notice is put up before the name is added.
Once approved, download the e-EPIC free from the portal. The printed PVC card is posted separately to your address.
The whole process usually takes a few weeks, and is faster when a roll revision is under way.
schemes.helpline: 1950 — National Voter Helpline (dial your district's STD code before it)

schemes.title: Jeevan Pramaan — Digital Life Certificate
schemes.department: Ministry of Electronics & Information Technology (MeitY)
schemes.brief: Every pensioner has to prove once a year that they are alive, or the pension stops. Jeevan Pramaan replaces the trip to the bank with a biometric or face scan that can be done at home on a phone. The certificate reaches your bank electronically, so there is no paper to hand in.
schemes.benefit: Digital Life Certificate (Pramaan ID)
eligibility: Any pensioner of the Central Government, a State Government or another government body whose pension disbursing agency has joined Jeevan Pramaan.
Your Aadhaar must already be recorded with the bank or agency that pays your pension — without that the certificate cannot be matched to your file.
The mobile number linked to your Aadhaar must be working, since the OTP goes there.
The certificate is submitted every year in November, and pensioners aged 80 and above may submit from 1 October.
Family pensioners can submit in the same way, using their own Aadhaar and the PPO number of the family pension.
documents: Aadhaar number, with the mobile linked to it in working order
PPO number, from the Pension Payment Order book
Bank account number and the branch where the pension is credited
The name of the pension sanctioning authority and the disbursing agency
