A smartphone with the Jeevan Pramaan or Face Authentication app, or a UIDAI-certified fingerprint or iris device

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: The same Aadhaar that your pension office holds on record. If the bank has a different number on file, get that corrected first or the certificate will not attach.

demoFields.label: Pensioner's Name
demoFields.hint: Exactly as it appears in your Aadhaar record, not as it appears in the PPO, if the two differ.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: Must be the number linked to your Aadhaar — the authentication OTP is sent there and nowhere else.

demoFields.label: Type of Pension
demoFields.hint: Service, family, disability or another category, as written in your PPO.

demoFields.label: Pension Sanctioning Authority
demoFields.hint: The office that sanctioned the pension — an Accountant General, a ministry, the CGDA for defence pensioners, or a state department. Pick it from the list.

demoFields.label: Disbursing Agency and Branch
demoFields.value: State Bank of India, Aliganj Branch, Lucknow
demoFields.hint: The bank or post office that actually credits your pension each month. The certificate is delivered to this agency.

demoFields.label: PPO Number
demoFields.hint: The Pension Payment Order number from the first page of your PPO book. Copy every digit — a wrong PPO number is the usual reason a certificate does not reach the bank.

demoFields.label: Pension Account Number
demoFields.hint: The account the pension is credited to, with its IFSC. Check it against your passbook.

demoFields.label: Re-employment and Re-marriage Declaration
demoFields.hint: A legal declaration that affects your entitlement. Family pensioners must answer the re-marriage question honestly; a false declaration can mean recovery of the pension.

demoFields.label: Biometric Authentication
demoFields.value: Right thumb fingerprint captured on the device
demoFields.hint: Fingerprint or iris on a certified device, or a face scan through the Face Authentication app. Elderly fingerprints often fail — use the face scan instead of trying repeatedly.

demoSteps: Install the Jeevan Pramaan app and the Aadhaar Face RD app on a smartphone, or go to a bank branch, post office, CSC or your pension office where an operator has the equipment.
Register with your Aadhaar number, mobile and email, and confirm the OTP that arrives.
Enter the PPO number, the sanctioning authority, the disbursing agency and your pension account number.

Authenticate biometrically — a fingerprint or iris scan on a UIDAI-certified device, or a face scan through the app, which needs no device at all. This step has to be done by the pensioner in person, but it can be done at home.
The Pramaan ID and the life certificate are generated on the spot and an SMS confirms it.
The certificate travels electronically to your pension disbursing agency. Nothing has to be printed, signed or carried to the bank.
Download the certificate from the Jeevan Pramaan site using your Pramaan ID if you want a copy for your records.
Repeat it every November. Pensioners of 80 and above may submit from 1 October, and the certificate stays valid for a year from the date it is generated.
schemes.helpline: 1800-111-555 — CSC and Jeevan Pramaan support · jeevanpramaan@gov.in

schemes.title: UDID — Unique Disability ID Card
schemes.department: Dept. of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment
schemes.brief: The UDID card is a single national identity card for a person with a disability, and it carries the disability certificate on it. One card replaces the separate certificates that different states and departments used to ask for, and it is what gets you reservation in jobs and education, travel concessions, scholarships and the disability pension.
schemes.benefit: UDID card and disability certificate
eligibility: Any person with one of the 21 disabilities listed in the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016.
Disability is assessed by a Medical Board, and most benefits require a certified disability of 40 per cent or more.
There is no age limit, and there is no income condition for the card itself.
Someone who already holds a state disability certificate can have it converted to a UDID without being examined again, if the certificate is valid.
The card is free, and the application, the medical assessment and the card all cost nothing.
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant
Recent passport-size colour photograph and a scanned signature or thumb impression
Any existing disability certificate, if one has already been issued
Medical reports or hospital records supporting the disability claim
Proof of address — Aadhaar, ration card, electricity bill or voter ID
Income certificate and BPL card, if you want to claim income-linked benefits

demoFields.label: Applicant's Full Name
demoFields.hint: As on Aadhaar. The card is printed from this entry, so check the spelling before submitting.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth
demoFields.hint: DD/MM/YYYY as on your birth certificate or Aadhaar. For a child, the parent or guardian fills the form.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: All 12 digits. Aadhaar is how the card is kept unique across states, so the same person cannot hold two.

demoFields.label: Type of Disability
demoFields.hint: Choose from the 21 conditions listed in the Act — locomotor, visual, hearing, speech, intellectual, multiple and others. The Medical Board confirms it later.

demoFields.label: Existing Disability Certificate
demoFields.hint: If a state certificate was issued to you earlier, enter its number and upload it; you may then be spared a fresh examination.

demoFields.label: Present and Permanent Address
demoFields.value: Village Barwadih, Post Chatra, District Latehar, Jharkhand – 829202
demoFields.hint: This decides which district's CMO office handles your file and which hospital you are called to, so give the address where you actually live.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number and Email
demoFields.hint: The assessment appointment and every status change are sent here. Give a number someone in the house answers.

demoFields.label: Employment and Education Status
demoFields.hint: Used for scholarship and job-reservation schemes linked to the card. It does not affect whether the certificate is issued.

demoFields.label: Photograph and Signature
demoFields.value: Colour passport photo, JPG under 1 MB, and a scanned signature
demoFields.hint: A plain background, face clearly visible. A thumb impression is accepted in place of a signature.

demoFields.label: Hospital for Assessment
demoFields.hint: Pick from the hospitals the portal lists for your district, or leave it to the CMO office to assign one.

demoSteps: Register on the UDID portal, or the UDID mobile app, and choose 'Apply for Disability Certificate and UDID Card'.
Fill your personal, disability, employment and identity details and upload your photograph, signature, Aadhaar and any existing disability certificate.
Submit the form and note the enrolment number. The CMO office of your district verifies what you have entered.
You are given a medical assessment appointment at a government hospital. Attend it in person — a specialist or a Medical Board examines you and records the type of disability and the percentage.
The board's finding is uploaded, the CMO signs off, and a UDID number is generated.
Download the e-Disability Certificate and the e-UDID card from the portal as soon as they appear — they are valid on their own and you need not wait for the plastic card.
The PVC card is printed centrally and delivered by post. Track it on the portal with your enrolment number.
A certificate given to a child, or one issued for a condition that can change, carries an expiry date and has to be renewed by a fresh assessment.
schemes.helpline: Your district Social Welfare Office or the Chief Medical Officer's office, which processes UDID applications and fixes the medical assessment

schemes.title: PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana
schemes.department: Ministry of New & Renewable Energy
schemes.brief: Put solar panels on your own roof and the government pays a large part of the cost straight into your bank account. A household system of about 3 kW can cover the electricity a normal family uses, up to 300 units a month, and whatever you do not use is sold back to the power company.
schemes.benefit: Subsidy up to Rs.78,000 and up to 300 free units a month
eligibility: An Indian household that owns the roof where the panels will go, with the owner's consent if it is shared
A valid electricity connection in the applicant's own name, with the consumer number on the bill
The roof must be strong enough and get direct sun, with about 100 square feet needed for each kilowatt
The household must not already have taken a central subsidy for a rooftop solar plant
Subsidy is Rs.30,000 per kW for the first 2 kW and Rs.18,000 for the third kW, with Rs.78,000 as the highest amount
documents: Latest electricity bill, showing the consumer number and the sanctioned load
Aadhaar card of the consumer
Proof that you own the roof: sale deed, property tax receipt or allotment letter
Bank passbook and a cancelled cheque, for the subsidy transfer
Recent photograph of the roof, uploaded during the application
Net-meter and inspection papers, which come later from the power company

demoFields.label: State and electricity company (DISCOM)
demoFields.hint: The company named at the top of your electricity bill. Choose it exactly, or your application will not reach anyone.

demoFields.label: Electricity consumer number
demoFields.hint: Printed on your electricity bill, usually at the top. Type it without spaces or dashes.

demoFields.label: Mobile number and email
demoFields.hint: Used for the login OTP and for every message about approval and subsidy. Email is optional but useful.

demoFields.label: Consumer name and address
demoFields.value: Lata Solanki, 12 Sunrise Society, Anand, Gujarat - 388001
demoFields.hint: Must match the name and address on the electricity bill. If the bill is in your late father's name, get it transferred first.

demoFields.label: Sanctioned load (kW)
demoFields.hint: Written on your electricity bill. The solar plant you ask for should not be larger than this, else you must apply to raise the load.

demoFields.label: Solar capacity you want (kW)
demoFields.hint: About 3 kW suits a family using 250 to 300 units a month. Subsidy is capped at 3 kW, so more than that gets no extra money.

demoFields.label: Roof area available (square feet)
demoFields.hint: Measure the clear, shade-free part of the roof. Roughly 100 square feet is needed for each kilowatt.

demoFields.label: Registered vendor chosen
demoFields.hint: Pick only from the vendor list on the portal. Work done by an outside fitter gets no subsidy.

demoFields.label: Bank account number and IFSC
demoFields.hint: Filled in after the plant is installed. The subsidy is credited here, usually within 30 days of commissioning.

demoFields.label: Cancelled cheque
demoFields.value: Photo of cheque with the account name printed
demoFields.hint: Upload a clear photo. The name on the cheque must match the name on the electricity bill.

demoSteps: Open pmsuryaghar.gov.in and click Apply for Rooftop Solar, then register with your state, power company, consumer number and mobile.
Log in with the consumer number and the OTP, and fill the application: sanctioned load, the capacity you want, and the roof area.
Submit and wait for the power company to approve feasibility. This usually takes a few days and comes as an SMS.
After approval, choose a vendor from the registered list on the portal and get the plant installed. Agree the price in writing first.
Once it is fitted, submit the plant details on the portal and apply for the net meter.
The power company installs the net meter and an inspector checks the work.
The commissioning certificate is issued on the portal. Only now add your bank account number and a cancelled cheque.
The subsidy reaches your account in about 30 days. After that, your bill shows only the units you draw over what your roof produces.

schemes.title: PM Ujjwala Yojana LPG Connection
schemes.department: Ministry of Petroleum & Natural Gas
schemes.brief: A free cooking gas connection for a woman of a poor household, so that the kitchen is free of smoke from wood and dung. The government pays the deposit for the cylinder and regulator, and gives the first refill and the stove free. Every refill after that gets a subsidy paid into the bank account.
schemes.benefit: Free connection, first refill and stove, plus Rs.300 subsidy on each refill
eligibility: The applicant must be a woman, aged 18 years or above
No other LPG connection may exist in the household, in anyone's name

The household must belong to one of the listed poor groups: SC or ST, PMAY beneficiary, Antyodaya card holder, most backward class, tea garden worker, forest dweller, island or river-island resident, or any poor family covered by the 14-point declaration
Aadhaar of the applicant, and of all adults in the family, must be given
A woman who has moved and cannot get a ration card in the new place may use a self-declaration of family instead
documents: Aadhaar card of the woman applying, used as identity and address proof
Aadhaar of all adult members of the family
Ration card or state-issued family certificate, or the KYC self-declaration form if you have moved
Bank passbook with account number and IFSC, in the applicant's own name
Recent passport-size photograph
Filled and signed KYC form of the gas company

demoFields.label: Gas company
demoFields.hint: Indane, Bharatgas or HP Gas. Choose the one whose delivery agency is closest to your village or ward.

demoFields.label: Type of connection
demoFields.hint: Choose the Ujjwala option, not the ordinary new connection, otherwise you will have to pay the deposit yourself.

demoFields.label: State, district and distributor
demoFields.value: Uttar Pradesh / Barabanki / Maa Sharda Indane Gramin Vitrak
demoFields.hint: The list shows the agencies near you. Pick one you can actually reach, since the cylinder comes from there.

demoFields.label: Name of the woman applying
demoFields.hint: The connection is given only in a woman's name. Spell it exactly as on her Aadhaar card.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number of the applicant
demoFields.hint: Her own 12-digit number, used both as identity and as address proof.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar of other adults in the family
demoFields.hint: Give the Aadhaar of every adult living in the house. This is how the system checks there is no other gas connection.

demoFields.label: Ration card number
demoFields.hint: Copy it from the ration card. If you have shifted and have no card here, fill the self-declaration of family instead.

demoFields.label: Which poor household category
demoFields.hint: Tick the group your family belongs to: SC, ST, Antyodaya, PMAY, most backward class, tea garden, forest dweller, or the 14-point declaration.

demoFields.label: Full address with PIN code
demoFields.value: Village Rampur Kalan, Post Dariyabad, Barabanki, Uttar Pradesh - 225414
demoFields.hint: Where the cylinder is to be delivered. Add a landmark so the delivery man finds the house.

demoFields.label: Bank account number and IFSC
demoFields.hint: In the applicant's own name. The refill subsidy comes into this account, so it must be Aadhaar-seeded and active.

demoSteps: Open pmuy.gov.in and click Apply for New Ujjwala 2.0 Connection.
Choose your gas company: Indane, Bharatgas or HP Gas. The site takes you to that company's own page.
Select Ujjwala new connection, then your state and district, and pick a distributor near your home.
Fill in the woman applicant's name, Aadhaar, address, ration card and the poor household category you belong to.
Add the Aadhaar of every adult in the family, and the bank account in the applicant's own name.
Upload the photograph and the documents, then submit and note the reference number.
Print the form, sign it, and take it with the original Aadhaar and ration card to the distributor's showroom.
The distributor checks the papers and delivers the cylinder, regulator, pipe and stove. Do not pay anything beyond the printed charges, and take a receipt.
schemes.helpline: 1800-266-6696 / LPG emergency 1906

schemes.title: Andaman & Nicobar e-District Certificates
schemes.department: Administration of the Andaman and Nicobar Islands
schemes.brief: The islands' single window for the certificates a resident needs — income, local certificate, SC and ST certificates, birth and death registration and residence proof. Applying online saves a boat trip, which matters when your tehsil office is on another island.
schemes.benefit: Digitally signed income, local, tribe and residence certificates without travelling to the tehsil
eligibility: Resident of the Andaman and Nicobar Islands, applying in the tehsil where you live
A local certificate needs proof that the family has lived in the islands for the qualifying period
A Scheduled Tribe certificate is issued only for the notified tribes of the islands
An income certificate is valid for one year; a tribe certificate does not expire
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant
Ration card of the family
Residence proof — electricity bill, rent agreement or a Panchayat certificate
Birth certificate or school certificate for date of birth
Salary certificate or an affidavit of income, for an income certificate
Passport-size photograph

demoFields.label: Certificate applied for
demoFields.hint: Income, local, SC, ST, residence, birth or death. Each opens its own form and asks for different proof.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Letter for letter as on Aadhaar. The certificate prints from this entry.

demoFields.label: Father's / Husband's Name
demoFields.hint: Used to identify the family in the tehsil records.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. Identity is confirmed on this and the OTP goes to the linked mobile.

demoFields.label: District / Tehsil / Village or Ward
demoFields.hint: Where you actually live. The Tehsildar of this tehsil signs the certificate.

demoFields.label: Years the family has lived in the islands
demoFields.hint: For a local certificate, say from when. The ration card, school records or an old electricity bill are what prove it.

demoFields.label: Annual Family Income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: For an income certificate, the household's total for the year from every source.

demoFields.label: Purpose
demoFields.hint: Say plainly what it is for. It is recorded but does not restrict where the certificate is used.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The application number and the ready message come here by SMS.

demoSteps: Register on edistrict.andamannicobar.gov.in with your mobile and confirm the OTP, or use a Common Service Centre on your island.
Choose the certificate you need and fill the form from your Aadhaar and ration card.
Upload Aadhaar, the ration card, the residence proof and the income or tribe proof, then submit and note the application number.
The Patwari or the tehsil staff verify the family. Be reachable on the mobile you gave, since an island visit may be replaced by a phone check.
The Tehsildar signs the certificate digitally and it is downloaded from the same login. A digitally signed copy needs no attestation.
If it is delayed beyond the time the service promises, quote the application number to the tehsil office or the Deputy Commissioner's office.
schemes.helpline: Your Tehsildar's office, or the Deputy Commissioner's office at Port Blair

schemes.title: Andaman & Nicobar eServices — Bills, Permits and Payments
schemes.department: Administration of the Andaman and Nicobar Islands
schemes.brief: The islands' online counter for the things residents pay and apply for regularly — electricity and water bills, licences, permits and departmental fees — without a trip to the office. Useful anywhere, essential when the office is a ferry ride away.
schemes.benefit: Electricity, water and departmental payments and applications made from home
eligibility: Resident or consumer in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands
A consumer number for the service you are paying for, as printed on the bill
A mobile number for the OTP and the payment receipt
Any card, net banking or UPI account for the payment
documents: Latest bill showing the consumer number
Aadhaar card, for an application rather than a payment
Address proof for the premises
Mobile number to receive the receipt

demoFields.label: Service wanted
demoFields.hint: Electricity, water, licence fee, permit or a departmental payment. Pick the department first, then the service.

demoFields.label: Consumer Number
demoFields.hint: Printed at the top of your bill. Copy it exactly — a wrong digit pays somebody else's bill and getting it back is slow.

demoFields.label: Consumer Name
demoFields.hint: As printed on the bill, which may differ from Aadhaar. The portal shows the name after you enter the consumer number — check it before paying.

demoFields.label: Billing period / Bill number
demoFields.hint: From the bill in your hand. Paying against the wrong bill number leaves the current one unpaid.

demoFields.label: Amount payable (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: The portal fills this from the department's record. If it differs from your paper bill, pay what the portal shows and take the paper bill to the office.

demoFields.label: Address of the premises
demoFields.hint: Needed for a new connection or a name change, not for an ordinary payment.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The payment receipt and the transaction reference come here by SMS. Keep it until the next bill shows the payment.

demoFields.label: Payment method
demoFields.hint: Card, net banking or UPI. Do not close the browser until the receipt appears, even if the money has left your account.

demoSteps: Open eservices.andamannicobar.gov.in and choose the department and the service you need.
Enter the consumer number from your bill and check that the name and amount the portal shows match your bill before going further.
Pay by card, net banking or UPI and wait for the receipt page. Do not close the browser while the payment is being confirmed.
Download or note the transaction reference and keep it until the next bill shows the payment credited.
If money leaves your account but no receipt appears, do not pay again. Take the transaction reference to the department office — a double payment is refunded, but it takes weeks.
For an application rather than a payment, fill the form, upload Aadhaar and the address proof, and track it by the application number the portal gives you.
schemes.helpline: The office of the department concerned; the Deputy Commissioner's office at Port Blair for anything unresolved

schemes.title: Andhra Pradesh Social Security Pension
schemes.department: Grama Ward Sachivalayam Department, Government of Andhra Pradesh
schemes.brief: Andhra Pradesh pays a monthly pension to old people, widows, people with disability, weavers, toddy tappers, single women and several other groups. The application is made at the Village or Ward Secretariat, not online, and the money is handed over at the door every month by the Volunteer or credited to the bank account.
schemes.benefit: Monthly pension from Rs.3,000, higher for disability and for bedridden pensioners
eligibility: Resident of Andhra Pradesh, in the household registered with the Village or Ward Secretariat
Age 60 or above for old-age pension; no age bar for widow, disability or single-woman pension
Family within the state's limits on land, income, vehicle, electricity use and government service
Disability of 40 per cent or more, certified by SADAREM, for a disability pension
Not drawing another government pension
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant
Rice card of the family
Age proof — Aadhaar, birth certificate or school record
Death certificate of the husband, for a widow pension
SADAREM disability certificate showing 40 per cent or more, for a disability pension
Bank or post office passbook in the applicant's own name
Two passport-size photographs
schemes.submitAt: Your Village or Ward Secretariat — the Welfare and Education Assistant or the Digital Assistant; the mandal MPDO office also accepts it

demoFields.label: Type of pension applied for
demoFields.hint: Old age, widow, disability, single woman, weaver, toddy tapper, transgender, dappu artist, traditional cobbler, ART or fishermen. Each has its own conditions.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: As on Aadhaar. A spelling that differs from the bank record is why a sanctioned pension does not arrive.

demoFields.label: Husband's / Father's Name
demoFields.hint: Write 'Late' before the name if he has died — it matters for a widow pension.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth / Age
demoFields.hint: You must be 60 or above on the day you apply for the old-age pension. Write the date as on the age proof you attach.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. Payment and the yearly life check are both done on this.

demoFields.label: Rice Card Number
demoFields.hint: From the family's rice card. The household's eligibility is checked against it.

demoFields.label: District / Mandal / Village or Ward and Secretariat code
demoFields.hint: The Secretariat code is on the board outside the office. It decides which Volunteer brings the money.

demoFields.label: Bank / Post Office Account and IFSC
demoFields.hint: In the applicant's own name, not a son's or daughter's, and Aadhaar-seeded.

demoFields.label: Whether drawing any other pension
demoFields.hint: Answer truthfully. It is matched against the state pension database, and a false answer cancels the sanction and recovers the money.

demoFields.label: Signature / Thumb Impression with date
demoFields.value: Left thumb impression of Subbamma Gorantla, 22-09-2026
demoFields.hint: A thumb impression is fully valid. The Secretariat staff attest it beside your mark.

demoSteps: Go to your Village or Ward Secretariat and ask the Welfare and Education Assistant for the pension application. There is no fee and no form to buy.
Fill it with the help of the Digital Assistant, attach Aadhaar, the rice card, the age or death or disability proof, the passbook copy and two photographs, and hand it in.
Ask for the acknowledgement with its application number. Without it you cannot follow the case.

The six-step eligibility check runs on the household — land, income, vehicle, electricity use, government service and municipal property. Most rejections are at this stage, and the reason is told to you.
The Volunteer and the Welfare Assistant verify the applicant at home. Be present; a person not found twice is marked untraceable and the file closes.

The MPDO or the Municipal Commissioner sanctions it, usually within 30 to 60 days. From the following month the Volunteer delivers the pension at your door on the first of the month, or it is credited to the account.

Complete the yearly Aadhaar life check when the Volunteer asks, or the pension stops. If it is refused, the reason is on the Beneficiary Management portal and can be corrected and reapplied at the same Secretariat.
schemes.helpline: 1902 — Grama Ward Sachivalayam helpline

schemes.title: Meebhoomi — AP Land Records, Adangal and e-Pattadar Passbook
schemes.department: Revenue Department, Government of Andhra Pradesh
schemes.brief: Meebhoomi is where an Andhra Pradesh farmer sees and downloads their own land record — the Adangal showing possession and the crop sown, the 1-B record of rights, the village map, the FMB sketch and the electronic pattadar passbook. Most of it opens without any login and costs nothing.
schemes.benefit: Free download of Adangal, 1-B, village map, FMB sketch and e-Pattadar passbook
eligibility: Land situated in Andhra Pradesh and recorded in the revenue register
Anyone may view a record; the e-Pattadar passbook and personalised copies need Aadhaar and OTP
For a mutation or a correction, the applicant must be the recorded holder or a legal heir
documents: Survey number, or the pattadar account number, or the owner's name
Aadhaar card, for the e-Pattadar passbook and any personalised record
Existing pattadar passbook, when asking for a correction
Registered sale deed or succession papers, when asking for a mutation

demoFields.label: District / Mandal / Village
demoFields.hint: Pick all three from the lists. The record is stored village by village.

demoFields.label: Search by
demoFields.hint: Survey number, account number, Aadhaar number or owner name. Survey number gives the cleanest result.

demoFields.label: Survey Number
demoFields.hint: Copy it exactly from an old Adangal or the pattadar passbook, including the letter at the end.

demoFields.label: Pattadar Account Number
demoFields.hint: The khata number. It covers all your survey numbers in that one village, so it is the quicker search if you hold several plots.

demoFields.label: Pattadar Name
demoFields.hint: Spelt as on the land record, which may differ from Aadhaar. Search by the record's spelling, then get it corrected if it is wrong.

demoFields.label: Record wanted
demoFields.hint: Your Adangal for possession and crop, 1-B for the record of rights, FMB for the measurement sketch, village map for the layout.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number (for e-Passbook only)
demoFields.hint: Needed only for the electronic pattadar passbook and personalised records, with an OTP to the linked mobile.

demoFields.label: Year / Fasli
demoFields.hint: The Adangal is kept year by year. Take the current year unless an office has asked for an older one.

demoSteps: Open meebhoomi.ap.gov.in and choose the record you want — Your Adangal, 1-B, village map, FMB sketch or e-Pattadar passbook.
Select district, mandal and village, then search by survey number, account number, Aadhaar or name. No login is needed for the ordinary views.
Check the extent, the pattadar name and the crop entry against what you know. Download or print the record; there is no fee.
For the e-Pattadar passbook, enter your Aadhaar and the OTP sent to the linked mobile.

If the record is wrong — a name misspelt, an extent short, a dead holder still shown — do not try to fix it here. Apply for a mutation or correction through AP Seva or at your Village Secretariat, with the sale deed or succession papers.
Keep a downloaded Adangal and 1-B with your papers. Farm subsidy, crop loan and input assistance applications all ask for them.
schemes.helpline: Your Village Secretariat, or the mandal Tahsildar's office

schemes.title: Jnanabhumi — AP Post-Matric Scholarship and Fee Reimbursement
schemes.department: AP State Council of Higher Education, with Social, BC, Tribal and Minority Welfare Departments
schemes.brief: Andhra Pradesh pays the college tuition fee of SC, ST, BC, EBC, minority and disabled students directly to the institution, and a separate maintenance amount to the student for food and hostel. Both are applied for on Jnanabhumi, once a year, after the college has admitted you.
schemes.benefit: Full tuition fee reimbursement paid to the college, plus maintenance charges to the student
eligibility: Student of Andhra Pradesh studying an approved course in a recognised institution
Belongs to SC, ST, BC, EBC, minority or disabled category, with a valid caste certificate
Family income within the limit for the category, proved by a current income certificate
Admitted through the notified counselling process for the course
Attendance of at least 75 per cent; the sanction is withheld for a student who stops attending
documents: Aadhaar card of the student
Caste certificate number issued in Andhra Pradesh
Income certificate number, issued within the last year
Admission or allotment letter from the counselling
Bank passbook in the student's own name, Aadhaar-seeded
Class 10 and Class 12 marks memos
Fee receipt paid to the college

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number of the Student
demoFields.hint: The student's own, not a parent's. The maintenance money is paid into the Aadhaar-seeded account behind it.

demoFields.label: Student Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Exactly as on Aadhaar. The college record and the bank record must agree with this or the payment fails.

demoFields.label: Caste Certificate Number
demoFields.hint: The number on your integrated caste certificate. Type it, do not guess — the portal checks it against the revenue database.

demoFields.label: Income Certificate Number
demoFields.hint: Must be a certificate issued within the last year. An expired one is the single commonest reason an application is rejected.

demoFields.label: Course and Year of Study
demoFields.hint: The course as the college has registered it, and which year you are entering now.

demoFields.label: College Name and Code
demoFields.value: Government College of Nursing, Kakinada — CODE GCNK01
demoFields.hint: Pick the college from the list on the portal. If it is not listed, the college has not registered and must do so first.

demoFields.label: Admission / Allotment Number
demoFields.hint: From the counselling allotment letter. A management-quota seat outside counselling does not qualify.

demoFields.label: Bank Account Number and IFSC
demoFields.hint: In the student's own name and Aadhaar-seeded. A parent's account is the usual reason the maintenance amount bounces.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: Sanction and payment messages come here. Give a number the student keeps through the course.

demoSteps: Get the caste certificate and a fresh income certificate in hand first, both from AP Seva. Jnanabhumi validates the numbers against the revenue database, so an expired income certificate stops everything.
Register on jnanabhumi.ap.gov.in with your Aadhaar and mobile, confirm the OTP, and fill the application for the current academic year.
Enter the college and course from the portal's own list, the admission number from the allotment letter, and your own Aadhaar-seeded bank account.
Submit and note the application number, then take the printout to your college office — the college has to verify and forward it, and nothing moves until it does.
The Welfare and Education Assistant at your Village or Ward Secretariat carries out the field verification of the family's income and caste.
The welfare department sanctions it; the tuition fee goes straight to the college and the maintenance amount into your account by DBT. Track both on the portal with your application number.
Renew it every year. It is not automatic — a fresh income certificate and a fresh application are needed for each year of the course.
schemes.helpline: Your college scholarship section, or the Welfare and Education Assistant at your Village or Ward Secretariat

schemes.title: APPSC Recruitment — One Time Profile Registration
schemes.department: Andhra Pradesh Public Service Commission
schemes.brief: Every Andhra Pradesh state government job advertised by the Public Service Commission — Group 1, 2, 3 and 4, engineering and technical posts — is applied for through one profile called OTPR. You build the profile once with your education and identity details, and after that each notification takes only a few minutes to apply to.
schemes.benefit: One profile for every APPSC recruitment, with hall tickets and results in the same place
eligibility: Indian citizen meeting the age limits in the notification, usually 18 to 42 with relaxation for SC, ST, BC and disability
Educational qualification as the notification requires, held on the closing date
Local status in Andhra Pradesh where the post is reserved for local candidates
Each notification sets its own conditions; the OTPR profile by itself is not an application
documents: Aadhaar card
Class 10 certificate for date of birth
Degree or diploma certificates and marks memos
Caste certificate, for a reserved category
SADAREM disability certificate, where claiming that reservation
Recent passport photograph and a scanned signature
Local status or study certificates for the last seven years of schooling

demoFields.label: Candidate Name (as on Class 10 certificate)
demoFields.hint: The Class 10 certificate governs, not Aadhaar, if the two differ. Every later certificate is matched against this.

demoFields.label: Father's Name
demoFields.hint: As on the Class 10 certificate.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth
demoFields.hint: As on the Class 10 certificate. Age limits are counted from this date and it cannot be changed after the profile is created.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits, used to keep one candidate to one profile. A second profile gets both cancelled.

demoFields.label: Category and sub-category
demoFields.hint: Claim only what you can produce a certificate for. Age relaxation and fee concession both follow from this.

demoFields.label: Local Status (district)
demoFields.hint: Decided by where you studied Classes 4 to 10. Many posts are reserved for locals of a zone, so fill it carefully.

demoFields.label: Educational Qualification
demoFields.hint: Course, university, year of passing and marks. The qualification must be complete on the notification's closing date.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number and Email
demoFields.hint: The OTPR ID, every notification alert and the hall ticket link come here. Do not use a friend's.

demoFields.label: Photograph and Signature
demoFields.value: Colour photo under 50 KB and signature under 30 KB, both JPG
demoFields.hint: Recent photo, plain background, face clear. A signature scanned from white paper in black ink.

demoSteps: Open psc.ap.gov.in and create the One Time Profile Registration with your name and date of birth exactly as on the Class 10 certificate. This is the one thing that cannot be corrected freely later.
Fill in education, category, local status and identity details, upload the photograph and signature, and confirm the mobile OTP. Write down the OTPR ID.
When a notification you qualify for is published, open it from the same site, log in with the OTPR ID and apply — the profile fills most of the form for you.
Pay the application fee and the examination fee online. SC, ST, BC, disabled and unemployed candidates are exempt from the examination fee on producing the certificate.
Keep the filled application printout and the payment receipt. Download the hall ticket about a week before the exam from the same login.

Results, answer keys and the final selection list are published on psc.ap.gov.in. Certificate verification comes after the written stage, where you must produce the originals of everything you claimed.
Keep the OTPR profile current. An education or category detail that is out of date on the closing date is treated as false and the candidature is cancelled.
schemes.helpline: 0866-2988333 — APPSC candidate helpdesk

schemes.title: Andhra Pradesh Income Certificate
schemes.department: Grama Ward Sachivalayam Department, Government of Andhra Pradesh
schemes.brief: The income certificate stating a family's yearly earnings, issued by the Tahsildar. Almost every welfare scheme, fee reimbursement and reserved seat in Andhra Pradesh asks for it. It is applied for on AP Seva, the state's single window, and the signed certificate is downloaded from the same site.
schemes.benefit: Digitally signed income certificate, valid for one year
eligibility: Resident of Andhra Pradesh, applying in the mandal where the family lives
Applied for by the head of the family, covering the whole household's income
Aadhaar linked to a working mobile number, since login is by OTP
A fresh certificate is needed each year; the old one expires twelve months from issue
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant
Ration card or rice card of the family
Address proof — electricity bill, property tax receipt or ration card
Salary certificate or Form 16 for a salaried applicant
Land record (Adangal or 1-B) where the family income is from farming
Passport-size photograph

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Your own twelve digits. The login OTP goes to the mobile linked to it, so it must be a number you hold.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Letter for letter as on Aadhaar. The certificate prints from this entry.

demoFields.label: Father's / Husband's Name
demoFields.hint: Used to tell apart families with the same surname in one village.

demoFields.label: District / Mandal / Village or Ward
demoFields.hint: Where the family actually lives. Your mandal Tahsildar's office handles the file, so this decides where it goes.

demoFields.label: Annual Family Income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: The whole household's earnings for the year, from all sources — wages, farming, rent, pension. Keep it consistent with any salary certificate you upload.

demoFields.label: Source of Income
demoFields.hint: Plain words are fine. Name every earning member's work, not only the head's.

demoFields.label: Caste / Category
demoFields.hint: As on your caste certificate. It is recorded on the income certificate and is checked against welfare quotas later.

demoFields.label: Purpose
demoFields.value: Fee reimbursement for my daughter's degree course
demoFields.hint: Say plainly what it is for. It is asked for the record and does not restrict where you use the certificate.

demoFields.label: Ration Card / Rice Card Number
demoFields.hint: From the front of the rice card. It is how the office pulls up the rest of your family's details.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The application number and the ready-to-download message come here by SMS.

demoSteps: Open apseva.ap.gov.in, log in with your Aadhaar number and the OTP, and choose Revenue Department, then Income Certificate. If you cannot do this at home, the Digital Assistant at your Village or Ward Secretariat files it for you free.
Fill the form, taking the spelling of names and the village from your Aadhaar and rice card, and state the family income honestly — it is cross-checked against land, vehicle and electricity records.
Upload the Aadhaar, the rice card, the address proof and the income proof. Each file must be a clear scan or photograph.
Pay the notified fee online and note the application number on the acknowledgement; the same number arrives by SMS.
The Village or Ward Revenue Secretary verifies the family, usually within a week, and may visit or call. Keep the originals at home.

The Tahsildar signs the certificate digitally, normally within 15 to 30 days, and it can then be downloaded from AP Seva with the application number. A downloaded copy with the digital signature is fully valid — it needs no further attestation.
If the deadline passes with nothing happening, raise a grievance on the same portal quoting the application number, then take it to the Tahsildar's office.
schemes.helpline: 1100 — AP Government call centre

schemes.title: Andhra Pradesh Integrated Caste Certificate
schemes.department: Grama Ward Sachivalayam Department, Government of Andhra Pradesh
schemes.brief: The caste certificate that proves SC, ST, BC or EBC status in Andhra Pradesh. It is called 'integrated' because one certificate carries caste, income and nativity together, so most offices accept it alone. Unlike the income certificate it does not expire, so it is worth getting right the first time.
schemes.benefit: Integrated caste certificate, issued once and valid permanently
eligibility: Resident of Andhra Pradesh whose family belongs to a caste on the state's SC, ST, BC or EBC list
The caste is traced through the father's family record, so his caste certificate or school record helps most
A married woman keeps the caste she was born into; it does not change on marriage
One certificate per person, applied for in the mandal where the family lives
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant
Father's caste certificate, or that of a paternal uncle or grandfather
School transfer certificate or Class 10 marks memo showing the caste entry
Ration card or rice card of the family
Address proof — electricity bill or property tax receipt
Passport-size photograph
Declaration signed by the applicant on the prescribed format

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. Login and identity both run on this, and the OTP goes to the linked mobile.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: As on Aadhaar. A mismatch with the school record is the commonest reason a caste file is sent back.

demoFields.label: Father's Name
demoFields.hint: The caste is verified through the father's family, so spell his name as it appears on his own certificate.

demoFields.label: Caste claimed
demoFields.hint: Pick from the state's list rather than typing it. A spelling that does not match the list will not be accepted.

demoFields.label: Sub-caste / Group
demoFields.hint: SC, ST, BC-A to BC-E, or EBC. If you are unsure which BC group your caste sits in, the list on the portal says.

demoFields.label: Religion
demoFields.hint: Recorded because SC status in particular is tied to religion in law.

demoFields.label: District / Mandal / Village or Ward
demoFields.hint: Where the family lives now. The Tahsildar of this mandal signs the certificate.

demoFields.label: Family caste reference (earlier certificate number, if any)
demoFields.hint: If anyone in the father's family already holds a caste certificate, give its number. It is the single fastest way to get yours cleared.

demoFields.label: Purpose
demoFields.hint: Written for the record. The certificate can be used anywhere once issued.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: Application number and status messages arrive here.

demoSteps: Collect the father's caste certificate or the school record showing the caste entry before you start. Nearly every rejection is for want of this one paper.
Log in to apseva.ap.gov.in with Aadhaar and OTP and choose Revenue Department, then Integrated Certificate. The Digital Assistant at the Village or Ward Secretariat will do it for you if you cannot.
Fill the form, picking the caste from the list rather than typing it, and upload Aadhaar, the family caste proof, the school record, the rice card and the address proof.
Pay the notified fee and keep the application number from the acknowledgement.
The Revenue Inspector verifies the family, and for a Scheduled Tribe claim the file may also go to the Tribal Welfare officer, which adds time.

The Tahsildar signs it digitally, usually within 30 days, and you download the certificate from AP Seva. Check the caste spelling and your father's name on it at once — correcting them later means applying again.
If it is refused, the order says why. You may appeal to the Revenue Divisional Officer with the missing proof rather than start a fresh application.
schemes.helpline: 1100 — AP Government call centre

schemes.title: Andhra Pradesh Rice Card
schemes.department: Civil Supplies Department, Government of Andhra Pradesh
schemes.brief: Andhra Pradesh's ration card is called the rice card. It brings subsidised rice and other commodities from the fair price shop, and it is also the household identity that most state welfare schemes check first. New cards, added names and removed names are all applied for on AP Seva.
schemes.benefit: Subsidised rice and commodities at the fair price shop, and the household identity used by state welfare schemes
eligibility: Family resident in Andhra Pradesh and not holding a ration card elsewhere in India
Household within the state's eligibility limits on land, income, vehicle and electricity use
The eldest woman of the family aged 18 or above is recorded as the head of the household
Every member's Aadhaar must be given; a name without Aadhaar draws no ration
documents: Aadhaar cards of every member of the family
Address proof — electricity bill, house tax receipt or rent agreement
Deletion certificate from the earlier card, if the family or a member has moved
Marriage certificate, for a bride whose name is being added
Birth certificate, for a newborn being added
Gas connection number and bank passbook copy

demoFields.label: Type of application
demoFields.value: Add a member to an existing card
demoFields.hint: New card, add a member, remove a member, split a card, or correct a detail. Pick one; each takes a different set of papers.

demoFields.label: Existing Rice Card Number
demoFields.hint: From the front of the card. Leave it blank only if you are applying for a brand new card.

demoFields.label: Head of the Household
demoFields.hint: The eldest woman of the family, aged 18 or above. The card is issued in her name.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar of the Head
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. The whole family's entitlement is tracked against this.

demoFields.label: Member to be added, relation and Aadhaar
demoFields.hint: Name as on that person's own Aadhaar, and how she or he is related to the head of the household.

demoFields.label: Reason and supporting certificate
demoFields.value: Marriage on 12-05-2026; deletion certificate from parents' card at Chirala, Bapatla district
demoFields.hint: A bride needs the marriage certificate and the deletion certificate from her parents' card. A newborn needs only the birth certificate.

demoFields.label: District / Mandal / Village or Ward
demoFields.hint: Where the family lives. The fair price shop is allotted from this address and the inspector verifies here.

demoFields.label: Annual Family Income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: The household's total for the year. It decides whether the family stays inside the eligibility limits.

demoFields.label: Gas Connection Number
demoFields.hint: From the gas book. It is asked to catch a household registered twice.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The application number and the ready message come here by SMS.

demoSteps: Log in to apseva.ap.gov.in with Aadhaar and OTP and choose Civil Supplies, then the rice card service you need. The Digital Assistant at your Village or Ward Secretariat files it free if you cannot.
Fill in every member who eats from the same kitchen, with the exact Aadhaar for each. The monthly rice is counted per name, so one missing member costs the family every month.
Upload Aadhaar for all members, the address proof and, where someone has moved in, the deletion certificate from the old card.
Submit and keep the application number from the acknowledgement.
The Volunteer and the Village or Ward Revenue Secretary verify the household at your address, usually within two weeks.
The card is issued or updated and can be downloaded from AP Seva. Check every name and Aadhaar on it before you rely on it.
Get the new member's Aadhaar e-KYC done on the machine at your fair price shop. Until that is done the family's quantity does not increase.
schemes.helpline: 1967 — Civil Supplies toll free

schemes.title: Arunachal eServices — Certificates and Departmental Services
schemes.department: Government of Arunachal Pradesh
schemes.brief: Arunachal Pradesh's e-District system, where a resident applies for the income, Scheduled Tribe, permanent residence and other certificates without going to the district headquarters — which in this state can be a day's journey.
schemes.benefit: Income, Scheduled Tribe and permanent residence certificates applied for online
eligibility: Resident of Arunachal Pradesh, applying in the district where you live
A Scheduled Tribe certificate is issued only for the tribes notified for Arunachal Pradesh
A permanent residence certificate needs proof that the family has lived in the state for the qualifying period
An income certificate is valid for one year
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant
Ration card of the family
Father's Scheduled Tribe certificate, for a tribe certificate
School certificate or birth certificate for date of birth
Residence proof — electricity bill or a certificate from the Gaon Burah or the village authority
Passport-size photograph

demoFields.label: Certificate applied for
demoFields.hint: Income, Scheduled Tribe, permanent residence, dependency or character certificate. Each has its own form and proof.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Letter for letter as on Aadhaar. The certificate prints from this entry.

demoFields.label: Father's Name
demoFields.hint: For a tribe certificate this decides the case — tribe is traced through the father's family record.

demoFields.label: Tribe claimed
demoFields.hint: Pick from the notified list for Arunachal Pradesh. A tribe notified in another state does not qualify here.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. Identity is confirmed on this and the OTP goes to the linked mobile.

demoFields.label: District / Circle / Village
demoFields.hint: Where the family lives. The Deputy Commissioner or the Extra Assistant Commissioner of this circle signs.

demoFields.label: Annual Family Income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: For an income certificate, the household's total for the year from every source.

demoFields.label: Recommendation of the Gaon Burah or village authority
demoFields.value: Gaon Burah, Kheel village — signed and stamped
demoFields.hint: Most certificates here need the village authority's recommendation. Get it before you apply, not after.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The application number and the ready message come here by SMS.

demoSteps: Get the recommendation of your Gaon Burah or village authority first. Almost every certificate in Arunachal Pradesh needs it and the file stops without it.
Register on eservice.arunachal.gov.in with your mobile, confirm the OTP, and choose the certificate.
Fill the form and upload Aadhaar, the ration card, the father's tribe certificate where relevant, and the village recommendation.
Submit and note the application number. A Common Service Centre or the district e-District counter will file it for you if the network at home is poor.
The circle officer verifies and the Deputy Commissioner's office issues the certificate.
Download the signed certificate from the same login. Check the tribe name and your father's name before you rely on it, because a correction means applying again.
schemes.helpline: Your circle officer, or the Deputy Commissioner's office of your district

schemes.title: Arunachal Pradesh Inner Line Permit (e-ILP)
schemes.department: Department of Political, Government of Arunachal Pradesh
schemes.brief: Any Indian who is not a resident of Arunachal Pradesh needs an Inner Line Permit to enter the state. It used to mean queuing at a liaison office; the e-ILP portal issues it online in a day or two, and the permit is shown on a phone at the check gate.
schemes.benefit: Inner Line Permit issued online, valid for the days and districts you ask for
eligibility: Indian citizen who is not a permanent resident of Arunachal Pradesh
A temporary permit is for a visit; a regular permit is for work or a longer stay and needs a sponsor
One permit per person; children travelling with a parent are added to that permit
Foreign nationals need a Protected Area Permit instead, not this
documents: Aadhaar card, voter card or passport as photo identity
Recent passport-size photograph
Travel details — the districts you will visit and the dates
Sponsor's details, for a regular permit for work
Vehicle registration number, if you are driving in

demoFields.label: Type of permit
demoFields.hint: Temporary for a visit, regular for work or a long stay. A regular permit needs a sponsor in the state.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name (as on the photo ID)
demoFields.hint: Exactly as on the identity document you upload. The check gate compares the two.

demoFields.label: Photo Identity type and number
demoFields.hint: Aadhaar, voter card or passport. Carry the same document with you, because it is checked at the gate.

demoFields.label: Districts to be visited
demoFields.hint: Name every district on your route. The permit is valid only for the districts written on it, and the gate turns you back for the rest.

demoFields.label: Dates of travel
demoFields.hint: From and to. Ask for a couple of days more than you plan — extending a permit from inside the state is harder than getting it right now.

demoFields.label: Purpose of visit
demoFields.hint: Tourism, business, work, or visiting family. A work purpose turns it into a regular permit needing a sponsor.

demoFields.label: Persons travelling with you
demoFields.hint: Children travelling with a parent go on the same permit. Adults each need their own.

demoFields.label: Vehicle Registration Number
demoFields.hint: Fill it if you are driving in. It is checked at the gate along with the permit.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number and Email
demoFields.hint: The permit comes here as a downloadable file. Save it to your phone before you set off — the network on the road is poor.

demoSteps: Apply on eilp.arunachal.gov.in at least a few days before you travel. Most temporary permits come within one or two working days.
Fill the form, naming every district on your route. A permit that does not list a district will not get you past its gate.
Upload your photo identity and photograph, pay the fee online and note the application number.
Wait for the approval message, then download the permit and save it to your phone. Print a copy too, since the network in the hills is unreliable.
Carry the same identity document you uploaded. At the check gate the permit and the document are compared.
If you need to stay longer or visit a district not on the permit, apply for an extension before the permit expires rather than after.
schemes.helpline: The Deputy Commissioner's office of the district you are entering

schemes.title: Sewa Setu — Assam Certificates and Public Services
schemes.department: Administrative Reforms, Training, Pension and Public Grievances Department, Government of Assam
schemes.brief: Sewa Setu is the one place an Assam resident applies for a certificate or a departmental service. It carries 307 services of many departments — income, caste and Permanent Residence Certificate, land and revenue work, trade licences, employment exchange registration and scheme applications. It has taken over the older RTPS Assam portal, which now only runs the login and the appeal at the back. Services notified under the Assam Right to Public Services Act carry a fixed number of days for the officer to decide, and the count starts the moment you submit.
schemes.benefit: 307 Assam government services on one mobile-OTP login, each with a time limit fixed by law
eligibility: Resident of Assam, applying in the district and revenue circle where you actually live
Permanent Residence Certificate: you or your family must have lived in Assam continuously and be able to show a land, school or voter record to prove it
Caste certificate: your community must be in Assam's notified SC, ST (Plains), ST (Hills) or OBC/MOBC list, and the claim is checked against your father's record
Income certificate: the figure is the whole family's income for the financial year from every source, not only salary
A mobile number that stays with you, because registration, every status message and the appeal all run on OTP to that number
No fee for most certificates; where a service charges one, the amount is shown before payment
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant
Proof of address in Assam — voter ID, ration card, electricity bill or the Gaon Panchayat certificate
Date of birth proof — school certificate, birth certificate or PAN
Father's or grandfather's caste certificate, land document or 1951 NRC/electoral entry, for a caste or residence certificate
Income proof — salary certificate, Form 16, or the Gaon Burha / ward member's income statement
Land document (jamabandi or patta), where the service is a revenue one
Recent passport-size photograph, scanned
Scanned signature

demoFields.label: Select Service
demoFields.value: Issue of Income Certificate (Revenue and Disaster Management)
demoFields.hint: Search the service by name first. Each of the 307 services has its own form, its own document list and its own time limit, so picking the wrong one means starting again.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name
demoFields.hint: Spell it exactly as on Aadhaar. The certificate is printed from this box and a spelling mistake later needs a fresh application.

demoFields.label: Father's / Husband's Name
demoFields.hint: As on Aadhaar. For a caste or residence certificate the officer traces the claim through the father's record, so this must match the document you upload.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth
demoFields.hint: As on the school certificate or birth certificate you are uploading, not from memory.

demoFields.label: Gender
demoFields.hint: As on Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: District / Revenue Circle / Village or Ward
demoFields.hint: Give the place you actually live. The file goes to the Circle Officer of the circle named here, and naming the wrong circle sends it to an officer who cannot decide it.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: The 12 digits on your own Aadhaar. The name and date of birth you typed above are matched against it.

demoFields.label: Annual Family Income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: Everything the whole family earned in the financial year — wages, farm income, shop income, rent. Understating it to fit a scheme gets the certificate cancelled later.

demoFields.label: Purpose of the Certificate
demoFields.value: Scholarship application for daughter's college admission
demoFields.hint: Say what you need it for. Some offices print the purpose on the certificate and the institution that asked for it checks this line.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The acknowledgement number, every stage of the enquiry and the message that the certificate is ready all come here. Use your own number, not a cyber cafe's.

demoSteps: Open sewasetu.assam.gov.in and register once with your mobile number and the OTP. Keep the login — the same one works for all 307 services.
Search for the service you need, read its document list and its time limit, then fill the form and upload the scans in the sizes the page states.
Submit. Note down the acknowledgement number the screen shows and the same number that arrives by SMS — everything after this is tracked with it.

The file reaches the Circle Officer or the concerned dealing officer, who verifies it and may call for the original documents. Sewa Setu also runs automated checks on some documents, so an obvious mismatch is caught at this stage.
Track the application on the portal by the acknowledgement number. The screen shows which officer is holding it and how many of the sanctioned days remain.
When it is approved, download the digitally signed certificate from the portal and print it. The signed PDF is valid on its own — no office stamp is needed on top of it.

If the time limit passes with no decision, file the appeal from the same login under the Right to Public Services Act, or call 1800-345-3574. Assisted filing is available at any Common Service Centre or Public Facilitation Centre if the upload is the problem.
schemes.helpline: 1800-345-3574 — Sewa Setu Assam toll-free

schemes.title: Kritagyata — Assam Pension Portal
schemes.department: Pension Cell, Administrative Reforms, Training, Pension and Public Grievances Department, Government of Assam
schemes.brief: Kritagyata is the Assam government's pension portal, listed on assam.gov.in as the state's pension-assistance system. A pension case is submitted here, moves through the office on the same portal, and can be tracked by the applicant at every stage. It covers old-age and other social security pensions along with pension case processing and assistance. The amount depends on which pension is sanctioned, and the sanction order shown on the portal states it in figures.
schemes.benefit: Monthly pension paid straight into the beneficiary's own bank account, with the sanction order and every instalment visible on the portal
eligibility: Permanent resident of Assam, applying in the district where you live
Old-age pension: 60 years of age or above on the date of the application
Disability pension: a disability certificate or UDID card showing 40 percent or more disability
Widow pension: a widow with no regular source of income of her own
The household should be below the poverty line or hold a priority or Antyodaya ration card, and the same person must not already draw a service pension or another government pension
A bank account in the applicant's own name, seeded with Aadhaar, because payment is by direct transfer and a joint or relative's account is rejected
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant
Age proof — school certificate, birth certificate, or the age entry in the voter roll for an old-age pension
Bank passbook first page showing the account number, IFSC and the name, with Aadhaar seeded
BPL or ration card of the family
Death certificate of the husband, for a widow pension
Disability certificate or UDID card, for a disability pension
Recent passport-size photograph
Residence proof — Gaon Panchayat or ward certificate

demoFields.label: Type of Pension applied for
demoFields.hint: Old age, widow or disability. Each has its own age and proof requirement, and only one can be drawn by the same person.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name
demoFields.hint: As on Aadhaar and on the bank passbook. If the two differ, get the bank record corrected first — the payment fails on a name mismatch, not on anything else.

demoFields.label: Father's / Husband's Name
demoFields.hint: As on Aadhaar. For a widow pension write the husband's name exactly as it appears on his death certificate.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth / Age
demoFields.hint: Copy it from the age proof you are uploading. For an old-age pension the officer counts 60 years from this date, so a guessed year gets the case rejected.

demoFields.label: Gender
demoFields.hint: As on Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: District / Revenue Circle / Village or Ward
demoFields.value: Jorhat / Jorhat East Revenue Circle / Baruabamungaon
demoFields.hint: The pension case is sanctioned by the office of the district named here, so give the place you actually live in.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: The 12 digits on your own Aadhaar. The same number must be seeded with your bank account or the transfer will not go through.

demoFields.label: Ration Card Number and category
demoFields.hint: Priority, Antyodaya or BPL. This is what the office uses to check that the household qualifies.

demoFields.label: Bank Account Number and IFSC
demoFields.hint: An account in the pensioner's own name only. Copy both from the passbook — one wrong digit in the IFSC holds the money up for months.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The acknowledgement number, the sanction message and each payment alert come to this number. Give a number that stays with the family.

demoSteps: Open kritagyata.assam.gov.in and register with your mobile number and the OTP.
Choose the pension you are applying for, fill the form, and upload the age proof, the bank passbook page, the ration card and the photograph.
Submit and write down the acknowledgement number. Keep it — every question you ask at the office later will be answered against this number.

The case is verified at the Gaon Panchayat or ward level and then by the Social Welfare section of the district office. Someone may visit or call to confirm that you live there and are not drawing another pension.
Track the case on the portal by the acknowledgement number. It shows which officer is holding it and whether it has been sanctioned.
On sanction, the order appears on the portal with the monthly amount written in figures. Read it and keep a printout.

The money starts arriving in the seeded bank account by direct transfer. If a month is missed, check the bank first for an Aadhaar-seeding failure, then take the sanction order and the acknowledgement number to the Social Welfare section of your District Commissioner's office.
schemes.helpline: No toll-free number is published for Kritagyata. Take the case to the Social Welfare section of your District Commissioner's office, or to the Circle Office or Gaon Panchayat that forwarded it.

schemes.title: Bihar Bhumi — Jamabandi, Mutation (Dakhil-Kharij) and LPC
schemes.department: Revenue and Land Reforms Department, Government of Bihar
schemes.brief: Bihar Bhumi is where a landholder sees and prints the jamabandi panji, the khatiyan and Register-II for their own plot, pays the land revenue (lagan), and applies online for mutation after a purchase or a death (dakhil-kharij), for a Land Possession Certificate, and for correction of a wrong entry through Parimarjan Plus. Viewing and printing the record costs nothing and needs no login.
schemes.benefit: Free view and download of jamabandi and khatiyan, and online application for mutation, LPC and record correction
eligibility: Land situated in Bihar and entered in the revenue register of its circle
Anyone may view and print a jamabandi or khatiyan; no login is needed for that
For a mutation, the applicant must be the buyer under a registered sale deed or the legal heir of the recorded raiyat
For a Land Possession Certificate, the applicant must be the recorded holder in a live jamabandi with the lagan paid up to date
For Parimarjan Plus, the applicant must produce the document that shows what the correct entry should be
documents: Registered sale deed (kewala), for a mutation after a purchase
Death certificate and the heirship (vanshavali) papers, for a mutation after a death
Latest online lagan receipt for that jamabandi
Copy of the existing jamabandi panji or khatiyan
Aadhaar card and mobile number of the applicant
Land details — district, circle, mauza, thana number, khata and khesra
Passport-size photograph of the applicant

demoFields.label: Service Selected
demoFields.hint: Mutation, Land Possession Certificate, Parimarjan Plus correction, jamabandi view or online lagan payment. Pick one.

demoFields.label: District / Circle (Anchal)
demoFields.hint: The circle where the land lies, not where you live. The Circle Officer of this anchal decides the case.

demoFields.label: Mauza (village) and Thana Number
demoFields.hint: Both are printed on the old jamabandi or the khatiyan. The thana number fixes which village record is searched.

demoFields.label: Khata Number and Khesra Number
demoFields.hint: Copy them from the deed and the jamabandi exactly. A single digit wrong opens the wrong plot.

demoFields.label: Area of the Plot
demoFields.hint: Write the area in decimal as it stands in the sale deed, not a rounded figure.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name and Father's Name
demoFields.value: Manoj Kumar Ram, son of Late Sitaram Ram
demoFields.hint: The buyer's or the heir's name, spelt as in the deed and on Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number and Mobile
demoFields.hint: Hearing dates and the order are messaged to this number, so give one you check.

demoFields.label: Deed Number, Date and Registry Office
demoFields.value: Deed No. 4721 of 2026, Sub-Registrar, Nathnagar, Bhagalpur
demoFields.hint: From the registered sale deed. Leave it blank only for a mutation after a death.

demoFields.label: Previous Raiyat's Name and Jamabandi Number
demoFields.hint: The seller or the deceased holder, as the running jamabandi shows the name. Find it on the view page first.

demoFields.label: Uploads — sale deed, lagan receipt, Aadhaar, photograph
demoFields.hint: Scan every page of the deed. A half-uploaded deed is the commonest reason a case is rejected at the first hearing.

demoSteps: Open biharbhumi.bihar.gov.in and first view your jamabandi panji free — choose district, circle and mauza and search by khata, khesra or the raiyat's name. Print it and read it carefully.
Pay any pending lagan online on the same portal and keep the receipt. A mutation or an LPC will not move while the land revenue is unpaid.
Register as a citizen with your mobile and OTP, choose dakhil-kharij, and enter the deed number, khata, khesra and area exactly as written in the deed.
Upload the sale deed or the heirship papers, the lagan receipt, Aadhaar and the photograph, submit, and keep the case number from the acknowledgement.

The Circle Officer (Anchal Adhikari) hears the case at the circle office and the seller or an objector may be called. Follow the hearing dates on the status page with your case number and attend when called.
When the order is passed, the new jamabandi opens in your name. Download it and check the khata, khesra, area and the spelling of your name at once.
If an entry is wrong, do not file a fresh mutation. Use Parimarjan Plus on the same portal with the paper that proves the correct entry, or appeal to the DCLR of your sub-division.
schemes.helpline: The Circle Office (Anchal Karyalaya) of your block, or the DCLR of your sub-division

schemes.title: Bihar Student Credit Card (BSCC)
schemes.department: Planning and Development Department, Government of Bihar — Saat Nishchay Yuva Upmission
schemes.brief: A Bihar student who has passed Class 12 can take an education loan of up to Rs 4 lakh for a higher, professional or technical course, with the state government standing guarantee, so no collateral and no guarantor are needed. The application is made on the Saat Nishchay Yuva Upmission (MNSSBY) portal; the loan is sanctioned and paid out by BSEFCL. Only the colleges and courses on the approved list published on the portal qualify.
schemes.benefit: Education loan up to Rs 4 lakh at 4 per cent simple interest, and 1 per cent for a woman, transgender or divyang student
eligibility: Passed Class 12 or an equivalent examination from a recognised board
Permanent resident of Bihar
Admitted to a course and an institution that appear on the approved list on the portal — a college outside that list cannot be funded
Aged not more than 25 years when applying
Not already taking another government education loan for the same course
No collateral and no guarantor are needed; the state government guarantees the loan
documents: Aadhaar card of the student and of the co-applicant (mother, father or guardian)
Class 10 and Class 12 marksheets and certificates
Admission or allotment letter from the college
Fee demand letter or fee structure on the institution's letterhead
Residence certificate of Bihar
Bank passbook of the student and of the co-applicant
Two passport-size photographs each of the student and the co-applicant
PAN card and a recent electricity bill of the house, asked for at the DRCC
schemes.portalName: MNSSBY — Saat Nishchay Yuva Upmission portal

demoFields.label: Scheme Applied For
demoFields.hint: The same login also carries the self-help allowance and Kushal Yuva Program. Choose the student credit card.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name
demoFields.hint: As on Aadhaar and the Class 10 certificate. The two must agree.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: The student's own twelve digits, entered at registration itself.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth
demoFields.hint: From the Class 10 certificate. Age is counted from this date against the 25-year limit.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number and Email
demoFields.hint: An OTP goes to both, and the username and password come to both. A dead email address stops the registration at the first step.

demoFields.label: Permanent Address with District
demoFields.hint: Your home address in Bihar, matching the residence certificate.

demoFields.label: Course and Institution (from the approved list)
demoFields.value: B.Tech Civil Engineering — Bhagalpur College of Engineering, Bhagalpur
demoFields.hint: Pick from the portal's own list. If your college is missing, its accreditation has lapsed or it is not approved, and the loan cannot be sanctioned.

demoFields.label: Total Course Fee and Loan Amount Applied For
demoFields.value: Rs 2,84,000 total fee — Rs 2,84,000 applied for
demoFields.hint: Take the figures from the college's demand letter. The ceiling is Rs 4,00,000 for the whole course, not per year.

demoFields.label: Co-applicant Name, Relation and Aadhaar
demoFields.hint: Mother, father or guardian. The co-applicant signs at the DRCC, so pick someone who can come with you.

demoFields.label: Bank Account Number and IFSC of the Student
demoFields.value: 3477 0021 6683 / CBIN0280391 / Central Bank of India, Sultanganj
demoFields.hint: In the student's own name. The hostel and book amount comes to this account; the tuition fee goes straight to the college.

demoSteps: Register as a new applicant on 7nishchay-yuvaupmission.bihar.gov.in with your name, mobile, email and Aadhaar, and confirm the OTP that comes to both the mobile and the email.
Log in with the username and password sent to you, choose Bihar Student Credit Card, and first check that your college and course are on the approved list on the portal.
Fill the form with the co-applicant's details and the fee taken from the college's demand letter, submit it, and print the acknowledgement.
Take the printout and every original document to your District Registration and Counselling Centre (DRCC) within 60 days, with the co-applicant. Missing this deadline cancels the application.
The DRCC checks the originals and forwards the case. BSEFCL sanctions the loan and issues you separate student portal credentials.
The tuition fee is released to the college semester by semester and the hostel and book amount to your own account. Watch the semester-wise position and the outstanding amount on bsefcl.bihar.gov.in.

Nothing is charged while you study. Repayment begins one year after the course ends or as soon as you get a job, whichever is earlier, at 4 per cent simple interest — 1 per cent for a woman, transgender or divyang student.
schemes.helpline: 1800 3456 444 — Saat Nishchay Yuva Upmission toll free

schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Nishchay Swayam Sahayata Bhatta (Unemployment Allowance)
schemes.department: Planning and Development Department, Government of Bihar — Saat Nishchay Yuva Upmission
schemes.brief: Bihar pays a young person who has passed Class 12 but is neither studying further nor working Rs 1,000 a month for up to two years, to meet the cost of looking for a job. It is applied for on the same Saat Nishchay Yuva Upmission portal as the student credit card, and the applicant must also join the free Kushal Yuva Program training.
schemes.benefit: Rs 1,000 a month for up to two years
eligibility: Aged between 20 and 25 years on the date of applying
Passed Class 12 or an equivalent examination and not enrolled in any regular course after it
Not in any job, government or private, and not self-employed
Permanent resident of Bihar
Not drawing any other government allowance, stipend or education loan for the same period
Must join the Kushal Yuva Program training; the allowance stops if the training is not done
documents: Aadhaar card
Class 10 certificate, for date of birth
Class 12 marksheet and certificate
Residence certificate of Bihar
Bank passbook in the applicant's own name showing the account number and IFSC
Two passport-size photographs
Mobile number and email address for the login
Self-declaration that you are neither employed nor studying
schemes.portalName: MNSSBY — Saat Nishchay Yuva Upmission portal

demoFields.label: Applicant Name

demoFields.label: Date of Birth

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Your own twelve digits, entered at registration itself.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number and Email
demoFields.hint: An OTP goes to both and the username and password come to both. Use an email you can actually open.
