demoFields.hint: Copy all three from the Intermediate marksheet.

demoFields.value: 5502 0087 4419 / SBIN0004121 / State Bank of India, Darbhanga
demoFields.hint: Your own account, not a parent's. The monthly Rs 1,000 comes here by direct transfer.

demoFields.label: Register for Kushal Yuva Program (KYP)
demoFields.hint: The free training in communication, basic English and computers. The allowance is tied to it, so say yes.

demoSteps: Register as a new applicant on 7nishchay-yuvaupmission.bihar.gov.in with your name, mobile, email and Aadhaar, and confirm the OTP sent to both the mobile and the email.
Log in with the username and password you receive, choose Mukhyamantri Nishchay Swayam Sahayata Bhatta, and register for the Kushal Yuva Program at the same time.
Fill the form, give a bank account in your own name with the correct IFSC, submit, and print the acknowledgement with the application number.
Go to your District Registration and Counselling Centre (DRCC) within 60 days with all originals. Nothing is sanctioned until the DRCC has seen them.
After verification, Rs 1,000 reaches your account every month by direct transfer, for up to two years or until you get a job or join a course, whichever comes first.
Attend the Kushal Yuva Program training you registered for. Dropping out of it stops the monthly payment.
Tell the DRCC as soon as you start working or studying. Money drawn after that is recovered from you.

schemes.title: RTPS Bihar certificates
schemes.department: General Administration Department, Government of Bihar
schemes.brief: Bihar's single window for caste (jaati), income (aay), residence (aawasiya) and EWS certificates, along with land, ration card and social security services. Hindi and English. The Bihar Right to Public Service Act puts a fixed deadline on each service and lets you appeal if it is missed, and these certificates are issued free. You can file it yourself, or use the RTPS counter at your block (prakhand) office or any Vasudha Kendra (CSC), which is how most applications in the villages are made.
schemes.benefit: Caste, income and residence certificates free, within the time fixed by law
eligibility: Resident of Bihar, applying in the block or circle where you live
The household traceable in the circle office (anchal) records
A mobile number for the OTP and for the SMS carrying your application number
documents: Aadhaar card
Ration card or voter ID as proof of residence
Self-declaration (ghoshna patra) on the prescribed format, signed
Recent passport photograph
School certificate or matriculation certificate for date of birth
For income: a salary certificate for the employed, or a declaration for farming and daily-wage families
For caste: the father's or a close relative's caste certificate where one exists

demoFields.label: Applicant's name (Hindi and English)
demoFields.value: Manoj Kumar Paswan / मनोज कुमार पासवान
demoFields.hint: The certificate prints in Hindi, so fill the Hindi box with care. Match it to your Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Father's name
demoFields.hint: For a caste certificate this matters most, because the caste is traced through the father's family record.

demoFields.label: Certificate applied for
demoFields.value: Caste certificate (Jaati Praman Patra), block level

demoFields.value: Gram Bishunpur, Panchayat Rampur, Block Barh, District Patna, 803213
demoFields.hint: Give the full chain of village, panchayat, block and district. Your block office handles the file, so this decides where it goes.

demoFields.label: Annual family income
demoFields.hint: For an income certificate, the whole household's earnings for the year from all sources, including farming and labour.

demoFields.label: Purpose
demoFields.value: Admission and scholarship for my son
demoFields.hint: Write plainly what it is needed for. It is asked for the record and does not restrict how you use the certificate.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. Used to confirm identity and to pull your details in.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: The application number comes here by SMS and you need it to download the certificate, so use a number you keep.

demoSteps: Fill in the self-declaration (ghoshna patra). Download the format from the portal, write it, sign it, and photograph it clearly.

Either register on the Service Online portal with your mobile number and apply yourself, or take the papers to the RTPS counter at your block office or a Vasudha Kendra (CSC). These certificates are free; do not pay anything beyond the small notified kiosk charge.
Choose the department, the service and the level of the certificate as this sample shows.
Fill the form, taking care with the Hindi spelling of names and with the caste picked from the list.
Upload the documents and submit. Note the application number, which also arrives by SMS.
The karmchari and then the circle officer verify the record and the certificate is signed digitally.
Download it from the portal with your application number, or collect it at the RTPS counter. It needs no stamp or attestation on top of the digital signature.
If the deadline fixed under the Right to Public Service Act passes with nothing happening, file the first appeal that the same Act gives you, at the office named on your receipt.
schemes.helpline: 1800-345-6215 (RTPS Bihar helpline)

schemes.title: Bihar Social Security Pension — Old Age, Widow and Disability
schemes.department: Social Welfare Department, Government of Bihar (Directorate of Social Security)
schemes.brief: Bihar pays a monthly pension to old people, widows and disabled people. Mukhyamantri Vridhjan Pension Yojana covers every resident aged 60 and above with no income condition at all; the Laxmibai Samajik Suraksha Pension covers widows; the disability pension covers people certified with 40 per cent or more disability. All three are applied for on the ServiceOnline RTPS portal and paid straight into the pensioner's own bank account.
schemes.benefit: Rs 1,100 a month by direct transfer, raised from Rs 400 in July 2025
eligibility: Aged 60 or above and a resident of Bihar, for Mukhyamantri Vridhjan Pension — there is no income limit for it
Widow aged 18 or above from a poor household, for the Laxmibai Samajik Suraksha Pension
Disability certified at 40 per cent or more, for the disability pension
The applicant is not drawing any other government pension, including a service pension
A bank account in the pensioner's own name, seeded with Aadhaar; a son's or daughter's account is not accepted
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant
Age proof — Aadhaar, voter ID, matric certificate or the date of birth on the ration card
Voter ID (EPIC) card, as the old age pension is checked against the Bihar electoral roll
Bank passbook in the applicant's own name showing the account number and IFSC
Passport-size photograph
Death certificate of the husband, for a widow pension
Disability certificate showing the percentage, for a disability pension
Mobile number linked to Aadhaar

demoFields.label: Service Selected
demoFields.hint: Under Social Welfare Department pick the pension that fits you — old age, widow (Laxmibai) or disability. One person can hold only one.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Exactly the spelling on Aadhaar. If the bank record spells it differently, get one of them corrected first or the money will not land.

demoFields.label: Father's / Husband's Name
demoFields.hint: As written on your Aadhaar or voter ID.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth / Age
demoFields.hint: Take it from Aadhaar or the matric certificate. The old age pension starts only at 60 completed years.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. The pension is paid to the bank account seeded with this Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Voter ID (EPIC) Number
demoFields.hint: From your voter card. The portal matches it against the electoral roll of your booth.

demoFields.label: District / Block / Panchayat or Ward
demoFields.hint: Where you live. The Block Development Office of this block handles the case.

demoFields.label: Bank Account Number, IFSC and Branch
demoFields.value: 3311 0056 8842 / SBIN0006143 / State Bank of India, Belaganj branch
demoFields.hint: Account in your own name only. Copy the IFSC from the passbook — one wrong letter and the monthly credit fails.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The application number and the sanction message come here by SMS.

demoFields.label: Any other government pension being drawn
demoFields.hint: Say plainly whether you already draw a pension. Drawing two stops both and the money is recovered.

demoSteps: Open serviceonline.bihar.gov.in, register as a citizen with your mobile and OTP, then choose Social Welfare Department and the pension you want. The RTPS counter at your block office files it free if you cannot do it yourself.
Fill the form with your name exactly as on Aadhaar, your date of birth, your voter ID number and a bank account in your own name with its IFSC.
Upload Aadhaar, the photograph and the bank passbook page, and for a widow or disability pension the death certificate or the disability certificate.
Submit and keep the application reference number on the acknowledgement. Track it on the same portal with that number.
The Block Development Officer verifies the papers and the Sub-Divisional Officer sanctions the pension, normally within the timeline fixed under the Bihar Right to Public Services Act.
Once sanctioned, Rs 1,100 reaches your bank account every month. Check the first credit at the bank counter or the CSC so you know it has started.
Give the life certificate every year when the block office calls for it. The pension stops the month it is missed and takes time to restart.
schemes.helpline: The RTPS counter at your Block Development Office, or the social security cell of your District Social Welfare Office

schemes.title: Bihar Ration Card (Jan Vitran Ann)
schemes.department: Department of Food and Consumer Protection, Government of Bihar
schemes.brief: The ration card is what brings your family subsidised foodgrain from the fair price shop under the National Food Security Act, and it is the household proof most other Bihar schemes ask to see first. A new card, a correction (Praptra KHA), a split of one card into two, and adding or removing a member are all done online on RC Online Bihar.
schemes.benefit: 5 kg of foodgrain per person a month for a priority household, 35 kg a month for an Antyodaya household
eligibility: Family living in Bihar and not holding a ration card anywhere else in India
No member is an income-tax payer or a permanent government employee
The family does not own a four-wheeler or a tractor
The eldest woman of the family aged 18 or above is recorded as the head of the household
Every member's Aadhaar must be given; a name without Aadhaar draws no grain
Antyodaya (AAY) cards go to the poorest households identified by the district; other eligible families get a priority household (PHH) card
documents: Aadhaar card of every member of the family
Aadhaar-linked mobile number of the head of the household, for the OTP
Passport-size photograph and signature of the head of the household
Residence proof — electricity bill, holding tax receipt or rent agreement
Bank passbook first page of the head of the household
Deletion certificate from the earlier card, if the family or a member has come from another card
Income declaration of the household

demoFields.label: Application Type
demoFields.hint: New card, correction under Praptra KHA, split of a card, adding a member or deleting one. Pick one; each needs a different set of papers.

demoFields.label: Name of the Head of the Family
demoFields.hint: The eldest woman of the family aged 18 or above. The card is issued in her name, spelt exactly as on her Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number of the Head
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits from her own Aadhaar card. The whole family's monthly grain is counted against this.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: Use the number linked to her Aadhaar. The OTP, the application ID and the ready message all come here.

demoFields.label: District / Block / Panchayat or Ward
demoFields.hint: Where the family actually lives. The fair price shop is allotted from this address and the officer verifies here.

demoFields.label: Full Address with House Number and PIN
demoFields.hint: Write the house number and tola or ward so the verifying officer can find the house.

demoFields.label: Family Members — name, relation, age, Aadhaar
demoFields.value: Bipin Kumar Sahni — husband — 41 — 9999 3320 5514; Anjali Kumari — daughter — 12 — 9999 7781 0462
demoFields.hint: Everyone who eats from the same kitchen, each with their own Aadhaar. One name left out costs the family 5 kg every month.

demoFields.label: Annual Family Income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: The household's total earning for the year, from all members and all work.

demoFields.label: Bank Account Number and IFSC of the Head
demoFields.hint: Account in the head of the household's own name. Copy the IFSC from the passbook, not from memory.

demoFields.label: Uploads — photograph, signature, residence proof, Aadhaar of all members
demoFields.value: Photo and signature as JPG under 100 KB, papers as PDF under 300 KB
demoFields.hint: Scan or photograph each paper and keep it small; the portal refuses a large file without saying why.

demoSteps: Register on rconline.bihar.gov.in with the Aadhaar-linked mobile of the head of the household and confirm the OTP. If you cannot do it yourself, the operator at a Vasudha Kendra or CSC will file it for you.
Fill the head's details, then add every person who eats from the same kitchen with their own Aadhaar, relation and age.
Upload the photograph, signature, residence proof and each member's Aadhaar within the size limits.
Submit and keep the application ID that comes by SMS. A part-filled application must be finally submitted within 30 days of starting it, or the draft lapses and you begin again.
The Block Supply Officer and the Circle Officer verify the household at your address, and the Sub-Divisional Officer sanctions the card.
Once approved, download the ration card from epds.bihar.gov.in and check every name, age and Aadhaar on it before you rely on it.
Get each member's Aadhaar e-KYC done on the ePoS machine at your fair price shop. Grain is released against the fingerprint, so a member without e-KYC gets nothing.
schemes.helpline: The Block Supply Officer (Marketing Officer) at your block office, or the Sub-Divisional Officer who sanctions the card

schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Kanya Utthan Yojana — Graduation Incentive
schemes.department: Education Department, Government of Bihar
schemes.brief: Bihar pays Rs 50,000 to a girl who passes her graduation from a university in the state. This part of Mukhyamantri Kanya Utthan Yojana is also called Mukhyamantri Balika (Snatak) Protsahan Yojana, and both married and unmarried graduates get it. A separate incentive for girls who pass Intermediate is claimed on the same portal. The money is paid by direct transfer into the student's own bank account.
schemes.benefit: Rs 50,000 after passing graduation
eligibility: Girl student who has passed graduation in any stream from a university in Bihar
Resident of Bihar; for the graduation incentive it makes no difference whether she is married or unmarried
Applied within the window notified for her passing year — a closed session cannot be claimed later
A bank account in the student's own name, Aadhaar-seeded and working; a joint account or a parent's account is not paid
The name on Aadhaar, on the bank record and on the university record must match
documents: Aadhaar card of the student
Graduation marksheet or provisional certificate from the university
Matric (Class 10) certificate, for date of birth and the correct spelling of the name
Bank passbook in the student's own name showing the account number and IFSC
Residence certificate of Bihar
University registration number and final-year roll number
Mobile number and email address for the login credentials

demoFields.label: Scheme Selected
demoFields.hint: The portal carries several student schemes. Pick the graduation (Snatak) one; the Inter and matric links are separate.

demoFields.label: University Name
demoFields.hint: Choose your university from the list. If it is not listed, its results have not been loaded yet — wait for the department's notice.

demoFields.label: College Name
demoFields.hint: The college you actually passed from, as the university has registered it.

demoFields.label: Student Name (as on the marksheet)
demoFields.hint: Copy it from the marksheet. If Aadhaar spells it differently, get that corrected before applying.

demoFields.label: Father's Name
demoFields.hint: As printed on the marksheet, not a shortened version.

demoFields.label: Registration Number, Roll Number and Year of Passing
demoFields.hint: All three are on the graduation marksheet. The portal matches them against the university result file.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth
demoFields.hint: Take it from the matric certificate, which is the record the department treats as final.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: The student's own, twelve digits. The payment goes to the account seeded with it.

demoFields.label: Bank Account Number, IFSC and Bank Name
demoFields.value: 6119 0034 2287 / SBIN0005698 / State Bank of India, Darbhanga Tower branch
demoFields.hint: In the student's own name. A wrong IFSC or a parent's account is the commonest reason the Rs 50,000 bounces.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number and Email
demoFields.hint: The user ID and password come here. Give a number and email you will still be using months later.

demoSteps: Watch medhasoft.bihar.gov.in for the notice opening applications for your passing year, and keep the graduation marksheet in hand.
Open the graduation (Snatak) link, register with your university, college, roll number and date of birth, and confirm the OTP. The portal then sends a user ID and password by SMS.
Log in and fill the form — name exactly as on the marksheet, Aadhaar, and a bank account in your own name with the correct IFSC.
Upload the marksheet, Aadhaar and the bank passbook page as small PDFs. The portal caps the file size and simply refuses anything larger.
Submit, note the application number and print the acknowledgement.

Your college verifies the entry and the university forwards the list to the department. Check status and any rejection reason on the same portal — a wrong IFSC, a name mismatch or an inactive account are the usual ones, and they can be corrected and resubmitted.
Rs 50,000 is paid by direct transfer into your account once the sanction list is published. Watch the payment status page on Medhasoft until it shows paid.
schemes.helpline: The Kanya Utthan nodal teacher at your college, or the District Education Officer of your district

schemes.benefit: Board flat applications, payments, transfers and no-dues certificates online
eligibility: For a new scheme, the conditions set out in that scheme's brochure, usually including Chandigarh residence
For allottee services, you must be the recorded allottee or a legal heir
A transfer needs the dues cleared and the Board's permission before the deed
One flat per family under the subsidised categories

Allotment letter, for an existing allottee
Residence proof of Chandigarh
Income proof, for a category-based scheme
Latest payment receipts, for a no-dues certificate
Succession certificate or a will, for a transfer on inheritance
Passport-size photographs

demoFields.label: Service wanted
demoFields.hint: New scheme application, instalment or rent payment, transfer, need-based change, no-dues certificate, or e-auction. Pick the one you need.

demoFields.label: Allottee Name (as on the allotment letter)
demoFields.hint: As on the allotment letter, which is what the Board's record follows, even if Aadhaar spells it differently.

demoFields.label: Allotment / File Number

Choose the service. For a payment, check the amount the portal shows against your own record before paying — interest may have been added since the last demand.
Pay online and download the receipt at once. Keep every receipt until the final no-dues certificate is issued.
For a transfer, apply for the Board's permission first and clear the dues. A deed signed before that permission is not recognised.
For a new scheme, read the brochure for the price, the category and the closing date, then apply and pay the registration money in time.
Track the application on the portal by the file number, and take anything unresolved to the Board's office in Sector 9 with the application number.
schemes.helpline: 0172-4601826 — Chandigarh Housing Board

schemes.title: Chhattisgarh e-District — Income, Caste and Residence Certificates
schemes.department: Chhattisgarh Infotech Promotion Society (CHiPS), Government of Chhattisgarh
schemes.brief: Chhattisgarh e-District issues the certificates a citizen is asked for again and again — income, caste, domicile or residence, birth, death and marriage — along with other revenue, social welfare and licensing services. You apply, upload the documents, pay the fee, track the file by its reference number and download the signed certificate as a PDF. The citizen login sits at cgedistrict.cgstate.gov.in, and newer services are being moved to the state's Sewa Setu platform at sewasetu.cgstate.gov.in.
schemes.benefit: Income, caste, domicile and civil registration certificates applied for online and downloaded as a signed PDF
eligibility: Resident of Chhattisgarh, applying in the district and tehsil where you live

Caste certificate: your community must appear in Chhattisgarh's own notified SC, ST or OBC list, and the claim is traced through your father's record — a certificate from another state is not accepted here
Domicile or residence certificate: the family must have lived in Chhattisgarh continuously, normally shown by a land record, school record or old voter entry
Income certificate: the figure is the whole family's income for the financial year from all sources, and a patwari enquiry may be held on it
Birth, death and marriage certificates are applied for by the person concerned or an immediate family member
A working mobile number, since registration and every status message run on OTP
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant
Ration card of the family
Proof of address — voter ID, electricity bill or the panchayat/ward certificate
Father's caste certificate or an old school record showing the caste, for a caste certificate
Land record (B-1 / khasra-khatauni) or an old school transfer certificate, for domicile
Income proof — salary slip, Form 16, or the patwari's or sarpanch's income statement
Self-declaration or affidavit on the form the service page gives
Recent passport-size photograph, scanned

demoFields.label: Select Service
demoFields.hint: Pick the service before anything else. Each one has its own document list and its own fee, shown on the service page.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name (Hindi and English)
demoFields.value: रमेश कुमार साहू / Ramesh Kumar Sahu
demoFields.hint: Both boxes must carry the same name. The certificate prints from the Hindi box, so check the spelling there carefully.

demoFields.label: Father's / Husband's Name
demoFields.hint: As on Aadhaar. For a caste certificate the officer traces the claim through the father, so this must match the record you upload.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth
demoFields.hint: From the school certificate or birth certificate you are uploading.

demoFields.label: Gender
demoFields.hint: As on Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: The 12 digits on your own Aadhaar. The portal matches the name and date of birth against it.

demoFields.label: District / Tehsil / Village or Ward
demoFields.hint: The file goes to the tehsildar of the tehsil named here. Give the place you actually live, not a relative's address.

demoFields.label: Annual Family Income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: The whole family's income for the financial year from every source. The patwari may verify it, and a figure that does not match what he reports gets the application rejected.

demoFields.label: Purpose of the Certificate
demoFields.hint: Write what you need it for. Scholarships, admissions and scheme applications each want the certificate issued recently, so apply close to the time you need it.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number and Email
demoFields.hint: The reference number and every status update come here. Keep the number active until the certificate is downloaded.

demoSteps: Open edistrict.cgstate.gov.in, go to the citizen login and register once with your mobile number and the OTP.
Choose the service, read its document list, fill the form in Hindi and English where both are asked, and upload the scans.
Pay the fee online if the service charges one, submit, and note the reference number the screen shows.
The file reaches the patwari and then the tehsildar or the concerned officer. A field enquiry is normal for income, caste and domicile certificates, so keep the original documents ready at home.
Track the file by the reference number on the portal. It names the officer holding it and the stage it has reached.
Download the approved certificate as a PDF from the same login and print it. The digital signature on it makes it valid without any further stamp.
If it is rejected, the reason is written on the portal. Fix that one point and apply again, or take the reference number to the Lok Seva Kendra or the Collectorate.
schemes.helpline: No public helpline number is published for the portal. Ask at the Lok Seva Kendra or Choice Centre in your tehsil, or at the e-District cell in your District Collectorate.

schemes.title: Mahtari Vandan Yojana — Monthly Assistance for Married Women
schemes.department: Women and Child Development Department, Government of Chhattisgarh
schemes.brief: Mahtari Vandan Yojana pays Rs 1,000 a month — Rs 12,000 in a year — to an eligible married woman of Chhattisgarh, straight into her own bank account. Widowed, divorced and abandoned women are covered along with married women. Fresh registration opens only in windows announced by the department; between those windows the portal is still used to check the application status, read the provisional and final beneficiary lists, file an objection and follow each instalment.
schemes.benefit: Rs 1,000 a month, Rs 12,000 a year, into the woman's own Aadhaar-seeded account
eligibility: Married woman who is a permanent resident of Chhattisgarh; widowed, divorced and abandoned women are also eligible
Must have completed 21 years of age on 1 January of the year the registration window opens

The family must have no income-tax payer, and no member in a regular or contractual post of the central or state government, a board, corporation or government undertaking — class IV and group D posts are not counted
No one in the family may be a sitting or former MP or MLA, or the chairman or vice-chairman of a board or corporation
A woman already drawing a government social pension gets only the difference, up to Rs 1,000 a month
A bank account in the woman's own name, seeded with Aadhaar and DBT-enabled; a husband's or joint account will not receive the money
documents: Aadhaar card of the woman and of her husband
Bank passbook first page in the woman's own name, Aadhaar-seeded and DBT-enabled
Residence proof of Chhattisgarh — ration card, voter ID or domicile certificate
Age proof — school certificate, birth certificate or the Aadhaar date of birth
Marriage certificate, or the self-declaration the portal provides where there is none
Death certificate of the husband for a widow, or the court order for a divorced woman
Recent passport-size photograph
The signed self-declaration and undertaking form printed from the portal

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number of the applicant
demoFields.hint: The application starts from the woman's own Aadhaar and an OTP to the mobile number linked to it. If no mobile is linked to your Aadhaar, get that done at an Aadhaar centre first — nothing else can be filled until then.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name
demoFields.hint: Exactly as on Aadhaar and on the bank passbook. A difference between the two is the single most common reason the money does not arrive.

demoFields.label: Husband's Name
demoFields.hint: As on his Aadhaar. For a widow, write the husband's name as on his death certificate.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth
demoFields.hint: From Aadhaar. You must have completed 21 years on 1 January of the year the window opened, so check this date against that.

demoFields.label: Marital Status
demoFields.hint: Married, widow, divorced or abandoned. Choosing widow or divorced means you must upload the death certificate or the court order.

demoFields.label: Category
demoFields.hint: General, SC, ST or OBC. The amount is the same for everyone; this is only recorded.

demoFields.label: District / Block / Village or Ward
demoFields.hint: The place you live. Your form is verified by the Anganwadi worker and the supervisor of this area, so a wrong address stalls the check.

demoFields.label: Anganwadi Centre or Ward Office
demoFields.hint: The centre that serves your locality. The Anganwadi worker can fill and submit the form for you if you cannot do it yourself.

demoFields.label: Bank Account Number and IFSC
demoFields.hint: The woman's own account, Aadhaar-seeded and DBT-enabled. Ask the bank to confirm the DBT seeding — an ordinary account with the Aadhaar number merely written in the file is not enough.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The OTP, the application number and each monthly payment message come here.

demoSteps: Check that registration is open. The portal announces the window; outside it you can still see the lists and the payment status but cannot submit a new form.
Get the bank account right before you apply — in the woman's own name, Aadhaar-seeded and DBT-enabled. The bank does this free of charge.
Open mahtarivandan.cgstate.gov.in and start the application with the woman's Aadhaar number and the OTP, or ask the Anganwadi worker, the ward office or the gram panchayat to fill it for you.
Fill the form, upload the documents and submit. Note the application number and take a printout of the acknowledgement.

The Anganwadi worker and the supervisor verify the details. Your name then appears in the provisional beneficiary list published on the portal — check it, and if a name is wrongly included or wrongly left out, file an objection on the portal within the days allowed.
After the objections are settled, the final list is published. Confirm your name is in it.

Rs 1,000 reaches the account every month by direct transfer. The portal's payment status page shows each instalment; if one is missing, check the bank for a seeding failure first, then take the application number to the Anganwadi centre or the District Programme Officer, Women and Child Development.
schemes.helpline: No toll-free number is published on the portal. Ask your Anganwadi worker, the ward office or gram panchayat, or the District Programme Officer, Women and Child Development, in your district.

schemes.title: DDA Housing Schemes and e-Auction
schemes.department: Delhi Development Authority
schemes.brief: The Delhi Development Authority sells flats through its own e-Services portal — some on first come first served, some by draw of lots and some by e-auction. Recent rounds have included the Sasta Ghar and Madhyam Vargiya schemes, Dwarka flats, the Janta, Jan Sadharan, Sabka Ghar and Shramik Awaas Yojana of 2025, and the Nagrik, Karmajeevi and Towering Heights schemes of 2026. You register with PAN and a mobile OTP, pay the registration money online and book or bid from the same login. On a first come first served scheme the flat you pick must be paid for within 30 minutes, so the money has to be ready before you start.
schemes.benefit: A DDA flat by first come first served, draw of lots or e-auction, with categories from EWS and LIG upwards
eligibility: Indian citizen aged 18 years or above on the date of application
Neither you nor your spouse nor a dependent child may own, in full or in part, a flat or plot of 67 square metres or more in Delhi, New Delhi or Delhi Cantonment
One application per person in a scheme; a husband and wife may both apply but only one flat will be kept if both are successful
PAN is compulsory, as it is a property transaction, and the registration money must come from your own account
For a reserved category flat — SC, ST, war widow, ex-serviceman or person with disability — the certificate on the prescribed format
Income within the ceiling of the category, where the scheme sets one for EWS or LIG flats
documents: PAN card
Aadhaar card
Proof of address
Bank account with net banking or UPI for the registration money and the instalments
Income proof — salary slips, Form 16 or an income certificate, where the category requires it
SC, ST, war widow, ex-serviceman or disability certificate, where a reserved flat is claimed
Scanned passport-size photograph and signature
Cancelled cheque for the refund of the registration money

demoFields.label: Scheme and flat category
demoFields.value: Sasta Ghar Housing Scheme — EWS flat, Siraspur
demoFields.hint: Read the brochure for that scheme first: the price, the carpet area, the maintenance charge and the closing date. Each scheme opens for a fixed window only.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name (as on PAN)
demoFields.hint: It must match PAN exactly. The allotment letter and the conveyance deed are made in this name, and correcting it later costs money and months.

demoFields.label: Father's / Husband's Name
demoFields.hint: As on Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: PAN
demoFields.hint: Compulsory. Registration will not go past this box without a valid PAN, and it is verified live.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: The 12 digits on your own Aadhaar, used to confirm identity alongside PAN.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth
demoFields.hint: As on PAN. You must be 18 or above on the date you apply.

demoFields.label: Reserved category claimed
demoFields.hint: SC, ST, war widow, ex-serviceman or person with disability. Claim one only if you hold the certificate, because it is checked before the allotment letter is issued.

demoFields.label: Declaration about property owned in Delhi
demoFields.value: No flat or plot of 67 sq m or more owned by self, spouse or dependent children
demoFields.hint: This is a sworn declaration. A false answer here cancels the allotment and the money paid is forfeited, even years later.

demoFields.label: Bank Account Number and IFSC for refund
demoFields.hint: If you are not allotted a flat or you withdraw, the registration money comes back to this account, so give a live one in your own name.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number and Email
demoFields.hint: The registration number, the draw result, every instalment notice and the possession date come here. Do not use an agent's number.

demoSteps: Open eservices.dda.org.in, see which schemes are live and download the brochure. The price, the category, the area and the payment schedule are all in it.
Register with your PAN, mobile number and email, confirm the OTP, and pay the registration fee online.
Fill the application for the scheme and category you qualify for, upload the documents, and pay the registration money from your own account.

On a first come first served scheme, pick the flat from the live inventory and pay within 30 minutes of selection or the flat goes back into the pool — arrange the funds and the transfer limit beforehand. On a draw-of-lots scheme, wait for the result on the portal. On an e-auction, bid within the auction window.
If you are not allotted a flat, the registration money is refunded to the account you gave. Keep the acknowledgement until it arrives.
On allotment, download the demand-cum-allotment letter and pay the instalments by the dates written in it. Missing a date attracts interest and eventually cancellation.

After full payment the conveyance deed is executed and possession is given. Inspect the flat, get every defect recorded in writing before taking the keys, and keep the allotment letter and the deed together.
schemes.helpline: No toll-free number is published on the e-Services portal. Take the registration number to the Housing Branch of the Delhi Development Authority at Vikas Sadan, INA, New Delhi, or use the grievance link on dda.gov.in.

schemes.title: e-District Delhi — Certificates and Marriage Registration
schemes.department: Revenue Department, Government of NCT of Delhi
schemes.brief: e-District Delhi is the Revenue Department's portal for the certificates a Delhi resident needs — caste (SC, ST, OBC), income, domicile or residence, EWS, solvency, Lal Dora and survival certificates — as well as registration of marriage, the disability identity card, birth and death orders including delayed birth registration, and ration card services. The same site is served at edistrict.delhigovt.nic.in. Tracking an application and printing or verifying a signed certificate can be done without logging in.
schemes.benefit: Delhi certificates, marriage registration and the disability ID card applied for online, with a digitally signed certificate to download
eligibility: Resident of Delhi, applying under the sub-division where you live
Domicile or residence certificate: you must have lived in Delhi for three years or more and be able to show it with a dated document
Caste certificate: the community must be in the central or Delhi list for SC, ST or OBC, and the claim is traced through the father's or a blood relative's existing certificate
EWS certificate for the 10 percent reservation: annual family income below Rs 8 lakh, within the land and flat limits the rule sets
Registration of marriage: both parties must appear before the Sub-Divisional Magistrate on the appointment date with three witnesses
Registration needs an Aadhaar or a Voter ID, which the portal verifies before the form opens
documents: Aadhaar card or Voter ID, used to create the login
Proof of residence in Delhi — electricity or water bill, ration card, rent agreement or the registry of the house
Proof of date of birth — school certificate, birth certificate or passport
Father's or a blood relative's caste certificate, for a caste certificate
Income proof — salary slips, Form 16, or the income affidavit the service page prescribes
Self-declaration on the format the portal gives, signed and scanned
Marriage invitation card, joint photograph and the witnesses' ID, for registration of marriage
Recent passport-size photograph, scanned

demoFields.label: Select Department and Service
demoFields.value: Revenue Department — Issuance of Income Certificate
demoFields.hint: Choose the department first and then the service. The document list, the fee and the officer who will decide it all change with the service.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name
demoFields.hint: As on the Aadhaar or Voter ID you registered with. The certificate is printed from this box.

demoFields.label: Father's / Husband's Name
demoFields.hint: As on Aadhaar. For a caste certificate this must match the relative's certificate you are uploading, or the claim cannot be traced.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth
demoFields.hint: From the document you are uploading as age proof, not from memory.

demoFields.label: Gender
demoFields.hint: As on Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar / Voter ID used for registration
demoFields.hint: New registration runs on one of these two. Whichever you pick is verified live, so the name and date of birth you type must match it exactly.

demoFields.label: Present Address with District and Sub-Division
demoFields.value: B-142, Vikaspuri, West Delhi district, Punjabi Bagh sub-division, 110018
demoFields.hint: The file goes to the Sub-Divisional Magistrate of the sub-division named here. If you are unsure which one covers your colony, the portal lists the colonies under each.

demoFields.label: Period of residence in Delhi
demoFields.hint: For a domicile certificate this must be three years or more, and the document you upload has to be dated far enough back to show it.

demoFields.label: Annual Family Income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: The whole household's income for the financial year. For an EWS certificate the limit is Rs 8 lakh a year and the figure is checked, so do not guess.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number and Email
demoFields.hint: The user ID, the OTP, the application number and the message that the certificate is ready all come here.

demoSteps: Open edistrict.delhi.gov.in and use New User Registration with your Aadhaar or Voter ID. Confirm the mobile OTP and note the user ID the portal gives you.
Log in, pick the department and the service, and read its document list before filling anything.
Fill the form, upload the scans and the signed self-declaration, and submit. Write down the application number.

The file goes to the Sub-Divisional Magistrate's office for your sub-division. A field enquiry by the patwari or the local authority is normal for income, caste and domicile certificates. For registration of marriage, an appointment date is given on which both parties and three witnesses must attend in person.
Track the application on the portal by its number — this page works without logging in.
When it is approved, use Print or Download Certificate to get the digitally signed PDF. Anyone can check it on the portal's verification page, so the download alone is enough proof.
If it is rejected, the reason appears against the application number. Correct that point and apply again, or take the printout to the SDM office named on it.
schemes.helpline: No single helpline is published for the portal. Take the application number to the office of the Sub-Divisional Magistrate for your sub-division, or the District Office of the Revenue Department, Government of NCT of Delhi.

schemes.title: Goa Government Recruitment — CBES Online
schemes.department: Goa Staff Selection Commission and Department of Personnel, Government of Goa
schemes.brief: Goa's online recruitment system, where advertisements for state government posts are published and applications filed. One profile serves every advertisement, and the admit card and result come to the same login.
schemes.benefit: One profile for every Goa government recruitment advertisement
eligibility: Indian citizen meeting the age limits in the advertisement, usually 18 to 45
Fifteen years' residence in Goa is required for most state posts, proved by a residence certificate
Knowledge of Konkani is required for many posts, and Marathi is often preferred
The qualification the advertisement states, complete on its closing date
documents: Aadhaar card
Class 10 certificate for date of birth
Degree or diploma certificates and marksheets
Residence certificate showing fifteen years in Goa
Knowledge of Konkani certificate, where the post requires it
Caste or disability certificate, where claiming that reservation
Recent passport photograph and a scanned signature

demoFields.label: Post applied for
demoFields.value: Lower Division Clerk, Directorate of Education
demoFields.hint: One application per advertisement. Read the qualification and age limit in that advertisement before paying.

demoFields.label: Candidate Name (as on Class 10 certificate)
demoFields.hint: The Class 10 certificate governs, not Aadhaar, where the two differ. Everything later is checked against it.

demoFields.label: Father's Name
demoFields.hint: As on the Class 10 certificate.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth
demoFields.hint: As on the Class 10 certificate. Age limits count from this date.

demoFields.label: Residence in Goa
demoFields.hint: Most Goa state posts require fifteen years' residence. Get the certificate from Goa Online before the closing date, not after.

demoFields.label: Knowledge of Konkani
demoFields.value: Yes — studied Konkani up to Class 10
demoFields.hint: Many posts require it and ask for a certificate or a school record. Declare it honestly; it is verified.

demoFields.label: Educational Qualification
demoFields.hint: It must be complete on the advertisement's closing date, not merely expected.

demoFields.label: Category claimed
demoFields.hint: Claim only what you hold a Goa certificate for. A certificate from another state is not accepted for the reservation.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number and Email
demoFields.hint: The application number, admit card and every notice come here.

demoSteps: Create the profile on cbes.goa.gov.in with your name and date of birth exactly as on the Class 10 certificate.
Get the fifteen-year residence certificate and, where the post needs it, the Konkani knowledge certificate before the closing date. These are what most candidates are rejected for.
Open the advertisement, apply through the same login, upload the photograph and signature in the sizes stated, and pay the fee.
Print the filled application and keep it with the payment receipt until the recruitment ends.
Download the admit card from the same login and take it with a photo ID.
Results are published on the portal. Document verification comes last, where the originals of everything claimed must be produced.
schemes.helpline: Goa Staff Selection Commission, Panaji

schemes.title: Goa Online — Certificates and Government Services
schemes.department: Government of Goa
schemes.brief: Goa Online is the state's single window. Residence and income certificates, birth and death records, scheme applications, licences and departmental payments are all filed here, and the same services are available across a counter at a Citizen Service Centre.
schemes.benefit: Residence, income and other certificates and scheme applications in one place
eligibility: Resident of Goa, applying in the taluka where you live
A residence certificate needs proof the family has lived in Goa for the qualifying period
Some schemes on the portal need fifteen years' residence in Goa; each says so on its own form
An income certificate is valid for one year
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant
Ration card of the family
Electricity bill or house tax receipt for the address
Birth certificate or school leaving certificate for date of birth
Salary certificate or Form 16, for an income certificate
Passport-size photograph and a scanned signature

demoFields.label: Service wanted
demoFields.hint: Residence, income, caste, birth or death certificate, a scheme application, or a licence. Each has its own form and fee.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Letter for letter as on Aadhaar. The certificate prints from this entry.

demoFields.label: Father's / Husband's Name
demoFields.hint: Used to identify the family in the taluka records.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. Identity is confirmed on this and the OTP goes to the linked mobile.

demoFields.label: Taluka / Village or Ward
demoFields.hint: Where you actually live. The Mamlatdar of this taluka signs the certificate.

demoFields.label: Years resident in Goa
demoFields.hint: For a residence certificate. School records, the ration card or an old electricity bill are what prove it.

demoFields.label: Annual Family Income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: For an income certificate, the household's total for the year from every source.

demoFields.label: Purpose
demoFields.value: Application for a state government post
demoFields.hint: Recorded for the file. It does not restrict where the certificate is used.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The application number and the ready message come here by SMS.

demoSteps: Register on goaonline.gov.in with your mobile and confirm the OTP, or go to a Citizen Service Centre, which files it across the counter.
Choose the service and fill the form from your Aadhaar and ration card.
Upload the documents, pay the fee online, and note the application number.
The talathi or the taluka staff verify the household at your address.
The Mamlatdar signs the certificate and it is downloaded from the same login.
If it runs past the time the service promises, quote the application number at the Mamlatdar's office and then to the Collector of your district.
schemes.helpline: Your taluka Mamlatdar's office, or the Collectorate at Panaji or Margao

schemes.title: Gujarat Ration Card - New Card or Adding a Member
schemes.department: Food, Civil Supplies & Consumer Affairs Department, Gujarat
schemes.brief: A barcoded ration card for a new family, or the addition of a member - a newborn, or a bride who has come into the family. The printed forms are on the department's site in Gujarati: Form 1 and 2 for a new card, Form 3 to add a member. Most people fill them at the Jan Seva Kendra or through the VCE at the e-Gram centre and submit them at the taluka Mamlatdar's office. After a name is added, get that member's Aadhaar e-KYC done at your fair price shop or the extra grain will not start.
schemes.benefit: Barcoded ration card; an NFSA card brings subsidised grain at the fair price shop
eligibility: Resident of Gujarat, not holding a ration card anywhere else in India
A family that has moved must bring a deletion certificate from the earlier ration card
A newborn is added on the birth certificate; a bride on her marriage certificate and deletion from her parents' card
NFSA (subsidised grain) status depends on the family's income and category, and is decided separately from the card itself
Only the head of the family can apply for the family's card
documents: Aadhaar cards of every member of the family
Proof of residence - electricity bill, rent agreement or property tax receipt
Deletion certificate from the previous ration card, for anyone moving in
Birth certificate of the newborn, or the marriage certificate of the bride
Passport photograph of the head of the family
Gas connection book
The existing ration card, when adding a member
schemes.submitAt: Mamlatdar's office of your taluka, or the Zonal office in city areas - the Jan Seva Kendra counter accepts the form in most talukas

demoFields.label: Form type
demoFields.hint: Form 1 or 2 for a brand new card, Form 3 to add a name, Form 4 to remove one, Form 5 for a duplicate card.

demoFields.label: Head of the family
demoFields.hint: The name printed first on the existing card. The application has to be signed by this person.

demoFields.label: Ration card number
demoFields.hint: From the front of your barcoded card. Leave it blank if you are applying for a new card.

demoFields.label: Member to be added, and relation
demoFields.hint: The name as on that person's Aadhaar, and how she or he is related to the head of the family.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar numbers
demoFields.hint: Aadhaar of the head and of the person being added. Every member's Aadhaar is needed for a new card.

demoFields.label: Reason and supporting certificate
demoFields.value: Marriage on 26-04-2026; deletion certificate from the parents' card at Vanthali, Junagadh
demoFields.hint: A bride needs the marriage certificate and the deletion certificate from her parents' card. A newborn needs only the birth certificate.

demoFields.label: Full address
demoFields.value: Patelvas, Limbasi, taluka Matar, district Kheda - 387530
demoFields.hint: The address as on the residence proof you are attaching. The inspector verifies here.

demoFields.label: Gas connection number
demoFields.hint: From the gas book. It is asked to check that the family is not registered twice.

demoFields.label: Annual family income
demoFields.hint: Income of the whole family. It decides whether the card comes under NFSA for subsidised grain.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: Give the head of the family's number. The token and the status messages come here.

demoSteps: Download Form 3 from the department's site, or take a printed copy at the Jan Seva Kendra or from the VCE at the e-Gram centre. The forms are in Gujarati.
Fill it in Gujarati, in the head of the family's name, and have him or her sign it.
Attach the existing ration card, the new member's Aadhaar, and the birth certificate or the marriage certificate with the deletion certificate from the earlier card.
Submit the set at the Mamlatdar's office of your taluka, or at the Zonal office if you live in a city. In most talukas the Jan Seva Kendra counter takes it in.
Collect the acknowledgement slip with its token number - do not leave without it, it is how you follow the case.
The Talati or the supply inspector verifies the family at your address.
The name is added and the updated barcoded card is issued. Check the spelling and the Aadhaar on it before you leave the counter.
Get the new member's Aadhaar e-KYC done on the machine at your fair price shop. The family's grain quota does not increase until this is done.
For a brand new card, the same route applies with Form 1 or 2 and the Aadhaar of every member, plus residence proof.
There is no fee beyond the small charge printed on the form; do not pay anyone to get it passed faster.
schemes.helpline: Mamlatdar's office of your taluka, or the District Supply Officer

schemes.title: iKhedut Farm Subsidy - Equipment & Inputs
schemes.department: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation Department, Gujarat
schemes.brief: Subsidy on farm equipment and inputs - rotavator, pump set, thresher, sprayer, drip irrigation, seeds and plant protection items. Applications open only in windows the department announces, so the portal is closed most of the year. The whole site is in Gujarati. Very few farmers apply from home: most go to the Village Computer Entrepreneur (VCE) at the e-Gram centre in the Gram Panchayat, who fills the form and prints it.
schemes.benefit: 25% to 75% of the cost, with a ceiling fixed for each item
eligibility: Farmer with agricultural land in Gujarat, held in the applicant's own name
7/12 and 8-A land records must show the applicant's name
Higher rates of subsidy for small and marginal farmers, women farmers and SC/ST farmers
One item can be claimed again only after the cycle fixed for it (a tractor, for example, only once in several years)
One application per item per window; the same family cannot claim the same item twice
documents: 7/12 and 8-A extracts of the land (download free from AnyRoR)
Aadhaar card
First page of the bank passbook or a cancelled cheque
Caste certificate, if claiming the SC or ST rate
Ration card
Quotation from a dealer approved by the department, where the item needs one

demoFields.label: Farmer's name (as on the 7/12)
demoFields.hint: Write the name exactly as it is printed on the land record, not a short form.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: Your own 12-digit Aadhaar number. It must be the one linked to your bank account, or the subsidy will not reach you.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: A number you actually carry. Every message about approval and inspection comes to it.

demoFields.label: District / Taluka / Village
demoFields.hint: Pick from the drop-downs. Choose the village where the land is, not where you live, if the two are different.

demoFields.label: Survey number (from 7/12)
demoFields.hint: Copy it letter for letter from the 7/12, including 'paiki' and the part number.

demoFields.label: Khata number (from 8-A)
demoFields.hint: The account number on the 8-A extract. It covers all your survey numbers in that village.

demoFields.label: Component applied for
demoFields.hint: Choose the exact item and size. If you buy a different size later, the subsidy is refused.

demoFields.label: Land area for this item (hectare)
demoFields.hint: Area as shown on the 7/12, in hectares. One vigha is roughly 0.16 hectare.

demoFields.label: Bank account number and IFSC
demoFields.hint: The account must be in the applicant's own name and Aadhaar-seeded. A joint account in the father's name is a common reason for failed payment.

demoFields.label: Category
demoFields.hint: General, SC, ST or OBC. Say SC or ST only if you can attach the certificate.

demoSteps: Check on the portal whether the window for your scheme group is open - Agriculture, Horticulture, Animal Husbandry or Fisheries each open separately.
Choose 'Apply as an individual farmer'. If you have applied before, say yes and give your registration number instead of registering again.
Fill the form. The portal is in Gujarati; type names in Gujarati as they appear on the land record.
Save the form and note the application number that appears.
Now confirm the application. This is the step people miss - an application that is saved but not confirmed is treated as never made, and it cannot be confirmed after the window shuts.
Print the confirmed application and sign it.

Attach the 7/12, 8-A, Aadhaar, bank passbook copy and caste certificate, and hand the set to the Gram Sevak, the Taluka Agriculture Office or the VCE at the e-Gram centre within the days printed on the form.
Wait for pre-approval (purva manjuri). Do not buy the item before it comes - a purchase made earlier gets no subsidy.
Buy from an approved dealer, submit the bill and the dealer's certificate.
An officer inspects the item, and the subsidy is credited to your bank account by DBT.
schemes.helpline: Kisan Call Centre 1800-180-1551, or your Taluka Agriculture Officer / Gram Sevak

schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Yuva Swavalamban Yojana (MYSY)
schemes.department: Knowledge Consortium of Gujarat, Education Department
schemes.brief: Fee, hostel and book help for students of middle-income families who did well in the board exam. It is meant for the student who got the marks but whose family cannot pay the college fee. The portal works in Gujarati and English. After filling the form online you still have to carry the printout and your original certificates to an MYSY help centre - the application is not complete until that verification is done.
schemes.benefit: Tuition help up to Rs.2 lakh a year for medical and dental, Rs.50,000 a year for degree and diploma courses, plus Rs.12,000 hostel help and a book grant
eligibility: 80th percentile or above in the Class 10 board exam for a diploma, or Class 12 for a degree course
Family income up to Rs.6 lakh a year
Studying in a recognised college or institute in Gujarat
Admission taken through the official admission committee, or against a management seat where the scheme allows it
Renewal every year needs a pass result and the attendance the college certifies
documents: Class 10 and Class 12 marksheets
Income certificate from the Mamlatdar, issued within the period the portal states
Fee receipt and the admission letter
Aadhaar card
Bank passbook in the student's own name
Proof that the family home is far from the college, for the hostel grant
Self-declaration on the form the portal provides

demoFields.label: Student's name
demoFields.hint: Exactly as printed on the Class 10 marksheet. The board record is what the portal checks against.

demoFields.label: Class 12 seat number and year
demoFields.hint: From your board marksheet. The portal pulls your percentile from this, so one wrong digit stops the form.

demoFields.label: Percentile
demoFields.hint: The percentile printed on the marksheet, not the percentage. 80 and above qualifies.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: The student's own Aadhaar, seeded to the student's own bank account.

demoFields.label: Course and college
demoFields.value: B.E. Civil, first year, government engineering college, Rajkot
demoFields.hint: Course, year of study and the full name of the institute as it appears on the admission letter.

demoFields.label: Family annual income
demoFields.hint: The figure on the Mamlatdar's income certificate, counting both parents. It must be Rs.6 lakh or less.

demoFields.label: Income certificate number and date
demoFields.hint: From the certificate issued by the Mamlatdar or the Jan Seva Kendra. An old certificate is rejected.

demoFields.label: Bank account number and IFSC
demoFields.hint: The student's own savings account. A parent's account is not accepted.

demoFields.label: Hostel help needed
demoFields.value: Yes - home at Limbasi, Kheda; college at Rajkot
demoFields.hint: Say yes only if you stay in a hostel or on rent because the college is far. Keep the rent agreement or hostel receipt ready.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: The user id and PIN for the portal come to this number by SMS. Use the student's own number.

demoSteps: Get the income certificate first, from the Mamlatdar's office or a Jan Seva Kendra. It takes a few days and the form cannot be completed without it.
Register on the MYSY portal with the student's mobile number. A user id and PIN come back by SMS - write them down, you need them every year for renewal.
Log in and choose the right form: fresh application if this is the first year, renewal if you got the help last year.
Fill the form. Switch the portal to Gujarati if that is easier to read; the entries are the same either way.
Upload the marksheets, income certificate, fee receipt and bank passbook as clear scans.
Submit and print the application.
Take the printout with all original certificates to the nearest MYSY help centre. These sit inside selected colleges and the portal lists them district by district.
The officer at the help centre checks the originals and gives an acknowledgement. Keep it - it is your proof of applying.
Track the status on the portal with your user id.
The amount comes to the student's bank account by DBT, usually in parts as the college confirms the fee.
Apply again the next year with the new marksheet. Missing a year's renewal ends the help.
schemes.helpline: MYSY help centre at your college - the portal lists one for every district

schemes.title: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC, ST, OBC and EBC Students
schemes.department: Scheduled Caste Welfare, Developing Castes Welfare and Tribal Development Departments, Gujarat
schemes.brief: Fee reimbursement and a maintenance allowance for students of SC, ST, OBC and EBC families studying after Class 10. Every one of these scholarships is applied for on Digital Gujarat with a single citizen account, and the site works in Gujarati, Hindi and English. Students without a computer at home usually do it at the college scholarship desk or at a Jan Seva Kendra.
schemes.benefit: Tuition and other compulsory fees reimbursed, plus a monthly maintenance allowance that is higher for hostellers
eligibility: Domicile of Gujarat, with a caste certificate for SC, ST, OBC or an EBC certificate
Studying a recognised course after Class 10, in Gujarat
Family income within the ceiling fixed for your category - it differs for SC, ST, OBC and EBC, and the current figure is shown on the portal before you apply
Not repeating the same year of the same course
One scholarship only - you cannot draw two government scholarships for the same year
documents: Caste certificate issued by the competent authority
Income certificate from the Mamlatdar or the Jan Seva Kendra
Last year's marksheet and the current admission or fee receipt
Aadhaar card
Bank passbook in the student's own name, Aadhaar-seeded
Hostel certificate from the warden, if claiming the hosteller rate
School leaving certificate

demoFields.label: Student's name
demoFields.hint: As on the Class 10 marksheet. The name must match the bank account too, or the transfer fails.

demoFields.label: Digital Gujarat registered mobile
demoFields.hint: One account, one mobile number. Use the student's own - the OTP for every login comes here.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: The student's Aadhaar. Check on the portal that it is seeded to the bank account before you submit.

demoFields.label: Caste and caste certificate number
demoFields.hint: Choose the category that matches your certificate. Applying under the wrong department's scheme is the commonest reason for rejection.

demoFields.label: Income certificate number and date
demoFields.hint: Must be within the validity the portal states, usually issued in the same financial year.

demoFields.label: Course, year and college
demoFields.value: B.Com, second year, arts and commerce college, Nadiad
demoFields.hint: Write the course exactly as the college registers it. The college has to approve your form online afterwards.

demoFields.label: Hosteller or day scholar
demoFields.hint: Say hosteller only with a warden's certificate. The maintenance rate is different for the two.

demoFields.label: Bank account number and IFSC
demoFields.hint: The student's own account. Accounts in a parent's name, and dormant accounts, are rejected.

demoFields.label: Last year's marksheet and percentage
demoFields.hint: Upload the marksheet of the year just passed. A student who failed and is repeating the year cannot claim again.

demoSteps: Create one Digital Gujarat citizen account with your mobile number and an OTP. Do not make a second account later - all your years of scholarship sit under this one.
Switch the site to Gujarati from the language button at the top if that is easier to read.
Complete your profile first, including Aadhaar and bank details. The scholarship form pulls from it.
Open 'Scholarship' services and pick the scheme that matches your certificate - Scheduled Caste, Tribal, Developing Castes (OBC) or EBC. Each is run by a different department.
Fill the form, upload the caste certificate, income certificate, marksheet, fee receipt and passbook.
Submit, and print the acknowledgement.
Hand the printout and originals to your college scholarship clerk. The college has to verify the application on its own login - until it does, nothing moves.
The district officer of the concerned department sanctions the amount.
The fee part goes to the college and the maintenance part comes to your account by DBT.
Apply again at the start of each academic year, as soon as the portal opens; the window closes well before the exams.
schemes.helpline: Digital Gujarat helpdesk 1800-233-5500, or your college scholarship desk

schemes.title: Manav Garima Yojana - Free Tool Kits
schemes.department: Scheduled Caste Welfare Directorate, Social Justice & Empowerment Department, Gujarat
schemes.brief: A free tool kit so a person can start earning from a small trade at home - a sewing machine for tailoring, a carpentry set, a beauty parlour kit, a plumbing or mochi kit, and other trades on the department's list. The kit is given in kind, never as cash. Applications are made on e-Samaj Kalyan, which has a Gujarati interface, and when there are more applicants than kits the selection is made by a computerised draw.
schemes.benefit: A free tool kit for one trade of your choice from the department's list
eligibility: Belongs to a Scheduled Caste or a socially and economically backward class of Gujarat
Age between 18 and 60
Family income within the ceiling shown on the portal for the year
Should already know the trade, or have trained in it
One kit per family, once only - a family that has taken a kit under this scheme cannot apply again
documents: Aadhaar card
Caste certificate
Income certificate from the Mamlatdar or the Jan Seva Kendra
Ration card
Proof of age - school leaving certificate or birth certificate
Bank passbook
Proof of knowing the trade, such as a training certificate or an experience letter, where the trade needs it

demoFields.label: Applicant's name
demoFields.hint: As on the Aadhaar card. The caste certificate should carry the same name.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: Your own 12-digit number. e-Samaj Kalyan verifies the applicant against it.

demoFields.label: Date of birth / age
demoFields.hint: You must be between 18 and 60 on the date of applying.

demoFields.label: Caste and certificate number
demoFields.hint: Apply under the department that matches your certificate. An SC applicant applying under the OBC department is rejected outright.

demoFields.label: Trade chosen
demoFields.hint: Pick one trade only, from the list on the portal. You cannot change it after submitting.

demoFields.label: Income certificate number and date
demoFields.hint: Recent certificate from the Mamlatdar. Check the year's income ceiling on the portal before applying.

demoFields.label: Address
demoFields.value: Rathodvas, Limbasi, taluka Matar, district Kheda
demoFields.hint: Where you live now. The Talati verifies at this address.

demoFields.label: Ration card number
demoFields.hint: From the front of your barcoded ration card. It is used to check the family.

demoFields.label: Bank account number and IFSC
demoFields.hint: Give it even though the kit comes in kind - the department keeps it on record.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: The draw result and the collection message come by SMS to this number.

demoSteps: Register once as a citizen on e-Samaj Kalyan with your mobile number. Switch the site to Gujarati from the button at the top if that reads easier.
Choose the department that matches your certificate - Scheduled Caste Welfare, or Developing Castes Welfare for OBC applicants.
Open Manav Garima Yojana and pick the one trade you want the kit for.
Fill the form and upload the Aadhaar, caste certificate, income certificate, age proof and ration card.
Submit and take a printout. Many applicants get all this done by the VCE at the e-Gram centre or at a Jan Seva Kendra; if you do, keep your own user id and password with you.
If the district office asks for it, hand the printout with the original certificates at the district Deputy Director's office.
When there are more applicants than kits, a computerised draw decides. Watch for the SMS.
If selected, collect the kit from the place named in the message, against your ID.
There is no cash in this scheme - anyone asking for money to 'pass' your application is cheating you.
schemes.helpline: District Deputy Director, Scheduled Caste Welfare, or your nearest Jan Seva Kendra

schemes.title: OJAS - Gujarat Government Job Applications
schemes.department: Recruiting Boards of the Government of Gujarat
schemes.brief: The single site where Gujarat's recruiting boards advertise and take applications - panchayat service, subordinate services, police and Lok Rakshak, forest and many more. The advertisements themselves are published in Gujarati. The application is not counted until you confirm it and get a confirmation number, and the fee can be paid online or by printing a challan and paying it at a computerised post office.
schemes.benefit: One registration to apply for state and panchayat service vacancies
eligibility: Age, qualification and other conditions are as stated in each advertisement, not on the site generally
Knowledge of Gujarati is required for most posts
Age relaxation for SC, ST, OBC, women and ex-servicemen, as the advertisement says
The fee is usually waived for SC, ST, ex-servicemen and physically handicapped candidates
Apply separately for every advertisement - one registration does not apply you to everything
documents: Photograph and signature scanned to the size the advertisement states, in the stated file size
Class 10 and Class 12 marksheets and the degree or diploma certificate
School leaving certificate
Caste certificate, and a non-creamy-layer certificate for OBC candidates
EWS certificate, where claimed
Aadhaar card
Computer course certificate (CCC), where the post requires it

demoFields.label: Advertisement number
demoFields.hint: Copy it from the advertisement. Each post has its own number and its own application.

demoFields.label: Post applied for
demoFields.hint: Read the advertisement fully before choosing. You cannot change the post after confirming.

demoFields.label: Candidate's name
demoFields.hint: Exactly as on the Class 10 marksheet. A different spelling later can cost you the appointment.

demoFields.label: Date of birth
demoFields.hint: As on the Class 10 marksheet. Age is counted on the date the advertisement fixes, not on the day you apply.

demoFields.label: Category
demoFields.hint: Claim a category only with a valid certificate in the government's own format. The fee and the age relaxation follow from it.

demoFields.label: Qualification and percentage
demoFields.hint: The qualification the post asks for, with the university and the year of passing.

demoFields.label: Photograph and signature
demoFields.value: Photo 10 kb JPG, signature 8 kb JPG
demoFields.hint: Follow the size in the advertisement exactly. An oversized file will not upload and a blurred signature gets the form rejected at the exam hall.

demoFields.label: Mobile number and email
demoFields.hint: Use your own, and keep them for the whole recruitment - the call letter notice comes here.

demoFields.label: Confirmation number
demoFields.hint: This number is the only proof that you applied. Note it down and keep the printout.

demoFields.label: Fee payment
demoFields.hint: Pay online, or print the challan and pay it at a computerised post office before the last date. An unpaid application is not considered.

demoSteps: Open the advertisement on OJAS and read it end to end - age, qualification, fee and the last date. They are published in Gujarati.
Click Apply for that advertisement and fill the form. Fill it yourself where you can; if a cyber cafe or Jan Seva Kendra types it for you, sit with them and keep your own user id and password.
Upload the photograph and signature in the exact size stated.
Save the form, then confirm it. This is the step candidates lose their year on - an unconfirmed application is not an application, and it cannot be confirmed after the last date.
Note the confirmation number that appears.
Pay the fee online, or print the challan and pay it at a computerised post office within the days allowed.
Print the confirmed application and keep it with the fee receipt until the whole recruitment is over.
Download the call letter from the same site when it is released; it is not posted to you.
Carry the call letter and an original photo ID to the exam hall.
Check the site for the answer key, results and document verification notices - all of it is published here and nowhere else.
schemes.helpline: The helpdesk number printed on the advertisement you are applying against

schemes.title: AnyRoR - 7/12 and 8-A Land Records
schemes.department: Revenue Department, Gujarat (e-Dhara)
schemes.brief: See and print the land record of any village in Gujarat - the 7/12 (village form 7 and 12) survey-wise, the 8-A khata-wise, and the mutation entries. Viewing is free and needs no login. The site and the extract are both in Gujarati. The copy you print here is unsigned and meant for information; for a bank loan or a court case take the digitally signed copy, or the stamped copy from the e-Dhara Kendra at your taluka Mamlatdar office.
schemes.benefit: Free view and print of 7/12, 8-A and entry records for any village in the state
eligibility: Open to anyone - no login is needed just to view a record
You need to know the district, taluka and village, and the survey number or khata number
The owner's name can be searched if you do not know the number
A registered login and a small fee are needed for a digitally signed copy
Urban property cards are under the separate urban section, not under 7/12
documents: Nothing is needed to view a record
Know your district, taluka and village
The survey number from an old 7/12, or the khata number from the 8-A
A mobile number, for the digitally signed copy

demoFields.label: Record wanted
demoFields.hint: VF-7 for the 7/12 by survey number, VF-8A for the khata, VF-6 for the mutation entries.

demoFields.label: Area type
demoFields.hint: Rural for village land. For a flat or plot inside a city, use the urban property card section instead.

demoFields.label: District
demoFields.hint: Choose from the list. If the district was split, pick the one the village falls under today.

demoFields.label: Taluka
demoFields.hint: The taluka the village belongs to. The village list changes once you pick this.

demoFields.label: Village
demoFields.hint: Pick from the drop-down. Village names repeat across talukas, so check the taluka first.

demoFields.label: Survey number
demoFields.hint: Exactly as on an old 7/12, with the 'paiki' part if there is one. A missing part number brings up the wrong plot.

demoFields.label: Khata number
demoFields.hint: Only for VF-8A. It lists every survey number the same owner holds in that village.

demoFields.label: Owner's name (to search)
demoFields.hint: Use this when you do not know the survey number. Type the name in Gujarati as it appears in the record.

demoFields.label: Verification code
demoFields.hint: Type the characters shown in the box. If it will not accept them, refresh for a new code.

demoSteps: Open the AnyRoR site and switch it to Gujarati if that is easier to read.
Choose 'View land record - rural' for village land, or the urban section for a city property.
Pick VF-7 for the 7/12, VF-8A for the khata, or VF-6 to see the mutation entries and how the land changed hands.
Select the district, taluka and village.
Enter the survey number or the khata number. If you have neither, search by the owner's name.
Type the verification code and the record opens on screen, in Gujarati.
Print it or save the PDF. This free copy is unsigned and is for your information only.
For a digitally signed copy, register on the site with your mobile number and pay the small fee - this one is accepted where a certified copy is asked for.
For a court case, or where the bank insists on a stamped copy, go to the e-Dhara Kendra at your taluka Mamlatdar office.
If the record shows an old owner after a sale or inheritance, the mutation has not been done - that is a job for the Talati and the e-Dhara Kendra, not the website.
schemes.helpline: e-Dhara Kendra at your taluka Mamlatdar office

schemes.title: e-Nagar - Birth Certificate, Property Tax & Municipal Services
schemes.department: Urban Development & Urban Housing Department, Gujarat
schemes.brief: One login for the municipal work of Gujarat's cities and towns - birth and death certificates, property tax, professional tax, water and drainage connections, shop licences and complaints. Certificates come as digitally signed PDFs you can print at home, so there is no need to stand in a queue for a copy. The portal works in Gujarati and English, and the Civic Centre or Jan Seva Kendra of your municipality will do it for you if you have no computer.
schemes.benefit: Certificates, tax payments and municipal applications without a trip to the office
eligibility: The birth or death must have been registered with a municipality or municipal corporation in Gujarat - village births are registered at the Gram Panchayat instead
For property tax you need the tenement or property number of the property
Anyone can register on the portal with a mobile number
A birth certificate is free if the birth is registered within 21 days; a late fee applies after that
documents: Hospital birth record or the discharge slip, for a first registration
Parents' Aadhaar cards
Address proof
An old property tax bill or receipt showing the tenement number, for tax services
Nothing at all to download a certificate that is already registered - the registration number is enough

demoFields.label: Service chosen
demoFields.value: Birth certificate - download a certified copy
demoFields.hint: Pick the service first. The form changes completely between certificates, tax and connections.

demoFields.label: City or Nagarpalika
demoFields.hint: Choose the body where the birth was registered or where the property is. Choosing the wrong town shows no record.
