demoFields.label: Child's name and date of birth
demoFields.hint: If the birth was registered before the child was named, search by date and parents' names instead.

demoFields.label: Registration number
demoFields.hint: From the slip the hospital or the municipality gave at registration. With this the record comes up at once.

demoFields.label: Father's name
demoFields.hint: As given at the time of registration. Used to find the record when you have no registration number.

demoFields.label: Mother's name
demoFields.hint: As given at registration. Both parents' names together narrow the search.

demoFields.label: Tenement / property number
demoFields.hint: For property tax only. It is printed at the top of any old tax bill.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: Login is by OTP on this number, and the payment receipt is sent here.

demoFields.label: Amount payable
demoFields.hint: Certificates carry a small fee; property tax shows the dues for the year. Pay by UPI, card or net banking.

demoSteps: Register on e-Nagar with your mobile number and an OTP, or log in if you already have an account.
Switch the language to Gujarati from the top of the page if that is easier.
Choose your municipality or municipal corporation. Everything after this is specific to that town.
For a certificate, open Birth & Death and search by the registration number, or by date of birth with the parents' names.
Check the record on screen carefully - the spelling on the screen is what will print on the certificate.
Pay the small fee online and download the digitally signed PDF. A printout of it is valid; it does not need any further stamp.
For property tax, search by the tenement number, see the dues, pay online and download the receipt at once.
For a new water or drainage connection, or a shop licence, fill the form and upload the papers; the file is then processed by the town's office.
If you have no computer or smartphone, the Civic Centre or Jan Seva Kendra at your municipality does all of this at the counter.
Register a birth within 21 days and the certificate costs nothing - after that a late fee applies and the delay has to be explained.
schemes.helpline: Civic Centre of your municipality or municipal corporation

schemes.title: Ganga Swarupa Yojana - Widow Pension
schemes.department: Women & Child Development Department, Gujarat
schemes.brief: A monthly pension for a widow, paid straight into her bank or post office account. The name of the scheme is deliberate - the government treats her as Ganga Swarupa rather than as a widow. The pension is not stopped when her son turns 21; that old rule has gone. Applications go through e-Samaj Kalyan, but most widows hand the form in at the taluka Mamlatdar's office or a Jan Seva Kendra, and the Talati does the village verification.
schemes.benefit: Rs.1,250 a month, credited by direct transfer
eligibility: Widow aged 18 or above, resident of Gujarat
Family income within the ceiling fixed for rural and for urban areas
Has not remarried - the pension stops on remarriage
Continues even if an adult son lives with her
A continuation certificate has to be given every year for the pension to go on
documents: Husband's death certificate
Widow certificate from the Talati-cum-Mantri or the Mamlatdar
Applicant's Aadhaar card
Income certificate
Age proof - school leaving certificate, birth certificate or an election card
Bank or post office passbook in her own name
Ration card and residence proof

demoFields.label: Applicant's name
demoFields.hint: Her own name as on her Aadhaar card, not her husband's name alone.

demoFields.label: Husband's name and death certificate number
demoFields.hint: The number printed on the death certificate from the Gram Panchayat or Nagarpalika. Nothing moves without this certificate.

demoFields.label: Date of birth / age
demoFields.hint: She must be 18 or above. Give whatever age proof you have - an election card is accepted.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: Her own Aadhaar, seeded to the account where the pension will come.

demoFields.label: Family annual income
demoFields.hint: From the Mamlatdar's income certificate. The ceiling is different for village and city areas - ask at the Mamlatdar's office which applies to you.

demoFields.label: Bank or post office account and IFSC
demoFields.hint: In her own name only. A post office account is fine. It must be active - a dormant account is the usual reason a pension stops.

demoFields.label: Village / Taluka / District
demoFields.hint: Where she lives. The Talati of this village signs the verification.

demoFields.label: Ration card number
demoFields.hint: From the front of the barcoded ration card, used to establish the family.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: Her own or a family member's. The sanction and the monthly credit messages come here.

demoSteps: Collect the husband's death certificate from the Gram Panchayat or Nagarpalika.
Get the widow certificate and the income certificate from the Talati-cum-Mantri and the Mamlatdar's office.
Open a savings account in her own name, at a bank or post office, and get the Aadhaar seeded.

Apply on e-Samaj Kalyan, which can be switched to Gujarati from the top of the page, or fill the Gujarati form and hand it in at the taluka Mamlatdar's office or the Jan Seva Kendra - the counter route is what most applicants use, and the clerk checks the papers on the spot.
The Talati verifies in the village and the Mamlatdar's office processes the case.
Keep the acknowledgement slip. Ask for the sanction order number once it is passed.
The pension is credited every month by direct transfer.
Every year, give the continuation certificate - that she is alive and has not remarried - at the Mamlatdar's office. Miss it and the pension stops until you go and restart it.
Tell the Mamlatdar's office at once if the bank account or the address changes.
schemes.helpline: Taluka Mamlatdar's office, or the District Women & Child Development Officer

schemes.title: Kunvarbai nu Mameru Yojana - Marriage Assistance
schemes.department: Developing Castes Welfare and Scheduled Caste Welfare Directorates, Gujarat
schemes.brief: Rs.12,000 paid to a bride from an SC, socially and educationally backward, or EBC family at the time of her marriage - the government's mameru. The money goes to the bride's own bank account, not to the groom or the family. The marriage must be registered first, and the claim has to be made within two years of the wedding. Applications are on e-Samaj Kalyan, which works in Gujarati.
schemes.benefit: Rs.12,000 to the bride, by direct bank transfer
eligibility: Bride from a Scheduled Caste, socially and educationally backward class, or EBC family of Gujarat
Bride 18 or above and groom 21 or above on the date of marriage
Help is given for at most two daughters in one family
Family income within the ceiling shown on the portal
The application must be made within two years of the marriage date
documents: Marriage registration certificate
Caste certificate of the bride's family
Income certificate
Bride's Aadhaar card and bank passbook
Age proof of the bride and the groom - school leaving certificate or birth certificate
Groom's Aadhaar card
Wedding invitation card (kankotri) and a joint photograph

demoFields.label: Bride's name
demoFields.hint: Her maiden name as on the school leaving certificate and the caste certificate, even if she has changed it after marriage.

demoFields.label: Groom's name
demoFields.hint: As on his Aadhaar and on the marriage registration certificate.

demoFields.label: Date of marriage
demoFields.hint: From the marriage registration certificate. Count two years from this date - that is your last day to apply.

demoFields.label: Marriage registration number
demoFields.hint: Register the marriage at the Gram Panchayat or Nagarpalika first. Without this certificate the form cannot be submitted.

demoFields.label: Bride's date of birth
demoFields.hint: She must have been 18 or more on the wedding day, and the groom 21 or more.

demoFields.label: Caste and certificate number
demoFields.hint: The bride's own family's certificate. Apply under the department that issued it.

demoFields.label: Family annual income
demoFields.hint: From the Mamlatdar's income certificate. Check the year's ceiling on the portal.

demoFields.label: Bride's bank account and IFSC
demoFields.hint: It must be the bride's own single account, Aadhaar-seeded. A joint account with the husband or an account in the father's name is rejected.

demoFields.label: Village / Taluka / District
demoFields.hint: The bride's parental address, which is where the caste and income certificates were issued.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: Keep the same number until the money arrives; the sanction message comes here.

demoSteps: Register the marriage at the Gram Panchayat or the Nagarpalika and collect the certificate. Nothing else can start before this.
Open a savings account in the bride's own name if she does not have one, and get her Aadhaar seeded to it.
Log in to e-Samaj Kalyan as a citizen, or register with your mobile number. The site can be switched to Gujarati.
Choose the department matching the bride's caste certificate, then Kunvarbai nu Mameru Yojana.
Fill the form and upload the marriage certificate, caste and income certificates, both Aadhaar cards, age proofs, the invitation card and the photograph.
Submit within two years of the wedding date and print the acknowledgement.
Hand the printout with the originals at the district office of the concerned welfare department, or through the Jan Seva Kendra if they tell you to.
The district officer verifies and sanctions.
Rs.12,000 is credited to the bride's own account by DBT.
If the payment fails, the fault is nearly always the bank account - check the seeding before you file anything again.
schemes.helpline: District Deputy Director of the concerned welfare department, or your nearest Jan Seva Kendra

schemes.title: Namo Laxmi Yojana
schemes.department: Education Department, Gujarat
schemes.brief: Rs.50,000 to a girl over her four years of secondary and higher secondary schooling - Rs.10,000 in each of classes 9 and 10, and Rs.15,000 in each of classes 11 and 12. Part comes month by month and part on passing the board exam. Parents do not apply on their own: the school enters the girl on the portal, so the documents go to the class teacher or the school clerk. The portal is available in Gujarati.
schemes.benefit: Rs.50,000 in all, across classes 9 to 12
eligibility: Girl studying in class 9 to 12 in a government, grant-in-aid or approved private school in Gujarat
Family income up to Rs.6 lakh a year
Regular attendance - the instalment for a term depends on it
The board exam instalment is paid on passing Class 10 and Class 12
A girl who drops out stops receiving the money from that term
documents: Girl's Aadhaar card
Mother's or father's Aadhaar card
Income certificate, or the self-declaration the school gives out
Bank account in the girl's name, or a joint account with the mother
School admission number (GR number)
Ration card

demoFields.label: Girl's name
demoFields.hint: As written in the school register. The school types it from the GR, so tell them if the spelling on the Aadhaar is different.

demoFields.label: School and GR number
demoFields.value: Shri Sarvajanik High School, Vanthali, Junagadh - GR 4482
demoFields.hint: The GR number is on the girl's school ID or the fee book. The clerk can read it out.

demoFields.label: Class and division
demoFields.hint: The class she is in now. The amount changes when she reaches class 11.

demoFields.label: Date of birth
demoFields.hint: Same as the school record and the Aadhaar. A mismatch holds up the payment.

demoFields.label: Mother's name
demoFields.hint: The mother's name as on her Aadhaar, since the account is usually joint with her.

demoFields.label: Girl's Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: The girl's own Aadhaar. If she does not have one yet, get it made first - the payment cannot be released without it.

demoFields.label: Family annual income
demoFields.hint: Both parents together. Up to Rs.6 lakh qualifies. Give the income certificate or the school's declaration form.

demoFields.label: Bank account number and IFSC
demoFields.hint: In the girl's name or joint with the mother. It must be active and Aadhaar-seeded - a dormant account is the main reason money bounces back.

demoFields.label: Parent's mobile number
demoFields.hint: Every instalment message comes here. Give the number the family actually uses.

demoSteps: Get a bank account opened in the girl's name, or joint with her mother, and have the Aadhaar seeded to it. Do this first - everything else waits on it.
If the school asks for an income certificate rather than its own declaration form, get it from the Mamlatdar's office or a Jan Seva Kendra.
Give the class teacher or the school clerk copies of the girl's Aadhaar, the mother's Aadhaar, the passbook and the income proof.
The school enrols the girl on the portal from its own login. There is no separate parent login for this scheme.
Check with the clerk that the bank account and Aadhaar were entered correctly, and that the account is shown as verified.
Attendance is reported by the school each term; the term instalment follows it.
The monthly part is credited through the year and the board-exam part after she passes Class 10, and again after Class 12.
If the money does not arrive, ask the school to check the account status on the portal before going anywhere else - almost every failure is a bank seeding problem.
Nothing has to be filled again when she moves from class 9 to 10 or 11 to 12; the school carries the record forward.
schemes.helpline: Your school's principal or clerk; Digital Gujarat helpdesk 1800-233-5500

schemes.title: Vahali Dikri Yojana
schemes.department: Women & Child Development Department, Gujarat
schemes.brief: Rs.1.10 lakh for a daughter of a family with small means, given in three parts - Rs.4,000 when she joins Class 1, Rs.6,000 when she joins Class 9, and Rs.1,00,000 when she turns 18, for her higher education or marriage. Only the first and second daughters count. The form has to be given within one year of the daughter's birth, and most families hand it in through their Anganwadi worker or the VCE at the Gram Panchayat rather than online.
schemes.benefit: Rs.1,10,000 in three instalments - Rs.4,000, Rs.6,000 and Rs.1,00,000
eligibility: First and second daughter of the family; a third daughter is not covered
Family income up to Rs.2 lakh a year
The parents' marriage must be registered
The application has to be made within one year of the daughter's birth
The family must be resident in Gujarat
documents: Daughter's birth certificate
Aadhaar cards of both parents
Income certificate from the Mamlatdar or the Jan Seva Kendra
Marriage registration certificate of the parents
Bank passbook of the parent in whose account the money goes
Self-declaration on stamp paper about the number of daughters, on the form the department provides
Ration card and residence proof

demoFields.label: Daughter's name and date of birth
demoFields.hint: As on the birth certificate. If the child has not been named yet on the certificate, get it updated first.

demoFields.label: Birth registration number
demoFields.hint: Printed on the birth certificate given by the Gram Panchayat or the Nagarpalika.

demoFields.label: Father's name
demoFields.hint: As on his Aadhaar card.

demoFields.label: Mother's name
demoFields.hint: As on her Aadhaar card. It should match the marriage registration certificate.

demoFields.label: Which daughter is she
demoFields.hint: First or second only. Declare all living children honestly - the Talati verifies this in the village record.

demoFields.label: Family annual income
demoFields.hint: Must be Rs.2 lakh or less. The figure has to come from the Mamlatdar's income certificate, not your own estimate.

demoFields.label: Parents' marriage registration number
demoFields.hint: From the marriage registration certificate. If the marriage was never registered, get it registered at the Gram Panchayat first.

demoFields.label: Bank account number and IFSC
demoFields.hint: An account of the parent, active and Aadhaar-seeded. The Rs.1 lakh at 18 later goes to the daughter's own account.

demoFields.label: Village / Taluka / District
demoFields.hint: Where the family actually lives. The Talati of this village does the verification.

demoSteps: Register the daughter's birth and collect the birth certificate from the Gram Panchayat or Nagarpalika.
Get the income certificate from the Mamlatdar or a Jan Seva Kendra, and the parents' marriage registration certificate if you do not already have one.
Take the form from your Anganwadi worker, the Gram Panchayat VCE, or download it from the department's site. It is in Gujarati.
Fill it and attach the birth certificate, both parents' Aadhaar, income certificate, marriage certificate, passbook copy and the declaration about the number of daughters.

Hand the set in at the Anganwadi centre, or at the taluka ICDS (CDPO) office or the Mamlatdar's office. The Anganwadi route is what most families use, and the worker checks the papers before they go up.
Do this within one year of the birth. An application made later is not accepted, whatever the reason.
Keep the acknowledgement slip safely - you will need it at each of the three instalments.
The District Women & Child Development Officer sanctions the case.
The first instalment comes when the girl is admitted to Class 1, the second at Class 9, and Rs.1 lakh when she turns 18 and is unmarried at that date.
At each stage produce the school certificate; the money does not come on its own.
schemes.helpline: Your Anganwadi worker, or the District Women & Child Development Officer / taluka CDPO office

schemes.title: Jamabandi Haryana — Land Records and Mutation
schemes.department: Revenue and Disaster Management Department, Government of Haryana
schemes.brief: Jamabandi is where a Haryana landholder sees the record of rights, the mutation register and the cadastral map, checks the collector rate before a sale, and tracks a mutation after a purchase or a death. Most of it needs no login.
schemes.benefit: Jamabandi nakal, mutation status, cadastral map and collector rates online
eligibility: Land situated in Haryana and entered in the revenue record
Anyone may view a jamabandi or a mutation; only the holder or an heir can apply to change one
A mutation on sale needs the registered deed; one on inheritance needs the death certificate and heirship papers
A certified copy for a bank or a court is issued by the tehsil, not printed from the site
documents: District, tehsil and village name
Khewat, khasra or murabba number, or the owner's name
Aadhaar card, for a mutation application
Registered sale deed, for a mutation on purchase
Death certificate and legal heir details, for a mutation on inheritance

demoFields.label: What you want to see
demoFields.hint: Jamabandi nakal, mutation status, registered deed, cadastral map, collector rate, or the check on land ownership before buying.

demoFields.label: District / Tehsil / Village
demoFields.hint: Pick all three from the lists. The record is held village by village.

demoFields.label: Search by
demoFields.hint: Khewat, khasra or murabba number, or the owner's name. Khewat is the account and gives the cleanest result.

demoFields.label: Khewat Number
demoFields.hint: From an older jamabandi or the purchase deed.

demoFields.label: Khasra / Murabba and Killa Number
demoFields.hint: Copy it exactly. In Haryana the murabba and killa are how a plot is actually identified on the ground.

demoFields.label: Owner's name as on the record
demoFields.value: Ranbir Singh, son of Dalbir Singh
demoFields.hint: Spelt as on the land record, which may differ from Aadhaar. Search the record's spelling first.

demoFields.label: Jamabandi year
demoFields.hint: The jamabandi is revised every five years. Take the latest unless an office has asked for an older one.

demoFields.label: Mutation number, to check status
demoFields.hint: Given when the mutation is entered. Track the stage against it rather than going to the tehsil.

demoSteps: Open jamabandi.nic.in, pick district, tehsil and village, and search by khewat, khasra or owner's name. The view is free and needs no login.
Check the share, the area and the owner's name against what you know. Before buying land, use the same site to see the registered deeds and the collector rate for that village.
For a bank or a court, ask the tehsil for a certified copy. The print from the site is for your own reference.
After a purchase or a death, the mutation is entered at the tehsil with the registered deed or the death certificate and heirship papers.
Track the mutation on the site by its number. The stages — entry, notice, order — are all shown.
Once the order is passed, pull a fresh jamabandi and check that your name and share are right. An error is far easier to fix now than years later.
schemes.helpline: Your tehsil revenue office, or the patwari of your village circle

schemes.title: Antyodaya SARAL Haryana — Schemes and Certificates
schemes.department: Citizen Resources Information Department, Government of Haryana
schemes.brief: SARAL is the single window through which Haryana delivers its schemes and certificates — income, caste, residence and domicile certificates, pensions, scholarships and departmental services. Most of it is tied to the Parivar Pehchan Patra, the family ID, which the portal reads your details from.
schemes.benefit: Certificates, pensions and scheme applications in one place, with a fixed delivery time
eligibility: Resident of Haryana, with the family registered under the Parivar Pehchan Patra
A domicile certificate needs proof the family has lived in Haryana for the qualifying period
A caste certificate needs the caste to be on the Haryana SC, BC-A or BC-B list
Each service has its own delivery time under the state's Right to Service Act
documents: Parivar Pehchan Patra (Family ID) number
Aadhaar card of the applicant
Ration card or voter card as residence proof
Father's caste certificate or a school record, for a caste certificate
Income proof — salary certificate, or a land record for a farming family
Passport-size photograph

demoFields.label: Service wanted
demoFields.hint: Income, caste, residence or domicile certificate, an old-age pension, a scholarship, or a departmental service. Each has its own form and delivery time.

demoFields.label: Parivar Pehchan Patra (Family ID)
demoFields.hint: Eight digits. Most services read your name, family and income from it, so get the Family ID made and verified first.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Letter for letter as on Aadhaar and the Family ID. A mismatch between the two stops the application.

demoFields.label: Father's / Husband's Name
demoFields.hint: Used to identify the family; essential for a caste certificate.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. Identity is confirmed on this and the OTP goes to the linked mobile.

demoFields.label: District / Tehsil / Village or Ward
demoFields.hint: Where the family lives. The Tehsildar of this tehsil signs the certificate.

demoFields.label: Annual Family Income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: For an income certificate. Note that the income already recorded in the Family ID is what most schemes actually use, so get that corrected if it is wrong.

demoFields.label: Caste and category
demoFields.hint: Pick from the Haryana list. BC-A and BC-B are separate lists with separate benefits.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The ticket number and the ready message come here by SMS.

demoSteps: Check your Parivar Pehchan Patra first on the Family ID portal, and get the income and member details corrected there if they are wrong. SARAL and most Haryana schemes take the figures from it, not from what you type.
Register on saralharyana.gov.in with your mobile, or go to a Saral Kendra or Atal Seva Kendra, which files it across the counter.
Choose the service, fill the form — most of it fills itself from the Family ID — and upload the documents.
Pay the fee and note the ticket number from the acknowledgement.
The patwari or the tehsil staff verify the family. Be reachable on the mobile you gave.
The signed certificate is issued within the time the Right to Service Act sets for that service, and is downloaded from the same login.
If the deadline passes, the same Act gives you an appeal, and the ticket number is what you quote. The status of any SARAL application can be tracked without logging in.
schemes.helpline: 1800 2000 023 — SARAL Haryana helpline

schemes.title: HimSeva — Himachal Pradesh e-District Certificates
schemes.department: Department of Revenue, Government of Himachal Pradesh
schemes.brief: HimSeva is Himachal Pradesh's e-District system. Bonafide Himachali, income, caste, agriculturist and other revenue certificates are applied for here instead of at the tehsil, which in the hills can be several hours away.
schemes.benefit: Bonafide Himachali, income, caste and agriculturist certificates applied for online
eligibility: Resident of Himachal Pradesh, applying in the tehsil where the family lives
A bonafide Himachali certificate needs proof the family has lived in the state for the qualifying period
An agriculturist certificate needs land recorded in the family's name in Himachal Pradesh
An income certificate is valid for one year
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant
Ration card of the family
Parivar register (parivar nakal) copy from the panchayat
Land record (jamabandi) copy, for an agriculturist certificate
Father's caste certificate, for a caste certificate
Income proof — salary certificate or an affidavit
Passport-size photograph

demoFields.label: Certificate applied for
demoFields.hint: Bonafide Himachali, income, caste, agriculturist, character or a revenue service. Each has its own form and proof.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Letter for letter as on Aadhaar. The certificate prints from this entry.

demoFields.label: Father's / Husband's Name
demoFields.hint: Used to identify the family in the parivar register and the revenue records.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. Identity is confirmed on this and the OTP goes to the linked mobile.

demoFields.label: District / Tehsil / Panchayat or Ward
demoFields.hint: Where the family lives. The Tehsildar of this tehsil signs the certificate.

demoFields.label: Parivar Register number
demoFields.hint: The panchayat's family register entry. Most Himachal certificates are checked against it, so get a fresh copy before applying.

demoFields.label: Years resident in Himachal Pradesh
demoFields.hint: For the bonafide Himachali certificate. The parivar register and old land records are what prove it.

demoFields.label: Annual Family Income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: For an income certificate, the household's total for the year including farming and horticulture.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The application number and the ready message come here by SMS.

demoSteps: Get a current copy of the parivar register from your panchayat first. Most Himachal certificates are verified against it and the file stops without it.
Register on himseva.hp.gov.in with your mobile, or use a Lok Mitra Kendra, which files it for the notified fee.
Choose the certificate and fill the form from your Aadhaar, ration card and parivar register.
Upload the documents, pay the fee, and note the application number.
The patwari and the panchayat secretary verify the family, then the Tehsildar signs.
Download the signed certificate from the same login. A digitally signed copy needs no attestation.
If it is delayed beyond the time the service promises, quote the application number at the tehsil and then at the Deputy Commissioner's office.
schemes.helpline: 1100 — Himachal Pradesh CM Seva Sankalp helpline

schemes.title: Himachal Pradesh Ration Card — ePDS
schemes.department: Department of Food, Civil Supplies and Consumer Affairs, Himachal Pradesh
schemes.brief: Himachal Pradesh's ration card system, where you check the family's card, see what the depot issued in your name, add or remove a member, and apply for a new card. The state gives subsidised pulses and oil alongside the NFSA grain, so the card is worth keeping correct even for families above the poverty line.
schemes.benefit: Ration card with NFSA grain, and the state's subsidised pulses, oil and salt
eligibility: Family resident in Himachal Pradesh and holding no ration card elsewhere in India
NFSA category decided from the household's circumstances; other families get an APL card with the state subsidy
A woman of the household aged 18 or above is recorded as head of the family
Every member's Aadhaar must be seeded, or that member's share is not issued
documents: Aadhaar cards of every member of the family
Parivar register (parivar nakal) copy from the panchayat
Address proof — electricity bill or house tax receipt
Deletion certificate from the earlier card, where a member has moved in
Birth certificate for a newborn, or marriage certificate for a bride
Gas connection number
Passport photograph of the head of the family

demoFields.label: Service wanted
demoFields.hint: New card, add a member, remove a member, correct a detail, or check the depot's issue against your name.

demoFields.label: Ration Card Number
demoFields.hint: From the front of the card. Leave it blank only for a brand new card.

demoFields.label: Head of the Family
demoFields.hint: A woman of the household aged 18 or above. The card is issued in her name.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar of the Head
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. The family's entitlement is tracked against this.

demoFields.label: Member to be added, relation and Aadhaar
demoFields.hint: Name as on that person's own Aadhaar, and the relation to the head.

demoFields.label: Reason and supporting certificate
demoFields.value: Marriage on 07-04-2026; deletion certificate from parents' card at Karsog
demoFields.hint: A bride needs the marriage certificate and the deletion certificate from her parents' card. A newborn needs only the birth certificate.

demoFields.label: District / Tehsil / Panchayat or Ward
demoFields.hint: Where the family lives. The depot is allotted from this address.

demoFields.label: Fair Price Shop (depot) code
demoFields.hint: Printed on the card and on the depot's board. It tells the office which register to update.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The application number and each month's issue message come here.

demoSteps: Open epds.hp.gov.in and search your card first. The same site shows what the depot recorded as issued in your name each month.
Choose the service you need, or take the papers to the Inspector, Food and Civil Supplies of your circle, who files it across the counter.
List every member who eats from the same kitchen, each with the exact Aadhaar. The grain and the subsidised pulses are counted per name.
Attach the parivar register copy, the address proof, and for a member moving in the deletion certificate from the old card.
The inspector verifies the household and the card is issued or updated. Download it and check every name and Aadhaar.
Get the new member's Aadhaar seeded at the depot's ePoS machine. Until then the family's quantity does not increase.
If the record shows grain issued in a month you did not collect any, that is the evidence. Take a printout to the Inspector and complain on 1967.
schemes.helpline: 1967 and 1800 180 8026 — HP Food and Civil Supplies

schemes.title: JKSSB Recruitment — Jammu & Kashmir Group C and D Posts
schemes.department: Jammu and Kashmir Services Selection Board
schemes.brief: The Services Selection Board recruits for most non-gazetted posts in Jammu and Kashmir — junior assistant, patwari, teacher, technician and the police and health cadres. Every advertisement is applied for through the Board's own online system.
schemes.benefit: One online profile for every JKSSB advertisement, with admit cards and results
eligibility: Domicile of Jammu and Kashmir, proved by the domicile certificate
Age as the advertisement states, usually 18 to 40, with relaxation for reserved categories and disability
The qualification the post requires, complete on the closing date of that advertisement
Reservation claims under RBA, ALC, SC, ST, OBC, EWS or disability need the certificate on the J&K format
documents: Domicile certificate of Jammu and Kashmir
Aadhaar card
Class 10 certificate for date of birth
Degree, diploma or technical qualification certificates and marksheets
Category certificate — RBA, ALC, SC, ST, OBC or EWS — on the J&K format
Disability or ex-serviceman certificate, where claiming that reservation
Recent passport photograph and a scanned signature

demoFields.label: Advertisement and post applied for
demoFields.value: Advt 04 of 2026 — Junior Assistant, Revenue Department
demoFields.hint: One application per post. Read the qualification and the age limit in that advertisement before paying.

demoFields.label: Candidate Name (as on Class 10 certificate)
demoFields.hint: The Class 10 certificate governs, not Aadhaar, where the two differ. Everything later is checked against it.

demoFields.label: Father's Name
demoFields.hint: As on the Class 10 certificate.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth
demoFields.hint: As on the Class 10 certificate. Age limits count from this date and it cannot be changed after registration.

demoFields.label: Domicile Certificate Number
demoFields.hint: No JKSSB post can be applied for without a J&K domicile certificate. Get it from e-UNNAT well before the closing date.

demoFields.label: Category claimed
demoFields.hint: Open merit, RBA, ALC, SC, ST, OBC, EWS, disability or ex-serviceman. Claim only what you hold a J&K-format certificate for.

demoFields.label: Educational Qualification
demoFields.hint: It must be complete on the closing date, not merely expected. Many posts also need a computer certificate.

demoFields.label: Examination district preference
demoFields.hint: Give two or three. The Board allots the nearest centre it can.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number and Email
demoFields.hint: The application number, admit card and every notice come here. Do not use a friend's number.

demoSteps: Get the domicile certificate from e-UNNAT first if you do not have it. Nothing at JKSSB can be applied for without one.
Watch jkssb.nic.in for the advertisement and read the qualification and age limits before anything else.
Register with your name and date of birth exactly as on the Class 10 certificate, and upload the photograph and signature in the sizes stated.
Fill the application, claim only the categories you hold J&K-format certificates for, choose your centres and pay the fee online.
Use the correction window if the Board opens one; it is the only chance to fix a wrong entry.
Download the admit card about a week before the exam and take it with a photo ID.
Results and the answer key come out on the same site. Document verification is last, where the originals of the domicile and category certificates must be produced.
schemes.helpline: JKSSB office, Zamzam Building, Rambagh, Srinagar; helpdesk details on jkssb.nic.in

schemes.title: e-UNNAT Jammu & Kashmir — Certificates and Services
schemes.department: Department of Information Technology, Jammu and Kashmir
schemes.brief: e-UNNAT brings the services of nearly every Jammu and Kashmir department into one place — domicile, income, category and other certificates, revenue services, scheme applications and departmental permissions, each with a delivery time set under the Public Services Guarantee Act.
schemes.benefit: Domicile, income and category certificates and departmental services in one place
eligibility: Resident of Jammu and Kashmir, applying in the tehsil where the family lives
A domicile certificate has its own conditions on years of residence, study or service in the union territory
A category certificate is issued for the categories notified for Jammu and Kashmir
An income certificate is valid for one year
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant
Ration card of the family
Permanent Resident Certificate of a parent, or other proof of residence, for a domicile certificate
School leaving certificate or Class 10 certificate for date of birth
Electricity bill or rent agreement for the address
Income proof — salary certificate or an affidavit
Passport-size photograph

demoFields.label: Service wanted
demoFields.hint: Domicile, income, category, character or a revenue service. Each has its own form, fee and delivery time.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Letter for letter as on Aadhaar. The certificate prints from this entry.

demoFields.label: Father's / Husband's Name
demoFields.hint: For a domicile certificate this matters most, since the claim usually runs through a parent's residence.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. Identity is confirmed on this and the OTP goes to the linked mobile.

demoFields.label: District / Tehsil / Village or Ward
demoFields.hint: Where the family lives. The Tehsildar of this tehsil signs the certificate.

demoFields.label: Basis of the domicile claim
demoFields.value: Father holds a Permanent Resident Certificate of J&K
demoFields.hint: Residence for the qualifying period, a parent's PRC, study in the union territory, or government service. Say which one and attach its proof.

demoFields.label: Annual Family Income (Rs.)

demoFields.label: Purpose

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The application number and the ready message come here by SMS.

Choose the service and fill the form. For a domicile certificate, state clearly which ground you are claiming under and attach the proof for that ground.
Upload the documents, pay the fee, and note the application number.
The patwari and the tehsil staff verify the family. Be reachable on the mobile you gave.
The Tehsildar signs the certificate and it is downloaded from the same login.
Each service has a delivery time under the Public Services Guarantee Act. If it passes, the Act gives you an appeal, and the application number is what you quote.
schemes.helpline: 0194-2506062 — e-UNNAT helpdesk, Jammu and Kashmir

schemes.title: e-Kalyan Jharkhand — Scholarships for SC, ST, OBC and Minority Students
schemes.department: Department of Scheduled Tribe, Scheduled Caste, Minority and Backward Class Welfare, Government of Jharkhand
schemes.brief: e-Kalyan is the Jharkhand welfare department's own scholarship portal — it is separate from the National Scholarship Portal. SC, ST, OBC and minority students apply here for pre-matric scholarships (Classes 1 to 10) and post-matric scholarships (college and above), renew them each year and check the payment. The portal reports 6 schemes and Rs 1,339.35 crore disbursed in 2024-25. The address is ekalyan.cgg.gov.in and not a jharkhand.gov.in name because the system is hosted by the Centre for Good Governance.
schemes.benefit: Pre-matric and post-matric scholarship paid by DBT into the student's own bank account
eligibility: Student belongs to a Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe, Backward Class or notified minority community of Jharkhand
Student is domiciled in Jharkhand — the scholarship follows the home state, not the state where the college is
Studying in a recognised school or institution that is registered on the portal; if your college is not registered, it cannot verify your form
Family income must be within the limit notified for that scholarship for the year, so read the notice on the portal before filling the form
The bank account must be in the student's own name and seeded with the student's Aadhaar; a parent's or joint account is rejected
Renewal is applied for every year and is not automatic
documents: Aadhaar card of the student
Caste certificate issued in Jharkhand, or the minority declaration
Income certificate of the parent or guardian
Residence (domicile) certificate of Jharkhand
Last passed marksheet
Fee receipt or admission receipt from the institution for the current year
Bank passbook in the student's own name showing account number and IFSC
Passport-size photograph

demoFields.label: Scholarship applied for
demoFields.hint: Pre-matric is for Classes 1 to 10, post-matric for college and above. Choose fresh for the first year and renewal after that.

demoFields.label: Student Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Letter for letter as on Aadhaar and on the marksheet. A mismatch stops the payment at the bank stage.

demoFields.label: Father's / Guardian's Name
demoFields.hint: The same name as on the income certificate you are uploading.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth
demoFields.hint: As printed on the Class 10 certificate.

demoFields.label: Category
demoFields.hint: Exactly as on the caste certificate. The scheme and the rate depend on this.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. The same Aadhaar must be seeded to the bank account, or the DBT transfer fails.

demoFields.label: District / Block
demoFields.hint: Your home district and block. The district welfare officer of this district sanctions the scholarship.

demoFields.label: Institution, Course and Year
demoFields.value: P.K. Roy Memorial College, Dhanbad — B.A. (Hons) History — 2nd year
demoFields.hint: Pick the institution from the portal's list. If it is not listed, ask the college to get itself registered first.

demoFields.label: Annual Family Income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: Copy the figure from the income certificate you are uploading. The two must be the same number.

demoFields.label: Bank Account Number and IFSC
demoFields.hint: The student's own account. Copy both from the first page of the passbook, digit by digit.

demoSteps: Watch ekalyan.cgg.gov.in for the year's notice. Pre-matric and post-matric open on different dates and the last date is hard — a late form is not accepted.
Before anything else, open a bank account in the student's own name and get the student's Aadhaar seeded to it at the branch. Payment is by DBT and a parent's or joint account is rejected.
Register as a student with your mobile and Aadhaar, then fill the form: category, institution, course, year, fees paid and bank details.
Upload the caste certificate, income certificate, residence certificate, last marksheet and the fee receipt. Submit and note the application number.
Your institution must verify the application on its own login. Go to the college office and confirm that it has been forwarded — more applications stall at this step than anywhere else.
The district welfare office sanctions it and the money is credited to the seeded account. Check the payment status on the portal with the same login.
Apply again for renewal in the next academic year. A renewal that misses the last date lapses and cannot be claimed later.
schemes.helpline: No helpline number is published on the portal. Contact the District Welfare Officer of your district, or the welfare section of your college, which holds the institution login.

schemes.title: JharSewa — Jharkhand e-District Certificates
schemes.department: Department of Information Technology & e-Governance, Government of Jharkhand
schemes.brief: JharSewa is Jharkhand's e-District system. Caste, income and residence (domicile) certificates, birth and death certificates, land record services and social security pension applications are filed here instead of at the block office, and the signed certificate is downloaded from the same login. A Pragya Kendra (Common Service Centre) will file it for you for the notified fee if you cannot do it yourself.
schemes.benefit: Caste, income, residence, birth and death certificates applied for and downloaded online
eligibility: Resident of Jharkhand, applying in the block and circle where the family actually lives
A residence (domicile) certificate needs proof that the family lives in Jharkhand — the ration card and the land or rent record for that address
A caste certificate is issued only for a caste on Jharkhand's own list, and is checked against the father's certificate
An income certificate states the household income for one financial year, so departments ask for a recent one
The mobile number linked to your Aadhaar must be working, because the whole process runs on OTP and SMS
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant
Ration card of the family
Address proof — electricity bill, holding tax receipt or rent agreement
Father's caste certificate, for a caste certificate
Income proof — salary certificate, or a self-declaration where there is no salary
School leaving certificate or Class 10 marksheet for date of birth
Land record (khatiyan or rent receipt), where the claim rests on land in the family's name
Passport-size photograph

demoFields.label: Service wanted
demoFields.hint: Caste, income, residence, birth, death, land record or pension. Each service has its own form and its own list of proofs.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Letter for letter as on Aadhaar. The certificate prints exactly from this box.

demoFields.label: Father's / Husband's Name
demoFields.hint: The family is traced through this name in the revenue and caste records, so use the spelling on his own papers.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth
demoFields.hint: As on the Class 10 certificate or the birth certificate, not as remembered.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. Identity is confirmed on this and the OTP goes to the mobile linked to it.

demoFields.label: District / Block / Panchayat / Village
demoFields.hint: Where the family lives. The Circle Officer of this circle signs the certificate.

demoFields.label: Caste and Category
demoFields.hint: Write the caste exactly as it appears on your father's caste certificate. The office checks it against the state's notified list.

demoFields.label: Annual Family Income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: The whole household's income for the year — wages, farming, shop, rent and pension together, not only your own.

demoFields.label: Purpose
demoFields.hint: Recorded on the file. It does not limit where you can use the certificate afterwards.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The application number and the 'certificate ready' message come here by SMS.

demoSteps: Register on jharsewa.jharkhand.gov.in with your name, mobile and email and confirm the OTP — or take the papers to a Pragya Kendra or your block office, which files it across the counter for the notified fee.
Pick the service and fill the form from your Aadhaar and ration card. Do not mix up the block and the panchayat; the file is routed on them.
Upload the scans, submit, and write down the application number. Everything after this is tracked on that number alone.
The Circle Officer's staff verify the claim. For a caste certificate the check runs through your father's record, so keep his certificate at hand.
When it is approved, download the digitally signed certificate from the same login. A digitally signed copy does not need any further attestation.
Jharkhand's service guarantee law fixes a time limit for each of these certificates. If it passes, quote the application number to the Circle Officer, then at the Deputy Commissioner's office.
schemes.helpline: No helpline number is published for JharSewa. Ask at your block office (prakhand karyalaya) or the nearest Pragya Kendra, and at the District Informatics Office for a technical problem with the portal.

schemes.title: Bhoomi — Karnataka RTC (Pahani) and Mutation
schemes.department: Revenue Department, Government of Karnataka
schemes.brief: Bhoomi holds the land record of every agricultural holding in Karnataka. The RTC, also called the pahani, shows who holds the land, how much, and what was sown. The i-RTC is a digitally signed copy that banks and offices accept, and mutation status after a sale or a death is tracked on the same site.
schemes.benefit: RTC and digitally signed i-RTC online, with mutation status and survey sketches
eligibility: Agricultural land situated in Karnataka and entered in the record of rights
Anyone may view an RTC; only the holder or a legal heir can apply for a mutation
A mutation on sale needs the registered deed; one on inheritance needs the death certificate and heirship papers
An i-RTC needs a mobile number, since it is delivered against an OTP
documents: Survey number and hissa number, or the owner's name
Aadhaar card, for an i-RTC or a mutation
Registered sale deed, for a mutation on purchase
Death certificate and family tree, for a mutation on inheritance
Existing RTC or pahani copy

demoFields.label: Service wanted
demoFields.hint: A free RTC view for your own reference, an i-RTC for a bank or an office, mutation status, or a Mojini survey sketch.

demoFields.label: District / Taluk / Hobli / Village
demoFields.hint: Pick all four from the lists. The record is held village by village.

demoFields.label: Survey Number
demoFields.hint: From the old RTC or the purchase deed.

demoFields.label: Surnoc / Hissa Number
demoFields.hint: The sub-division of the survey number. Copy it exactly — a wrong hissa pulls up a neighbour's land.

demoFields.label: Owner's Name as on the record
demoFields.hint: Spelt as on the land record, which may differ from Aadhaar. Search the record's spelling first and get a correction later if needed.

demoFields.label: Year / Period
demoFields.hint: The RTC is kept year by year. Take the current year unless an office has asked for an older one.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar and Mobile (for an i-RTC)
demoFields.hint: Needed for a digitally signed copy. The download link comes to this mobile against an OTP.

demoFields.label: Mutation (MR) number, to check status
demoFields.hint: Given when the mutation is filed. Track the stage against it rather than going to the office.

demoSteps: Open landrecords.karnataka.gov.in and view the RTC for your survey and hissa number. Check the extent, the owner's name and the crop entry against what you know. This view is free.
For a bank, a court or a subsidy claim, buy the i-RTC — the digitally signed copy. The free print is not accepted for those.
After a purchase or a death, file the mutation at the taluk office or through Nadakacheri with the registered deed, or the death certificate and family tree.
Keep the MR number and track the mutation stage on Bhoomi rather than waiting at the office.
The Revenue Inspector gives notice and hears any objection before the Tahsildar passes the order.
Once the order is passed, pull a fresh RTC and check that the name and extent are right. An error here is much easier to fix now than years later.
Keep a current RTC with your papers. Crop loans, PM-Kisan and state farm schemes all ask for it.
schemes.helpline: Your taluk office, or the nearest Nadakacheri centre

schemes.title: Karnataka State Scholarship Portal — SC, ST, OBC and Minority
schemes.department: Social Welfare, Backward Classes and Minority Welfare Departments, Karnataka
schemes.brief: One portal for every Karnataka state scholarship — pre-matric for school children and post-matric for SC, ST, OBC, Category-1 and minority students in college. Applications are made fresh each year and the money is paid by DBT into the student's own account.
schemes.benefit: Pre-matric and post-matric scholarship paid by DBT into the student's account
eligibility: Student domiciled in Karnataka and studying in a recognised institution in the state
SC, ST, OBC, Category-1 or a notified minority, on a Karnataka caste certificate
Family income within the limit for the category, on a current income certificate
Passed the previous year; a student repeating a failed year is not eligible
Not drawing another scholarship for the same course
documents: Aadhaar card of the student
Karnataka caste and income certificate (Sindhutva Pramana Patra) numbers
Previous year's marks card
Bonafide or admission certificate from the institution
Bank passbook in the student's own name, Aadhaar-seeded
Fee receipt paid to the institution
Passport-size photograph

demoFields.label: Type of application
demoFields.hint: Pre-matric for Classes 1 to 10, post-matric from Class 11 upwards. Fresh for the first year of a course, renewal after.

demoFields.label: Student Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Exactly as on Aadhaar. The institution record and the bank record must agree or the DBT fails.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: The student's own. The portal does an Aadhaar e-KYC, so the name and date of birth must match.

demoFields.label: Caste and Income Certificate Number (Sindhutva Pramana Patra)
demoFields.hint: The RD number of the Karnataka caste-cum-income certificate. The portal validates it, so an expired or wrongly typed number stops the application.

demoFields.label: Institution and Course
demoFields.value: Karnatak Arts College, Dharwad — B.A., 2nd year
demoFields.hint: Pick the institution from the portal's list. If it is not listed, it has not registered on SSP and must do so first.

demoFields.label: Previous year marks
demoFields.hint: From the marks card you upload. A student repeating a failed year is not eligible.

demoFields.label: Bank Account Number and IFSC
demoFields.hint: In the student's own name and Aadhaar-seeded. A parent's account is the usual reason the money bounces.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The application number and the payment message come here.

demoSteps: Get the Sindhutva Pramana Patra — the Karnataka caste-cum-income certificate — from Seva Sindhu first. SSP validates its RD number and will not proceed without a current one.
Register on ssp.karnataka.gov.in with your Aadhaar, complete the e-KYC and choose pre-matric or post-matric, fresh or renewal.
Fill in the institution and course from the portal's list, upload the marks card, the bonafide certificate and the fee receipt, and give an Aadhaar-seeded account in your own name.
Submit and note the application number, then follow it up with the institution — it has to verify and forward the application before anything moves.
The welfare department sanctions it and the money is credited by DBT. The portal shows the sanction and the payment against your application number.
Apply again every year with a current certificate. Renewal is not automatic and missing the window costs that year's money.
schemes.helpline: 8050770004 — SSP Karnataka helpdesk

schemes.title: KPSC Recruitment — KAS, FDA and SDA
schemes.department: Karnataka Public Service Commission
schemes.brief: The Karnataka Public Service Commission recruits for the Karnataka Administrative Service and for Group A, B and C posts including First and Second Division Assistant and the engineering services. Notifications appear on the Commission's site and applications are filed on its online portal.
schemes.benefit: One online profile for every KPSC recruitment, with admit cards and results
eligibility: Indian citizen; a Karnataka domicile for the reserved quotas and for posts with a local requirement
Age as the notification states, usually 21 to 35 for KAS, with relaxation for SC, ST, Category-1, OBC and disability
A degree from a recognised university, held on the closing date, for KAS and most Group A and B posts
Kannada language knowledge as the notification requires for several posts
Each notification sets its own conditions; read that one before you pay
documents: Aadhaar card
SSLC (Class 10) marks card for date of birth
Degree certificate and marks cards
Karnataka caste and income certificate, for a reserved category
Rural, Kannada medium or Hyderabad-Karnataka certificate, where claiming those quotas
Disability or ex-serviceman certificate, where claiming that reservation
Recent passport photograph and a scanned signature

demoFields.label: Post or examination applied for
demoFields.value: Gazetted Probationers (KAS) Group A and B
demoFields.hint: One application per notification. Check the qualification and the age limit in that notification before paying.

demoFields.label: Candidate Name (as on SSLC marks card)
demoFields.hint: The SSLC marks card governs, not Aadhaar, where the two differ. Everything later is checked against it.

demoFields.label: Father's Name
demoFields.hint: As on the SSLC marks card.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth
demoFields.hint: As on the SSLC marks card. Age limits count from this date and it cannot be changed after registration.

demoFields.label: Category and special quotas claimed
demoFields.hint: Claim only what you hold a Karnataka certificate for. The rural and Kannada-medium quotas need separate certificates from your school and the taluk office.

demoFields.label: Educational Qualification
demoFields.hint: It must be complete on the closing date, not merely expected.

demoFields.label: Kannada language knowledge
demoFields.value: Studied Kannada as first language up to SSLC
demoFields.hint: Several posts require it and test it. Declare it honestly and keep the school certificate.

demoFields.label: Examination centre preference
demoFields.hint: Give two or three. The Commission allots the nearest centre it can.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number and Email
demoFields.hint: The application number, admit card and every notice come here. Do not use a cyber cafe's.

demoSteps: Watch kpsc.kar.nic.in for the notification and read the age, qualification and language conditions before anything else.
Register on kpsconline.karnataka.gov.in with your name and date of birth exactly as on the SSLC marks card, and upload the photograph and signature in the stated sizes.
Fill the application, claim only the quotas you hold certificates for, choose your centres and pay the fee online.
Use the correction window if the Commission opens one. It is the only chance to fix a wrong entry and it closes quickly.
Download the admit card about a week before each stage and take it with a photo ID.
KAS runs as a preliminary, a main examination and an interview. Results for each are published on the Commission's site.
Document verification comes last. Produce the originals of everything you claimed — a rural or Kannada-medium certificate you cannot produce there costs you the post.
schemes.helpline: 080-30574957 — KPSC online application helpdesk

schemes.title: Kaveri Online Services — Registration, EC and Marriage
schemes.department: Department of Stamps and Registration, Government of Karnataka
schemes.brief: Kaveri is where property is registered in Karnataka. You do the data entry and pay the stamp duty online, then keep one appointment at the Sub-Registrar's office. The encumbrance certificate, a certified copy of a deed and marriage registration are on the same portal.
schemes.benefit: Online property registration with a booked slot, plus EC, certified copies and marriage registration
eligibility: Property situated in Karnataka, for registration, an EC or a certified copy
Both parties present at the Sub-Registrar's office on the appointment date, with two witnesses
For marriage registration, both parties of legal age with proof of the marriage having taken place
A mobile number and email, since the slot and every notice go there
documents: Aadhaar cards of both parties and of the two witnesses
PAN cards of both parties, for a property transaction
Draft of the deed to be registered
Latest khata certificate, tax paid receipt and the earlier title deed
Encumbrance certificate for the past thirteen years
Marriage invitation, photographs and a priest's or registrar's certificate, for marriage registration
Passport-size photographs of both parties

demoFields.label: Service wanted
demoFields.hint: Property registration, EC, certified copy of a deed, or marriage registration. Each has its own form and fee.

demoFields.label: District / Taluk / Hobli / Village
demoFields.hint: Where the property lies. The EC is searched against the Sub-Registrar's office for that area.

demoFields.label: Property identification
demoFields.hint: Survey and hissa number for agricultural land, or the site and khata number for a site. Copy it from the title deed.

demoFields.label: Period for which the EC is wanted
demoFields.hint: Banks usually ask for thirteen years. Ask for a longer period if the title has changed hands often.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name and Aadhaar
demoFields.hint: As on Aadhaar. The certificate is issued in this name.

demoFields.label: Owner's name as on the records
demoFields.hint: The EC is searched against the name in the registered documents, which may not match Aadhaar exactly.

demoFields.label: Purpose
demoFields.hint: Recorded for the file. It does not restrict where the certificate is used.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number and Email
demoFields.hint: The application number and the download link come here.

demoSteps: Register on kaveri.karnataka.gov.in with your mobile and email, and choose the service you need.
For an EC, enter the district, the Sub-Registrar's office, the property details and the period, pay the fee online and download the certificate when it is ready.
For a property registration, do the data entry on the portal, work out the stamp duty and registration fee with the calculator, and pay online.
Book the Sub-Registrar appointment slot on the portal. This is what saves the day of waiting — the slot is a fixed time, not a queue token.
Attend on the date with both parties, two witnesses and the originals of every document. Photographs and thumb impressions are taken there.
The registered deed is scanned and returned, and the certified copy can be downloaded from the portal afterwards.
Pull a fresh EC a few weeks later and check that the registration shows on it. That is the proof the record has actually been updated.
schemes.helpline: 080-22220192 — Department of Stamps and Registration, Karnataka

schemes.title: Seva Sindhu citizen services
schemes.department: Centre for e-Governance, Government of Karnataka
schemes.brief: Karnataka's single window for several hundred services across departments: caste, income and residence certificates from the revenue department, transport, labour welfare, social security and scheme registrations. Kannada and English. You can apply yourself with a mobile OTP, or walk into a Bangalore One, Karnataka One or Grama One counter, or the Atalji Janasnehi Kendra at the taluk office, and have it filed for you. The Sakala Act puts a deadline on most of these services, and your acknowledgement carries a Sakala number you can complain against.
schemes.benefit: Several hundred state services, with a deadline fixed under the Sakala Act
eligibility: Resident of Karnataka
Aadhaar with a mobile number linked to it, for the OTP and e-KYC
Whatever the particular service itself requires; the portal lists this before you begin
documents: Aadhaar card
Ration card
Proof of residence: electricity bill, property tax receipt or voter ID
Income proof: salary certificate, or a declaration for farming and daily-wage families
For a caste certificate: a parent's or close relative's caste certificate with its RD number
Passport photograph
Bank passbook, for any service that pays money into your account

demoFields.label: Applicant's name
demoFields.hint: As on Aadhaar. The certificate is printed with this spelling in both Kannada and English.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: e-KYC is done against this, so the mobile linked to your Aadhaar must be with you.

demoFields.label: Service applied for
demoFields.hint: Choose the department first. Income, caste and residence certificates are three separate applications.

demoFields.label: Parent's caste certificate RD number
demoFields.hint: Needed only for a caste certificate. It is the reference number on your father's or mother's existing certificate, and it saves a fresh field enquiry.

demoFields.label: District / Taluk / Village
demoFields.hint: This decides which revenue inspector and tahsildar handle the file, so it must be where you live.

demoFields.label: Ration card number
demoFields.hint: From the top of your ration card. It is used to confirm the members of the household.

demoFields.label: Annual family income
demoFields.hint: The household's total earnings for the last financial year from every source.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: The OTP, the Sakala acknowledgement number and the download link all come here.

demoFields.label: Bank account number and IFSC
demoFields.hint: Only for services that pay you money. Put your own account, Aadhaar-seeded.

demoSteps: Check which service you need and what it asks for. Seva Sindhu lists the documents for each service on the service's own page before you start.
Register on Seva Sindhu with your Aadhaar and mobile number, and complete the e-KYC with the OTP.
Choose the department and the service, and fill the form as this sample shows.
Upload the documents and pay the fee where one applies. Many certificates cost only a small statutory amount.
Submit and save the acknowledgement. It carries a Sakala number and the date by which the office must answer you.

If you would rather not do this on a phone, take the same documents to a Bangalore One, Karnataka One or Grama One counter, or the Atalji Janasnehi Kendra at the taluk office, and the operator files it under your name.
The revenue inspector verifies and the tahsildar signs digitally. Track it on the portal with your acknowledgement number.
Download the signed certificate from your login. If the Sakala deadline passes, use the Sakala number to complain; the Act provides compensation for delay.
schemes.helpline: 1902 (Sakala citizen helpline)

schemes.title: Karnataka Ration Card — Ahara
schemes.department: Food, Civil Supplies and Consumer Affairs Department, Government of Karnataka
schemes.brief: Ahara is Karnataka's ration card system. A Priority Household or Antyodaya card brings free rice under Anna Bhagya from the fair price shop, and the card is also the household record that Gruha Lakshmi, Gruha Jyothi and other state schemes are paid against, so it is worth keeping correct.
schemes.benefit: Priority Household or Antyodaya card, with free rice under Anna Bhagya
eligibility: Family resident in Karnataka and holding no ration card elsewhere in India
Household within the state's limits on income, land, vehicle ownership and government service, for a Priority Household card
A woman of the household aged 18 or above is recorded as head of the family
Every member's Aadhaar must be seeded and the biometric e-KYC done, or that member's rice is not issued
documents: Aadhaar cards of every member of the family
Address proof — electricity bill, house tax receipt or rent agreement
Deletion certificate from the earlier card, where a member has moved in
Birth certificate for a newborn, or marriage certificate for a bride being added
Gas connection number
Bank passbook of the head of the family

demoFields.label: Type of application
demoFields.hint: New card, add a member, remove a member, correct a detail, or change the head of the family. Pick the right one or the file is returned.

demoFields.label: Ration Card Number
demoFields.hint: From the front of the card. Leave it blank only for a brand new card.

demoFields.label: Head of the Family
demoFields.hint: A woman of the household aged 18 or above. Gruha Lakshmi is paid to whoever is named here, so get it right.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar of the Head
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. The family's whole entitlement is tracked against this.

demoFields.label: Member to be added, relation and Aadhaar
demoFields.hint: Name as on that person's own Aadhaar, and how they are related to the head.

demoFields.label: Reason and supporting certificate
demoFields.hint: A newborn needs the birth certificate and an Aadhaar. A bride needs the marriage certificate and the deletion certificate from her parents' card.

demoFields.label: District / Taluk / Village or Ward
demoFields.hint: Where the family lives. The fair price shop is allotted from this address.

demoFields.label: Annual Family Income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: The household's total for the year. It decides whether the card is Priority Household or APL.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The acknowledgement number and the status messages come here.

demoSteps: Open ahara.karnataka.gov.in and choose the service you need, or go to a Grama One or Karnataka One centre, which files it for the notified fee.
List every member who eats from the same kitchen, each with the exact Aadhaar. The rice is counted per name, so a missing member costs the family every month.
Attach the address proof and, for a member moving in, the deletion certificate from the old card. Without it the system blocks the addition as a duplicate.
Submit and keep the acknowledgement number; the portal shows the status against it.
The food inspector verifies the household at the address, and for a new card the category — Antyodaya, Priority Household or APL — is decided at this stage.
Once approved, download the card and check every name and Aadhaar on it.
Take the new member to the fair price shop for the biometric e-KYC on the ePoS machine. Until that is done the family's rice does not increase.
schemes.helpline: 1967 and 1800 425 9339 — Karnataka Food and Civil Supplies

schemes.title: Gruha Lakshmi — Karnataka Monthly Assistance to the Woman of the House
schemes.department: Department of Women and Child Development, Government of Karnataka
schemes.brief: Karnataka pays Rs.2,000 a month to the woman recorded as head of the family on the ration card. One woman per household, and the money goes into her own bank account. It is applied for on Seva Sindhu, free, and at a Bangalore One, Karnataka One or Grama One centre if you would rather have help.
schemes.benefit: Rs.2,000 a month into the woman head of household's own account
eligibility: Woman recorded as head of the family on an Antyodaya, BPL or APL ration card of Karnataka
One woman per household — if the card names another head, that is the person who qualifies
Neither she nor her husband pays income tax or files GST returns
Not a government employee, and not drawing another state monthly assistance of this kind
documents: Aadhaar card of the woman applying
Ration card showing her as head of the family
Aadhaar card of the husband, where she is married
Bank passbook in her own name, Aadhaar-seeded with NPCI
Mobile number linked to her Aadhaar

demoFields.label: Ration Card Number
demoFields.hint: The whole application is built from this. The portal pulls the family up and shows who is recorded as head.

demoFields.label: Name of the woman head of the family
demoFields.hint: It must be the name the ration card shows as head. If the card names someone else, get the card corrected first.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Her own twelve digits. The OTP for the application goes to the mobile linked to it.

demoFields.label: Husband's Name and Aadhaar
demoFields.hint: Asked so the income-tax and GST check can be run on him too. Leave it blank if she is unmarried or widowed.

demoFields.label: Do you or your husband pay income tax or file GST?
demoFields.hint: Answer truthfully. It is matched against the tax database, and a false answer cancels the sanction and recovers the money.

demoFields.label: District / Taluk / Village or Ward
demoFields.hint: As on the ration card. It decides which office handles the file.

demoFields.label: Bank Account Number and IFSC
demoFields.hint: In her own name, and NPCI-seeded with Aadhaar — not merely linked. This is the single commonest reason the money does not arrive.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The application number and every monthly credit are announced here by SMS.

demoSteps: Check first that the ration card records you as head of the family. If it does not, get the card corrected through Ahara before applying — the scheme goes by the card, not by who actually runs the house.
Open the Seva Sindhu services portal, choose Gruha Lakshmi, and enter your ration card number. The portal fills the family details itself.
Confirm your Aadhaar with the OTP, add your husband's Aadhaar where you are married, and give a bank account in your own name.
Submit and note the application number. There is no fee; a Grama One, Karnataka One or Bangalore One centre will file it for you free too.
Check the NPCI seeding of your account on the portal or at your bank. An account that is linked to Aadhaar but not NPCI-seeded will still fail when the money is sent.
Once approved, Rs.2,000 is credited each month. Track the sanction and each payment on the portal against your application number.
If a month is missed, check the seeding first, then take the application number to your Grama One centre or the taluk office.
schemes.helpline: 1902 — Seva Sindhu helpline

schemes.title: Thulasi — Kerala PSC Registration and Applications
schemes.department: Kerala Public Service Commission
schemes.brief: Thulasi is the Kerala Public Service Commission's application system. You build one profile — the One Time Registration — and then apply from it to every PSC notification: Last Grade Servants, Lower Division Clerk, Civil Police Officer, Village Extension Officer, Staff Nurse, Assistant Professor, departmental tests and hundreds of other posts. There is no application fee. The same login is used to update the profile, confirm each application, download the admission ticket and see the short list and the rank list.
schemes.benefit: One profile, then applications to every Kerala PSC notification at no fee
eligibility: Indian citizen; most Kerala PSC posts also require Kerala nativity, and each notification states its own condition
Age limits are set in each notification, commonly 18 to 36 years on 1 January of the qualifying year, with the relaxations allowed to SC, ST and OBC candidates
One person may hold only one Thulasi profile — a second profile blocks you from applying
The qualification named in the notification must already be entered in your profile, and acquired before the last date, or you cannot apply for that post
The photograph must have been taken within six months of creating the profile, with your name and the date printed on it, for profiles created from 1 January 2022
documents: Photograph taken within the last six months, with your name and the date of the photograph printed below the face
Scanned signature
SSLC book or Class 10 certificate, for the name and the date of birth
Degree, diploma or other qualification certificates named in the notification
Community certificate, for an SC, ST or OBC claim
Non-creamy layer certificate, for an OBC claim
Aadhaar card
Nativity certificate, where the notification asks for one

demoFields.label: Name (as in SSLC Book)
demoFields.hint: Exactly as in the SSLC book, including initials. The rank list and the advice memo will carry this name.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth (as in SSLC Book)
demoFields.hint: From the SSLC book only. Age for every post is counted from this date and it cannot be changed afterwards.

demoFields.label: Gender
demoFields.hint: Some posts are notified for women only, and the system filters on this.

demoFields.label: Religion, Caste and Community
demoFields.hint: As on your community certificate. Age relaxation and reservation are given on this entry, so an error here costs you the claim.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. It ties the profile to you and stops a duplicate registration.

demoFields.label: Permanent Address — House, Post Office, District, PIN
demoFields.hint: The address for post from the Commission. Keep it current in the profile if you move.

demoFields.label: Educational Qualification
demoFields.value: B.Com, University of Kerala, passed May 2022
demoFields.hint: Add every qualification with the month and year it was acquired. You can only apply for a post whose qualification is already in the profile.

demoFields.label: Photograph
demoFields.value: Photo taken 12-02-2026, with 'Anoop Krishnan' and the date printed below the face
demoFields.hint: Taken within the last six months, name and date printed on it. A photo without this is rejected.

demoFields.label: Access Code
demoFields.hint: A short word you choose. You are asked for it every time you confirm an application, so write it down somewhere safe.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: Notification alerts, the admission ticket message and the rank list message come here.

demoSteps: Get the photograph right before you start: taken within the last six months, with your name and the date printed below the face. A profile created from 1 January 2022 is rejected without it.
Open thulasi.psc.kerala.gov.in, click New Registration and fill the profile from your SSLC book. Name, date of birth and community must match it exactly.
Save the user ID, the password and the access code. The access code is asked again each time you confirm an application.
Enter every qualification in the profile with the date you acquired it. A post will not open for you unless its qualification is already recorded.
Open the notification you want and click Apply. Kerala PSC charges no application fee.
Confirm the application before the last date. An application that is submitted but never confirmed is not considered at all — this is the commonest way candidates lose a chance.
Download the admission ticket when it is released, then follow the short list, the rank list and the advice memo through the same login.
schemes.helpline: No helpline number is published for Thulasi. Contact the Kerala PSC District Office of your district, or the Commission's office at Pattom, Thiruvananthapuram. Akshaya e-Kendras also help with the registration.

schemes.title: Akshaya e-Kendras — Kerala's Assisted Service Centres
schemes.department: Akshaya Project, Kerala State IT Mission
schemes.brief: Akshaya is Kerala's own network of assisted service centres — about 2,650 e-Kendras, with at least two in every panchayat. You walk in and an operator files the application for you: e-District certificates such as income, community, nativity and possession, e-Grantz scholarship forms, Aadhaar enrolment, update and seeding, birth and death certificate printing, and utility and fee payments. The network started on 18 November 2002 and has handled over 1.81 crore Aadhaar enrolments. The website lists the services and the centres; the filing itself happens at the counter.
schemes.benefit: Assisted filing of certificates, scholarships, Aadhaar work and payments at about 2,650 centres
eligibility: Anyone living in Kerala can use an Akshaya e-Kendra; you do not need an account on the website
You must still meet the conditions of the department whose service you are applying for — Akshaya only files it
Aadhaar is needed for most services, and for e-District certificates the mobile linked to it has to be working for the OTP
Service charges are fixed by the government for each service and are displayed at the centre; the department's own fee is separate
For Aadhaar enrolment or update of a child, a parent must come along with their own Aadhaar
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant — original and one photocopy
Ration card of the family
Address proof — electricity bill, water bill or land tax receipt
Income proof — salary certificate, or a self-declaration where there is no salary, for an income certificate
Community or caste certificate of a parent, for a community certificate
School certificate or birth certificate for date of birth
Bank passbook, for scholarship and other DBT services
