Passport-size photograph

demoFields.label: District (centre search)
demoFields.hint: Pick your district on the site to list the Akshaya centres near you before you set out.

demoFields.label: Local body / Panchayat
demoFields.hint: Narrows the list to the centres in your own panchayat or municipality. There are at least two in every panchayat.

demoFields.label: Service wanted
demoFields.hint: Check the service list on the site first — it also shows what the service costs and what to carry.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Letter for letter as on Aadhaar. The certificate prints from this entry in both Malayalam and English.

demoFields.label: Father's / Husband's Name
demoFields.hint: As on his own Aadhaar or ration card, since the family is identified through it.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. The operator verifies you on this and the OTP comes to the linked mobile.

demoFields.label: Address — House, Village, Taluk, District
demoFields.value: Thekkethil House, Koratty, Chalakudy Taluk, Thrissur
demoFields.hint: The address the village officer will verify. Use the one on the ration card.

demoFields.label: Annual Family Income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: The whole household's income for the year from every source. The village officer checks this before the certificate is signed.

demoFields.label: Purpose
demoFields.value: Fee concession for daughter's degree admission
demoFields.hint: Recorded on the file. It does not restrict where the certificate can be used.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The application number and the 'ready' message come here by SMS, so give a number you carry.

demoSteps: Find your nearest e-Kendra on akshaya.kerala.gov.in and read the service page, which lists what to carry and what the service costs.
Carry the originals and one photocopy of each document. The operator scans the originals at the counter.

The operator fills the form for you. Before it is submitted, read the name, age, address and income back off the screen — in Malayalam and in English. A spelling mistake here means applying all over again.
Pay the government fee and the notified service charge and take the printed receipt. The application number on it is the only way to follow the file.
The village officer verifies income, residence and family claims. You may be called to the village office, so stay reachable.
An SMS tells you when it is ready. Collect the signed certificate at the centre or download it yourself; a digitally signed copy needs no attestation.
The service charges are fixed and displayed at the centre. If more than that is asked, complain to the District Akshaya Project Office for your district.
schemes.helpline: No statewide helpline number is published. Contact the District Akshaya Project Office (District Project Manager) for your district, or the e-Kendra itself for a query about your own application.

schemes.title: Ladakh Domicile Certificate
schemes.department: Revenue Department, Union Territory of Ladakh
schemes.brief: The domicile certificate of Ladakh, which decides who can hold a state government post and buy land in the territory. It has its own portal, separate from the general e-services, and its own conditions on years of residence, study or government service.
schemes.benefit: Ladakh domicile certificate, required for territory government posts and land
eligibility: Resident of Ladakh for the qualifying period, or a child of a government servant who served there for the required years
A person who studied in Ladakh for the qualifying years and sat Class 10 or Class 12 there also qualifies
Children of a Ladakh domicile holder qualify through the parent
One certificate per person; it does not expire
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant
Parent's domicile certificate or Permanent Resident Certificate, where claiming through a parent
School certificates showing the years studied in Ladakh
Ration card of the family
Revenue record or rent agreement showing residence
Government service certificate of the parent, where claiming on that ground
Passport-size photograph

demoFields.label: Ground of the domicile claim
demoFields.value: Resident of Ladakh for fifteen years
demoFields.hint: Residence for the qualifying period, study and examination in Ladakh, a parent's domicile, or a parent's government service. Say which one and attach its proof — this is what the whole application turns on.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Letter for letter as on Aadhaar. The certificate prints from this entry.

demoFields.label: Father's / Mother's Name
demoFields.hint: Where you are claiming through a parent, their name must match their own domicile or service certificate.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth
demoFields.hint: As on the Class 10 certificate or the birth certificate you attach.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits, of the applicant.

demoFields.label: District / Tehsil / Village
demoFields.hint: Where the family lives. The Tehsildar of this tehsil issues the certificate.

demoFields.label: Years and place of residence or study
demoFields.value: Resident at Chuchot Shamma since 2004; Class 10 from Government High School, Chuchot, 2018
demoFields.hint: Be exact with the years and the school. This is the part the verifying officer actually checks.

demoFields.label: Parent's certificate number, where claiming through a parent
demoFields.value: Not applicable — claiming on own residence
demoFields.hint: Fill it only if the claim runs through a parent's domicile or government service, and attach that certificate.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The application number and the ready message come here by SMS.

demoSteps: Decide which ground you are claiming under and gather the proof for that ground before you start. Applying on the wrong ground is why most files come back.
Register on the domicile portal with your Aadhaar and mobile and confirm the OTP.
Fill the form, stating the years and the place of residence or study exactly, and upload the school certificates, the revenue record and the parent's certificate where relevant.
Submit and note the application number.
The patwari and the tehsil staff verify the claim on the ground. Be available at the address, since this verification is done in person.
The Tehsildar issues the certificate and it is downloaded from the portal.
Keep it safely. It does not expire, and territory government recruitment and land purchase both turn on it.
schemes.helpline: Your Tehsildar's office, or the Deputy Commissioner's office at Leh or Kargil

schemes.title: Ladakh e-SEVA — Certificates and Citizen Services
schemes.department: Administration of the Union Territory of Ladakh
schemes.brief: Ladakh's own e-services portal, set up after the union territory was formed. Income, category, character and other certificates and departmental services are applied for here instead of travelling to Leh or Kargil, which in winter can mean waiting for a road to open.
schemes.benefit: Income, category and other certificates applied for without travelling to the district headquarters
eligibility: Resident of Ladakh, applying in the district — Leh or Kargil — where the family lives
A Scheduled Tribe certificate is issued for the tribes notified for Ladakh
A residence certificate needs proof the family has lived in the territory for the qualifying period
An income certificate is valid for one year
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant
Ration card of the family
Father's Scheduled Tribe certificate, for a tribe certificate
School certificate or birth certificate for date of birth
Certificate from the Numberdar or the village head
Income proof — salary certificate or an affidavit
Passport-size photograph

demoFields.label: Service wanted
demoFields.hint: Income, Scheduled Tribe, residence, character or a departmental service. Each has its own form and proof.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Letter for letter as on Aadhaar. The certificate prints from this entry.

demoFields.label: Father's / Husband's Name
demoFields.hint: Used to identify the family; essential for a tribe certificate.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. Identity is confirmed on this and the OTP goes to the linked mobile.

demoFields.label: District / Block / Village
demoFields.hint: Where the family lives. The Tehsildar or the Sub-Divisional Magistrate of this area signs.

demoFields.label: Numberdar or village head certificate
demoFields.value: Goba, Chuchot Shamma — signed and stamped
demoFields.hint: Most Ladakh certificates need it. Get it before you apply, since the village head may be hard to reach later.

demoFields.label: Annual Family Income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: For an income certificate, the household's total for the year including farming and any tourism season work.

demoFields.label: Purpose
demoFields.hint: Recorded for the file. It does not restrict where the certificate is used.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The application number and the ready message come here by SMS.

demoSteps: Get the Numberdar's or village head's certificate first. Most Ladakh certificates rest on it.
Register on eseva.ladakh.gov.in with your mobile and confirm the OTP, or use a Common Service Centre.
Choose the certificate and fill the form from your Aadhaar and the ration card.
Upload the documents, pay any fee, and note the application number.
The tehsil staff verify the family, then the Tehsildar or the Sub-Divisional Magistrate signs.
Download the certificate from the same login. In winter, apply well before you need it — verification in the outlying blocks can be slow when roads are closed.
schemes.helpline: Your Tehsildar's office, or the Deputy Commissioner's office at Leh or Kargil

schemes.title: Lakshadweep Residence and Income Certificates
schemes.department: Revenue Department, Union Territory of Lakshadweep
schemes.brief: The residence, income and Scheduled Tribe certificates of Lakshadweep, issued by the Sub-Divisional Officer of your island through the Village (Dweep) Panchayat. Almost the whole indigenous population of the islands is Scheduled Tribe, and the tribe certificate is what secures admission, jobs and land rights.
schemes.benefit: Residence, income and Scheduled Tribe certificates for admission, jobs and land
eligibility: Resident of Lakshadweep, applying on the island where the family lives
A Scheduled Tribe certificate is issued to the indigenous inhabitants of the islands
A residence certificate needs proof the family has lived in the territory for the qualifying period
An income certificate is valid for one year
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant
Ration card of the family
Father's Scheduled Tribe certificate, for a tribe certificate
School certificate or birth certificate for date of birth
Certificate from the Village (Dweep) Panchayat
Income proof — salary certificate or an affidavit
Passport-size photograph
schemes.submitAt: Sub-Divisional Officer's office on your island, through the Village (Dweep) Panchayat; the Collectorate at Kavaratti for anything unresolved

demoFields.label: Certificate applied for
demoFields.hint: Residence, income, Scheduled Tribe or nativity. Each needs a different set of papers.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Letter for letter as on Aadhaar. The certificate is written from this entry.

demoFields.label: Father's / Husband's Name
demoFields.hint: For a tribe certificate this decides the case — it is traced through the father's family record.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits, of the applicant.

demoFields.label: Island / Village Panchayat
demoFields.hint: The island where the family lives. The Sub-Divisional Officer of that island issues the certificate.

demoFields.label: Village Panchayat certificate
demoFields.value: Secretary, Kavaratti Village (Dweep) Panchayat — signed and stamped
demoFields.hint: The Panchayat's certificate is what carries the application. Get it before going to the Sub-Divisional Officer.

demoFields.label: Annual Family Income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: For an income certificate, the household's total for the year including fishing and coir work.

demoFields.label: Purpose
demoFields.value: Admission to a mainland college under the tribal quota
demoFields.hint: Say plainly what it is for; it is recorded but does not restrict where the certificate is used.

demoFields.label: Signature / Thumb Impression with date
demoFields.hint: Sign or put your thumb impression, and write the date yourself.

demoSteps: Get the certificate from your Village (Dweep) Panchayat first. It is the paper the whole application rests on.
Collect the application form free at the Sub-Divisional Officer's office on your island.
Fill it in ink and attach Aadhaar, the ration card, the Panchayat certificate and, for a tribe certificate, the father's certificate.
Hand it in and ask for a dated acknowledgement with its number.
The Panchayat and the revenue staff verify the family, then the Sub-Divisional Officer signs.
Collect the certificate and check the spelling of names before you leave. Apply well ahead of any deadline — boat schedules between the islands and Kavaratti can add weeks to a file.
schemes.helpline: Sub-Divisional Officer's office on your island; the Collectorate at Kavaratti

schemes.title: Lakshadweep Ration Card
schemes.department: Department of Civil Supplies, Union Territory of Lakshadweep
schemes.brief: The ration card of Lakshadweep, which brings subsidised rice, wheat, sugar and kerosene to a household. Because everything on the islands arrives by ship, the card matters more here than in most places. Applications are made at the Civil Supplies office of the island.
schemes.benefit: Subsidised rice, wheat, sugar and kerosene from the island's fair price shop
eligibility: Family resident on one of the islands of Lakshadweep and holding no ration card elsewhere in India
Category decided from the household's circumstances under the National Food Security Act
The Village (Dweep) Panchayat must certify that the family lives in its area
Every member's Aadhaar must be given; a name without Aadhaar draws no ration
documents: Aadhaar cards of every member of the family
Village (Dweep) Panchayat certificate of residence
Deletion certificate from the earlier card, where the family or a member has moved
Birth certificate for a newborn, or marriage certificate for a bride
Income declaration of the household
Passport photograph of the head of the family
schemes.submitAt: Civil Supplies office on your island, through the Village (Dweep) Panchayat; the Collectorate at Kavaratti for anything unresolved

demoFields.label: Type of application
demoFields.hint: New card, add a member, remove a member, or correct a detail. Each needs a different set of papers.

demoFields.label: Head of the Household
demoFields.hint: The card is issued in this person's name and the family's entitlement is tracked against it.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar of the Head
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits.

demoFields.label: Members of the family (name, relation, age, Aadhaar)
demoFields.value: 1. Fathima Beevi Koya, self, 41, 9999 5541 3308; 2. Abdul Koya, husband, 46, 9999 3308 5541; 3. Ayisha Koya, daughter, 14, 9999 7720 1146
demoFields.hint: Everyone who eats from the same kitchen, one per line. The ration is counted per name, so a missing member costs the family every month.

demoFields.label: Island / Village Panchayat
demoFields.hint: Where the family lives. The fair price shop of that island is allotted from this.

demoFields.label: Village Panchayat certificate
demoFields.value: Secretary, Kavaratti Village (Dweep) Panchayat — signed and stamped
demoFields.hint: The Panchayat certificate is what carries the application forward.

demoFields.label: Annual Family Income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: The household's total for the year. It decides the category under the Food Security Act.

demoFields.label: Occupation of the head of the household
demoFields.hint: Plain words are enough.

demoFields.label: Signature / Thumb Impression with date
demoFields.hint: Sign or put your thumb impression, and write the date yourself.

demoSteps: Get the Village (Dweep) Panchayat certificate of residence first.
Collect the application form free at the Civil Supplies office on your island.
Fill it in ink listing every member who eats from the same kitchen, with each one's exact Aadhaar number.
Attach the Aadhaar copies, the Panchayat certificate, the income declaration and, where someone has moved in, the deletion certificate from the old card.
Hand it in and ask for a dated acknowledgement with its number.
The Civil Supplies staff verify the household, and the category is decided at this stage.
Collect the card and check every name, age and Aadhaar before leaving the counter.
schemes.helpline: 1967 — Food and Public Distribution toll free; the Civil Supplies office on your island

schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Ladli Behna Yojana
schemes.department: Women and Child Development Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh
schemes.brief: A monthly payment to women of Madhya Pradesh aged 21 to 60, paid into her own Aadhaar-linked, DBT-enabled account, usually in the first half of the month. The portal is in Hindi. The form is not filled at home: the state seats operators at the gram panchayat, the ward office and special camps, and the woman must be present for her photograph and e-KYC to be captured. Fresh registration opens only when the government opens a window, so ask at the panchayat when the next one is.
schemes.benefit: Rs.1,500 per month
eligibility: Woman who is a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh
Married, widowed, divorced or abandoned
Aged 21 to 60 on 1 January of the year of application
Total family income under Rs.2.5 lakh a year
No one in the family pays income tax, holds a regular government job or draws a government pension
The family holds less than five acres of land
Not already receiving Rs.1,500 or more a month from another government scheme
documents: Samagra family ID and her own Samagra member ID
Aadhaar card, with e-KYC completed on the Samagra portal
Bank account in her own name, Aadhaar-linked and switched on for DBT
Mobile number for the OTP
Recent photograph, which the operator takes at the camp itself
schemes.submitAt: At the registration camp, the gram panchayat office or the urban ward office, on the dates the state announces. Go in person with your Samagra ID, Aadhaar and bank passbook. The operator fills in the form and takes your photograph there.

demoFields.label: Samagra member ID
demoFields.hint: Your own nine-digit number in the Samagra record, not the family's. Ask at the panchayat if you do not know it.

demoFields.label: Samagra family ID
demoFields.hint: The eight-digit family number. Both numbers are on the Samagra card or slip.

demoFields.label: Applicant's name
demoFields.hint: It must match the Samagra record and Aadhaar. If the three spellings differ, get Samagra corrected first, because the form will not go through.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: e-KYC on the Samagra portal must be done against this Aadhaar before the application is accepted.

demoFields.label: Date of birth
demoFields.hint: You must have completed 21 years and not crossed 60 as on 1 January of the application year.

demoFields.label: Marital status
demoFields.hint: Married, widow, divorced or abandoned. An unmarried woman is not eligible under this scheme.

demoFields.label: Bank account number
demoFields.hint: Her own single account. It must be Aadhaar-linked and DBT-enabled; ask the bank to confirm, because a merely Aadhaar-noted account is not enough.

demoFields.label: IFSC code
demoFields.hint: From the first page of the passbook.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: The OTP and every later payment message come here. Give your own number where you can.

demoSteps: Find out when the registration window and the camps are open. Ask at the gram panchayat, the ward office or the anganwadi; applications are not taken all year round.

Before the camp, get two things right: e-KYC of your Aadhaar on the Samagra portal, and a bank account in your own name that is Aadhaar-linked and DBT-enabled. Both can be done free at a kiosk or the bank branch.
Go to the camp or the panchayat office yourself, with the Samagra number, Aadhaar and passbook. You have to be present, because the operator takes your photograph there.
The operator fills the form in front of you as this sample shows. Check your name, bank account and mobile number on the screen before it is submitted.
Collect the printed acknowledgement with the application number and keep it safely.
The provisional list is put up at the panchayat or ward office. Look for your name in it; objections can be made within the period announced.
After the final list, the money starts coming to your account every month. Check the status on the portal with your Samagra or application number.
If a payment stops, first check whether your Aadhaar and bank linking has lapsed, which is the commonest cause, and then call the helpline.
schemes.helpline: 0755-2700800 (scheme helpdesk), CM Helpline 181

schemes.title: MP Bhulekh — Khasra, Khatauni and Land Map
schemes.department: Commissioner Land Records, Government of Madhya Pradesh
schemes.brief: MP Bhulekh is where a Madhya Pradesh landholder sees the khasra, the khatauni (B1) and the plot map, pays land revenue, and tracks a mutation. A free view is enough for your own reference; a certified copy for a bank or a court is bought on the same site.
schemes.benefit: Free land record view, certified copies on payment, and online land revenue payment
eligibility: Land situated in Madhya Pradesh and entered in the revenue record
Anyone may view a record free; a certified copy is issued on payment of the fee
Only the recorded holder or a legal heir can apply for a mutation or a correction
A diversion application must come from the recorded holder of the plot
documents: District, tehsil and village name
Khasra number, or the khatauni (B1) number, or the holder's name
Aadhaar card, for a certified copy or a mutation
Registered sale deed, for a mutation on sale
Death certificate and succession papers, for a mutation on inheritance

demoFields.label: District / Tehsil / Village
demoFields.hint: Pick all three from the lists. The record is held village by village.

demoFields.label: Search by
demoFields.hint: Khasra number, khatauni number or holder's name. Khasra gives the cleanest result; a name search returns every similar name in the village.

demoFields.label: Khasra Number
demoFields.hint: Copy it from an older khasra copy or the purchase deed, including the part number.

demoFields.label: Khatauni (B1) Number
demoFields.hint: Covers every plot you hold in that village, so it is quicker if you own several.

demoFields.label: Holder's Name as on the record
demoFields.value: Budhram Singh Uikey, son of Sukhlal Singh
demoFields.hint: Spelt as on the land record, which may differ from Aadhaar. Search the record's spelling first and get it corrected later if wrong.

demoFields.label: Type of copy wanted
demoFields.hint: A free view is enough to check your own details. A bank, a court or a subsidy office needs the certified copy, which carries a fee.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number (for a certified copy)
demoFields.hint: Needed to buy a certified copy or to file a mutation, with an OTP to the linked mobile.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The download link for a certified copy and any mutation notice come here.

demoSteps: Open mpbhulekh.gov.in and pick district, tehsil and village, then search by khasra number, khatauni number or holder's name.
Check the area, the holder's name and the crop entry against what you know. The free view costs nothing and needs no login.
For a bank, a court or a subsidy claim, log in and buy the certified copy — the free print is not accepted for those.
Land revenue for the plot can be paid from the same site, and the receipt downloaded at once.
If a sale or a death has not been entered, file the mutation (namantaran) with the registered deed or the succession papers, and track it by the application number on the portal.
Keep a current khasra and B1 with your papers. PM-Kisan, crop loans and state farm schemes all ask for them.
The site can be slow or unreachable at busy times. If it does not open, any MPOnline kiosk will pull the same record for the notified fee.
schemes.helpline: Your tehsil office, or the Patwari of your village circle

schemes.title: MP ESB Recruitment — Group Exams, Patwari and Constable
schemes.department: Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board
schemes.brief: The Employees Selection Board runs most non-gazetted recruitment in Madhya Pradesh — Group 1 to 5 posts, Patwari, Sub Engineer, Police and Excise Constable, and the teacher eligibility tests. Every application goes through the ESB portal, and the fee is paid at an MPOnline kiosk or online.
schemes.benefit: One portal for every MP subordinate-service recruitment and teacher eligibility test
eligibility: Age as the notification states, usually 18 to 40, with relaxation for MP domiciles, women, SC, ST, OBC and disability
The qualification the post requires, complete on the notification's closing date
Domicile of Madhya Pradesh for reserved-category benefits and the lower fee
Physical standards and a running test for constable posts, set out in that notification
documents: Aadhaar card
Class 10 certificate for date of birth
Higher qualification certificates and marks sheets
MP domicile certificate
Caste certificate on the MP format, for a reserved category
Disability or ex-serviceman certificate, where claiming that reservation
Recent passport photograph and a scanned signature

demoFields.label: Candidate Name (as on Class 10 certificate)
demoFields.hint: The Class 10 certificate governs, not Aadhaar, where the two differ. Everything later is checked against it.

demoFields.label: Father's / Mother's Name
demoFields.hint: As on the Class 10 certificate.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth
demoFields.hint: As on the Class 10 certificate. Age limits count from this date and it cannot be changed later.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits, used to keep one candidate to one profile.

demoFields.label: Domicile of Madhya Pradesh
demoFields.hint: Reserved-category benefits and the lower examination fee are for MP domiciles only. A candidate from another state pays the full fee and competes unreserved.

demoFields.label: Category and sub-category
demoFields.value: SC; no disability; not an ex-serviceman
demoFields.hint: Claim only what you hold an MP-format certificate for. Age relaxation and the fee both follow from this.

demoFields.label: Post and examination applied for
demoFields.hint: One application per notification. Check the qualification in that notification before paying.

demoFields.label: Educational Qualification
demoFields.value: B.Com, Dr. Harisingh Gour University Sagar, 2023, 64%
demoFields.hint: Course, university, year and marks. It must be complete on the closing date, not merely expected.

demoFields.label: Preferred examination city
demoFields.hint: Give two or three. The board allots the nearest centre it can.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number and Email
demoFields.hint: Admit card and every notice come here. Do not use a cyber cafe's number.

demoSteps: Watch esb.mp.gov.in for the notification for the post you want, and read the qualification and age limits before anything else.
Register with your name and date of birth exactly as on the Class 10 certificate, and upload the photograph and signature in the sizes the site states.
Fill the application, choose your examination cities, and pay the fee online or at an MPOnline kiosk. MP domiciles in the reserved categories pay less.
Use the correction window if the board opens one — it is the only chance to fix a wrong entry, and it closes quickly.
Download the admit card about a week before the exam and take it with a photo ID.
Results and the answer key come out on the same site. For constable posts the physical test follows, and for all posts document verification comes last.
At verification, produce the originals of everything you claimed. A domicile or caste certificate that is not on the MP format is rejected there, and the candidature goes with it.
schemes.helpline: 0755-2578801 — MP ESB office

schemes.title: MP Housing Board — Flats, Plots and PMAY-U Units
schemes.department: MP Housing and Infrastructure Development Board
schemes.brief: The MP Housing Board builds and sells flats and plots in the state's cities, including the affordable PMAY-U units meant for lower and middle income families. Registration, the first-come-first-served booking, instalments and the e-auction of leftover properties are all done on its own portal.
schemes.benefit: Board-built flat or plot, with PMAY-U units at subsidised prices
eligibility: Indian citizen aged 18 or above; a Madhya Pradesh domicile for the schemes reserved for state residents
For a PMAY-U unit, the family must own no pucca house anywhere in India and must be within the income limit for its category
One unit per family under the subsidised schemes
Booking is first come first served, or by lottery where a scheme is oversubscribed
documents: Aadhaar card and PAN card
Domicile certificate of Madhya Pradesh
Income proof — salary slips, Form 16 or an income certificate
Bank passbook and a cancelled cheque
Affidavit that the family owns no pucca house, for a PMAY-U unit
Passport-size photographs
Caste certificate, where applying against a reserved category

demoFields.label: Scheme and location
demoFields.value: PMAY-U AHP flats, Kolar Road, Bhopal
demoFields.hint: Pick the scheme from the list of live offers. Each one has its own price, size and closing date.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: As on Aadhaar. The allotment letter and the sale deed are both issued in this name, so a later correction is expensive.

demoFields.label: Father's / Husband's Name
demoFields.hint: As on Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar and PAN
demoFields.hint: Both are needed. PAN is required because the purchase is a property transaction.

demoFields.label: Category applied under
demoFields.hint: EWS, LIG, MIG or general. The income limit for the category is checked against the income proof you upload.

demoFields.label: Annual Family Income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: The household's total for the year. For a PMAY-U unit it must be inside the limit for the category you chose.

demoFields.label: Do you own a pucca house anywhere in India?
demoFields.hint: Answer truthfully and back it with the affidavit. A false answer cancels the allotment and forfeits the deposit.

demoFields.label: Bank Account and IFSC for refund
demoFields.hint: If you are not allotted a unit, the registration money is refunded here, so give a live account in your own name.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number and Email
demoFields.hint: The allotment result, every instalment notice and the possession date all come here.

demoSteps: Look at the live schemes on mphousing.in and read the price, the size, the instalment plan and the closing date before you register for one.
Register on the portal with Aadhaar, PAN and your mobile, and confirm the OTP.
Fill the application for the scheme you want, upload the income proof, the domicile certificate and, for a PMAY-U unit, the affidavit that the family owns no pucca house.
Pay the registration money online and keep the receipt. Booking is first come first served on most schemes, so the date and time of payment can decide the case.
Watch for the allotment result on the portal. If you are not allotted, the registration money is refunded to the account you gave.
On allotment, pay the instalments by the dates in the allotment letter. Missing them attracts interest and, if you fall far enough behind, cancellation.
Possession comes after the full payment and the registry. Inspect the unit before you take the keys and get any defect recorded in writing.
schemes.helpline: 0755-2551000 — MP Housing Board, Bhopal

schemes.title: MP e-District — Income, Caste and Domicile Certificates
schemes.department: Revenue Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh
schemes.brief: The Tahsildar's certificates that Madhya Pradesh runs online — income, caste, domicile and residence — applied for on the e-District portal or at an MPOnline kiosk. Each one is signed digitally and downloaded from the same site, and the state's public service guarantee puts a deadline on it.
schemes.benefit: Digitally signed income, caste or domicile certificate within the guaranteed time
eligibility: Resident of Madhya Pradesh, applying in the tehsil where the family lives
Samagra Member ID, since the portal pulls your family details from it
For a caste certificate, the caste must be on the state's SC, ST or OBC list and traceable through the father's family
An income certificate is valid for one year; a caste and a domicile certificate do not expire
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant
Samagra Family ID and Member ID
Address proof — electricity bill, property tax receipt or voter ID
Father's caste certificate or a school record showing the caste, for a caste certificate
Salary certificate or land record, for an income certificate
Passport-size photograph

demoFields.label: Certificate applied for
demoFields.hint: Income, caste, domicile, residence, birth or death. Each opens a different form and asks for different proof.

demoFields.label: Samagra Member ID
demoFields.hint: Nine digits. The portal fills your name, family and address from it, so get the Samagra done first.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Letter for letter as on Aadhaar. The certificate prints from this entry.

demoFields.label: Father's Name
demoFields.hint: For a caste certificate this matters most — the caste is traced through the father's family record.

demoFields.label: Caste claimed
demoFields.hint: Pick from the state list rather than typing it. A spelling that is not on the list will not be accepted.

demoFields.label: District / Tehsil / Village
demoFields.hint: Where the family lives. The Tahsildar of this tehsil signs the certificate.

demoFields.label: Annual Family Income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: For an income certificate, the household's total for the year from every source. It is checked against land and other records.

demoFields.label: Family caste reference, if any
demoFields.hint: If anyone in the father's family already holds a caste certificate, give its number. It is the quickest way to get yours cleared.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The application number and the ready-to-download message come here by SMS.

demoSteps: Get the Samagra Member ID first if you do not have it. The e-District form is built around it and cannot be completed without one.
Open mpedistrict.gov.in, register or log in, and choose the certificate you need. An MPOnline kiosk will do the same for the notified fee.
Fill the form and upload Aadhaar, the address proof, and the income or caste proof. For a caste certificate the father's certificate or the school record is the paper that decides the case.
Pay the fee and keep the application number from the acknowledgement.
The Patwari and the Revenue Inspector verify the family, usually within a week, and may visit.
The Tahsildar signs the certificate digitally within the time the public service guarantee allows, and you download it from the portal. A digitally signed copy needs no further attestation.
If the deadline passes, the same Act gives you an appeal to the Sub-Divisional Officer, and the fine falls on the officer who delayed it.
schemes.helpline: 181 — CM Helpline Madhya Pradesh

schemes.title: Samagra ID — Madhya Pradesh Family and Member ID
schemes.department: Department of Social Justice and Disabled Welfare, Government of Madhya Pradesh
schemes.brief: Samagra is the family register of Madhya Pradesh. Each family gets an eight-digit Samagra Family ID and each person a nine-digit Member ID. Nearly every state benefit — Ladli Behna, scholarships, pensions, ration — is paid against this number, so getting it made and the e-KYC done comes before anything else.
schemes.benefit: Samagra Family ID and Member ID, the number every MP state scheme is paid against
eligibility: Family living in Madhya Pradesh, registered in the village or ward where it lives
Every member needs an Aadhaar, and the Aadhaar must be linked to a working mobile
One family record per household; a member can be in only one family
A woman who marries is moved from her parents' family to her husband's, not registered twice
documents: Aadhaar cards of every member of the family
Mobile number linked to the Aadhaar of each member, for the e-KYC OTP
Address proof — electricity bill, house tax receipt or voter ID
Bank passbook of each member, for DBT seeding
Age proof for children — birth certificate or school record

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. Registration and e-KYC both run on this, and the OTP goes to the linked mobile.

demoFields.label: Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Letter for letter as on Aadhaar. A mismatch is why e-KYC fails and benefits stop.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth
demoFields.hint: As on Aadhaar. Age decides eligibility for schemes like Ladli Behna, so it must be right.

demoFields.label: Head of the Family and relation
demoFields.hint: The family record is built around the head. State how you are related to that person.

demoFields.label: District / Tehsil / Village or Ward
demoFields.hint: Where the family actually lives. The Panchayat Secretary or ward officer verifies here.

demoFields.label: Caste / Category
demoFields.hint: Recorded against each member and checked by the schemes that have category quotas.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: Must be the number linked to the member's own Aadhaar, since e-KYC is done by OTP.

demoFields.label: Bank Account Number and IFSC
demoFields.hint: In the member's own name and Aadhaar-seeded with NPCI, not merely linked. Samagra shows the DBT status separately — check that it says active.

demoFields.label: Samagra Family ID (after registration)
demoFields.hint: Eight digits for the family. Each member then gets a nine-digit Member ID under it.

demoSteps: Search samagra.gov.in first with your Aadhaar or mobile — most families in Madhya Pradesh are already registered, and you only need to find the number and print it.
If the family is not there, register it with the head's Aadhaar and add every member, giving each one's Aadhaar and date of birth.
Complete the e-KYC for every member. It needs an OTP to that member's own Aadhaar-linked mobile, so have the family present.
Check the DBT and NPCI seeding status on the portal for each member. A bank account that is linked but not NPCI-seeded still fails when money is sent.
The Panchayat Secretary or the ward officer verifies the family. Once approved, print the Family ID and each Member ID.
Keep both numbers with your papers. Ladli Behna, scholarships, pensions and ration all ask for the Samagra number before anything else.
schemes.helpline: 0755-2700800 — Samagra helpdesk

schemes.title: MP Police Citizen Services — e-FIR and Character Certificate
schemes.department: Madhya Pradesh Police
schemes.brief: Madhya Pradesh Police takes several things online that used to mean a trip to the thana — an FIR for a stolen vehicle or a missing article, a police character verification certificate for a job or a passport, tenant and domestic-help verification, and a missing-person report.
schemes.benefit: e-FIR, character verification certificate and tenant verification without going to the police station
eligibility: Complainant or applicant resident in, or the incident having happened in, Madhya Pradesh
An e-FIR covers property offences with no named accused — a stolen vehicle, a lost article, theft in your absence
A serious offence, or one with a named accused, must still be reported at the police station in person
A mobile number that works, since every step is confirmed by OTP
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant
Address proof for the address to be verified
Vehicle registration certificate, for a stolen vehicle e-FIR
Purchase bill or IMEI, for a lost article
Passport-size photograph, for a character certificate
Employer's letter or passport file number, where the certificate is asked for by them

demoFields.label: Service wanted
demoFields.hint: e-FIR, character verification, lost article, tenant or domestic-help verification, or missing person. Each opens a different form.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: As on Aadhaar. The certificate is issued in this name.

demoFields.label: Father's / Husband's Name
demoFields.hint: Used with the address to identify you in the police records.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. Identity is confirmed on this and an OTP goes to the linked mobile.

demoFields.label: Address to be verified
demoFields.value: House 24, Ward 9, Makronia, Sagar, Madhya Pradesh 470004
demoFields.hint: The address the police will actually visit or check. Give a landmark so the beat constable finds it.

demoFields.label: Purpose
demoFields.hint: Job, passport, visa, tenancy or a licence. It is printed on the certificate, so say the real reason.

demoFields.label: Police Station area
demoFields.hint: The station covering your address. If you are unsure, the portal finds it from the district and the locality.

demoFields.label: Details of the incident (for an e-FIR)
demoFields.hint: For an e-FIR, write when and where it happened and exactly what was taken, with numbers — chassis, engine, IMEI.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The acknowledgement number and the ready message come here by SMS.

demoSteps: Open citizen.mppolice.gov.in, register with your mobile and confirm the OTP, then choose the service you need.
Fill the form carefully. For an e-FIR, the chassis, engine or IMEI number is what makes a recovery possible, so copy those exactly from the papers.
Upload Aadhaar, the address proof, and the vehicle or purchase papers where they apply.
Submit and note the acknowledgement number. An e-FIR gets a copy you can download at once and take to your insurance company.
For a character certificate, the beat constable visits the address and the station forwards a report. Be available, or the file waits.
The signed certificate or the FIR copy is downloaded from the same login. If a real offence needs investigating, the station converts the e-FIR into a regular FIR and calls you.
For anything urgent or violent, do not use this portal — call 100 or 112 and go to the station.
schemes.helpline: 100 or 112 for an emergency; 0755-2443500 for the MP Police citizen portal

schemes.title: Mahabhulekh — 7/12, 8A and Property Card
schemes.department: Revenue Department — Settlement Commissioner and Director of Land Records, Government of Maharashtra
schemes.brief: Mahabhulekh carries the land record of every village in Maharashtra — all districts, 716 talukas and more than 89,000 villages. The 7/12, called the satbara, shows who holds a piece of agricultural land, how much, what is sown on it and any bank charge against it; the 8A lists every holding of one khatedar in the village; the property card does the same for surveyed urban land. Viewing is free, and a digitally signed copy that banks and offices accept costs about Rs 15.
schemes.benefit: Free 7/12, 8A and property card view; digitally signed extract for about Rs 15
eligibility: Land situated in Maharashtra and entered in the record of rights
Anyone may view a 7/12, an 8A or a property card — no login, no fee and no proof of ownership is needed
A digitally signed extract needs registration with a mobile number and payment of about Rs 15 per copy
7/12 and 8A cover agricultural land; a property card covers surveyed urban land holding a City Survey number
Only the khatedar or a legal heir can ask the Talathi to correct an entry or to record a mutation
documents: Survey number or gat number of the land, or the khatedar's name
The village, taluka, district and the revenue division they fall in
Mobile number, for a digitally signed copy
Aadhaar card, if you are getting the extract at an Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendra or a CSC
Registered sale deed, for a mutation after a purchase
Death certificate and the heirship paper, for a mutation after a death
The existing 7/12 or 8A extract, where you are asking for a correction

demoFields.label: Revenue division (Vibhag)
demoFields.hint: The six divisions are Amravati, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, Konkan, Nagpur, Nashik and Pune. Satara falls under Pune division.

demoFields.label: Record wanted
demoFields.hint: 7/12 for one piece of agricultural land, 8A to see every holding of one khatedar in the village, property card for urban land.

demoFields.label: District / Taluka / Village
demoFields.hint: Pick all three from the lists. The record is kept village by village, so a wrong village shows nothing.

demoFields.label: Search by
demoFields.hint: Search by survey or gat number if you know it, otherwise by the khatedar's surname. The number is the surer way.

demoFields.label: Survey Number / Gat Number
demoFields.hint: Copy it exactly from the old extract or the purchase deed. A wrong sub-division number pulls up a neighbour's land.

demoFields.label: Khatedar's name — surname, first name, middle name
demoFields.hint: Only if you are searching by name. Use the spelling on the land record, which may not match Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Verification code shown on the screen
demoFields.hint: Type the characters exactly as displayed. It refreshes if you get it wrong.

demoFields.label: Mobile number, for a digitally signed copy
demoFields.hint: Needed only for the paid signed extract. The download link comes to this number against an OTP.

demoFields.label: Payment for the digitally signed extract
demoFields.hint: Pay for each copy you need. Buy one for each bank or office that will keep a copy.

demoSteps: Open bhulekh.mahabhumi.gov.in, choose your division, then the district, taluka and village.
Search by the gat or survey number and open the 7/12. Check the area, the khatedar names, the crop entry and the 'other rights' column, which is where a bank charge or a loan is recorded.
Pull the 8A as well to see every piece of land held in that village under the same khata. That is what land revenue is charged on.

The free print is for your own reference. For a bank, a court, a subsidy claim or a sale, buy the digitally signed extract from digitalsatbara.mahabhumi.gov.in for about Rs 15 — offices do not accept the unsigned print.
Read the ferfar (mutation) entries. After a purchase or a death the change shows here only once the Talathi has recorded it and the Tahsildar has passed the order.
If a name, an area or a crop entry is wrong, apply to the village Talathi with the deed or the heirship paper. Fixing it now is far easier than at the time of a sale.
If you cannot use the site, the same extracts are issued at an Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendra or a CSC for a small fee.
schemes.helpline: Your village Talathi or the taluka Tahsildar's office; extracts are also issued at Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendras and CSCs

schemes.title: MahaDBT post-matric scholarship
schemes.department: Social Justice, Tribal Development, OBC and Higher Education Departments, Government of Maharashtra
schemes.brief: One portal carrying about forty scholarships and freeships for students of Maharashtra from class 11 upward, covering SC, ST, OBC, VJNT, SBC, EBC and minority students. Tuition and exam fees go to the college and the maintenance allowance comes to the student's own account. Marathi and English. The college has to verify your application online after you submit it, so a form that is never followed up at the college office simply sits there. Renewal is needed every single year.
schemes.benefit: Tuition and exam fees paid in full, plus a maintenance allowance
eligibility: Domiciled in Maharashtra
Studying in class 11 or above in a recognised institution inside the state
Caste certificate and, for professional courses, caste validity for SC, ST, OBC, VJNT and SBC students
Family income within the ceiling of the particular scholarship; for most freeships and EBC schemes it is Rs.8 lakh a year
At least 75 percent attendance in the previous year, and not repeating the same year twice
documents: Aadhaar card, linked to a bank account that is switched on for DBT
Caste certificate, and caste validity certificate where the course demands it
Income certificate from the tehsildar, issued through Aaple Sarkar
Last year's mark sheet, and the class 10 certificate for date of birth
College admission receipt or bonafide certificate with the fee structure
Domicile certificate of Maharashtra
Gap certificate on affidavit, if there was a break in studies

demoFields.label: Student's name
demoFields.hint: Spelled exactly as on the class 10 certificate. The college verifies against that, not against your college ID.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: It must be seeded with your bank account and DBT-enabled. Ask the bank to confirm; an un-seeded account is the single biggest reason money does not arrive.

demoFields.label: Caste and caste certificate number
demoFields.hint: Copy the number from the certificate itself. Leave this out if you are applying for an open-category EBC freeship.

demoFields.label: Income certificate number
demoFields.hint: The number on the tehsildar's income certificate. It has to be current, usually issued within the last year.

demoFields.label: College and course
demoFields.value: Rajaram College, Kolhapur / B.Sc. Agriculture, 2nd year
demoFields.hint: Pick the college from the drop-down list rather than typing it. If your college is not listed, tell the college office, because they must first be registered on MahaDBT.

demoFields.label: Year of admission
demoFields.hint: The year you joined this course, not the year you are in now.

demoFields.label: Previous year percentage
demoFields.hint: From your last mark sheet. Some scholarships have a minimum; the portal will tell you which ones you clear.

demoFields.label: Bank account number
demoFields.hint: Must be the student's own account, not a parent's. The maintenance allowance can only be paid into the student's account.

demoFields.label: IFSC code
demoFields.hint: From the first page of the passbook. Check the zeros carefully, they are digits, not the letter O.

demoSteps: Get the papers in place before the portal opens for the year: caste certificate, caste validity if your course needs it, and a fresh income certificate from Aaple Sarkar. These take the longest, so start with them.
Go to the bank and confirm that your own account is Aadhaar-seeded and DBT-enabled. Ask them for it in writing if they hesitate.
Register on MahaDBT with your Aadhaar and mobile number, complete the e-KYC, and log in.
Fill your personal, address, academic and bank details once. They are saved to your profile and reused for every scholarship you apply to.
The portal then shows the list of schemes you are eligible for. Apply to all of them that apply to you, not just one, because they are sanctioned by different departments.
Upload the documents and submit. Note the application ID.
Now go to your college office and ask them to verify your application on their MahaDBT login. This step is not automatic and nothing moves until they do it.
Track the status through your login. Tuition and exam fees are paid to the college and the maintenance allowance comes to your account. Remember to renew next year, in the same way.
schemes.helpline: 022-49150800 (MahaDBT helpdesk)

schemes.title: MPSC Recruitment — Rajyaseva, Group B and Group C
schemes.department: Maharashtra Public Service Commission
schemes.brief: The Maharashtra Public Service Commission recruits for the Maharashtra Civil Services (Rajyaseva) and for the Group B and Group C combined services, which include PSI, STI and Assistant Section Officer, as well as the engineering, agriculture, forest and judicial services. Notifications and syllabi are published on mpsc.gov.in; the application itself is filed on the separate online system. You build one candidate profile, lock it, and then apply to each advertisement from it.
schemes.benefit: One online profile for every MPSC examination and direct recruitment, with hall tickets and results
eligibility: Indian citizen; a Maharashtra domicile certificate is needed for the reserved category posts and for most state services
Age as the advertisement states — generally 19 to 38 years for the open category, relaxed to 43 for backward class candidates, with further relaxation for ex-servicemen and disabled candidates
A degree from a recognised university, complete on the closing date the advertisement gives, for Rajyaseva and the Group B posts
Knowledge of Marathi is required, and it is tested in the examination
A Non-Creamy Layer certificate valid on the closing date, for OBC, VJNT and SBC candidates
Each advertisement sets its own age, qualification and physical standards — read that one before you pay the fee
documents: Aadhaar card
SSC (Class 10) certificate, which governs the date of birth and the spelling of the name
Degree certificate and every marksheet
Maharashtra domicile certificate
Caste certificate and Caste Validity Certificate, for a reserved category
Non-Creamy Layer certificate valid on the closing date, for OBC, VJNT and SBC
Disability, ex-serviceman, sportsperson or project-affected certificate, where that reservation is claimed
Recent passport photograph and a scanned signature in the sizes the portal states

demoFields.label: Examination or post applied for
demoFields.value: Maharashtra Group B (Combined) — PSI, STI and ASO
demoFields.hint: One application per advertisement. Check the age limit and the qualification in that advertisement before you pay anything.

demoFields.label: Candidate's full name as on the SSC certificate
demoFields.hint: The SSC certificate governs, not Aadhaar, where the two differ. Every later check is made against it.

demoFields.label: Father's name and Mother's name
demoFields.value: Bhaskar Namdev Deshmukh / Shobha Bhaskar Deshmukh
demoFields.hint: As on the SSC certificate.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth
demoFields.hint: As on the SSC certificate. The age limit counts from this date and it cannot be changed once the profile is locked.

demoFields.label: Category, caste and caste certificate number
demoFields.hint: Claim only the category you hold a Maharashtra certificate for. The number is printed on the certificate itself.

demoFields.label: Non-Creamy Layer certificate number and validity
demoFields.hint: It must be valid on the closing date of the advertisement, not merely on the day you apply. An expired one loses you the reservation.

demoFields.label: Maharashtra domicile
demoFields.hint: Needed for the reserved seats and for most state posts. Get it from the tehsil or through Aaple Sarkar if you do not have it.

demoFields.label: Educational qualification
demoFields.hint: It must be complete on the closing date, not merely expected. Enter the marks as printed on the final marksheet.

demoFields.label: Knowledge of Marathi
demoFields.value: Yes — studied Marathi up to SSC
demoFields.hint: MPSC requires it and tests it. Declare it honestly and keep the school certificate for verification.

demoFields.label: Examination centre preference
demoFields.hint: Give the choices the form allows. The Commission allots the nearest centre it can, but it is not guaranteed.

demoSteps: Watch mpsc.gov.in for the advertisement and read the age, qualification, physical standards and reservation conditions before doing anything else.
Create your candidate profile on mpsconline.gov.in with your name and date of birth exactly as on the SSC certificate, and upload the photograph and signature in the stated sizes.
Lock the profile. Check every entry twice first — the locked profile is what is carried into all your applications and it is not freely editable afterwards.
Run the eligibility check for that advertisement, submit the application and pay the fee online. Save the application number and the payment receipt.
Download the hall ticket about a week before each stage and take it with a photo identity card.
Rajyaseva runs as a preliminary, a main examination and an interview; the combined Group B and Group C examinations run as a preliminary and a main. Each result is published on the Commission's site.

Document verification comes last. Produce the originals of everything you claimed, including the Caste Validity Certificate within the time the Commission allows — a claim you cannot prove there costs you the post.
schemes.helpline: Maharashtra Public Service Commission — contact details and every notice are published on mpsc.gov.in

schemes.title: Aaple Sarkar certificates, income and domicile
schemes.department: Directorate of Information Technology, Government of Maharashtra
schemes.brief: One login for the certificates that every other scheme asks you for: income, domicile (adhivas), non-creamy layer, age and nationality, senior citizen, solvency and around five hundred more services. The Maharashtra Right to Public Service Act puts a deadline on each one, so the tehsildar cannot sit on it. The portal is in Marathi and English. You can file it yourself, or hand the papers over at a Maha e-Seva Kendra or the Setu centre in the tehsil office, which is how most people outside the cities do it.
schemes.benefit: Income, domicile and caste certificates within 15 working days
eligibility: Any resident of Maharashtra
A mobile number that can receive an OTP, used as your login
Papers for the particular certificate you are asking for; the portal lists them before you start
documents: Aadhaar card
Proof of where you live: ration card, electricity bill, water bill or voter ID
Proof of age: birth certificate, school leaving certificate or bonafide from the school
Proof of income for an income certificate: salary slip, Form 16, or the talathi's report for farming and daily-wage families
Self-declaration on the format the portal gives you, signed
Recent passport photograph

demoFields.label: Username you want
demoFields.hint: Pick something you will remember. This one login opens every service on the portal, so do not create a fresh one each time.

demoFields.label: Full name
demoFields.hint: Exactly as on Aadhaar. The certificate is printed with this spelling and a mismatch later costs you another application.

demoFields.label: Service applied for
demoFields.hint: Choose the department first, then the service. Income certificates sit under Revenue, not under Social Justice.

demoFields.label: District / Taluka / Village
demoFields.hint: The tehsil office that gets your application is decided by what you put here, so it must be where you actually live.

demoFields.label: Annual family income
demoFields.hint: Total earnings of the whole household for the last financial year. For farming families the talathi's report is what the office goes by.

demoFields.label: Purpose of the certificate
demoFields.hint: Say plainly what it is for: scholarship, hostel admission, EWS quota, a scheme. This decides the format that is issued.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: Used to pull your name and address in automatically, which saves typing mistakes.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: Every status message and the download link for the signed certificate comes to this number.

demoSteps: Work out which certificate you actually need. An income certificate and a non-creamy-layer certificate are different papers, and applying for the wrong one wastes two weeks.
Register once on Aaple Sarkar with your mobile number and an OTP. Keep the username and password written down somewhere safe, because the same login is used for every future service.
Choose the department and then the service. The screen lists the exact documents that service needs before you commit to anything.
Fill the form as this sample shows and upload scanned or photographed documents. Each file has a size limit, so photograph on a plain surface in daylight rather than scanning badly.
Pay the small statutory fee online if that service has one. Many certificates are free.
Submit, and save the application ID. The portal shows the deadline by which the office must answer you under the Right to Public Service Act.
If you would rather not do this yourself, take the same documents to a Maha e-Seva Kendra or the Setu centre at the tehsil office and the operator will file it under your name for the notified fee.
When it is approved, download the digitally signed certificate from your login. It is valid as it is; you do not need a stamp or an attestation on top of it.
schemes.helpline: 1800-120-8040 (Aaple Sarkar helpdesk)

schemes.title: Mahavitaran — New Electricity Connection and Consumer Services
schemes.department: Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution Co. Ltd. (MSEDCL / Mahavitaran)
schemes.brief: Mahavitaran, the state electricity distribution company, supplies the whole of Maharashtra except most of Mumbai city and its suburbs. A new domestic, commercial or agricultural connection is applied for on its Web Self Service portal, which also handles bill payment, self meter readings, a name or address change on the account, a load change, reconnection after disconnection, security deposit refund and complaints. The information site is mahadiscom.in; the applications and account transactions happen on the self-service portal.
schemes.benefit: New connection normally released within one month of a complete application, plus online billing, meter readings and complaints
eligibility: Premises anywhere in the MSEDCL supply area — the whole of Maharashtra except most of Mumbai city and its suburbs
You own the premises or lawfully occupy them, and can produce proof of that
No unpaid electricity dues standing against the premises or against you at another connection
The internal wiring is finished and tested, with a test report signed by a licensed electrical contractor
Under the Electricity Act, supply must be given within one month of a complete application wherever the line and the network already reach the premises
documents: Proof of ownership or occupancy — 7/12 extract, property tax receipt, sale deed, Index II or a registered rent agreement
Photo identity proof and Aadhaar card
Recent passport-size photograph
Test report of the internal wiring from a licensed electrical contractor
Consumer number and the latest paid bill of a neighbouring or existing connection, to identify the feeder
No Objection Certificate from the owner, if you are a tenant
Municipal or Gram Panchayat building permission, where the sub-division asks for it

demoFields.label: Service wanted
demoFields.hint: New connection, bill payment, name or address change, load change, reconnection, security deposit refund or a complaint. A new connection can be started without registering.

demoFields.label: Tariff category and phase
demoFields.hint: Residential for a home, commercial for a shop, agricultural for a pump. The wrong category means the wrong rate on every bill afterwards.

demoFields.label: Connected load applied for
demoFields.hint: Add up the wattage of the lights, fans, pump and appliances you will run. Asking for too little means paying again later for a load change.

demoFields.label: Applicant's name as it should appear on the bill
demoFields.hint: Spelt as on Aadhaar and matching the ownership or rent paper. Changing it later is a separate name-change application.

demoFields.label: Full address of the premises where supply is wanted
demoFields.value: Plot 27, Shivneri Nagar, Hudkeshwar Road, Nagpur — 440034
demoFields.hint: The address of the building itself, not a correspondence address. The section engineer comes to this spot.

demoFields.label: Nearest existing consumer number

Priority Household (yellow or saffron) under NFSA: annual family income up to Rs 44,000 in a rural area and up to Rs 59,000 in an urban area
Antyodaya (yellow): the poorest families picked by the tehsil — landless labourers, widows, the aged and households with no assured income

Aadhaar of every member must be seeded and e-KYC done at the fair price shop before grain is released
documents: Aadhaar card of every family member
Proof of residence — electricity bill, property tax receipt, registered rent agreement or a Gram Panchayat letter
Passport-size photograph of the head of the family

Surrender or removal certificate from the earlier taluka, if the family has moved

schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana
schemes.department: Women and Child Development Department, Government of Maharashtra
schemes.brief: A monthly payment to women of Maharashtra between 21 and 65, sent straight to her own bank account so that she does not have to ask anyone for it. The portal works in Marathi and English. You may fill it yourself on a phone, but most women applied through the anganwadi sevika, the gram sevak or a Maha e-Seva Kendra (CSC), which costs nothing extra and gets the e-KYC done on the spot. The state revises the amount in its budget, so treat the figure below as the rate the scheme pays and check the portal for the rate in force today.
schemes.benefit: Rs.1,500 per month
eligibility: Woman who lives in Maharashtra, aged 21 to 65 on the date of applying
Married, widowed, divorced, abandoned or destitute woman; one unmarried woman per family may also apply
Total family income Rs.2.5 lakh a year or less
No one in the family pays income tax or holds a regular government job
The family owns no four-wheeler (a tractor does not count)
She has a bank account in her own name, linked to her Aadhaar and switched on for DBT
documents: Aadhaar card
Bank passbook in her own name, first page, Aadhaar-seeded
Domicile certificate of Maharashtra, or a birth certificate or school leaving certificate in its place
Ration card (a yellow or orange card is accepted instead of an income certificate)

demoFields.label: Applicant's name (as on Aadhaar)

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: The 12 digits on your Aadhaar card. The state uses this to match your bank account, so check every digit twice.

demoFields.label: Date of birth
demoFields.hint: As written on Aadhaar. You must have completed 21 years and not yet crossed 65.

demoFields.label: Marital status
demoFields.hint: Married, widow, divorced, abandoned or unmarried. A widow or an abandoned woman is fully eligible, so do not leave this blank out of hesitation.

demoFields.label: District / Taluka / Village
demoFields.hint: The place where you actually live now, not your maternal village.

demoFields.label: Ration card number
demoFields.hint: Copy it from the top of your ration card. A yellow or orange card is itself the proof that your income is within the limit.

demoFields.label: Annual family income
demoFields.hint: Everyone in the household added together for the whole year. It must be Rs.2,50,000 or less.

demoFields.label: Bank account number
demoFields.hint: It must be in your own name. A joint account with your husband, or his account, will be rejected.

demoFields.label: IFSC code
demoFields.hint: Eleven characters printed on the first page of your passbook, next to the branch name.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: A number you hold yourself if possible, because the OTP and every later message about the payment comes to it.

demoSteps: Decide where to apply from. You can do it on your own phone, or walk into an anganwadi centre, the gram panchayat office or a Maha e-Seva Kendra (CSC) and have the sevika or operator do it. The government route is free; a CSC may charge only the notified service fee.

Keep the papers ready before you start: Aadhaar, ration card, bank passbook and a photo. Photograph each one clearly in daylight, because blurred uploads are the commonest reason an application comes back.
Open the Ladki Bahin portal, choose 'Applicant Login', and register with your mobile number. An OTP comes to that number; type it in and set a password you will remember.
Fill the application form: name, Aadhaar, date of birth, address, ration card, income and bank details, exactly as this sample shows.
Upload the documents and the signed self-declaration (hami patra). The declaration format can be downloaded from the same page, printed, signed and photographed.
Submit and note down the application number that appears on the screen. Take a photograph of that screen.
The anganwadi sevika and then the CDPO office check your form and the list of applicants is displayed publicly at the anganwadi. If something is objected to, you get a chance to correct it.
Once approved, the money starts arriving in your own account. Check the status any time on the portal with your application number, and pass a complaint to 181 if payment stops without reason.

schemes.title: Biju Pucca Ghar Yojana - Pucca House Grant
schemes.department: Panchayati Raj & Drinking Water Department, Government of Odisha
schemes.brief: The state's own rural housing grant, for poor families in villages who have no pucca house and whose names did not come in the central Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin list. It replaced the earlier Mo Kudia scheme. The grant is Rs 1,20,000 in plain areas, released in four instalments as the house goes up, with up to 95 days of MGNREGS wage on your job card for building it yourself. The house must stand on land you own or on homestead land given to you by the government. Everything is done at the Gram Panchayat and the Block office.
schemes.benefit: Rs 1,20,000 in four instalments, plus up to 95 days of MGNREGS wage for building the house
eligibility: A family living in rural Odisha with no pucca house of its own, living in a kutcha house or one that has fallen down
The family's name must be in the permanent waiting list kept at the Gram Panchayat; a family already helped under Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin is not taken again
The family must own the homestead land, or have been given homestead land by the government
A family with a government job, an income-tax payer, or a motorised four-wheeler is left out
Priority goes to families hit by fire, flood or cyclone, and to widows, persons with disability and particularly vulnerable tribal groups
documents: Aadhaar card of the head of the family and of the spouse
MGNREGS job card issued by the Gram Panchayat
First page of the bank passbook of an account in the beneficiary's own name, Aadhaar-seeded
Ration card of the family
Land record (RoR) of the homestead plot, or the government land patta
Photograph of the kutcha house the family lives in now
Caste certificate, where a reserved category is claimed
Death certificate or disability certificate, where priority is claimed on that ground
schemes.submitAt: Gram Panchayat office, with the Panchayat Executive Officer or the Gram Rozgar Sevak, or the Block Development Officer's office of your block

Fill the application there with their help and attach Aadhaar, the job card, the passbook copy, the ration card and the land record. Submit it at the Gram Panchayat or the Block office and take the receipt with the case number.
Attend the Palli Sabha where the list is read out. Names are added and struck off at that meeting, so be there in person.
Block staff come and verify the family and photograph the kutcha house. Leave the old house standing until this is done.
On sanction, Rs 1,20,000 comes in four instalments - on sanction, at plinth level, at lintel level, and on completion. Each one is released only after that stage is photographed and geo-tagged.
Do the building work under MGNREGS on your own job card. Up to 95 days of unskilled wage is paid on top of the grant.

schemes.title: Madhu Babu Pension Yojana - Old Age, Widow and Disability Pension
schemes.department: Social Security & Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities Department (SSEPD), Government of Odisha
schemes.brief: Odisha's monthly social security pension. It brought the old Old Age Pension and the state's disability pension together into one scheme, so you will still hear it called by those older names. It pays Rs 500 a month, rising to Rs 700 a month once the pensioner turns 80. Old people aged 60 and above, widows of any age, persons with 40 per cent or more disability, leprosy patients with visible deformity, and AIDS patients and AIDS widows can all apply. The form is filled and submitted at the Block office, or at the NAC or Municipality office in a town. Pension is paid on the 15th of every month.
schemes.benefit: Rs 500 a month, rising to Rs 700 a month from the age of 80
eligibility: Living in Odisha, and aged 60 or above for the old age pension
A widow of any age, a person with 40 per cent or more disability, a leprosy patient with visible deformity, or an AIDS patient or AIDS widow can apply at any age
The family must be poor by the income test the Block applies; an income-tax paying family is not eligible
Not drawing any other government pension, including a service pension or a National Social Assistance Programme pension
Aadhaar, and a bank or post office account in the applicant's own name, are needed for the monthly payment
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant
Age proof - Aadhaar, voter ID, or a certificate from the medical officer where no document exists
Residence proof showing an Odisha address
Income certificate from the Tahasildar, or the ration card showing the family's category
Death certificate of the husband, for a widow pension
Disability certificate from the Chief District Medical Officer, for a disability pension
First page of the bank or post office passbook, in the applicant's own name
Two passport photographs
schemes.submitAt: Block Development Officer's office of your block if you live in a village, or the Executive Officer of your NAC, Municipality or Corporation if you live in a town. The Gram Panchayat office and Mo Seva Kendras also hand out and take in the form.

demoFields.label: Type of pension applied for

demoFields.hint: The place you actually live. Block staff come to this address to verify, and the pension is paid there.

schemes.title: OPSC Recruitment - Applying on OPSC Chayan

Caste certificate in the Odisha format, for SC, ST or SEBC
Residence or nativity certificate of Odisha
Disability certificate, for a person with benchmark disability

Fill the application, upload the photograph, signature and certificates in the sizes shown, and pay the fee online if your category has to pay.

schemes.title: Odisha Income Certificate
schemes.department: Revenue & Disaster Management Department, Government of Odisha
schemes.brief: The certificate from the Tahasildar that states your family's yearly income. Almost every scholarship, fee concession, hostel seat and welfare scheme asks for it. Apply on Odisha One, the state's single citizen portal, which has taken over the old e-District counter for this service. If you cannot fill it yourself, the operator at any Mo Seva Kendra or CSC will do it for you. The Revenue Inspector of your tahasil verifies the income before the Tahasildar signs.
schemes.benefit: Income certificate signed digitally by the Tahasildar, downloaded as a PDF
eligibility: You must live in Odisha and apply in the tahasil where you actually live
The certificate is issued for the whole family's yearly income from every source, not for one person's salary
The applicant must be 18 or above; for a student under 18 the parent or guardian applies
An Aadhaar number and a mobile number that can receive an OTP are needed to register on the portal
The income you write must match what the Revenue Inspector finds on enquiry, or the application is rejected
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant
Residence proof with the Odisha address - electricity bill, voter ID or ration card
Passport photograph of the applicant
Salary slip or the employer's certificate, if anyone in the family is in service
Land record (RoR) from Bhulekh, if the family income comes from farming
Ration card, where the family holds one

demoFields.label: Applicant's Name
demoFields.hint: Write it exactly as it is spelt on your Aadhaar card. The certificate is printed with this spelling and cannot be corrected later without a fresh application.

demoFields.label: Father's / Husband's Name
demoFields.hint: Your father's name, or your husband's name if you are married and want the certificate in your married name.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth
demoFields.hint: As printed on your Aadhaar or your matriculation certificate.

demoFields.label: Gender
demoFields.hint: Pick from the drop-down.

demoFields.hint: Your own 12 digits. An OTP goes to the mobile number linked to this Aadhaar, so carry that phone.

demoFields.hint: A number you actually carry. The acknowledgement and the download link arrive here by SMS.

schemes.title: Bhulekh Odisha - Land Record (RoR / Khatian)
schemes.department: Revenue & Disaster Management Department, Government of Odisha
schemes.brief: Bhulekh is the state's online land record. You can look up and print the Record of Rights - the khatian - for any plot in Odisha free of charge, with no login. You can search by khata number, by plot number, or by the tenant's name

documents: Nothing is needed to view the record - no Aadhaar, no login and no fee

Caste certificate, if the family is claiming the Antyodaya (AAY) category
