demoFields.hint: The whole family's income for one year. It decides whether you come under NFSA, under SFSS, or under neither.

demoFields.label: Scheme applied for
demoFields.hint: NFSA if the family is on the priority list, SFSS if it was left out of NFSA but is still poor. Ask at the Block office which list your family is on.

demoFields.label: Bank Account Number and IFSC of the Head
demoFields.hint: Copy both from the first page of her passbook. The account should be in her own name and Aadhaar-seeded.

demoFields.label: Fair Price Shop to draw from
demoFields.value: Sakhigopal FPS, picked from the list for the Gram Panchayat
demoFields.hint: Choose the ration shop nearest your house from the drop-down. Changing it later means a fresh application at the Block office.

demoFields.label: Old Ration Card Number, if any
demoFields.value: Blank - the family has never held a card
demoFields.hint: Leave it blank for a brand new card. If the family held a card elsewhere, write that number and attach the deletion certificate.

demoSteps: Open the NFSA new-card form on the PDS Odisha portal, or the SFSS form if your family is outside the NFSA list. Mo Seva Kendra and CSC operators fill it for you.
Enter the head of the family's Aadhaar and verify with the OTP on her Aadhaar-linked mobile, then add every member of the family with their own Aadhaar.

Upload the residence proof and the photograph, submit, and write down the Form Number printed on the acknowledgement. Every later step - tracking, adding a member, removing a member - uses this Form Number.
The Block office or the ULB verifies the household, and the Sarpanch or ward officer may be asked about your family.
Once approved, the card is printed and handed over at the Block or ULB office or at your fair price shop. Check every name, relation and Aadhaar on it before you leave.
Get each member's Aadhaar e-KYC done on the machine at the fair price shop. The family's grain does not start until this is finished.
Track the application by the Form Number on the same portal, or ring the department's toll-free helpline if it has not moved in a month.
schemes.helpline: 1800-345-6724 or 155335 (Food, Supplies & Consumer Welfare Department, Odisha)

schemes.title: Subhadra Yojana - Rs 50,000 for Women
schemes.department: Women & Child Development and Mission Shakti Department, Government of Odisha
schemes.brief: A cash payment to women of Odisha aged 21 to 60: Rs 10,000 a year for five years, Rs 50,000 in all. It comes in two instalments of Rs 5,000 each year, near Rakhi Purnima and near International Women's Day on 8 March. The money is paid straight into the woman's own bank account by DBT, so the account must be Aadhaar-seeded and DBT-enabled - an ordinary Aadhaar link is not enough. Apply on the Subhadra portal, or free of charge at any Mo Seva Kendra, Anganwadi centre or CSC.
schemes.benefit: Rs 10,000 a year for five years, paid as two instalments of Rs 5,000 - Rs 50,000 in total
eligibility: A woman living in Odisha, aged 21 to 60 on the qualifying date the government fixes for that year
The family holds an NFSA or State Food Security Scheme ration card; a woman without either can apply if the family's yearly income is Rs 2,50,000 or less
She must not be getting Rs 1,500 a month or more, or Rs 18,000 a year or more, from any other government scheme
Not an income-tax payer, and not a serving or retired government or public sector employee
Not a sitting or former MP or MLA, and not an elected head of a local body
e-KYC must be completed, and the bank account must be in her own name, Aadhaar-seeded and DBT-enabled
documents: Aadhaar card, with a mobile number linked to it for the OTP
NFSA or State Food Security Scheme ration card of the family
Income certificate from the Tahasildar, only if the family holds neither ration card
Bank passbook of an account in her own name, Aadhaar-seeded and DBT-enabled
Residence proof showing an Odisha address
A mobile number she can use to receive the OTP herself

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Her own 12 digits. The whole application is built on this number, so check it twice.

demoFields.label: Applicant's Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Copy it letter for letter from the Aadhaar card. If the bank passbook has a different spelling, get one of them corrected before applying.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth
demoFields.hint: As on Aadhaar. You must be 21 or above and not over 60 on the date fixed for that year's round.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number linked to Aadhaar
demoFields.hint: The e-KYC OTP comes here. If nothing is linked to your Aadhaar, go to a Mo Seva Kendra and do face e-KYC instead.

demoFields.label: Ration Card Type and Number
demoFields.hint: NFSA or SFSS, with the number from the front of the card. If the family has no card, attach the income certificate instead.

demoFields.label: District / Block or ULB / Gram Panchayat / Village
demoFields.hint: Pick from the drop-downs, for the place where you live now.

demoFields.label: Bank Account Number and IFSC (account in her own name)
demoFields.hint: Copy both from your passbook. A joint account or your husband's account will not be paid - the money only goes to an account in your own name.

demoFields.label: Annual Family Income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: The family's income for one year. It must be Rs 2,50,000 or less if you are applying without a ration card.

demoFields.label: e-KYC
demoFields.value: Completed by OTP on the Aadhaar-linked mobile
demoFields.hint: The application is not counted until e-KYC is done. Face e-KYC at a Mo Seva Kendra is the way round a missing mobile link.

demoFields.label: Declaration
demoFields.value: I am not an income-tax payer, not a government employee, and I do not receive Rs 1,500 a month or more from another scheme
demoFields.hint: Tick it only if it is true. A false declaration means the money is recovered later.

demoSteps: Open the Subhadra portal and press Apply Now, or take your Aadhaar and ration card to a Mo Seva Kendra, Anganwadi centre or CSC. They file it free - do not pay anyone for it.
Enter your Aadhaar and finish e-KYC with the OTP on the Aadhaar-linked mobile. If no mobile is linked, do face e-KYC at a Mo Seva Kendra.
Fill the form, give a bank account in your own name, submit, and note the application number on the acknowledgement.
Ask your bank branch to make the account DBT-enabled, not merely Aadhaar-linked. This one step is behind most of the payments that fail.
Check your name on the beneficiary list on the portal. If you are on the rejected list, the reason is shown next to your name and you can file a grievance on the same site.
Rs 5,000 reaches the account at each instalment, near Rakhi Purnima and near 8 March. Check your passbook or the bank's own message, not a forwarded one.
Ring 14678 between 6 AM and 10 PM for any problem with the application or a missing payment.

schemes.title: Puducherry Old Age Pension
schemes.department: Department of Social Welfare, Government of Puducherry
schemes.brief: Puducherry pays a monthly pension to old people, widows, deserted wives, unmarried women above a certain age and people with disability. The application is made on paper at the Social Welfare office of your region and the money is credited to the pensioner's own bank account.
schemes.benefit: Monthly pension credited to the pensioner's own bank account
eligibility: Resident of Puducherry, Karaikal, Mahe or Yanam for the qualifying period
Age 60 or above for the old-age pension; no age bar for the widow or disability pension
Family income within the limit the department sets, proved by an income certificate
Not drawing a government service pension or another social security pension
Disability of 40 per cent or more, certified by a government medical board, for the disability pension
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant
Ration card of the family
Age proof — birth certificate, school record or voter card
Income certificate from e-District
Nativity or residence certificate of Puducherry
Death certificate of the husband, for a widow pension
Disability certificate showing 40 per cent or more, for a disability pension
Bank passbook in the applicant's own name and two photographs
schemes.submitAt: Department of Social Welfare office of your region — Puducherry, Karaikal, Mahe or Yanam; the Commune Panchayat or Municipality office also forwards the application

demoFields.label: Type of pension applied for
demoFields.hint: Old age, widow, deserted wife, unmarried woman above the prescribed age, or disability. Each has its own condition and certificate.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: As on Aadhaar. A spelling that differs from the bank record is why a sanctioned pension never arrives.

demoFields.label: Husband's / Father's Name
demoFields.hint: Write 'Late' before the name where he has died; for a widow pension it must match the death certificate.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth / Age
demoFields.hint: You must be 60 or above for the old-age pension on the date of application. Write the date as on the age proof you attach.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. Payment and the yearly life certificate both run on this.

demoFields.label: Ration Card Number
demoFields.hint: The household's card. Eligibility is judged against it.

demoFields.label: Region / Taluk / Commune or Municipality
demoFields.hint: Where you live. The Social Welfare office of this region processes the application.

demoFields.label: Annual Family Income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: From the income certificate you attach. It must be within the department's limit.

demoFields.label: Bank Account Number and IFSC
demoFields.hint: In the applicant's own name, not a son's or daughter's, and Aadhaar-seeded.

demoFields.label: Signature / Thumb Impression with date
demoFields.value: Left thumb impression of Lakshmi Ammal, 22-09-2026
demoFields.hint: A thumb impression is fully valid. The office staff attest it beside your mark.

demoSteps: Collect the income certificate and the nativity certificate from e-District first, and the death or disability certificate if the pension needs one.
Get the pension application form free at the Social Welfare office of your region, or at your Commune Panchayat or Municipality office.
Fill it and attach Aadhaar, the ration card, the age proof, the certificates, the passbook copy and two photographs.
Hand it in and ask for a dated acknowledgement with its number. Without it you cannot follow the case.
The department verifies the applicant and the household's income, and may call you in or visit.
Once sanctioned, the pension is credited to the account each month. Check the first credit and tell the office at once if it does not arrive.
Give the life certificate each year when the department asks, or the payment stops.
schemes.helpline: Department of Social Welfare, Government of Puducherry

schemes.title: Puducherry e-District — Certificates and Services
schemes.department: Government of Puducherry
schemes.brief: Puducherry's e-District portal covers the certificates and services of the union territory's four regions — Puducherry, Karaikal, Mahe and Yanam. Income, community, nativity and residence certificates are applied for and downloaded here.
schemes.benefit: Income, community, nativity and residence certificates applied for online
eligibility: Resident of Puducherry, Karaikal, Mahe or Yanam
A nativity certificate needs proof the family has lived in the territory for the qualifying period
A community certificate needs the community to be on the Puducherry SC, ST, BC or MBC list
An income certificate is valid for one year

Ration card of the family
Electricity bill or house tax receipt for the address
Father's community certificate, for a community certificate
School transfer certificate for date of birth and nativity
Income proof — salary certificate or an affidavit
Passport-size photograph

demoFields.label: Certificate applied for
demoFields.hint: Income, community, nativity, residence, birth or death. Each has its own form and proof.

demoFields.label: Region
demoFields.hint: Puducherry, Karaikal, Mahe or Yanam. The taluk office of that region handles the file.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Letter for letter as on Aadhaar. The certificate prints from this entry.

demoFields.label: Father's / Husband's Name
demoFields.hint: For a community certificate this decides the case — community is traced through the father's family record.

demoFields.label: Community claimed

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number

demoSteps: Register on edistrict.py.gov.in with your mobile and confirm the OTP, or use a Common Service Centre in your region.
Choose the certificate, pick your region, and fill the form from your Aadhaar and ration card.
Upload the documents. For a community certificate, the father's certificate is the paper that matters most.
Submit, pay the fee, and note the application number.
The Village Administrative Officer verifies the family, then the Tahsildar signs the certificate.
Download it from the same login and check the community name and your father's name at once.
schemes.helpline: Your taluk Tahsildar's office, or the Collectorate of your region

schemes.title: Jamabandi Punjab — Land Records, Fard and Mutation
schemes.department: Punjab Land Records Society, Department of Revenue, Rehabilitation and Disaster Management, Government of Punjab
schemes.brief: Punjab's land records portal. Looking up the jamabandi by owner name, khewat, khatauni or khasra number is free and needs no account, and you can also see mutations, the roznamcha and registered deeds. A digital fard can be bought and delivered on WhatsApp. Requests for virasat (inheritance) mutation, mutation on a registered deed (vasika), fard badar correction, rapat entry and oral or family partition under the Chief Minister's 30-day taksim scheme are filed on the same site with a mobile OTP, and tracked on the application number.
schemes.benefit: Free jamabandi viewing, digital fard on WhatsApp, and mutation requests filed online
eligibility: The land must lie in Punjab and be entered in the jamabandi of that village
Viewing the jamabandi, mutations, roznamcha and registered deeds is free and open to anyone, with no login
For a virasat mutation you must be a legal heir of the owner recorded in the jamabandi
For a mutation on a deed, the vasika must already be registered at the sub-registrar's office before you file here
For the Chief Minister's 30-day partition scheme, every co-sharer of the khewat has to agree to the partition
You need a mobile number that can take the OTP; there is no standing citizen account, so the application number is your only handle on the file
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant
Copy of the current jamabandi (fard) showing the khewat, khatauni and khasra numbers
Death certificate of the recorded owner, for a virasat mutation
Family tree (kursinama) of the heirs, attested by the sarpanch or the patwari
Registered deed (vasika) with its registration number and date, for a deed mutation
Written consent of all co-sharers, for a family partition
Court order or decree, where the land is under one
Mobile number for the OTP, and for WhatsApp delivery of a digital fard

demoFields.label: Request type
demoFields.hint: Virasat mutation, mutation on a registered vasika, fard badar, rapat, or partition. Each has its own page on the site.

demoFields.label: District
demoFields.hint: The district where the land is, which is not always the district you live in.

demoFields.label: Tehsil
demoFields.hint: The revenue tehsil of the land. The Revenue Officer of this tehsil sanctions the mutation.

demoFields.label: Village / Hadbast
demoFields.hint: Pick the village from the dropdown. The dropdown takes a moment to load, so wait for the list.

demoFields.label: Jamabandi Year
demoFields.hint: Jamabandi is rewritten every five years. Choose the latest year shown for your village.

demoFields.label: Khewat / Khatauni Number
demoFields.hint: Copy both from the fard exactly. The whole request is filed against these numbers.

demoFields.label: Khasra (Killa) Numbers
demoFields.hint: Every khasra of the holding being mutated, with the slashes as printed in the record.

demoFields.label: Name of the recorded owner
demoFields.value: Bachan Singh son of Inder Singh
demoFields.hint: The name as it stands in the jamabandi, not as spoken. For a virasat mutation this is the deceased owner.

demoFields.label: Applicant's name and relation
demoFields.value: Manjit Singh — son of the deceased
demoFields.hint: Your name as on Aadhaar and how you are related to the recorded owner. List every heir; leaving one out means the mutation has to be redone.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number for OTP
demoFields.hint: The OTP, the application number and the hearing date come here. A digital fard is delivered to this number on WhatsApp.

demoSteps: Open jamabandi.punjab.gov.in and view the jamabandi free first — search by owner name, khewat, khatauni or khasra. Write down the spelling and the numbers exactly as the record shows them.
If you only need a copy, use the digital fard service; it can be sent to your mobile on WhatsApp for the notified fee. A paid subscription is offered for people who need fards often.
For inheritance, open the Virasat mutation request, fill the district, tehsil, village, jamabandi year and khewat, add every legal heir, and verify your mobile number by OTP. No account is needed.
Note the application number the site gives you and follow it on the online request status page.
The patwari enters the rapat in the roznamcha and the Revenue Officer — Naib Tehsildar or Tehsildar — sanctions the mutation after hearing the co-sharers. Attend the hearing when you are called.
Once it is sanctioned, look up the jamabandi again and check the new names, the shares and the khasra numbers. If anything is wrong, file a Fard Badar correction request on the same site.
There is a grievance form on the portal with its own tracking number. Use it if the request sits without movement, and keep the application number with you.
schemes.helpline: No helpline number is published on the portal. Contact the Fard Kendra or the Tehsildar's office of the tehsil where the land lies, and the Punjab Land Records Society through the Deputy Commissioner's office if it is not resolved there.

schemes.title: e-Sewa Punjab — Sewa Kendra Certificates and Services
schemes.department: Department of Governance Reforms and Public Grievances, Government of Punjab
schemes.brief: e-Sewa Punjab is the Sewa Kendra counter put online. More than 400 services of over 30 departments run through it — birth, death and marriage certificates, caste, residence and income certificates, fard (a copy of the land record), arms licence, vehicle and driving licence services, labour registration and social security pensions. You can file it yourself with a mobile OTP, or hand the papers in at any Sewa Kendra and let the counter do it.
schemes.benefit: Over 400 services of more than 30 departments, filed online or at a Sewa Kendra
eligibility: Resident of Punjab, applying in the tehsil where the family actually lives
A residence certificate needs proof that the family has been living in Punjab — the ration card, an old electricity bill or a school record for the address
A caste certificate is issued only for a caste on Punjab's notified list and is checked against the father's certificate
An income certificate covers one financial year, and departments normally want a recently issued one
You need a mobile number that can take the OTP, and it should be the one linked to your Aadhaar
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant
Ration card or blue card of the family
Address proof — electricity bill, water bill or house tax receipt
Father's caste certificate, for a caste certificate
Income proof — salary slip, or a self-declaration and affidavit where there is no salary
Matriculation certificate or birth certificate for date of birth
Copy of the jamabandi or rent agreement, where the address rests on land or a tenancy
Passport-size photograph

demoFields.label: Department and Service
demoFields.hint: Pick the department first, then the service. Each one has its own form, its own fee and its own delivery time.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Letter for letter as on Aadhaar. The certificate prints from this box in Punjabi and English.

demoFields.label: Father's / Husband's Name
demoFields.hint: As on his own Aadhaar or the family's ration card, since the family is traced through it.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth
demoFields.hint: As on the matriculation certificate or the birth certificate.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. Identity is confirmed on this and the OTP goes to the linked mobile.

demoFields.label: District / Tehsil / Village or Ward
demoFields.hint: Where the family lives. The tehsil office named here processes and signs the certificate.

demoFields.label: Caste and Category
demoFields.hint: Exactly as on your father's caste certificate. Leave it blank if the service does not need it.

demoFields.label: Annual Family Income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: The household's total for the year — wages, farming, shop and rent together, not just the applicant's earnings.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The application number, the OTP and the 'ready for collection' message all come here.

demoSteps: Register on esewa.punjab.gov.in with your mobile number and the OTP — or take the papers to any Sewa Kendra and let the counter file it for you.
Choose the department and the service, then fill the form. The name must match the Aadhaar letter for letter, or the file comes back for correction.
Upload the scans, pay the fee, and keep the receipt. It carries the application number and the date the service is promised by.
The patwari or the tehsil clerk verifies the address, the income or the caste claim. Stay reachable on the mobile you gave.

Track the application number on the portal. When it is approved, download the digitally signed certificate from the same login or collect it at the Sewa Kendra — a digitally signed copy needs no attestation.
If the promised date passes, Punjab's service delivery law gives you an appeal to the department's designated appellate officer. Quote the application number when you file it.
schemes.helpline: No helpline number is published for e-Sewa. Ask at the Sewa Kendra counter in your tehsil, or at the District Governance Reforms office in the Deputy Commissioner's complex.

Age as the notification states, usually 18 to 40, with relaxation for Rajasthan SC, ST, OBC, women and disability
The qualification the post requires, complete on the notification's closing date

Class 10 certificate for date of birth
Higher qualification certificates and marksheets
Rajasthan caste certificate, for a reserved category

Recent passport photograph and a scanned signature

demoSteps: Create an SSO ID at sso.rajasthan.gov.in if you do not have one. No Rajasthan recruitment can be applied to without it.
Watch rsmssb.rajasthan.gov.in for the notification, and check whether the post needs a valid CET score before anything else.
Log in through SSO, open the recruitment portal and fill the application with your name and date of birth exactly as on the Class 10 certificate.
Upload the photograph and signature in the sizes stated, and pay the fee online. Rajasthan candidates in the reserved categories pay less.
Use the correction window if the Board opens one — it is the only chance to fix a wrong entry.
Download the admit card about a week before the exam and take it with a photo ID and the printed application.

Results and the answer key appear on the same site. Document verification comes last, where the originals of everything claimed — including the Mool Niwas and caste certificate on the Rajasthan format — must be produced.

schemes.title: Jan Aadhaar card enrolment
schemes.department: Jan Aadhaar Yojana Directorate, Planning Department, Government of Rajasthan
schemes.brief: Rajasthan's family identity card, which replaced Bhamashah. It gives the family a ten-digit number and every member an eleven-digit number, and almost every state benefit is now released against it: free ration, old age and widow pensions, scholarships, Chiranjeevi health cover and e-Mitra services. The woman of the house aged 18 or above is registered as the head of the family. Hindi and English. Enrolment is free and can be done on the portal with an SSO ID, or at any e-Mitra kiosk or the gram panchayat, which is how most families do it.
schemes.benefit: One family number that unlocks state pensions, ration and health cover
eligibility: The family lives permanently in Rajasthan
The head of the family is a woman aged 18 or above; where there is no adult woman, the eldest adult male is registered instead
Every member being added has an Aadhaar number
One enrolment per family; members are added to it later rather than making a second card
documents: Aadhaar card of every family member being added
Bank passbook of the head of the family, in her own name
Proof of residence: ration card, electricity bill or voter ID
Date of birth proof for each member: school certificate or birth certificate
Caste certificate, if you want the category recorded
Mobile number of the head of the family, for the OTP

demoFields.label: Head of the family
demoFields.hint: This must be a woman of the household aged 18 or above. The card and most benefits are issued in her name; this is the rule, not a preference.

demoFields.label: Her Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits from her Aadhaar card. Her mobile must be linked to this Aadhaar for the e-KYC to go through.

demoFields.label: Her bank account and IFSC
demoFields.hint: Benefits are paid into this account, so it must be in her own name and Aadhaar-seeded.

demoFields.label: Family members and relation
demoFields.value: Ramniwas Jat (husband), Suman Jat (daughter), Vikram Jat (son)
demoFields.hint: Add everyone who actually lives in the household, with each one's Aadhaar. A child left out now cannot claim a scholarship later.

demoFields.label: District / Tehsil / Gram Panchayat / Village
demoFields.hint: Fill the full chain. The panchayat decides which officer verifies your enrolment.

demoFields.label: Ration card number
demoFields.hint: If the family has one. Linking it here is what keeps the free ration entitlement running against the Jan Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Caste category
demoFields.hint: General, OBC, SC, ST or MBC. Keep the caste certificate ready; the category recorded here is used by scholarship and pension schemes.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: Use the head of the family's own number. The Jan Aadhaar number, and every payment message afterwards, comes to it.

demoSteps: Collect the Aadhaar cards of everyone in the household and the passbook of the woman who will be the head of the family.
Decide who the head of the family will be: it must be a woman of 18 or above if there is one in the house.
Either log in on the Jan Aadhaar portal with your SSO ID and choose enrolment, or take the papers to an e-Mitra kiosk or the gram panchayat, where the operator does it free of charge.
Fill the family details as this sample shows, adding every member with their Aadhaar and relation.
Complete the e-KYC with the OTP that comes to the Aadhaar-linked mobile of the head of the family.
Submit and keep the enrolment receipt. A temporary registration number is given at once.
After the panchayat or municipal officer verifies it, the ten-digit Jan Aadhaar number is issued and comes by SMS. Download the e-card from the portal or collect the card from the e-Mitra kiosk.
Whenever the family changes, a birth, a marriage, a death or a new bank account, go back and update it. Schemes read this record, so an old record quietly stops payments.
schemes.helpline: 1800-180-6127 (Jan Aadhaar helpline)

schemes.title: e-Mitra Rajasthan — Certificates, Bills and Applications
schemes.department: Department of Information Technology and Communication, Rajasthan
schemes.brief: e-Mitra is the counter through which most Rajasthan government services are actually delivered — income, caste, domicile and birth certificates, scheme applications, bill payments and land records. There are kiosks in every panchayat and ward, and the same services can be used from home with an SSO login.
schemes.benefit: Certificates, scheme applications and bill payments at a kiosk near home or online
eligibility: Resident of Rajasthan; some services need the family's Jan Aadhaar
An SSO ID to use the services from home; a kiosk needs no login of your own
For a caste certificate, the caste must be on the Rajasthan SC, ST or OBC list
Each service charges a fixed notified fee, which is printed on the receipt
documents: Jan Aadhaar card of the family
Aadhaar card of the applicant
Ration card or voter card as residence proof
Father's caste certificate or a school record, for a caste certificate
Income proof — salary certificate, or a land record for a farming family
Passport-size photograph

demoFields.label: Service wanted
demoFields.hint: Income, caste, domicile (Mool Niwas), birth or death certificate, scheme application, or a bill payment. Each has its own fixed fee.

demoFields.label: Jan Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: The family's number. Most services pull your name, family and address from it, so keep it with you.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Letter for letter as on Aadhaar. The certificate prints from this entry.

demoFields.label: Father's Name
demoFields.hint: For a caste certificate this decides the case — caste is traced through the father's family record.

demoFields.label: District / Tehsil / Village or Ward
demoFields.hint: Where the family lives. The Tehsildar of this tehsil signs the certificate.

demoFields.label: Annual Family Income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: For an income certificate, the household's total for the year from every source.

demoFields.label: Caste and category
demoFields.hint: Pick from the Rajasthan list rather than typing it. A spelling not on the list is not accepted.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The token number and the ready message come here by SMS.

demoFields.label: e-Mitra receipt / token number
demoFields.hint: Printed on the kiosk receipt. Every follow-up runs on it, so keep the slip.

demoSteps: Take the papers to any e-Mitra kiosk — there is one in most panchayats and wards — or log in yourself at emitra.rajasthan.gov.in with an SSO ID.
Give the Jan Aadhaar number and choose the service. The operator's screen fills your family details from it.
Hand over or upload Aadhaar, the residence proof, and the caste or income proof. For a caste certificate the father's certificate is the paper that matters most.
Pay only the fee printed on the receipt, and check that the receipt carries a token number. A kiosk asking for more than the notified fee can be reported on the helpline.
The Tehsildar's office verifies and signs. Most certificates come within 7 to 21 days depending on the service.
Collect the certificate at the kiosk or download it with the token number. A digitally signed copy needs no further attestation.
The status of any e-Mitra application, and most Rajasthan scheme records, can also be looked up free on the Jan Soochna portal without logging in.
schemes.helpline: 1800 180 6127 — Rajasthan e-Mitra helpline

schemes.title: Jan Soochna — Rajasthan Public Information Portal
schemes.department: Department of Information Technology and Communication, Rajasthan
schemes.brief: Jan Soochna puts the government's own records in the open. Without any login you can see whether your pension was paid, whether your ration was issued, who the beneficiaries in your village are, the status of a scheme application, and a great deal more. It is the fastest way to find out what has actually happened to your case.
schemes.benefit: Free look-up of your own pension, ration, scheme and land records with no login
eligibility: Anyone may use it — there is no login, no registration and no fee
Your own records are found by Jan Aadhaar number, Aadhaar number, or scheme application number
Village and ward level lists are open to everybody
Covers only Rajasthan state departments and schemes
documents: Jan Aadhaar number of the family, for most personal look-ups
Aadhaar number, where a scheme is searched that way
The scheme application or PPO number, where you have one
Ration card number, for the food department records

demoFields.label: What you want to check
demoFields.hint: Pension payments, ration issued, scheme beneficiary lists, land records, electricity and water connections, e-Mitra application status and more.

demoFields.label: Department or scheme
demoFields.hint: The portal is arranged department by department. Pick the one that runs your scheme.

demoFields.label: Jan Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: The family's number. Most personal look-ups work from it alone.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: An alternative where the scheme is searched by Aadhaar rather than Jan Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: PPO / Application Number
demoFields.hint: If you have the pension PPO number or an application number, it gives the most exact answer.

demoFields.label: District / Block / Gram Panchayat
demoFields.hint: For a village or ward level list — who in your panchayat draws a pension, holds a ration card, or has been sanctioned a scheme.

demoFields.label: Ration Card Number
demoFields.hint: For the food department records — how much grain was issued in your name and in which month.

demoSteps: Open jansoochna.rajasthan.gov.in. There is nothing to register and nothing to pay.
Pick the department or scheme you are asking about, then the particular information — payment status, beneficiary list, application status.
Enter your Jan Aadhaar number, Aadhaar number or application number as the screen asks.
Read the result carefully. For a pension it shows the sanction, the PPO number and every month's payment, which tells you at once whether the money was sent or is stuck.
Use the village and ward lists to check whether a name has been left off, or whether someone is drawing a benefit they should not.
If the record shows a payment you never received, that printout is the evidence. Take it with the PPO number to the block office or the e-Mitra kiosk, and complain on the Rajasthan Sampark helpline.
schemes.helpline: 181 — Rajasthan Sampark

schemes.title: SSO Rajasthan single sign-on
schemes.department: Department of Information Technology and Communication, Government of Rajasthan
schemes.brief: One free SSO ID that opens well over a hundred Rajasthan services with a single password: Jan Aadhaar, e-Mitra, scholarships, pensions, electricity and water bills, Rajasthan Sampark complaints and most recruitment forms. Hindi and English. Registering takes a few minutes on a phone, and any e-Mitra kiosk will create it for you if you would rather not do it yourself. Make the ID once and keep it; creating a second one for the same person causes trouble later when a scheme is tied to the first.
schemes.benefit: One login for over a hundred state services
eligibility: Any resident of Rajasthan, registering as a citizen
One of these to register with: a Jan Aadhaar number, an Aadhaar number, or a Google account
Government employees register with their SIPF number and businesses with their business registration number instead
documents: Jan Aadhaar number, or Aadhaar number, of the person registering
Mobile number that can receive an OTP
An email address, useful for password recovery
For a government employee: the SIPF (State Insurance and Provident Fund) number

demoFields.label: Register as
demoFields.hint: Citizen for ordinary people, Udyog for a business, Government Employee for state staff. Almost everyone needs Citizen.

demoFields.label: Register using
demoFields.hint: Registering with Jan Aadhaar is best, because your family details then flow automatically into pension, scholarship and ration services.

demoFields.label: Jan Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: The ten-digit family number printed on the Jan Aadhaar card. If your family has no Jan Aadhaar yet, get that first.

demoFields.label: Family member to register
demoFields.hint: The portal lists everyone in the Jan Aadhaar family. Pick your own name from the list; each adult can have their own SSO ID.

demoFields.label: SSO ID you want
demoFields.hint: This becomes your permanent username for every state service. Choose something plain that you can tell a kiosk operator over the counter.

demoFields.label: Password
demoFields.value: Set your own, at least 8 characters with a capital, a number and a symbol
demoFields.hint: Never share it, and never let anyone else keep it for you. A government office will never ask you for this password.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: Every OTP comes here. Use your own number, not a shopkeeper's or an operator's, otherwise you cannot log in without them.

demoFields.label: Email address
demoFields.hint: Optional but worth filling. It is the easiest way to reset a forgotten password.

demoSteps: Keep your Jan Aadhaar card, or Aadhaar card, and your own mobile phone with you.
Open the SSO Rajasthan site and choose 'Registration', then 'Citizen'.
Choose to register through Jan Aadhaar, type the ten-digit family number, and press the button to fetch your family.
Pick your own name from the family list and get the OTP on the registered mobile number.
Choose your SSO ID and set a password. Write the SSO ID on the back of your Jan Aadhaar card so you never lose it, but do not write the password there.
Log in once straight away to confirm it works, and look at the tile list: e-Mitra, Jan Aadhaar, scholarship, pension and the rest are all inside this one login.

If you find the registration difficult, walk into any e-Mitra kiosk with your Jan Aadhaar and mobile phone; the operator creates it in a few minutes. Make sure the mobile number registered is yours and that you, not the operator, set the password.
schemes.helpline: 0141-5123717 (SSO and e-Mitra helpdesk)

schemes.title: RajSSP — Rajasthan Social Security Pension
schemes.department: Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Rajasthan
schemes.brief: Rajasthan pays a monthly pension to old people, widows, single women, people with disability and destitute families through RajSSP. The application starts from the Jan Aadhaar of the family, is filed at an e-Mitra kiosk or online, and the money reaches the pensioner's own bank account.
schemes.benefit: Monthly pension, the amount rising with the pensioner's age
eligibility: Resident of Rajasthan with a Jan Aadhaar card for the family
Age 55 for a woman and 58 for a man, for the old-age pension
Widow, divorced, abandoned or never-married woman of 18 or above, for the single woman pension
Disability of 40 per cent or more, certified by the medical board, for the disability pension
Family income within the state's limit and not drawing another government pension
documents: Jan Aadhaar card of the family
Aadhaar card of the applicant
Age proof — Aadhaar, birth certificate or voter card
Death certificate of the husband, for a widow pension
Disability certificate showing 40 per cent or more, for a disability pension
Bank passbook in the applicant's own name, Aadhaar-seeded
Income certificate
Recent passport photograph

demoFields.label: Jan Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: The family's Jan Aadhaar. The whole application is built from it, so get the Jan Aadhaar made first if the family has none.

demoFields.label: Type of pension applied for
demoFields.hint: Old age, single woman, disability, or destitute. Each has its own age condition and supporting certificate.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name (as on Jan Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: As on Jan Aadhaar and Aadhaar. A spelling that differs from the bank record is why a sanctioned pension never arrives.

demoFields.label: Husband's / Father's Name
demoFields.hint: Write 'Late' before the name where he has died; for a widow pension it must match the death certificate.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth / Age
demoFields.hint: Old age pension starts at 55 for a woman and 58 for a man. There is no lower age bar for the single woman pension above 18.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. Payment and the yearly physical verification both run on this.

demoFields.label: District / Tehsil / Village or Ward
demoFields.hint: Where you live. The Sub-Divisional Officer of this area sanctions the pension.

demoFields.label: Supporting certificate number
demoFields.hint: The death certificate for a widow, or the disability certificate number and percentage for a disability pension.

demoFields.label: Bank Account Number and IFSC
demoFields.hint: In the applicant's own name, not a son's or daughter's, and Aadhaar-seeded.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The PPO number and every credit are announced here by SMS.

demoSteps: Get the family's Jan Aadhaar made first if it does not exist. RajSSP is built on it and no pension application can be filed without one.
Go to an e-Mitra kiosk with the papers, or apply yourself through the SSO login, and choose the pension type.
Fill in the details from Jan Aadhaar and Aadhaar, attach the age, death or disability proof and the passbook, and give an account in your own name.
Keep the application number. Once it is sanctioned you are given a PPO number, which is what you quote afterwards.
The Sub-Divisional Officer verifies and sanctions, usually within 30 to 60 days, and the pension is credited to the account each month.
Do the yearly physical verification at an e-Mitra kiosk or through the Rajasthan Sampark app, or the pension stops. Anyone over 80 can have it done at home on request.
Status, the PPO number and every payment can be checked on the RajSSP portal and on the Jan Soochna portal without logging in.
schemes.helpline: 1800 180 6127 — Rajasthan Social Justice department

schemes.title: Sikkim Public Service Commission Recruitment
schemes.department: Sikkim Public Service Commission
schemes.brief: The Sikkim Public Service Commission recruits for the state civil service and for the gazetted and non-gazetted posts of the state departments. Applications are filed on its own online recruitment system.
schemes.benefit: One online profile for every Sikkim PSC recruitment
eligibility: Holder of a Sikkim Subject Certificate or Certificate of Identification, for most state posts
Age as the advertisement states, usually 21 to 30 for the civil service, with relaxation for reserved categories
The qualification the advertisement requires, complete on its closing date
Knowledge of a Sikkimese language as the advertisement specifies for some posts
documents: Certificate of Identification or Sikkim Subject Certificate
Aadhaar card
Class 10 certificate for date of birth
Degree certificate and marksheets
Category certificate, where claiming a reservation
Employment exchange registration, where the advertisement asks for it
Recent passport photograph and a scanned signature

demoFields.label: Post applied for
demoFields.hint: One application per advertisement. Read the qualification and age limit in that advertisement before paying.

demoFields.label: Candidate Name (as on Class 10 certificate)
demoFields.hint: The Class 10 certificate governs, not Aadhaar, where the two differ.

demoFields.label: Father's Name
demoFields.hint: As on the Class 10 certificate.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth
demoFields.hint: As on the Class 10 certificate. Age limits count from this date.

demoFields.label: Certificate of Identification number
demoFields.hint: Most Sikkim state posts require it. Get it from Sikkim GO before the closing date.

demoFields.label: Category claimed
demoFields.hint: Claim only what you hold a Sikkim certificate for. The state's reservation categories differ from those elsewhere.

demoFields.label: Educational Qualification
demoFields.hint: It must be complete on the advertisement's closing date.

demoFields.label: Employment exchange registration number
demoFields.hint: Some advertisements require a live registration. Renew it if it has lapsed.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number and Email
demoFields.hint: The application number, admit card and every notice come here.

demoSteps: Get the Certificate of Identification in hand before anything else. Most Sikkim state posts cannot be applied for without it.
Register on the SPSC recruitment portal with your name and date of birth exactly as on the Class 10 certificate.
Open the advertisement, apply through the same login, upload the photograph and signature in the sizes stated, and pay the fee.
Print the filled application and keep it with the payment receipt until the recruitment ends.
Download the admit card from the same login and take it with a photo ID.
Results are published on the Commission's site. Document verification is last, where the originals of the COI and category certificate must be produced.
schemes.helpline: Sikkim Public Service Commission, Old Tourism Complex, Gangtok

schemes.title: Sikkim GO — State e-Services Single Sign-On
schemes.department: Department of Information Technology, Government of Sikkim
schemes.brief: Sikkim GO is one login for the state's online services — certificates of identification, income, and other departmental applications. You register once and use the same account for whatever department you need afterwards.
schemes.benefit: One login for Sikkim's certificates and departmental services
eligibility: Resident of Sikkim, applying in the district where the family lives
A Certificate of Identification is issued to those whose families are recorded in the Sikkim Subject Register or its successor records
An income certificate is valid for one year
A mobile number linked to Aadhaar, since the account is confirmed by OTP
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant
Certificate of Identification of a parent, where claiming one
Ration card of the family
School certificate or birth certificate for date of birth
Electricity bill or rent agreement for the address
Income proof — salary certificate or an affidavit
Passport-size photograph

demoFields.label: Service wanted
demoFields.hint: Certificate of Identification, income, residence or a departmental service. Each opens its own form once you are logged in.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Letter for letter as on Aadhaar. The certificate prints from this entry.

demoFields.label: Father's / Husband's Name
demoFields.hint: Used to identify the family; essential for a Certificate of Identification, which runs through the father's record.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. Identity is confirmed on this and the OTP goes to the linked mobile.

demoFields.label: District / Sub-division / Village or Ward
demoFields.hint: Where the family lives. The Sub-Divisional Magistrate of this sub-division signs the certificate.

demoFields.label: Parent's Certificate of Identification number
demoFields.hint: Where you are claiming a Certificate of Identification, the parent's number is the paper that decides the case.

demoFields.label: Annual Family Income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: For an income certificate, the household's total for the year from every source.

demoFields.label: Purpose
demoFields.hint: Recorded for the file. It does not restrict where the certificate is used.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The application number and the ready message come here by SMS.

demoSteps: Register once on sso.sikkim.gov.in with your Aadhaar and mobile, and confirm the OTP. The same account then works for every department.
Choose the service and fill the form from your Aadhaar and ration card.
Upload the documents. For a Certificate of Identification, the parent's certificate is the one that matters most.
Submit, pay any fee, and note the application number.
The block or sub-division staff verify the family, then the Sub-Divisional Magistrate signs.
Download the signed certificate from the same login, and check the spelling of names before relying on it.
schemes.helpline: Your Sub-Divisional Magistrate's office, or the district administrative centre

schemes.title: Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thogai — Rs 1,000 a Month for Women Heads of Family
schemes.department: Department of Cooperation, Food and Consumer Protection, Government of Tamil Nadu
schemes.brief: Tamil Nadu pays Rs 1,000 every month to one eligible woman head of family, sent straight to her own bank account. The whole scheme runs off the family card, so the woman's name must already be entered as head of the family on the smart ration card. Applications are taken at e-Sevai centres and ration shops, and the kmut.tn.gov.in portal is where you check status, log in as a beneficiary and file a complaint.
schemes.benefit: Rs 1,000 a month, paid by DBT into the woman's own account
eligibility: Woman whose name stands as head of the family on the Tamil Nadu smart family card
Only one woman per family card is paid, and she must be 21 or older
The family must not include an income-tax payer or a government employee or pensioner
Families holding more than 3.53 acres of wet land or 5 acres of dry land are left out
Families owning a four-wheeler, other than a taxi, an auto or a tractor, are left out
The bank account must be in the woman's own name and Aadhaar-seeded, since payment is by DBT
documents: Smart family card, with the applicant's name as head of the family
Aadhaar card of the applicant
Mobile number linked to that Aadhaar, for the OTP
Bank passbook in the applicant's own name, showing account number and IFSC
Passport-size photograph
Widow, deserted-wife or similar proof, only if the family card was changed on that ground
schemes.submitAt: At an e-Sevai centre or at your fair price (ration) shop. Take the smart family card, Aadhaar and bank passbook. The list of e-Sevai centres is on kmut.tn.gov.in.

demoFields.label: Family Card Number
demoFields.hint: The number printed on the smart family card. Everything in this scheme is matched against it.

demoFields.label: Name of the Applicant
demoFields.hint: Exactly as it stands on the family card. If the card and the Aadhaar differ, get the card corrected first.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits, the applicant's own. The OTP goes to the mobile linked to it.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth / Age
demoFields.hint: As on Aadhaar. She must be at least 21 on the date of the application.

demoFields.label: District / Taluk / Village or Ward
demoFields.hint: Where the family actually lives. The Village Administrative Officer of this area verifies the claim.

demoFields.label: Bank Account Number
demoFields.hint: In the applicant's own name. A joint account in the husband's name first will not receive the money.

demoFields.label: IFSC Code
demoFields.hint: Eleven characters, printed on the first page of the passbook.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The application number, the approval message and each month's credit message come here.

demoFields.label: Declaration — income tax, government service, land, car
demoFields.value: No income-tax payer, no government servant or pensioner, 1.2 acres of dry land, no four-wheeler
demoFields.hint: Answer truthfully. These four answers are checked against records, and a false claim means recovery of the money paid.

demoSteps: Check the smart family card first. If the woman's name is not entered as head of the family, get that changed on the TNPDS portal before anything else.
Apply at an e-Sevai centre or the fair price shop with the family card, Aadhaar and bank passbook. The list of centres is on the scheme portal at kmut.tn.gov.in/esevai-centers.html.
Collect the acknowledgement with the application number. Nothing can be traced without it.
The Village Administrative Officer or the ward officer verifies the family — land, vehicle, income tax and government service.
Track the application number under beneficiary login on kmut.tn.gov.in. It shows approved, rejected or under verification.
Once approved, Rs 1,000 is credited to the woman's account every month. Check the bank passbook, not the portal, to confirm the money arrived.
If the application is rejected or a month's payment does not come, file the grievance on the same portal or call 044-25619208.
schemes.helpline: 044-25619208 — Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thogai helpline

schemes.title: Patta Chitta — Tamil Nadu Land Record Extract
schemes.department: Commissionerate of Land Administration, Revenue and Disaster Management Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
schemes.brief: The patta names the holder of a piece of land and the chitta says what kind of land it is. Tamil Nadu puts both online on the Revenue Department's e-Services site, along with the A-Register extract, the FMB field sketch and the TSLR extract. Viewing your own record costs nothing and needs no login; the same site is where you apply for a transfer of registry after a sale or a death, and where you verify that a patta someone shows you is genuine.
schemes.benefit: Free online patta, chitta, A-Register and FMB sketch, and online transfer of registry
eligibility: Land situated in Tamil Nadu and entered in the revenue record
Anyone may view a patta or chitta free; no login is needed to look
Only the recorded holder or a legal heir can apply for a transfer of registry or a sub-division
A transactional request needs a mobile OTP, so keep the phone in hand
Town and city land sits in Urban TamilNilam and village land in rural TamilNilam — pick the right one or the search returns nothing
documents: District, taluk and village name of the land
Survey number and sub-division number, or the patta number
Aadhaar card, for a transfer of registry or a sub-division request
Registered sale deed, for a transfer after a purchase
Death certificate and legal heir certificate, for a transfer after a death
Encumbrance certificate for the plot, which the taluk office usually asks to see

demoFields.label: Area type — rural or urban
demoFields.hint: Village land goes to rural TamilNilam, land inside a town or corporation goes to Urban TamilNilam. Choosing wrong is the commonest reason a search fails.

demoFields.label: District
demoFields.hint: Pick from the list. Use the district as it stands today — several Tamil Nadu districts have been split.

demoFields.label: Taluk
demoFields.hint: The taluk the land falls in, not the one you live in.

demoFields.label: Village
demoFields.hint: Revenue village name as written in the record, which can differ from the post office name.

demoFields.label: Search by
demoFields.hint: Survey number or patta number. The survey number gives the cleanest result; a patta number pulls every plot under that patta.

demoFields.label: Survey Number
demoFields.hint: Copy it from the sale deed or an older patta, exactly as printed.

demoFields.label: Sub-Division Number
demoFields.hint: The part after the survey number. Leave it out and the site asks you to choose from the list it shows.

demoFields.label: Patta Number
demoFields.hint: Needed if you search by patta instead of survey number. It is printed at the top of any earlier patta copy.

demoFields.label: Name of the Pattadar as recorded
demoFields.value: Murugesan Thangavel, son of Thangavel Pandian
demoFields.hint: Check the name that comes up against your own papers. Revenue spelling often differs from Aadhaar — note the difference and get it corrected.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number (for a transfer of registry)
demoFields.hint: The OTP, the application number and the hearing notice from the taluk office all come here.

demoSteps: Open eservices.tn.gov.in, choose the patta and chitta view, and say whether the land is rural or urban.
Pick district, taluk and village, then search by survey number or patta number and read the extract on screen. It is free and needs no login.
Check the extent, the holder's name and the classification of the land against your deed. Note anything that does not match.
Use the verification option on the same site to confirm a patta someone has shown you — enter the reference number printed on it and see whether the record answers.
If a sale or a death has not been entered, apply for the transfer of registry with the registered deed or the legal heir certificate, online or at the taluk office or an e-Sevai centre.
Track the application at eservices.tn.gov.in/eservicesnew/login/Appstatus.html. The Village Administrative Officer and the Tahsildar verify it and may call a hearing.
Keep a current patta and chitta with your papers — crop loans, PM-Kisan, farm subsidies and any sale all start by asking for them.
schemes.helpline: Your Taluk Office (Tahsildar), or the Village Administrative Officer of your revenue village

schemes.title: TNPSC — One Time Registration and Group Examinations
schemes.department: Tamil Nadu Public Service Commission
schemes.brief: Every Tamil Nadu government job filled through the Public Service Commission — Group I, Group II and IIA, Group IV and VAO, engineering and statistical services — is applied for through one account called the One Time Registration. The OTR costs Rs 150, stays valid for five years, and must exist before you can apply to any notification. No certificates are uploaded at the registration stage; they are checked much later, at certificate verification.
schemes.benefit: One account for every TNPSC recruitment, Rs 150 and valid five years
eligibility: Minimum age 18 for most posts; the upper age limit changes with the post and the community, so read the notification
The educational qualification is fixed per post — SSLC or higher for Group IV, a degree for Group I and Group II
Ability to read and write Tamil is required for most posts
One person may hold only one One Time Registration; a second one gets the candidate debarred
The registration must be renewed after five years, or the account stops accepting applications
documents: SSLC certificate, which is the proof of date of birth TNPSC accepts
Degree or diploma certificates for the post applied to
Community certificate, for a candidate claiming SC, ST, MBC, BC or BCM
Aadhaar card
Recent passport-size photograph and signature, scanned in the size the site asks for
A working email address and mobile number, both verified by OTP
Certificate of physical disability or ex-serviceman papers, if a reserved category is claimed

demoFields.label: Name of the Candidate (as in SSLC)
demoFields.hint: Exactly as printed on the SSLC certificate, not as on Aadhaar. A mismatch is caught at certificate verification and costs the job.

demoFields.label: Father's Name
demoFields.hint: As on the SSLC certificate.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth
demoFields.hint: As on the SSLC certificate. The age limit for the post is counted from this date.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. It is used to make sure one person does not hold two registrations.

demoFields.label: Community
demoFields.hint: Pick the community entered on your community certificate. Fee concession and the age relaxation both follow this.

demoFields.label: Educational Qualification
demoFields.hint: Enter the highest qualification you have already completed. A degree you are still studying for cannot be claimed.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: Verified by OTP at registration. Every notification alert and hall ticket message comes here.

demoFields.label: Email Address
demoFields.hint: Also OTP verified. The TNPSC registration number is sent here — keep this address alive for five years.

demoFields.label: Photograph and Signature upload
demoFields.value: Photo 200 KB JPG, signature 200 KB JPG
demoFields.hint: Recent photo against a plain background, signature in black ink on white paper. A rejected photo blocks the whole application.

demoFields.label: District of Residence / Examination Centre preference
demoFields.hint: Choose a centre you can reach on the exam morning. It cannot be changed after the application closes.

demoSteps: Open tnpsc.gov.in and create the One Time Registration, verifying the email and mobile by OTP. The live registration module runs on apply.tnpscexams.in, reached from the homepage.
Fill in the personal, community and educational details, upload the photograph and signature, and pay the Rs 150 registration fee. No certificates are uploaded at this stage.
Note the TNPSC registration number and password. The registration lasts five years and is used for every application after this.
When a notification you qualify for opens, log in to the dashboard, apply against it, and pay the examination fee or claim the exemption your community allows.
Download the hall ticket about ten days before the exam from tnpsc.gov.in/english/viewhallticket.aspx and carry it with a photo ID.

Answer keys and results come to the same dashboard. Candidates who clear the written stage are called for certificate verification, where the SSLC, degree and community certificates are checked in original.
Keep the registration up to date — an address, qualification or community change must be entered in the OTR before the next application, and the whole registration must be renewed at five years.
schemes.helpline: The TNPSC office in Chennai, through the query and grievance link on the TNPSC website

schemes.title: Encumbrance Certificate and Document Registration — TNREGINET
schemes.department: Registration Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
schemes.brief: The encumbrance certificate lists every sale, mortgage and court attachment recorded against a property for the years you ask about. It is the paper every bank asks for before a home loan and every buyer should read before paying. Tamil Nadu issues it free online on TNREGINET, which is also where a first sale of a plot or flat can be registered without going to the sub-registrar's office, where stamp duty is paid, and where a marriage is registered.
schemes.benefit: Free online encumbrance certificate, plus online document and marriage registration
eligibility: Property situated in Tamil Nadu and registered with a sub-registrar office in the state
Anyone may search and take an encumbrance certificate; you need not be the owner
The certificate covers only the period you ask for, so give a range long enough for the bank
Online presenceless registration is open for a first sale of a plot or flat and for a deposit of title deeds
Registration and marriage registration need a citizen account with mobile or email verification and Aadhaar eKYC
documents: Survey number and sub-division number of the property
Village and sub-registrar office the property falls under
Patta or the earlier sale deed, to copy those details from
Aadhaar card, for registering an account or for eKYC
Mobile number and email for the account and the OTP
Earlier document number, if you are tracing a particular deed

demoFields.label: Zone
demoFields.hint: The registration zone the property falls in. The site narrows the next lists from this.

demoFields.label: District
demoFields.hint: District as it stands today, which may differ from the district named on an old deed.

demoFields.label: Sub Registrar Office
demoFields.hint: The office where documents for that village are registered. If unsure, check the office named on the last sale deed.

demoFields.label: EC Start Date
demoFields.hint: Go back far enough. Banks usually ask for thirteen or thirty years, so start well before you think you need to.

demoFields.label: EC End Date
demoFields.hint: Today's date, so that the certificate shows anything registered right up to now.

demoFields.label: Village
demoFields.hint: Revenue village of the property, spelt as the registration record has it.

demoFields.label: Survey Number
demoFields.hint: Copy from the patta or the sale deed, exactly as printed.

demoFields.label: Sub-Division Number
demoFields.hint: The part number after the survey number. Leave it blank and the search returns every plot in that survey number.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name and Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: For your own reference and for the OTP. You do not have to be the owner to take an encumbrance certificate.

demoSteps: Open tnreginet.gov.in and register a citizen account with your mobile number and email, verified by OTP. Searching an encumbrance certificate is free.
Under e-Services choose the encumbrance certificate search, then pick zone, district and sub-registrar office.
Enter the village, survey number and sub-division number, and the start and end dates of the period you want, then run the search.
Read every entry that comes up — sales, mortgages, attachments. A blank result means nothing was registered in that period, which is itself worth printing.
Download the certificate and keep it. A bank will usually want it to run right up to the current date, so take a fresh one when the loan is filed.
For a first sale of a plot or flat, use presenceless registration on the same portal, pay stamp duty and fees online, and track the document by its status number.
If a search will not run or an entry looks wrong, call 1800 102 5174 or ask at the sub-registrar office named above.
schemes.helpline: 1800 102 5174 — TNREGINET helpline

schemes.title: Smart Family Card — Tamil Nadu Ration Card
schemes.department: Department of Food and Consumer Protection (Civil Supplies), Government of Tamil Nadu
schemes.brief: Tamil Nadu has replaced the old paper ration card with a QR-coded Smart Family Card, applied for on the TNPDS portal. It is the card you draw rations against at the fair price shop, and it is also the number the state asks for in other schemes, including the Rs 1,000 a month women's assistance. The same portal is used to add or remove a member, change the address or card type, and re-print a lost card.
schemes.benefit: QR-coded Smart Family Card for the household, with monthly rations at the fair price shop
eligibility: Family living in Tamil Nadu and not holding a ration card in any other state or district
One card per family, made in the name of the head of the family
The head of the family needs an Aadhaar with a working mobile linked to it, because every step is confirmed by OTP
A family moving in from another state must first surrender the old card there and bring the surrender certificate
Choose the card type honestly — rice card, sugar card or no-commodity card. The type decides what you can draw
documents: Aadhaar cards of every member of the family
Mobile number linked to the head of the family's Aadhaar, for the OTP
Address proof — electricity bill, property tax receipt, rent agreement or gas connection book
Passport-size photograph of the head of the family
Surrender certificate from the earlier ration card, if the family held one
LPG gas connection number and the name of the agency, which the form asks for
schemes.portalName: TNPDS — Tamil Nadu Smart Ration Card portal

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The whole application opens on an OTP to this number, so use the mobile linked to the head of the family's Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Name of the Head of the Family
demoFields.hint: Letter for letter as on Aadhaar. The card prints in this name and other schemes are matched against it.

demoFields.label: Father's / Husband's Name
demoFields.hint: As written on Aadhaar. Do not use initials if the Aadhaar spells the name in full.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth
demoFields.hint: As on Aadhaar. The head of the family must be 18 or older.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits, of the head of the family. Each member's Aadhaar is entered again further down.

demoFields.label: Residential Address with District and Taluk
demoFields.value: 14/3 Kamarajar Street, Thirumangalam, Madurai district, Madurai taluk — 625706
demoFields.hint: The address where the family actually lives. The ration shop you are attached to is decided from this.

demoFields.label: Type of Card applied for
demoFields.hint: Rice card for rations, sugar card if you do not want rice, no-commodity card if you want the card only as proof.

demoFields.label: Gas Connection Number and Agency
demoFields.hint: Copy it from the gas passbook. Leave blank only if the family truly has no connection.

demoFields.label: Family Member details — name, Aadhaar, relation, age
demoFields.value: Sundaram Karuppaiah / 9999 6620 5513 / husband / 46; Anbarasi Sundaram / 9999 3318 7042 / daughter / 17
demoFields.hint: Add every person who eats from this household. Anyone left out cannot draw rations on the card.

demoFields.label: Bank Account Number and IFSC of the head
demoFields.hint: In the head of the family's own name. Schemes paid against the family card, like the Rs 1,000 women's assistance, send money to this account.

demoSteps: Open tnpds.gov.in, choose the smart card application, and pick Tamil or English before you start. An e-Sevai centre or your ration shop will file the same form for you.
Verify the mobile number by OTP, then fill the head of the family's details and add every member with their Aadhaar.
Upload the address proof and the photograph, and enter the gas connection details, then submit and write down the reference number.
The Taluk Supply Office checks the address, and an official may visit the house. Keep the Aadhaar cards ready for that visit.
Track the reference number on the same portal. An SMS comes to the registered mobile when the card is approved.
Download and print the smart card from the portal, then take it to the fair price shop you have been attached to and start drawing rations.
Later changes — a birth, a death, a marriage or a move — are made on the same login under member addition, deletion or address change.
schemes.helpline: Your Taluk Supply Office, or the fair price shop the family is attached to

schemes.title: e-Sevai citizen services
schemes.department: Tamil Nadu e-Governance Agency, Information Technology Department
schemes.brief: Tamil Nadu's single window for community (jaathi), income, nativity, first graduate, residence and legal heir certificates, along with utility payments and department services. Tamil and English. Everything hangs off a CAN, the Citizen Access Number, which is made once and reused for life. Most people go to the nearest e-Sevai Maiyam, the common service centre found in taluk offices and many villages, and the operator files it for a small fixed fee. The VAO verifies and the Tahsildar signs the certificate digitally.
schemes.benefit: Community, income and nativity certificates, digitally signed
eligibility: Resident of Tamil Nadu, applying in the taluk where you live
A CAN number, which is created free at any e-Sevai centre or on the portal
The household known to the Village Administrative Officer, who does the verification
documents: Aadhaar card
Ration card or smart card
Proof of residence: electricity bill, property tax receipt or house rent agreement
School transfer certificate, which is the usual proof of community and date of birth
Self-declaration on the format the centre provides, signed
Recent passport photograph
For income: salary certificate for the employed, or a declaration for farming and daily-wage households

demoFields.label: CAN number
demoFields.hint: The Citizen Access Number. If you do not have one, the first step is to create it, free, at any e-Sevai centre or on the portal. Keep it for life; you do not need a new one each time.

demoFields.label: Applicant's name
demoFields.hint: As on Aadhaar and the school transfer certificate. The certificate prints in Tamil and English.

demoFields.label: Father's or husband's name
demoFields.hint: For a community certificate this is what the record is traced through, so it must match the school transfer certificate.

demoFields.label: Certificate applied for
demoFields.hint: Community, income, nativity and first graduate are separate applications. Apply for each one you actually need.

demoFields.label: District / Taluk / Village
demoFields.hint: This sends the file to the right VAO and Tahsildar. Choosing the wrong taluk means the application is returned.

demoFields.label: Ration card number
demoFields.hint: From your smart ration card. It is used to confirm the household members.

demoFields.label: Annual family income
demoFields.hint: The household's total for the last year. For an income certificate the VAO checks this before the Tahsildar signs.

demoFields.label: Purpose
demoFields.value: College admission under the community quota
demoFields.hint: Write what it is for. Admission and scholarship are the commonest reasons and the office is used to them.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: The OTP, the application number and the message that your certificate is ready all come here.

demoSteps: Create a CAN number first if you do not already have one. It is free, takes a few minutes at any e-Sevai centre or on the portal, and is used for every service afterwards.
Collect the documents, above all the school transfer certificate, which is what community and date of birth are established from in Tamil Nadu.
Log in to the e-Sevai portal with your CAN and mobile OTP, or take the papers to the nearest e-Sevai Maiyam at the taluk office or in your village.
Choose the department and the service, and fill the form as this sample shows.
Upload the documents, pay the small fixed fee and submit. Keep the acknowledgement receipt with the application number.
The Village Administrative Officer verifies the details, and the Revenue Inspector and Tahsildar act on it in turn.
When it is ready, an SMS comes to your mobile. Download the digitally signed certificate from the portal, or collect the printout from the e-Sevai centre.
Keep a soft copy. Colleges and offices in Tamil Nadu accept the digitally signed certificate as it is, and you can reprint it from your CAN any time.
schemes.helpline: 1100 (Tamil Nadu citizen helpline)

schemes.title: New Electricity Service Connection — TNPDCL
schemes.department: Tamil Nadu Power Distribution Corporation Limited (TNPDCL), the former TANGEDCO distribution wing
schemes.brief: A new electricity connection for a house, a shop, a workshop or a farm pump is applied for online on the NSC Online portal, without going to the section office first. The application is filed, the fee paid and the reference number issued on the site; the section officer then inspects the premises and raises the demand. Distribution has been split out of TANGEDCO into TNPDCL, so the old tangedco.org site now only shows a migration notice.
schemes.benefit: New LT service connection, with online application, fee payment and status tracking
eligibility: Premises inside Tamil Nadu, in the area of a TNPDCL section office
Applicant must own the premises or have the owner's written consent
Connected load up to 150 kW is an LT connection; anything larger is an HT application
House wiring must be finished and tested by a licensed wiring contractor before the inspection
There must be no unpaid electricity dues standing against the same premises
documents: Proof of ownership — patta, registered sale deed or the latest property tax receipt
Owner's written consent and the rent agreement, if you are a tenant
Aadhaar card or another photo ID of the applicant
Wiring completion and test report from a licensed wiring contractor
Approved building plan, for a new building
Passport-size photograph of the applicant
The service connection number of a neighbouring service, which helps the section office locate the premises
schemes.portalName: NSC Online — TNPDCL new service connection portal

demoFields.label: District / Circle / Section Office
demoFields.hint: The section office that covers the street where the meter is to be fixed, not where you live now.

demoFields.label: Type of Service Connection
demoFields.hint: Domestic for a house, commercial for a shop, industrial for a workshop, agricultural for a pump set. The tariff follows this choice.

demoFields.label: Name of the Applicant
demoFields.hint: The name that will stand on the electricity bill. Keep it the same as on the ownership document to avoid a name-transfer later.

demoFields.label: Address of the Premises
demoFields.value: New Door 27, Ganapathy Nagar 2nd Street, Saravanampatti, Coimbatore — 641035
demoFields.hint: The full door number and street of the building needing supply. The inspecting officer comes to this address.

demoFields.label: Connected Load in kW
demoFields.hint: Add up the fans, lights, pump, fridge and heater you will run. Declaring too little means a penalty and a load enhancement later.

demoFields.label: Ownership Document details
demoFields.value: Patta 1176, Survey 142/3B, Coimbatore Corporation property tax assessment 27-0045-2210
demoFields.hint: Give the document you are uploading — patta, sale deed or tax receipt — with its number.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. The service connection can also be Aadhaar-seeded later from the TNPDCL online services page.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The Application Reference Number, the inspection visit and the demand notice all come here by SMS.

demoFields.label: Email Address
demoFields.hint: The copy of the application and the payment receipt are emailed here.

demoFields.label: Application Reference Number (issued after submission)
demoFields.hint: Write it down. It is also your username on the payment portal, with the registered mobile number as the password.

demoSteps: Get the wiring finished and the contractor's test report ready first — the connection is held up at inspection without it.
Open app1.tangedco.org/nsconline, register with your mobile number and email, and fill the application, choosing the correct district, circle and section.
Upload the ownership proof, the ID proof and the wiring test report, pay the registration fee online, and save the Application Reference Number.
The section officer inspects the premises, usually within a few days, and then raises the demand for the deposit and service charges.
Pay the demand on the consumer portal at www.tnebnet.org/awp/login, using the Application Reference Number as the username and the registered mobile number as the password.
The meter is fixed and supply given after the payment clears, and you receive the service connection number — keep it, every future bill and complaint runs on it.
Pay bills afterwards through the same consumer portal, or without logging in through Quick Pay at www.tnebnet.org/qwp/qpay.
schemes.helpline: Your TNPDCL section office; if it does not act, file a Consumer Grievance Redressal Forum petition at https://www.tnebltd.gov.in/cgrfonline/

schemes.title: Bhu Bharati — Telangana Land Records and Mutation
schemes.department: Revenue Department, Government of Telangana
schemes.brief: Bhu Bharati is where a Telangana farmer sees the Record of Rights and the Pahani for their land, and applies for a mutation when land is sold or inherited. It replaces the older Dharani system under the Record of Rights Act, 2025, and all agricultural land services now run through it.
schemes.benefit: Record of Rights and Pahani online, with mutation, correction and pattadar passbook services
eligibility: Agricultural land situated in Telangana and recorded in the Record of Rights
The applicant must be the recorded pattadar, or a legal heir, to apply for a mutation
Aadhaar linked to a working mobile, since every application is confirmed by OTP
