Anyone may view a Record of Rights; only the holder can change one
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant
Existing pattadar passbook
Registered sale deed, for a mutation on sale
Death certificate and legal heir certificate, for a mutation on succession
Survey number and khata number of the land
Passport photograph

demoFields.label: Service wanted
demoFields.hint: View Record of Rights, mutation on sale (Form V), mutation on succession (Form VI), correction, or pattadar passbook. Pick the one that fits what happened to the land.

demoFields.label: District / Mandal / Village
demoFields.hint: Pick all three from the lists. The record is held village by village.

demoFields.label: Survey Number
demoFields.hint: Copy it exactly from the pattadar passbook or an old Pahani, including any letter at the end.

demoFields.label: Khata / Pattadar Account Number
demoFields.hint: Covers all your survey numbers in that one village, so it is the quicker way in if you hold several plots.

demoFields.label: Pattadar Name as on the record
demoFields.hint: Spelt as on the land record, which may not match Aadhaar. Search by the record's spelling first, then ask for a correction if it is wrong.

demoFields.label: Applicant's Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits, of the person applying. The OTP goes to the mobile linked to it.

demoFields.label: Relation to the recorded holder
demoFields.hint: For a succession mutation, state the relationship and attach the legal heir certificate and death certificate.

demoFields.label: Extent claimed (acres / guntas)
demoFields.hint: As on the passbook. A figure that does not match the record is the usual reason a mutation is held up.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The application number, the hearing notice and the final order all come here.

demoSteps: Open bhubharati.telangana.gov.in and view the Record of Rights and Pahani for your survey number. Check the extent, the pattadar name and the classification before you apply for anything.
Choose the service you need — Form V for a mutation after a sale, Form VI after a death in the family — and log in with Aadhaar and OTP.
Fill in the survey number, the extent and the parties, and upload the registered sale deed, or the death certificate and legal heir certificate.
Pay the fee online and keep the application number. Where a registration is involved, book the Sub-Registrar slot from the same system.
The Tahsildar examines it, and both sides may be called for a hearing where there is an objection. Attend, with the originals.
Once the order is passed, the Record of Rights is updated and a new pattadar passbook is issued. Download the updated record and check the extent and spelling at once.
Keep the updated Record of Rights with your papers. Rythu Bharosa, crop loans and farm subsidy applications are all matched against it.
schemes.helpline: Your mandal Tahsildar's office

schemes.title: Telangana ePASS — Post-Matric Scholarship and Fee Reimbursement
schemes.department: Social, BC, Tribal and Minority Welfare Departments, Government of Telangana
schemes.brief: Telangana pays the college tuition fee of SC, ST, BC, EBC, minority and disabled students straight to the institution, and a maintenance amount to the student. Both run through ePASS, applied for fresh in the first year and renewed every year after that.
schemes.benefit: Tuition fee reimbursement paid to the college, plus a monthly maintenance allowance
eligibility: Student of Telangana studying an approved course in a recognised institution
SC, ST, BC, EBC, minority or disabled category with a valid caste certificate
Family income within the limit for the category, on a current income certificate
Admitted through the notified counselling; a management-quota seat is usually outside the scheme
Attendance kept up through the year — the sanction is stopped for a student who has left
documents: Aadhaar card of the student
Caste certificate number issued in Telangana
Income certificate number, issued within the last year
Bonafide certificate from the college
Admission or allotment letter from counselling
Bank passbook in the student's own name, Aadhaar-seeded
Class 10 and Class 12 marks memos

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number of the Student
demoFields.hint: The student's own, not a parent's. The maintenance money goes into the Aadhaar-seeded account behind it.

demoFields.label: Student Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Exactly as on Aadhaar. The college record and the bank record must agree or the payment fails.

demoFields.label: Caste Certificate Number
demoFields.hint: The number on your Telangana caste certificate. The portal checks it against the revenue database, so type it, do not guess.

demoFields.label: Income Certificate Number
demoFields.hint: Must have been issued within the last year. An expired income certificate is the single commonest cause of rejection.

demoFields.label: Course, Year and College
demoFields.value: B.Pharmacy, 2nd year, Kakatiya Government College, Warangal
demoFields.hint: Pick the college from the portal's list. If it is not listed, the college has not registered on ePASS and must do so first.

demoFields.label: Admission / Allotment Number
demoFields.hint: From the counselling allotment letter.

demoFields.label: Type of application
demoFields.hint: Fresh for the first year of a course, renewal for every year after. Choosing the wrong one sends the file back.

demoFields.label: Bank Account Number and IFSC
demoFields.hint: In the student's own name and Aadhaar-seeded. A parent's account is why maintenance money bounces.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: Sanction and payment messages come here. Use a number the student keeps through the course.

demoSteps: Get a fresh income certificate and the caste certificate from MeeSeva first. ePASS validates both numbers, so an expired income certificate stops the application dead.
Register on telanganaepass.cgg.gov.in with Aadhaar and mobile, confirm the OTP, and choose Fresh or Renewal for the current year.
Fill in the course, the college from the portal's list and your own Aadhaar-seeded bank account, then upload the bonafide certificate and marks memos.
Submit, note the application number, and take the printout to the college scholarship section — the college must verify and forward it before anything moves.
The welfare department sanctions it; the tuition fee goes to the college and the maintenance to your account by DBT. Track both on the portal.
Apply again every year of the course with a fresh income certificate. Renewal is not automatic, and missing the window costs that year's money.
schemes.helpline: Your college scholarship section, or the district welfare office

schemes.title: TGPSC Recruitment — One Time Registration
schemes.department: Telangana Public Service Commission
schemes.brief: Every Telangana state government post advertised by the Public Service Commission — Group 1, 2, 3 and 4, engineering, lecturer and forest posts — is applied for through one profile called OTR. You build it once, and each notification afterwards takes only minutes. The commission was renamed from TSPSC to TGPSC, and the old addresses now redirect here.
schemes.benefit: One registration for every TGPSC notification, with hall tickets and results in the same place
eligibility: Indian citizen meeting the age limits in the notification, usually 18 to 44 with relaxation for SC, ST, BC and disability
The qualification the notification requires, held on its closing date
Local status in Telangana where the post is reserved for local candidates
One OTR profile per person; a second profile gets both cancelled
documents: Aadhaar card
Class 10 certificate for date of birth
Degree or diploma certificates and marks memos
Caste certificate, for a reserved category
Disability certificate, where claiming that reservation
Study certificates for Classes 4 to 10, to prove local status
Recent passport photograph and a scanned signature

demoFields.label: Candidate Name (as on Class 10 certificate)
demoFields.hint: The Class 10 certificate governs, not Aadhaar, where the two differ. Every later certificate is matched against it.

demoFields.label: Father's Name
demoFields.hint: As on the Class 10 certificate.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth
demoFields.hint: As on the Class 10 certificate. Age limits count from this date and it cannot be changed after the profile is made.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits, used to keep one candidate to one profile.

demoFields.label: Category and sub-category
demoFields.hint: Claim only what you hold a certificate for. Age relaxation and fee concession both follow from this.

demoFields.label: Local Status (district)
demoFields.hint: Decided by where you studied Classes 4 to 10. Many posts are reserved for locals of a zone.

demoFields.label: Educational Qualification
demoFields.hint: Course, university, year of passing and marks. It must be complete on the notification's closing date.

demoFields.label: OTR Number (after registration)
demoFields.hint: Generated once and used for every application afterwards. Write it down.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number and Email
demoFields.hint: Every notification alert and the hall ticket link come here. Do not use a friend's number.

demoSteps: Open otr.tgpsc.gov.in and create the One Time Registration with your name and date of birth exactly as on the Class 10 certificate. This is the part that cannot be freely corrected later.
Fill in education, category, local status and identity, upload the photograph and signature, and confirm the mobile OTP. Note down the OTR number.
When a notification you qualify for is out, open it from tgpsc.gov.in, log in with the OTR number, and apply — the profile fills most of the form.
Pay the application and examination fees online. SC, ST, BC, disabled, ex-servicemen and unemployed candidates are exempt from the examination fee on producing the certificate.
Keep the filled application printout and the payment receipt, and download the hall ticket about a week before the exam from the same login.
Results, answer keys and the selection list appear on the TGPSC site. Certificate verification follows the written stage, where the originals of everything you claimed must be produced.
Keep the OTR profile up to date. A qualification or category that is out of date on the closing date is treated as a false claim and the candidature is cancelled.
schemes.helpline: 040-23542185 — TGPSC helpdesk

schemes.title: Indiramma Indlu — Telangana House Construction Assistance
schemes.department: Housing Department, Government of Telangana
schemes.brief: Telangana pays a poor family to build its own pucca house on its own plot, released in instalments as the construction reaches each stage. Families without any house of their own are chosen at the village level, and the money goes straight into the beneficiary's bank account.
schemes.benefit: House construction assistance paid in stage-wise instalments into the beneficiary's account
eligibility: Family resident in Telangana holding a Food Security Card and owning no pucca house anywhere
The applicant must own the plot, or be allotted government land, in his or her own name
Household within the state's income limit and not a government employee or income-tax payer
One house per family; a family that has taken housing assistance before is not eligible again
Priority for houseless, SC, ST and women-headed families
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant
Food Security Card of the family
Proof of the plot — sale deed, pattadar passbook, or the government allotment order
Property tax receipt or Panchayat record for the plot
Bank passbook in the applicant's own name, Aadhaar-seeded
Passport photograph and a photograph of the vacant plot

demoFields.label: Applicant Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: As on Aadhaar. The sanction and every instalment are issued in this name.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. The status of your application can be checked on the portal with this alone.

demoFields.label: Food Security Card Number
demoFields.hint: From the family's card. The household's eligibility is judged on it.

demoFields.label: District / Mandal / Village or Ward
demoFields.hint: Where the plot is. The village-level list is drawn up here.

demoFields.label: Plot details — survey number and extent
demoFields.value: Survey 88/2, 120 square yards, patta in applicant's name
demoFields.hint: The plot must be in your own name. Assistance is not released for building on someone else's land.

demoFields.label: Do you own a pucca house anywhere?
demoFields.value: No — living in a thatched house
demoFields.hint: Answer truthfully. It is checked against property and municipal records, and a false answer cancels the sanction and recovers the money.

demoFields.label: Annual Family Income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: The household's total for the year. It must be within the state's limit for the scheme.

demoFields.label: Bank Account Number and IFSC
demoFields.hint: In the applicant's own name and Aadhaar-seeded. Every instalment lands here.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: Selection, sanction and each instalment are announced here by SMS.

demoSteps: Check first that the plot is in your own name and that no one in the family owns a pucca house. Both are verified later against records, and a wrong claim ends the case.
Apply on indirammaindlu.telangana.gov.in, or through your Gram Panchayat or municipal ward office during the enrolment drive announced for your village.
Enter your Aadhaar, Food Security Card, plot details and bank account, and upload the plot proof and the photograph of the vacant site.
Keep the application number. Beneficiary status can be checked on the portal by Aadhaar, mobile, application number or Food Security Card number.
The Gram Sabha or ward meeting approves the village list, and the housing officials verify the plot and the family's circumstances.

Once sanctioned, build in stages. Each instalment is released after an officer photographs and certifies that the stage — foundation, walls, roof — is complete, so do not wait for the whole amount up front.
If something goes wrong, use the grievance option on the portal or the helpline, quoting the application number.
schemes.helpline: 1800 599 5991 — Indiramma Indlu helpline

schemes.title: Telangana Income Certificate
schemes.department: Revenue Department, Government of Telangana
schemes.brief: The Tahsildar's certificate stating a family's yearly income, needed for scholarships, fee reimbursement, welfare schemes and EWS claims in Telangana. It is applied for through MeeSeva, either at a MeeSeva centre or online, and it is valid for one year.
schemes.benefit: Income certificate signed digitally by the Tahsildar, valid one year
eligibility: Resident of Telangana, applying in the mandal where the family lives
Applied for by the head of the family, covering the whole household's income
Aadhaar linked to a working mobile number, since every step is confirmed by OTP
A fresh certificate is needed each year; an expired one is refused by every office
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant
Food Security Card of the family
Address proof — electricity bill, property tax receipt or rent agreement
Salary certificate or Form 16, for a salaried applicant
Pahani or ROR extract, where the income is from farming
Passport-size photograph

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Your own twelve digits. The OTP goes to the mobile linked to it, so it must be a number in your hand.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Letter for letter as on Aadhaar. The certificate is printed from this entry.

demoFields.label: Father's / Husband's Name
demoFields.hint: Used to separate families with the same surname in one village.

demoFields.label: District / Mandal / Village or Ward
demoFields.hint: Where the family actually lives. Your mandal Tahsildar signs the certificate, so this decides where the file goes.

demoFields.label: Annual Family Income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: The whole household's earnings for the year from every source. It is cross-checked against land, vehicle and electricity records, so an understated figure gets the file rejected.

demoFields.label: Source of Income
demoFields.value: Farming on two acres and a tailoring shop
demoFields.hint: Name the work of every earning member, not only the head's.

demoFields.label: Caste / Category
demoFields.hint: As on your caste certificate. It is printed on the income certificate and checked against welfare quotas later.

demoFields.label: Food Security Card Number
demoFields.hint: From the front of the card. The office pulls up the rest of the family's details from it.

demoFields.label: Purpose
demoFields.value: ePASS scholarship for my son's B.Tech
demoFields.hint: Say plainly what it is for. It is recorded but does not limit where the certificate can be used.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The application number and the ready-to-download message arrive here by SMS.

demoSteps: Open the MeeSeva portal or walk into any MeeSeva centre and ask for the Income Certificate service. The centre charges only the notified fee, which is printed on the receipt.
Fill the form with names and the village exactly as on Aadhaar and the Food Security Card, and state the household income honestly.
Upload or hand over Aadhaar, the Food Security Card, the address proof and any salary or land proof.
Pay the fee and take the acknowledgement with its application number. The same number comes by SMS and is how you track the file.
The Village Revenue Officer or the mandal staff verify the family, usually within a week, and may call or visit.
The Tahsildar signs it digitally, normally within 7 to 15 days, and you download it from MeeSeva or collect it at the centre. A digitally signed copy needs no further attestation.
If the time passes with nothing happening, quote the application number to the Tahsildar's office, and use the grievance link on the MeeSeva portal.
schemes.helpline: 1100 — Telangana citizen call centre

schemes.title: Aasara Pension — Telangana Social Security Pension
schemes.department: Rural Development Department, Government of Telangana
schemes.brief: Aasara is Telangana's monthly pension for old people, widows, people with disability, beedi workers, single women, weavers, toddy tappers and several other groups. It is sanctioned by the district administration and paid by DBT into the pensioner's own account.
schemes.benefit: Monthly pension, with a higher rate for people with disability
eligibility: Resident of Telangana, in a household that meets the state's income and land limits
Age 57 or above for the old-age pension; no age bar for widow, disability or single-woman pension
Disability of 40 per cent or more, certified by the district medical board, for the Divyangula pension
Death certificate of the husband, for the widow pension
Not drawing any other government pension
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant
Food Security Card of the family
Age proof — Aadhaar, birth certificate or school record
Death certificate of the husband, for a widow pension
Disability certificate showing 40 per cent or more, for a disability pension
Bank or post office passbook in the applicant's own name, Aadhaar-seeded
Two passport-size photographs

demoFields.label: Type of pension applied for
demoFields.hint: Old age, widow, differently abled, beedi worker, single woman, weaver, toddy tapper, AIDS patient or filaria patient. Each has its own conditions and rate.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: As on Aadhaar. A spelling that differs from the bank record is why a sanctioned pension never arrives.

demoFields.label: Husband's / Father's Name
demoFields.hint: Write 'Late' before the name where he has died; for a widow pension it must match the death certificate.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth / Age
demoFields.hint: There is no minimum age for the widow pension. For the old-age pension you must be 57 or above on the date of application.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. Payment and the yearly life check both run on this.

demoFields.label: Food Security Card Number
demoFields.hint: From the family's card. The household's eligibility is checked against it.

demoFields.label: District / Mandal / Village or Ward
demoFields.hint: Where you live. The MPDO or Municipal Commissioner of this mandal sanctions the pension.

demoFields.label: Supporting certificate number
demoFields.hint: The death certificate for a widow pension, or the disability certificate number and percentage for a disability pension.

demoFields.label: Bank Account Number and IFSC
demoFields.hint: In the applicant's own name, not a son's or daughter's, and Aadhaar-seeded.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: Sanction and every month's credit are announced here by SMS.

demoSteps: Collect the papers the pension type needs — the death certificate for a widow pension, the medical board's disability certificate for a disability pension — before starting.
Apply on the Aasara portal, or through your Gram Panchayat or municipal ward office, which files it for you free.
Fill in the details from Aadhaar and the Food Security Card and give a bank account in your own name that is Aadhaar-seeded.
Take the acknowledgement with its application number; every follow-up runs on it.
The Panchayat Secretary or ward staff verify the applicant at home, and the household is checked against the state's income and land limits.
The MPDO or Municipal Commissioner sanctions it, usually within 30 to 60 days, and the money reaches the account by DBT each month.
Do the yearly life certificate when asked, or the pension is stopped. If the application is refused, the reason is shown on the portal and can be corrected and filed again.
schemes.helpline: Your Gram Panchayat or municipal ward office; district Rural Development office for sanction status

schemes.title: Telangana Food Security Card
schemes.department: Civil Supplies Department, Government of Telangana
schemes.brief: Telangana's ration card is called the Food Security Card. It brings subsidised fine rice from the fair price shop and is the household record most state schemes check first. New cards are filed through MeeSeva; the EPDS portal is where you add or remove a member, do the Aadhaar e-KYC and check the status.
schemes.benefit: Subsidised fine rice at the fair price shop, and the household record used across state schemes
eligibility: Family resident in Telangana and not holding a ration card anywhere else in India
Household within the state's limits on land, income, vehicle ownership and government service
A woman of the household aged 18 or above is recorded as the head of the family
Every member's Aadhaar must be seeded and the e-KYC completed, or that member draws no ration
documents: Aadhaar cards of every member of the family
Address proof — electricity bill, house tax receipt or rent agreement
Deletion certificate from the earlier card, where a member or the family has moved
Marriage certificate, for a bride being added
Birth certificate, for a newborn being added
Gas connection number and a bank passbook copy

demoFields.label: Type of application
demoFields.value: Add a member to an existing card
demoFields.hint: New card, add a member, remove a member, split a card or correct a detail. A brand new card is filed at a MeeSeva centre; the rest can be done on EPDS.

demoFields.label: Food Security Card Number
demoFields.hint: From the front of the card. Leave it blank only for a brand new card.

demoFields.label: Head of the Household
demoFields.hint: A woman of the household aged 18 or above. The card is issued in her name.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar of the Head
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. The family's whole entitlement is tracked against this.

demoFields.label: Member to be added, relation and Aadhaar
demoFields.hint: Name as on that person's own Aadhaar, and how she or he is related to the head.

demoFields.label: Reason and supporting certificate
demoFields.value: Marriage on 03-03-2026; deletion certificate from parents' card at Siddipet
demoFields.hint: A bride needs the marriage certificate and the deletion certificate from her parents' card. A newborn needs only the birth certificate.

demoFields.label: District / Mandal / Village or Ward
demoFields.hint: Where the family lives. The fair price shop is allotted from this address and the inspector verifies here.

demoFields.label: Fair Price Shop Number
demoFields.hint: Printed on the card and on the shop's board. It tells the office which shop's register to update.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: Application number and status messages come here.

demoSteps: For a new card, go to a MeeSeva centre with every member's Aadhaar and the address proof; for adding or removing a name, open epds.telangana.gov.in and use the Food Security Card services.
List every member who eats from the same kitchen, each with the exact Aadhaar. The rice is counted per name, so a missing member costs the family every month.
Attach the address proof and, where someone has moved in, the deletion certificate from the previous card — without it the system blocks the addition as a duplicate.
Pay the notified fee at the centre and keep the acknowledgement with its application number.
The Village Revenue Officer or the civil supplies inspector verifies the household at your address.
Once approved, complete the new member's Aadhaar e-KYC on the ePoS machine at your fair price shop. The family's quantity does not increase until this is done.
Check the card and the month's issue on EPDS. If rice was drawn in your name but you did not get it, raise it with the Tahsildar and the Civil Supplies toll free number at once.
schemes.helpline: 1967 — Civil Supplies toll free

schemes.title: Tripura Public Service Commission Recruitment
schemes.department: Tripura Public Service Commission
schemes.brief: The Tripura Public Service Commission recruits for the state civil service and for the gazetted and technical posts of the state departments. Every advertisement is applied for through its online recruitment application system.
schemes.benefit: One online profile for every TPSC advertisement, with admit cards and results
eligibility: Indian citizen who is ordinarily a resident of Tripura for the posts that require it
Age as the advertisement states, usually 18 to 40, with relaxation for SC, ST, OBC and disability
The qualification the advertisement requires, complete on its closing date
Knowledge of Bengali or Kokborok as some advertisements specify
documents: Aadhaar card
Madhyamik (Class 10) certificate for date of birth
Degree certificate and marksheets
Tripura caste or tribe certificate, for a reserved category
Permanent residence certificate of Tripura
Disability or ex-serviceman certificate, where claiming that reservation
Recent passport photograph and a scanned signature

demoFields.label: Advertisement and post applied for
demoFields.value: Advt 09 of 2026 — Tripura Civil Service Grade II
demoFields.hint: One application per advertisement. Read the qualification and age limit there before paying.

demoFields.label: Candidate Name (as on Madhyamik certificate)
demoFields.hint: The Madhyamik certificate governs, not Aadhaar, where the two differ.

demoFields.label: Father's Name
demoFields.hint: As on the Madhyamik certificate.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth
demoFields.hint: As on the Madhyamik certificate. Age limits count from this date.

demoFields.label: Category claimed
demoFields.hint: Claim only what you hold a Tripura certificate for. A certificate from another state is not accepted for the reservation.

demoFields.label: Permanent Residence Certificate number
demoFields.hint: Required for most Tripura state posts. Get it from e-District before the closing date.

demoFields.label: Educational Qualification
demoFields.hint: It must be complete on the advertisement's closing date.

demoFields.label: Examination centre preference
demoFields.hint: Give a choice where the advertisement asks for one.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number and Email
demoFields.hint: The application number, admit card and every notice come here.

demoSteps: Get the permanent residence certificate and the caste or tribe certificate from e-District before the closing date. Most rejections are for want of these.
Register on tpsc.onlinetripura.in with your name and date of birth exactly as on the Madhyamik certificate.
Open the advertisement, apply through the same login, upload the photograph and signature in the sizes stated, and pay the fee.
Print the filled application and keep it with the payment receipt until the recruitment ends.
Download the admit card from the same login and take it with a photo ID.
Results are published on the Commission's site. Document verification is last, where the originals of everything claimed must be produced.
schemes.helpline: Tripura Public Service Commission, Agartala

schemes.title: Tripura e-District — Certificates and Digital Seva
schemes.department: Information Technology Department, Government of Tripura
schemes.brief: Tripura's e-District portal, where income, caste, permanent residence and other certificates are applied for and downloaded, along with a range of departmental services. The same services are available across a counter at a Common Service Centre.
schemes.benefit: Income, caste and permanent residence certificates applied for and downloaded online
eligibility: Resident of Tripura, applying in the sub-division where the family lives
A Scheduled Tribe certificate is issued for the tribes notified for Tripura
A permanent residence certificate needs proof the family has lived in the state for the qualifying period
An income certificate is valid for one year
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant
Ration card of the family
Voter card or electricity bill as residence proof
Father's caste or tribe certificate, for a caste certificate
School certificate or birth certificate for date of birth
Income proof — salary certificate or an affidavit
Passport-size photograph

demoFields.label: Certificate applied for
demoFields.hint: Income, caste, Scheduled Tribe, permanent residence or a departmental service. Each has its own form and proof.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Letter for letter as on Aadhaar. The certificate prints from this entry.

demoFields.label: Father's Name
demoFields.hint: For a tribe certificate this decides the case — tribe is traced through the father's family record.

demoFields.label: Tribe or caste claimed
demoFields.hint: Pick from the list notified for Tripura. A tribe notified in another state does not qualify here.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. Identity is confirmed on this and the OTP goes to the linked mobile.

demoFields.label: District / Sub-division / Village or Ward
demoFields.hint: Where the family lives. The Sub-Divisional Magistrate of this sub-division signs.

demoFields.label: Annual Family Income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: For an income certificate, the household's total for the year from every source.

demoFields.label: Purpose
demoFields.hint: Recorded for the file. It does not restrict where the certificate is used.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The application number and the ready message come here by SMS.

demoSteps: Register on edistrict.tripura.gov.in with your mobile and confirm the OTP, or go to a Common Service Centre, which files it for the notified fee.
Choose the certificate and fill the form from your Aadhaar and ration card.
Upload the documents. For a tribe certificate, the father's certificate is the paper that matters most.
Submit, pay the fee, and note the application number.
The block staff verify the family, then the Sub-Divisional Magistrate signs the certificate.
Download it from the same login and check the tribe name and your father's name at once, because a correction means applying again.
schemes.helpline: Your Sub-Divisional Magistrate's office, or the District Magistrate's office

schemes.title: UP Bhulekh — Khatauni and Khasra Land Records
schemes.department: Board of Revenue, Government of Uttar Pradesh
schemes.brief: UP Bhulekh is where you see and print the khatauni, the record of rights for a piece of land in Uttar Pradesh, and the khasra showing the plot and the crop. It is free and needs no login. Farm schemes, crop loans and mutation applications all ask for the khatauni.
schemes.benefit: Free khatauni and khasra copies, searchable by plot, khata number or owner name
eligibility: Land situated in Uttar Pradesh and entered in the revenue record
Anyone may view and print a record; no login and no fee
A certified copy for court or bank use is issued by the tehsil, not by this portal
Only the recorded holder or an heir can apply to change a record
documents: District, tehsil and village name
Khasra or gata number, or the khata number, or the owner's name
Aadhaar card, if you go on to apply for a mutation at the tehsil
Registered sale deed or succession papers, for a mutation

demoFields.label: District / Tehsil / Village
demoFields.hint: Pick all three from the lists. The record is held village by village.

demoFields.label: Search by
demoFields.hint: Khasra number, khata number, or owner's name. Khasra number gives the cleanest result; searching by name returns every similar name in the village.

demoFields.label: Khasra / Gata Number
demoFields.hint: Copy it from an older khatauni or from the purchase deed.

demoFields.label: Khata Number
demoFields.hint: The account number. It covers every plot you hold in that one village, so it is quicker if you own several.

demoFields.label: Owner's Name as on the record
demoFields.value: Ram Naresh Yadav, son of Sita Ram
demoFields.hint: Spelt as on the land record, which may differ from Aadhaar. Search by the record's spelling first.

demoFields.label: Record wanted
demoFields.hint: Khatauni for the record of rights, khasra for the plot and crop details, real-time khatauni for the current position including pending mutations.

demoFields.label: Captcha
demoFields.hint: The site asks for it on every search. It is the only thing standing between you and the record.

demoSteps: Open upbhulekh.gov.in and choose the record you want — khatauni, khasra or the real-time khatauni.
Select district, tehsil and village, then search by khasra number, khata number or owner's name and enter the captcha.
Check the area, the owner's name and the share against what you know, and print the copy. There is no fee.
For a bank or a court, ask the tehsil for a certified copy — the portal's print is for your own reference and is not stamped.
If the record is wrong, or a sale or a death has not been entered, apply for a mutation at the tehsil with the registered deed or the succession papers. It cannot be corrected from this portal.
Keep a printed khatauni with your papers. PM-Kisan, crop loans and state farm subsidies all ask for it.
schemes.helpline: Your tehsil office, or the Lekhpal of your village

schemes.title: UP Scholarship and fee reimbursement
schemes.department: Social Welfare Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
schemes.brief: Pre-matric scholarships for classes 9 and 10 and post-matric scholarships with fee reimbursement for students above class 10, for SC, ST, OBC, general and minority students of Uttar Pradesh. Hindi and English. The application has two parts: you first register and get a registration number, then fill the full form, then print it and hand a signed copy with the documents to your own institution. Students without a computer at home usually do the whole thing at a Jan Seva Kendra (CSC) or a cyber cafe, which is fine, but the printed copy must still reach the college.
schemes.benefit: Tuition fees reimbursed plus a maintenance allowance
eligibility: Domiciled in Uttar Pradesh, studying in an institution recognised by the state
Family income within the ceiling for the year: commonly Rs.2.5 lakh for SC and ST students and Rs.2 lakh for general, OBC and minority students in post-matric, with a lower ceiling for pre-matric
Caste certificate for SC, ST and OBC applicants, issued through UP e-District
Not drawing another government scholarship for the same course at the same time
Passed the previous class; students repeating a year are not eligible
documents: Aadhaar card, seeded with the student's own bank account
Caste certificate and its application number, from UP e-District
Income certificate and its application number, from UP e-District
Last passed class mark sheet and certificate
High school certificate, which is the accepted proof of date of birth
Institution's fee receipt and its registration number on the scholarship portal
Bank passbook first page in the student's own name

demoFields.label: Registration number
demoFields.hint: Generated the moment you register for the year. Write it down at once; you cannot log in again without it, and it is not sent by post.

demoFields.label: Student's name
demoFields.hint: Exactly as on the high school certificate. The board record is what the portal checks against.

demoFields.label: Father's name
demoFields.hint: Again as on the high school certificate, not as on Aadhaar, if the two differ.

demoFields.label: Caste certificate application number
demoFields.hint: The long application number on the e-District certificate, not the certificate serial. The portal verifies it live, so a wrong digit stops the form.

demoFields.label: Income certificate application number
demoFields.hint: Same idea, from the e-District income certificate. It must be issued in the current session.

demoFields.label: Institute name and code
demoFields.hint: Take the code from your college office. Choosing the wrong college with a similar name sends your form to a place that will never verify it.

demoFields.label: Course and year
demoFields.hint: The class or year you are studying in now, in this session.

demoFields.label: High school roll number and year
demoFields.hint: Used to confirm your date of birth and your last passed class automatically.

demoFields.label: Bank account number
demoFields.hint: Must be the student's own account with the Aadhaar seeded into it. A parent's or a joint account will not receive the money.

demoFields.label: IFSC code
demoFields.hint: From the first page of the passbook. Copy it letter by letter.

demoSteps: Before the window opens, get a fresh caste certificate and income certificate from UP e-District, because the scholarship form asks for their application numbers and checks them live.
Make sure the student's own bank account exists and is Aadhaar-seeded. Ask the bank branch to confirm the seeding.
Register on the UP Scholarship portal for the current session, choosing the right category (pre-matric or post-matric, and fresh or renewal). Note the registration number that appears.
Log in with that registration number and date of birth, and fill the full form as this sample shows.
Upload the documents, submit the form and take a printout of the final application.
Sign the printout, attach photocopies of the documents, and hand it in at your own school or college office. This physical step is compulsory and the form is rejected without it.
Ask the institution to forward and verify your application on their own login, and keep the receipt they give you.
Track the status on the portal with your registration number. If it shows a defect, correct it within the correction window, which is short and does not reopen.
schemes.helpline: 0522-2209270 (Social Welfare Department scholarship helpdesk)

schemes.title: UPSSSC PET and Group C Recruitment

Class 10 passed for the PET itself; each later post sets its own qualification
A PET score is valid for one year, and a fresh PET must be taken after that

Class 10 certificate for date of birth
Class 12 and degree certificates, for the posts that need them
Caste certificate on the UP format, for a reserved category
Domicile certificate of Uttar Pradesh
Disability certificate, where claiming that reservation
Recent passport photograph and a scanned signature

demoFields.label: Father's / Mother's Name

demoFields.label: Date of Birth

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number

demoFields.label: Category and sub-category
demoFields.value: OBC; no disability; not an ex-serviceman
