demoFields.hint: Reserved-category benefits are for UP domiciles only. A candidate from another state competes on the unreserved seats.

demoFields.label: Educational Qualification
demoFields.hint: For the PET itself Class 10 is enough. The post you later apply for sets its own requirement, and it must be complete on that notification's closing date.

demoFields.label: PET Registration / Roll Number
demoFields.hint: Generated when you register. Your PET score is tied to it and every later application asks for it.

demoFields.label: Preferred examination district
demoFields.hint: Give two or three choices. The commission allots the nearest centre it can.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number and Email
demoFields.hint: Admit card and every notification come here. Do not use a cyber cafe's number.

demoSteps: Register on upsssc.gov.in for the Preliminary Eligibility Test when the notification opens, entering your name and date of birth exactly as on the Class 10 certificate.
Fill category, domicile and qualification, upload the photograph and signature, pay the fee online and keep the registration number.
Download the admit card about a week before the exam and sit the PET. The score decides which posts you can go on to apply for.
When the score is published, note it with your registration number. It stays valid for one year.
Apply to individual posts — Lekhpal, VDO, Junior Assistant and the rest — as those notifications open, using the same login and your PET score.
Those posts have a main exam and, for some, a typing or physical test. Certificate verification comes last, where the originals of everything you claimed must be produced.
Take the PET again before your score expires, or you drop out of every Group C recruitment until you do.
schemes.helpline: UPSSSC candidate helpdesk, contact details on upsssc.gov.in

schemes.title: UP Family ID — Ek Parivar Ek Pehchan
schemes.department: Department of Planning, Government of Uttar Pradesh
schemes.brief: A single twelve-digit number for the whole family, meant to become the one record Uttar Pradesh checks before giving any benefit. A family that already has a ration card is given the ration card number as its Family ID; families without one register fresh. It is free and is done online or at a Jan Seva Kendra.
schemes.benefit: One family identity number linked to state welfare schemes and employment records
eligibility: Family living in Uttar Pradesh, with every member's Aadhaar linked to a mobile number
A family holding a ration card already has a Family ID — its ration card number — and need not register again
Only families with no ration card register fresh
One ID per family; a member can appear in only one family
documents: Aadhaar cards of every member of the family
Mobile number linked to the head of the family's Aadhaar
Ration card, if the family holds one
Address proof — electricity bill, house tax receipt or voter ID
Bank passbook of the head of the family

demoFields.label: Do you hold a ration card?
demoFields.hint: If yes, your ration card number is already your Family ID — just search and print it, do not register again.

demoFields.label: Head of the Family (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: The whole registration is made in this person's name, and the OTP goes to the mobile linked to their Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number of the Head
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. Every member is then added against this.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: Must be the number linked to the head's Aadhaar, since each member is verified by OTP.

demoFields.label: Members of the family (name, relation, Aadhaar)
demoFields.value: 1. Ram Naresh Yadav, self, 9999 6231 8074; 2. Sushila Devi, wife, 9999 4408 1123; 3. Anjali Yadav, daughter, 9999 7735 0296
demoFields.hint: Everyone who lives in the household. Each member's Aadhaar is verified by an OTP to their own linked mobile, so keep the family together when you fill this.

demoFields.label: Full Address with district, tehsil and village or ward
demoFields.value: Gram Rampur Kalan, Post Dariyabad, Tehsil Ramsanehighat, District Barabanki, 225414
demoFields.hint: Where the family actually lives. The Lekhpal or the ward staff verify at this address.

demoFields.label: Category (SC / ST / OBC / General)
demoFields.hint: Recorded for scheme eligibility. It changes nothing about whether the ID is issued.

demoFields.label: Bank Account of the Head and IFSC
demoFields.hint: Used to link state benefits later. It should be Aadhaar-seeded.

demoSteps: First search familyid.up.gov.in with your ration card number. If the family holds a ration card, the Family ID already exists — print it and stop there.
If there is no ration card, register the head of the family with Aadhaar and the linked mobile, and confirm the OTP.
Add every member with their Aadhaar. Each one is verified by an OTP sent to that member's own Aadhaar-linked mobile, so have the family present while you do it.
Fill the address, category and bank details, submit, and note the application number.
The Lekhpal or the ward-level officer verifies the household. Be available at the address; an unverified application does not proceed.
Once approved, download and print the Family ID from the same site. Keep it with your papers — state schemes and recruitment forms increasingly ask for it.
schemes.helpline: 1076 — UP Chief Minister's helpline

schemes.title: UP e-District certificates, caste, income and domicile
schemes.department: Revenue Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
schemes.brief: Caste (jati), income (aay) and domicile (nivas) certificates, along with khatauni copies, disability certificates and birth and death records. Hindi and English. A citizen login exists, but in practice most applications go through a Jan Seva Kendra (CSC), because the operator knows the formats the lekhpal expects and the fee is fixed and small. The lekhpal visits or checks the household record, the tehsildar signs it digitally, and you download the certificate; it needs no further attestation.
schemes.benefit: Digitally signed certificate, normally within 15 working days
eligibility: Resident of Uttar Pradesh, applying in the tehsil where you actually live
A mobile number for the OTP, and the household traceable in the lekhpal's records
For a caste certificate, a family record of the caste: the father's certificate, an older relative's certificate, or an affidavit where nothing exists on paper
documents: Aadhaar card
Ration card, or an electricity bill or voter ID as proof of residence
Self-declaration (swaghoshna patra) on the format the portal provides, signed
Recent passport photograph
For a caste certificate: the father's or a close relative's caste certificate, or an affidavit
For an income certificate: salary slip for the employed, or a declaration for farming and daily-wage households

demoFields.label: Applicant's name (Hindi and English)
demoFields.hint: The certificate prints in Hindi, so fill the Hindi box carefully. Type it as it appears on your Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Father's or husband's name
demoFields.hint: Whichever the certificate is to be issued against. For a married woman the husband's name is usual for a domicile certificate.

demoFields.label: Certificate applied for
demoFields.hint: Caste, income and domicile are three separate applications with three separate fees. Apply for each one you need.

demoFields.label: Tehsil and district
demoFields.hint: This decides which lekhpal and tehsildar handle your file. Choosing a tehsil you do not live in guarantees a rejection.

demoFields.label: Full address
demoFields.hint: The address as the lekhpal knows it. Add the village and post office, not just the town.

demoFields.label: Annual family income
demoFields.hint: The whole household's income for the last year, from all sources including farming. State it honestly; the lekhpal checks.

demoFields.label: Purpose
demoFields.value: Scholarship for my son's college admission
demoFields.hint: Say what you need it for. Scholarship applications later ask for this certificate's application number.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. Used to confirm your identity and pull in your name.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: The application number and the download link come here by SMS, so use a number you will keep.

demoSteps: Decide which certificate you need and gather the papers for it. A caste certificate needs some family record of the caste, so ask an elder for the oldest certificate in the house.
Fill in the self-declaration form. Download the format from the portal, write it out, sign it, and photograph it clearly.

Either register on the e-District portal with your mobile number and apply yourself, or take the papers to the nearest Jan Seva Kendra (CSC) and ask the operator to file it. The CSC route costs the notified fee, usually a small fixed amount, and is what most families use.
Fill the application as this sample shows, being careful with the Hindi spelling of names and the tehsil.
Upload the documents, pay the fee and submit. Keep the application number safe; everything afterwards depends on it.
The lekhpal verifies the household and sends a report up to the kanungo and then the tehsildar.
When it is issued, download the digitally signed certificate from the portal with the application number. It is valid as it is and needs no stamp or attestation.
If the deadline passes with no answer, take the application number to the tehsil day (tehsil diwas) or complain on the Jansunwai portal.
schemes.helpline: 0522-2304706 (e-District helpdesk)

schemes.title: UP Samajik Pension — Old Age, Widow and Divyangjan
schemes.department: Social Welfare, Women Welfare and Divyangjan Empowerment Departments, Uttar Pradesh
schemes.brief: Uttar Pradesh runs its three social pensions — old age, destitute women, and Divyangjan or leprosy — through one portal, SSPY. The money reaches the pensioner's own bank account every quarter, and the same site shows whether it has been sanctioned and paid.
schemes.benefit: Rs.1,000 a month, paid quarterly into the pensioner's own bank account
eligibility: Resident of Uttar Pradesh, applying in the district where the applicant lives
Age 60 or above for the old-age pension; no age bar for the widow or Divyangjan pension
Family income up to Rs.46,080 a year in rural areas and Rs.56,460 in urban areas
Disability of 40 per cent or more, certified by the Chief Medical Officer, for the Divyangjan pension
Not drawing any other government pension
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant
Age proof — Aadhaar, birth certificate or school certificate
Income certificate from e-District
Death certificate of the husband, for a widow pension
Disability certificate showing 40 per cent or more, for a Divyangjan pension
Bank passbook in the applicant's own name, Aadhaar-seeded
Recent passport photograph
Caste certificate, where the applicant claims a reserved category

demoFields.label: Type of pension applied for
demoFields.hint: Old age, widow or destitute woman, or Divyangjan and leprosy. Each opens a different form on the portal.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: As on Aadhaar. A spelling that differs from the bank record is why a sanctioned pension never arrives.

demoFields.label: Husband's / Father's Name
demoFields.hint: Write 'Late' before the name where he has died; for the widow pension it must match the death certificate.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth / Age
demoFields.hint: There is no minimum age for the widow pension. For the old-age pension you must be 60 or above on the date of application.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. Payment and the yearly verification both run on this.

demoFields.label: District / Tehsil / Village or Ward
demoFields.hint: Where you live. The District Social Welfare Officer of this district sanctions the pension.

demoFields.label: Annual Family Income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: Must be within Rs.46,080 in rural areas or Rs.56,460 in urban areas. Attach the income certificate you got from e-District.

demoFields.label: Supporting certificate number
demoFields.hint: The death certificate for a widow pension, or the disability certificate number and percentage for a Divyangjan pension.

demoFields.label: Bank Account Number and IFSC
demoFields.hint: In the applicant's own name, not a son's or daughter's, and Aadhaar-seeded. Upload the first page of the passbook.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The registration number and every credit are announced here by SMS.

demoSteps: Get the income certificate from e-District first, and the death or disability certificate if the pension needs one. The application cannot be completed without them.
Open sspy-up.gov.in, choose your pension type and fill the online application, uploading the photograph, the certificates and the passbook page.
Submit and note the registration number. Log in again with it to make any correction before the district office takes the file up.
The application is verified at the block or tehsil level — for the widow pension by the Sub-Divisional Magistrate's office, for Divyangjan by the district disability officer.
Once sanctioned, the pension is credited quarterly to the account. The same portal shows the sanction and each payment against your registration number.
Complete the yearly verification when asked, or the payment stops. If the application is refused, the reason is shown on the portal; fix it and apply again, or take it up on the 1076 helpline.
schemes.helpline: 1076 — UP Chief Minister's helpline

schemes.title: Uttar Pradesh Ration Card
schemes.department: Food and Civil Supplies Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
schemes.brief: The NFSA ration card that brings subsidised wheat and rice from the fair price shop in Uttar Pradesh, in two kinds — Antyodaya for the poorest households and Household for the rest. The FCS portal is where you check the eligibility list, add or remove a member, download the e-ration card and complain if the shop refuses grain.
schemes.benefit: 5 kg foodgrain per person per month; 35 kg per family for an Antyodaya card
eligibility: Family resident in Uttar Pradesh and holding no ration card elsewhere in India
Household inside the state's NFSA list, and not excluded by land, income, vehicle or government service
A woman of the household aged 18 or above is recorded as the head of the family
Every member's Aadhaar must be seeded, or that member's grain is not issued
documents: Aadhaar cards of every member of the family
Address proof — electricity bill, house tax receipt or voter ID
Deletion certificate from the previous card, where a member or the family has moved
Income certificate or a self-declaration of income
Passport photograph of the head of the family
Bank passbook copy and the gas connection number
schemes.portalName: UP Food and Civil Supplies portal

demoFields.label: Type of application
demoFields.hint: New card, add a member, remove a member, or correct a detail. A new card is filed at the tehsil supply office or a Jan Seva Kendra; the rest can be started online.

demoFields.label: Ration Card Number
demoFields.hint: From the front of the card. Leave it blank only for a brand new card.

demoFields.label: Head of the Household
demoFields.hint: A woman of the household aged 18 or above. The card is issued in her name.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar of the Head
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. The family's whole entitlement is tracked against this.

demoFields.label: Member to be added, relation and Aadhaar
demoFields.hint: Name as on that person's Aadhaar, and how they are related to the head. A newborn's Aadhaar must be made first.

demoFields.label: Reason and supporting certificate
demoFields.hint: A newborn needs the birth certificate. A bride needs the marriage certificate and the deletion certificate from her parents' card.

demoFields.label: District / Tehsil / Village or Ward
demoFields.hint: Where the family lives. The fair price shop is allotted from this address.

demoFields.label: Fair Price Shop Name or Code
demoFields.hint: Printed on the card and on the shop's board. It tells the office which register to update.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The application number and the ready message come here by SMS.

demoSteps: Search fcs.up.gov.in first to see whether the family is already on the NFSA eligibility list, and download the e-ration card if it is.
For a new card or a correction, fill the application and hand it in at the tehsil supply office or a Jan Seva Kendra, with Aadhaar for every member and the address proof.

For an addition, attach the birth certificate for a newborn, or the marriage certificate and the deletion certificate from the old card for a bride. Without the deletion certificate the system blocks the addition as a duplicate.
Keep the acknowledgement with its application number; every follow-up runs on it.
The supply inspector verifies the family at the address, usually within two to four weeks.
Once the card is issued or updated, download the e-ration card from the portal and check every name and Aadhaar on it.

Get the new member's Aadhaar seeded at the fair price shop's ePoS machine. Until that is done the family's quantity does not increase. If the shop refuses grain that is due, complain on the same portal and on 1967.
schemes.helpline: 1967 and 1800 1800 150 — UP Food and Civil Supplies

schemes.title: Bhulekh Uttarakhand — Khatauni and Land Records
schemes.department: Revenue Department, Government of Uttarakhand
schemes.brief: Bhulekh Uttarakhand is where a landholder in the state sees and prints the khatauni, the record of rights, and the khasra for a plot. It is free and needs no login. Most rural schemes, crop loans and mutation applications ask for the khatauni.
schemes.benefit: Free khatauni and khasra copies, searchable by plot, khata number or owner name
eligibility: Land situated in Uttarakhand and entered in the revenue record
Anyone may view and print a record; no login and no fee
A certified copy for a bank or a court is issued by the tehsil, not printed from the site
Only the recorded holder or an heir can apply to change a record
documents: District, tehsil and village name
Khasra number, or the khata number, or the owner's name
Aadhaar card, if you go on to file a mutation at the tehsil
Registered sale deed, for a mutation on purchase
Death certificate and succession papers, for a mutation on inheritance

demoFields.label: District / Tehsil / Village
demoFields.hint: Pick all three from the lists. The record is held village by village.

demoFields.label: Search by
demoFields.hint: Khasra number, khata number, or owner's name. Khata covers every plot you hold in that village.

demoFields.label: Khasra Number
demoFields.hint: Copy it from an older khatauni or the purchase deed.

demoFields.label: Khata Number
demoFields.hint: The account number. It is the quicker search if you own several plots in the village.

demoFields.label: Owner's Name as on the record
demoFields.value: Mahendra Singh Negi, son of Bachan Singh
demoFields.hint: Spelt as on the land record, which may differ from Aadhaar. Search the record's spelling first.

demoFields.label: Record wanted
demoFields.hint: Khatauni for the record of rights and the share; khasra for the plot and its details.

demoFields.label: Captcha
demoFields.hint: Asked on every search. It is the only step between you and the record.

demoSteps: Open bhulekh.uk.gov.in and pick district, tehsil and village, then search by khasra number, khata number or owner's name.
Check the area, the owner's name and the share against what you know, and print the copy. There is no fee.
For a bank or a court, ask the tehsil for a certified copy — the print from the site is for your own reference.
If a sale or a death has not been entered, file the mutation at the tehsil with the registered deed or the succession papers. It cannot be done from this site.
After a mutation order, pull a fresh khatauni and check that the name and share are right.
Keep a current khatauni with your papers. PM-Kisan, crop loans and state rural schemes all ask for it.
schemes.helpline: Your tehsil office, or the patwari of your village circle

schemes.title: Apuni Sarkar — Uttarakhand e-Services
schemes.department: Information Technology Development Agency, Government of Uttarakhand
schemes.brief: Apuni Sarkar is Uttarakhand's single window. Income, caste, domicile, character and permanent residence certificates and a long list of departmental services are applied for here, with a delivery time fixed for each under the state's Right to Service Act.
schemes.benefit: Income, caste, domicile and residence certificates with a guaranteed delivery time
eligibility: Resident of Uttarakhand, applying in the tehsil where the family lives
A permanent residence certificate needs proof the family has lived in the state for the qualifying period
A caste certificate needs the caste to be on the Uttarakhand SC, ST or OBC list
An income certificate is valid for one year
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant
Ration card of the family
Family register (parivar register) copy from the panchayat or the nagar nikay
Father's caste certificate or a school record, for a caste certificate
Electricity bill or house tax receipt for the address
Income proof — salary certificate or an affidavit
Passport-size photograph

demoFields.label: Certificate applied for
demoFields.hint: Income, caste, permanent residence, character or a departmental service. Each has its own form, fee and delivery time.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Letter for letter as on Aadhaar. The certificate prints from this entry.

demoFields.label: Father's / Husband's Name
demoFields.hint: Used to identify the family in the parivar register; essential for a caste certificate.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. Identity is confirmed on this and the OTP goes to the linked mobile.

demoFields.label: District / Tehsil / Village or Ward
demoFields.hint: Where the family lives. The Tehsildar of this tehsil signs the certificate.

demoFields.label: Parivar Register entry
demoFields.hint: The family register entry from the panchayat or nagar nikay. Most Uttarakhand certificates are checked against it.

demoFields.label: Years resident in Uttarakhand
demoFields.hint: For the permanent residence certificate. The parivar register and old land or school records are what prove it.

demoFields.label: Annual Family Income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: For an income certificate, the household's total for the year from every source.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The application number and the ready message come here by SMS.

demoSteps: Get a current copy of the parivar register from your panchayat or nagar nikay. Most Uttarakhand certificates are verified against it.
Register on eservices.uk.gov.in with your mobile, or use a Common Service Centre, which files it for the notified fee.
Choose the certificate, fill the form from your Aadhaar and the parivar register, and upload the documents.
Pay the fee and note the application number from the acknowledgement.
The patwari and the tehsil staff verify the family, then the Tehsildar signs the certificate.
Download it from the same login. A digitally signed copy needs no attestation.
Each service has a delivery time under the Right to Service Act. If it passes, the Act gives you an appeal and the application number is what you quote.
schemes.helpline: 1905 — Uttarakhand CM helpline

schemes.title: West Bengal Old Age and Widow Pension
schemes.department: Women and Child Development and Social Welfare Department, West Bengal
schemes.brief: West Bengal pays a monthly pension to old people and to widows through its social security portal, alongside Lakshmir Bhandar. Applications are taken at Duare Sarkar camps and at the block or municipal office, and the money is credited to the pensioner's own bank account.
schemes.benefit: Monthly old-age or widow pension paid into the pensioner's own bank account
eligibility: Resident of West Bengal for at least ten years
Age 60 or above for the old-age pension; a widow of 18 or above for the widow pension
Family income within the state's limit, and the applicant not an income-tax payer
Not drawing any other government pension
Name on the digital ration card of the household
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant
Digital ration card
Age proof — Aadhaar, birth certificate or voter card
Death certificate of the husband, for a widow pension
Bank passbook in the applicant's own name, Aadhaar-seeded
Residence proof of West Bengal
Recent passport photograph
schemes.submitAt: At a Duare Sarkar camp in your area, or at the Block Development Office in a village or the municipality office in a town. The staff there fill in the form for you free.

demoFields.label: Type of pension applied for
demoFields.hint: Old age or widow. Each has its own age condition and its own supporting certificate.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: As on Aadhaar. A spelling that differs from the bank record is why a sanctioned pension never arrives.

demoFields.label: Husband's / Father's Name
demoFields.hint: Write 'Late' before the name where he has died; for a widow pension it must match the death certificate.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth / Age
demoFields.hint: For the old-age pension you must be 60 or above. For the widow pension 18 or above is enough.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. Payment and the yearly verification both run on this.

demoFields.label: Digital Ration Card Number
demoFields.hint: The household's card. Eligibility is checked against it, so the applicant's name must be on it.

demoFields.label: District / Block or Municipality / Village or Ward
demoFields.hint: Where you live. The BDO or the municipal office here processes the file.

demoFields.label: Death certificate number (widow pension)
demoFields.hint: From the death certificate of the husband. Leave it blank for the old-age pension.

demoFields.label: Bank Account Number and IFSC
demoFields.hint: In the applicant's own name, not a son's or daughter's, and Aadhaar-seeded.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The application number and every credit are announced here by SMS.

demoSteps: Collect the age proof, or the husband's death certificate for a widow pension, and a passbook in your own name before you start.
Apply at the next Duare Sarkar camp in your area, or at the block or municipal office, where the staff fill it in for you free.
Fill in the details from Aadhaar and the digital ration card and give a bank account in your own name that is Aadhaar-seeded.
Keep the application number from the acknowledgement; the portal shows the status against it.
The block or municipal office verifies the applicant and the household's income, and may call you in.
Once sanctioned, the pension is credited to the account each month. Check the first credit and tell the block office at once if it does not arrive.
Do the yearly verification when asked, or the payment stops. If it is refused, the reason is shown on the portal and the gap can be fixed and filed again.
schemes.helpline: Your Block Development Office, or the municipal office of your ward

schemes.title: Lakshmir Bhandar monthly assistance for women
schemes.department: Women and Child Development and Social Welfare Department, Government of West Bengal
schemes.brief: A monthly payment to women of West Bengal between 25 and 60, sent by DBT into her own bank account. There is no self-service online application for this one: the form is given out and collected at Duare Sarkar camps, which the state holds in every ward and gram panchayat a few times a year, and at the Block Development Office, the Sub-Divisional Office or the municipality ward office in between camps. The department's site is in Bengali and English and is used for the form, the rules and checking the status afterwards. The amount is higher for Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe women; the state has revised these rates before, so confirm the current figure at the camp.
schemes.benefit: Rs.1,000 a month, and Rs.1,200 for SC and ST women
eligibility: Woman residing in West Bengal, aged 25 to 60
Her name entered on the family's Swasthya Sathi card
Not in regular government, public sector or local body service, and not drawing a government pension
A savings bank account in her own single name, Aadhaar-linked, in her sole holding and not a joint account
Every eligible woman of a household may apply in her own name
Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe women get the higher rate on producing a caste certificate
documents: Swasthya Sathi card, or its enrolment number
Aadhaar card
Caste certificate, for SC and ST applicants claiming the higher amount
Bank passbook first page, in her own single name, self-attested
Recent passport photograph
Proof of age: voter card, birth certificate or school certificate
Mobile number
schemes.submitAt: A Duare Sarkar camp in your own ward or gram panchayat when one is held; otherwise the Block Development Office (BDO) in rural areas, the Sub-Divisional Office (SDO) in a sub-division, or the municipality or corporation ward office in a town.

demoFields.label: Applicant's name
demoFields.hint: Write it in block letters exactly as it appears on the Swasthya Sathi card. A different spelling on the bank passbook is what holds up most payments.

demoFields.label: Swasthya Sathi card number
demoFields.hint: Copy it from the card. If the family has a card but your name is not on it, get your name added first; the application depends on it.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. The same Aadhaar must be linked to the bank account you give below.

demoFields.label: Date of birth and age
demoFields.hint: You must have completed 25 years and not yet crossed 60. Fill it from your voter card or birth certificate.

demoFields.label: Caste category
demoFields.hint: General, SC or ST. If you write SC or ST, attach the caste certificate, because that is what gets you the higher monthly amount.

demoFields.label: Full address
demoFields.value: Vill. Rajarampur, P.O. Haripal, P.S. Haripal, Hooghly, 712405
demoFields.hint: Give village, post office, police station, district and PIN. The camp is organised by ward or panchayat, so this decides where your file sits.

demoFields.label: Bank account number
demoFields.hint: It must be a savings account in your own single name. A joint account, or your husband's account, cannot be used.

demoFields.label: IFSC code
demoFields.hint: Eleven characters from the first page of your passbook, next to the branch name.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: The payment messages come here. Give your own number if you have one.

demoSteps: Find out when the next Duare Sarkar camp is being held in your ward or gram panchayat. It is announced locally by the panchayat, the ward office and the ASHA and anganwadi workers. If no camp is due, you can go straight to the Block Development Office or the municipality ward office instead.
Check first that your name is on the family's Swasthya Sathi card. If it is not, get it added, because the application rests on that card.
Open a savings account in your own single name if you do not have one, and get your Aadhaar linked to it. It cannot be a joint account.
Collect the Lakshmir Bhandar form at the camp or the office, or download and print it from the department's site before you go.

Fill the form in block letters as this sample shows, and attach self-attested copies of the Swasthya Sathi card, Aadhaar, bank passbook first page, caste certificate if you are SC or ST, and a photograph.
Hand it in at the camp counter or the office and insist on the acknowledgement slip. It carries your application number, which is the only way to follow the file afterwards.
Check the status with that number at the next camp, at the BDO office, or on the department's site.

Once it is sanctioned, the money comes into your account every month. If it stops, the usual reason is that the bank account or the Aadhaar link has become inactive, so check that first at your branch.
schemes.helpline: Ask at the Duare Sarkar camp or the Block Development Office; the acknowledgement slip carries the helpdesk number for your district

schemes.title: Banglarbhumi — West Bengal Land Records and Mutation
schemes.department: Land and Land Reforms Department, Government of West Bengal
schemes.brief: Banglarbhumi is where a West Bengal landholder sees the khatian, the record of rights, and the plot information, and applies online for a mutation after a purchase or a death in the family. Land conversion and the plot map are on the same site.
schemes.benefit: Khatian and plot records online, with mutation, inheritance and conversion applications
eligibility: Land situated in West Bengal and entered in the record of rights
Anyone may view a khatian or plot record; only the holder or an heir can apply to change one
A mutation on sale needs the registered deed; one on inheritance needs the death certificate and heirship papers
Mobile number and email, since the application is tracked against them
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant
Registered sale deed, for a mutation on purchase
Death certificate and legal heir certificate, for a warishan mutation
Existing khatian or parcha
Latest land revenue receipt
Passport-size photograph

demoFields.label: Service wanted
demoFields.hint: Know your property, mutation application, warishan mutation, conversion, or plot map. Pick the one that matches what happened to the land.

demoFields.label: District / Block / Mouza
demoFields.hint: Pick all three from the lists. The record is held mouza by mouza.

demoFields.label: Khatian Number
demoFields.hint: From the parcha or an older khatian. It covers every plot you hold in that mouza.

demoFields.label: Plot (Dag) Number
demoFields.hint: Copy it exactly from the deed or the parcha. A wrong dag number pulls up somebody else's land.

demoFields.label: Recorded Owner's Name
demoFields.hint: Spelt as on the land record, which may differ from Aadhaar. Search the record's spelling first.

demoFields.label: Applicant's relation to the recorded owner
demoFields.value: Daughter of the deceased recorded owner
demoFields.hint: For a warishan mutation, say the relationship and attach the death certificate and the heirship papers.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number of the applicant
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits, of the person applying. It identifies you on the application.

demoFields.label: Area claimed (in decimal or bigha)
demoFields.hint: As on the khatian. A figure that does not match the record is the usual reason a mutation is held up.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number and Email
demoFields.hint: The case number, the hearing notice and the final order all come here.

demoSteps: Open banglarbhumi.gov.in and use 'Know your property' to see the khatian and plot details first. Check the area, the owner's name and the share before applying for anything.
Register on the portal with your mobile and email, then choose the mutation type — an ordinary mutation after a purchase, or a warishan mutation after a death.
Fill in the mouza, khatian and dag numbers and upload the registered deed, or the death certificate and heirship papers, along with the last revenue receipt.
Pay the fee online and note the case number. The portal shows the status against it.
The BL&LRO calls a hearing. Attend with the originals; where somebody objects, both sides are heard before the order.
Once the order is passed, the record of rights is updated and you can download the new khatian. Check the name spelling and the area at once.
Keep the updated khatian with your papers. Crop loans, Krishak Bandhu and land sale all turn on it.
schemes.helpline: 1800 121 0022 — Banglarbhumi helpline

schemes.title: OASIS — West Bengal SC, ST and OBC Scholarship
schemes.department: Backward Classes Welfare Department, Government of West Bengal
schemes.brief: OASIS pays the pre-matric and post-matric scholarships for SC, ST and OBC students of West Bengal. The money goes straight into the student's own bank account by DBT. It is applied for fresh in the first year and renewed every year after.
schemes.benefit: Pre-matric and post-matric scholarship paid by DBT into the student's account
eligibility: Student domiciled in West Bengal and studying in a recognised institution in the state
SC, ST or OBC by a West Bengal caste certificate
Family income within the limit for the category, on a current income certificate
Passed the previous examination; a student who has failed and is repeating the year is not eligible
Not drawing another scholarship for the same course
documents: Aadhaar card of the student
West Bengal caste certificate
Income certificate issued within the last year
Previous year's marksheet
Admission receipt or bonafide certificate from the institution
Bank passbook in the student's own name, Aadhaar-seeded
Passport-size photograph and a scanned signature

demoFields.label: Type of application
demoFields.hint: Fresh for the first year of a course, renewal for every year after. Pre-matric is for Classes 9 and 10, post-matric from Class 11 upwards.

demoFields.label: Student Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Exactly as on Aadhaar. The institution record and the bank record must agree or the DBT fails.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: The student's own, twelve digits. The scholarship is paid into the Aadhaar-seeded account behind it.

demoFields.label: Caste Certificate Number
demoFields.hint: A West Bengal certificate. One issued by another state is not accepted here.

demoFields.label: Income Certificate Number
demoFields.hint: Must have been issued within the last year. An expired one is the commonest reason an application is rejected.

demoFields.label: Institution and Course
demoFields.value: Jhargram Raj College — B.Sc. Physics, 2nd year
demoFields.hint: Pick the institution from the portal's list. If it is not listed, the institution has not registered on OASIS and must do so first.

demoFields.label: Previous examination marks
demoFields.hint: From the marksheet you upload. A student repeating a failed year is not eligible.

demoFields.label: Bank Account Number and IFSC
demoFields.hint: In the student's own name and Aadhaar-seeded. A parent's account is the usual reason the money bounces.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The application number and the payment message come here.

demoSteps: Get a fresh income certificate and the West Bengal caste certificate from e-District first. OASIS checks both, and an expired income certificate stops the application.
Register on oasis.wb.gov.in with your Aadhaar and mobile, and note the application ID the portal gives you.
Fill the form, choose your institution and course from the list, and upload the caste and income certificates, the marksheet, the photograph and the signature.
Give a bank account in your own name that is Aadhaar-seeded, then submit and print the application.
Take the printout to the institution — it has to verify and forward it, and nothing moves until it does.
The department sanctions it and the money arrives by DBT. Track both the sanction and the payment on the portal with your application ID.
Apply again every year with a fresh income certificate. Renewal is not automatic and missing the window costs that year's money.
schemes.helpline: 1800 120 2130 — OASIS helpdesk

schemes.title: WBPSC Recruitment — WBCS, Clerkship and Miscellaneous Services
schemes.department: Public Service Commission, West Bengal
schemes.brief: The West Bengal Public Service Commission recruits for the state civil service, the Miscellaneous Services, the Clerkship and the technical services. Notices go up on the Commission's own site and applications are filed on its online system, uCanApply.
schemes.benefit: Applications to every WBPSC examination, with admit cards and results in one place
eligibility: Indian citizen, ordinarily a resident of West Bengal for the posts that require it
Age as the notification states, usually 21 to 36 for WBCS, with relaxation for SC, ST, OBC and disability
A degree from a recognised university, held on the closing date, for WBCS and most posts
Ability to read, write and speak Bengali or Nepali, which WBCS requires
Each notification sets its own conditions; read that one before you pay
documents: Aadhaar card
Madhyamik (Class 10) certificate for date of birth
Degree certificate and marksheets
West Bengal caste certificate, for a reserved category
Disability certificate, where claiming that reservation
Residence certificate of West Bengal
Recent passport photograph and a scanned signature

demoFields.label: Examination applied for
demoFields.hint: WBCS, Miscellaneous Services, Clerkship, Audit and Accounts, or a technical post. One application per notification.

demoFields.label: Candidate Name (as on Madhyamik certificate)
demoFields.hint: The Madhyamik certificate governs, not Aadhaar, where the two differ. Everything later is checked against it.

demoFields.label: Father's / Mother's Name
demoFields.hint: As on the Madhyamik certificate.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth
demoFields.hint: As on the Madhyamik certificate. Age limits count from this date and it cannot be changed after registration.

demoFields.label: Category and sub-category
demoFields.value: General; no disability; not an ex-serviceman
demoFields.hint: Claim only what you hold a West Bengal certificate for. Age relaxation and the fee both follow from this.

demoFields.label: Educational Qualification
demoFields.hint: It must be complete on the notification's closing date, not merely expected.

demoFields.label: Knowledge of Bengali or Nepali
demoFields.hint: WBCS requires it. Declare it honestly; it is tested at the personality test stage.

demoFields.label: Optional subject and examination centre
demoFields.hint: The optional matters only for some services. Give two or three centre choices.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number and Email
demoFields.hint: The application number, admit card and every notice come here. Do not use a friend's.

demoSteps: Watch psc.wb.gov.in for the notification and read the age, qualification and conditions before anything else.
Register on wbpsc.ucanapply.com with your name and date of birth exactly as on the Madhyamik certificate, and upload the photograph and signature in the sizes stated.
Fill the application, choose your examination centres, and pay the fee online. SC, ST and disabled candidates of West Bengal are exempt from the fee on producing the certificate.
Print the filled application and the payment receipt and keep them until the recruitment ends.
Download the admit card about a week before each stage and take it with a photo ID.
WBCS runs in three stages — preliminary, main and personality test. Results for each are published on the Commission's site.
At the personality test stage the originals of everything claimed must be produced. A caste or residence certificate not on the West Bengal format is rejected there.
schemes.helpline: WBPSC office, 161-A S.P. Mukherjee Road, Kolkata; helpdesk details on psc.wb.gov.in

schemes.title: West Bengal e-District — Income, Caste and Residence Certificates
schemes.department: Personnel and Administrative Reforms Department, Government of West Bengal
schemes.brief: West Bengal issues its income, SC/ST and OBC caste, residence and EWS certificates through e-District. You apply online or at a Bangla Sahayata Kendra, the block or municipal office verifies, and the signed certificate is downloaded from the same site.
schemes.benefit: Digitally signed income, caste, residence or EWS certificate
eligibility: Resident of West Bengal, applying in the block or municipality where the family lives
For a caste certificate, the caste must be on the West Bengal SC, ST or OBC list
Caste is traced through the father's family, so his certificate or school record is the key paper
An income certificate is valid for one year; a caste certificate does not expire
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant
Digital ration card or voter card as residence proof
Father's caste certificate, or a school record showing the caste
Class 10 admit card or birth certificate for date of birth
Salary certificate or land record, for an income certificate
Passport-size photograph and a scanned signature
Self-declaration on the prescribed format

demoFields.label: Certificate applied for
demoFields.hint: Income, SC/ST caste, OBC, residence or EWS. Each opens its own form and asks for different proof.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Letter for letter as on Aadhaar. The certificate prints from this entry.

demoFields.label: Father's Name
demoFields.hint: For a caste certificate this is the entry that decides the case — the caste is traced through the father's family record.

demoFields.label: Caste claimed
demoFields.hint: Pick from the West Bengal list rather than typing it, and note that OBC-A and OBC-B are separate lists with separate quotas.

demoFields.label: District / Block or Municipality / Village or Ward
demoFields.hint: Where the family actually lives. The BDO or the municipal office here verifies the file.

demoFields.label: Annual Family Income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: For an income certificate, the whole household's earnings for the year. Keep it consistent with any salary or land proof you upload.

demoFields.label: Family caste reference, if any
demoFields.hint: If anyone in the father's family already holds a caste certificate, give its number. It clears the file fastest.

demoFields.label: Digital Ration Card Number
demoFields.hint: Used as proof of residence and to pull up the family's details.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The application number and the ready-to-download message come here by SMS.

demoSteps: Get the father's caste certificate or the school record showing the caste before you start, if you are applying for a caste certificate. Nearly every rejection is for want of that one paper.
Open edistrict.wb.gov.in, register with your mobile, and choose the certificate you need. A Bangla Sahayata Kendra will file it for you free if you cannot.
Fill the form and upload Aadhaar, the ration or voter card, the caste or income proof, the photograph and the signature.
Submit and note the application number from the acknowledgement.
The block or municipal staff verify the family and may call you in with the originals. For a caste certificate the file goes on to the SDO.
The signed certificate is issued and downloaded from the same login. Check the caste spelling and your father's name at once — correcting them later means applying again.
If it is refused, the order says why. Fix the gap and file again, or appeal to the District Magistrate's office.
schemes.helpline: 1800 345 0111 — West Bengal e-District helpdesk

schemes.title: West Bengal Digital Ration Card — Khadya Sathi
schemes.department: Department of Food and Supplies, Government of West Bengal
schemes.brief: West Bengal's ration card is the digital ration card, issued under Khadya Sathi and the National Food Security Act. The RCMS portal is where you apply for a new card, add or remove a member, correct a detail, get a duplicate, and seed Aadhaar and a mobile number to the card.
schemes.benefit: Digital ration card giving subsidised foodgrain at the ration shop
eligibility: Family resident in West Bengal and holding no ration card elsewhere in India
Category decided by the state — AAY, PHH, SPHH or RKSY — from the household's circumstances
Every member's Aadhaar must be seeded to the card, or that member's grain is not issued
A member moving in from another district or state must bring a deletion certificate
documents: Aadhaar cards of every member of the family
Address proof — electricity bill, voter card or municipal tax receipt
Deletion certificate from the earlier card, where a member has moved in
Birth certificate, for a newborn being added
Marriage certificate, for a bride being added
Mobile number to be linked to the card
Passport-size photograph of the head of the family

demoFields.label: Form / service wanted
demoFields.hint: Form 3 for a new card, Form 4 to add a name, Form 5 to correct one, Form 6 for a duplicate, Form 7 to surrender. Pick the right one or the file is returned.

demoFields.label: Existing Ration Card Number
demoFields.hint: From the front of the digital ration card. Leave it blank only for a brand new card.

demoFields.label: Head of the Family
demoFields.hint: As printed first on the existing card. The application is made in this person's name.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar of the Head
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. The family's entitlement is tracked against this.

demoFields.label: Member to be added, relation and Aadhaar
demoFields.hint: Name as on that person's own Aadhaar, and the relation to the head of the family.

demoFields.label: Reason and supporting certificate
demoFields.value: Marriage on 21-02-2026; deletion certificate from parents' card at Ranaghat
demoFields.hint: A bride needs the marriage certificate and the deletion certificate from her parents' card. A newborn needs only the birth certificate.

demoFields.label: District / Block or Municipality / Village or Ward
demoFields.hint: Where the family lives. The ration shop is allotted from this address.

demoFields.label: Ration shop (FPS) code
demoFields.hint: Printed on the card and on the shop's board. It tells the office which register to update.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number to be linked
demoFields.hint: Linking a mobile is what lets you check the card and each month's issue by SMS.

demoSteps: Open the RCMS portal, or go to a Bangla Sahayata Kendra or your ration shop, and choose the form for what you need — a new card, an addition, a correction or a duplicate.
Fill in every member who eats from the same kitchen, each with the exact Aadhaar. The grain is counted per name, so a missing member costs the family every month.
Attach the address proof and, for a member moving in, the deletion certificate from the old card. Without it the system blocks the addition as a duplicate.
Submit and keep the application number. The same portal shows the status against it.
The inspector verifies the household, and for a new card the family's category — AAY, PHH, SPHH or RKSY — is decided at this stage.
Once approved, download the digital ration card and check every name and Aadhaar on it.
Get the new member's Aadhaar seeded at the ration shop's ePoS machine. The family's quantity does not increase until that is done.
schemes.helpline: 1967 and 1800 345 5505 — West Bengal Food and Supplies
